tei:div.tei:p: blu dag snang ye shes rol pa las: thugs rje chen po dri medapad+ma dkar po'i zhing bkod 'brel tshad sangs rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs rberngo:

rnu: na mo lo kai shwa ra ye: thugs dze+e'od zer bye ba'i rlabs phreng gis: 'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa dbyings su bsal: byams dang snying rje'i zer dngar 'khrungs pa'i: dri med pad+ma dkar por dad brgya'i 'dud: phyogs 'dzin bral ba'i btang snyomasospyan mnga' ba ris med ma gyur 'gro ba yangs la brdal: legs nyes kunagazegs chen gang de yi: zhing dang bkod pa blos dpag gnas min kyang: brgyud pa'ibyin rlabs snying la sim pa dang chengags spyo na las 'atso bzang po'i rten 'brel gyis rmi lam zhing khams rol bar sad: brda tshig gdams pas skad cig dal mi khoms: rang rig ngang las g.yo thabs mi 'dug go: chos brgyad dor ba'i ban spyon 'ur bslangs nga skabs mthar thug bde skyid nyi ma shar gzhi lam 'bras bus rtsal chen rdzogs pa 'di: pha gcigapad+ma 'byung gnas sku drin yin: su ma mgu yang zhing bkod bri par bgyi:ldan sgob bu rnams kyis spro ba bskyed: de yang bskal pa shing khyi'i lo'azla bgitshes bcu kyi nub mo nyams 'od gsal dang 'dren pa'i skabs su snang ba thams cad 'od da

rlu: mtha' dbus dang bral bar brdal de'i ngang du yun gcig tu gnas la byams dang snying rje'i bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'bar ro: de las ldan tshe lho nub phyogs nas 'ja' zer lnga ldan gyi lhug ma bdag gi mdun thad du brkyang ba'i lam la bu chung dkar po g.yu yi zur phud g.yas g.yon du 'phyang ba: lha'i gos dkar po g.yu yi tshom bu can gyi ma sham dang: gser g.yu rat+na mang po spras par dar sngon po'i dpyangs pa 'phur ba dam rtags rdo rje phyed pa dang rat+na'i rtse phran bkra ba: phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon pas gter bum 'dzin cing sha ba la zhon pa: 'ja' dang 'od zer mu med pa 'phro ba de dang: yu mo zhon pa'i bud med dung gi thor btsug phud sogs mdzes pa gnyis byung ste 'di skad zer byung:a ho g.ya' dag nam mkha'i dkyil na: 'ja' zer stong gi dpal 'bar:dri bral 'od dkar zlum 'khyil bde stong spros dang bral ba'i: 'od gsal rig sku mjal ba:ngo mtshar dga'i ba'i gnas so: bsil chab rdzing bu'i khrod na: ngang 'ur tsha gdungs bral song: bya bran nyi ma'i zer gyis: tsha bsregs bzod dka' ya nga: dug gi dga' tshal khrod na: rma bya

sgro mdangs ldan yang: mdangs 'dzin bya byin mang po: dug spyod srog 'gags snying rje: spangs ljong ku mud khrod na: rkang drug sbrang rtsi'i brgyag song: 'phur ldan 'bu phran g.yo lding ge sar sbubs mthum sha tsha: rgya mtsho gting klong ldan pa'i kha khyer gru bo'i nang du: zhugs pa'i bsal yas skye bo: le lo'i ngang la dus 'da' lho phyogs rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i:gru'athor chu la bying song: thar ba'i dus skabs mi yongs: sha tsha snying rje yi mug: de las 'don pa'i mag ngag: ri bo gru 'dzin phyogs na bod kyi bla ma bzhugs yod: dris lan sna tshogs mdzad na blo ldan mang por phan thog: de phyin nus ldan rdo rje ltad mor 'gro dang mi 'gro: sems la yang dog zhog lags: ces zer ba'i lan du bdag gis smras pa ske lha phrug gzhen nu ming sring 'khrul 'khor sgyu ma'i snang ba: zad pa'i dus ni dka' nges: 'on kyang ye sangs rgyas pa'i: chos sku gzhir gnas rig pa cung zad nges par mthong yod gcig shes kun grol zab mo'i sman kyi 'khor ba dong sprugs: nus na ya mtshan skyid pa: de las zab pa'i chos zhig tshol rgyu yod par mi 'dod: rang byung 'ja' lus sbubs gyi

྅ tshogs brgyad srid yul grong gi:cit+ta dpal gya ri bo'i:lnga ldan pho brang dbus na:rang rig pad+ma 'byung gnas:rje 'bangs rigs 'dzin rgya mtshoḥston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer medaḥ'adzad med dam chos sgo 'byed pha phog bu la ster nas:zag med chos kyis tshim yod:bla ma'i thabs chags mi 'dug:de dag thugs la zhog lags:ces smras tshe lha phrug nyid kyis 'gyengs thabs dgye sprug byas nas 'di ltar zer ro:he he mun gling bod kyi khrod na:sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyams dma' sprel tsha rgyud nas blo rgod:mi nag kha nas sgom khyer:gsang sngags bon du khrom bsgrags:sde ba nang 'khrugs phu nu:'thab rtsod khol mo yug spyod:nad mug mtshon gyis skabs thog:'jig rten mi bde mnar ba'i:rgud pa gso ba'i dam bca' byams dang snying rje bral ba'i:gdams bhe ga khong du chud na tshol dgos mi 'dug ha ha:rang snang dag pa'i cho rol pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal ras:sku gsung thugs kyi bkod pa:mjal ba sngon smon dag pa'i:rten 'brel bzang por go byung:dad pa'i 'khor lo rin chen:phyogs med khyab brda' min pa'i

mchog 'dzin tha chad blo tsam:nga rgyal 'dzin pa ma chod:'jigs rten pa dang khyad med:nged tshos bla ma'i gdams ngag de dang cung zad mi 'dra:'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i:gsungs mchog yi ge drug ma:rgyal kun thugs kyi yang snying 'dod dgu'i 'byor ba'i nor bu:sdug bsngal sel ba'i rtsi sman:'brel tshad 'dren pa'i lcags kyu nyon mongs 'joms pa'i tho lum:dus gsum 'byon dka'i gdams pa:yid len khyed la med na zhu bya mang po ma mchis:zer ba'i lan du bdag gi dad dang mos gus kyis ngang nas:e ma:grogs po lha phrug gzhon nu:da ni bdag gi rgyud la sngar las lhag pa'i dad pa:'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i:snying rje phyogs bral rkye byung:khyed kyi lam rol mdzod dang:dag pa'i ltad mor 'gro dus:ya mtshan ngo mtshar rmad byung:dga' 'o skyid do e ma:zhes smras pa'i lha phrug nyid zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas 'ja' lam gyi sngon so la bsgrod bdag kyang rjes su 'brang nas song tshe ri lung yul gling bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrod nas chu bo si larnya'i 'gram ngos ri bo gsal ldan spos dri snom pa'i rtser sleb tshe lha phrug na re sprul

rlu pa'i gter chen nus ldan rdo rje phyogs thams cad la ltad mo gzigs dang gsungs pa'i bdag gi de ltar byas tshe:shar na mi dkar po dar ber gyon pa zhig gis shar dang lho byang nub ngos su bskor nas dung dkar 'bud pa la: lho nas mi nag zhig gis dar nag po sprugs nas dung dkar bkab sgra snyan po ma grags: nub nas bu yug 'tshubs te dung sgra ma 'byin: byang shar gnyis su sgra shin tu grags pa mthong byung: lto phyogs na dug rlangs khrag mtsho rab tu khol ba zhig 'dug:nub phyogs na gdol ba shan pa gos sngon can gyis yul gling bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig mthong ba dang: byang phyogs su nyi ma 'od 'bar ba la sprin nag zhig chad nas re bsgrib la yang gsal ba sogs byed pa mthong tshe bdag gis smras pa: kya ho: lha phrug gzhen nu gson dang: 'di nas shar gyi phyogs na mi dkar dar ber can gyis gsungs snyan bkra shis dung dkar phyogs bzhir bskor nas 'bud kyang lho nas nag po dar 'geb nub nas 'tshubs ma'i skad bkags: byang shar sgra chen grags songs:brda thabs ci 'dra yin lags: lho rgyud me rlung dud

sprin:nad kyi ngad rlangs 'phyo ba'i dbal zer bzod par dka' 'o:brda thabs ci 'dra yin lags nub na rgya sogs bon po:gdol ba shan pa gos sngon:'du 'tshogs bsam yas snang ba:brda thabs ci 'dra byang phyogs rta bdun 'od 'bar:sprin nag g.yo bas bsgrib byed:sna tshogs snang ba de tsho:brda thabs ci 'dra zhus tshe lha phrug na re:a ho:rigs bzang nus ldan 'dus rtsal:legs par bdag la gson dang:de rig rten 'brel mtshan ma:bzang na brtag pa'i dus lags shar phyogs bu pho dkar po:tshe rab las kyi lha mchog phyag gi chos dung dkar po:snyan grags gang 'byung brtag thabs:lho nas bdud kyis bar chad:dam chos dpal la 'byung yongs:'du sgo rā dza'i bkag pa'i:brda rtags de 'dra yin no:nub phyogs mdzad phrin brkyang yan:dam sems kha smras gling mos:bstan la bar chad mang mchis:snyan grags nub la yal 'gro:brda rtags de 'dra yin no:byang shar gnyis la phyogs nas bstan pa'i ba dan bsgrengs na:gdul bya bsam yas 'dren no:snyan grags nam mkha'i mthar khyab smin grol dro rtags khyad 'phags brda

( rtags de 'dra yin no: nad rims dug gi rlangs pa: ngos mi zin pa'i gdon nad: sum sbrel ha la 'byel gas: sbos bshal gnyan grib sna tshogs: bod khams phung pa'i dal khaḥ bzlob byed thabs la 'bad dgos: brda rtags de 'dra yin no: nub phyogs 'du 'tshogs ma po: bsad gtub las ka dmar g.yos: bya bzhag 'du 'dzi mang po: mtha' mi kla kla'i cho 'phrul: 'jig rten rtsub 'gyur ston pa'i: smon log dam sri'i 'tshubs ma: 'joms pa 'i tho lum gzer gos: brda rtags de 'dra yin no: byang phyogs rta bdun 'od can: gser zhol skyid pa 'i rang bzhin: glo bur sprin gyis bskor ba: lho byang mtha' dmags 'khrugs ngo : cung zad bsgrib kyang gsal ba bsrung rims bsgrub rgyu yod nges: lha bsrungs sgrub sgol la sogs: rkyen 'dzoms gnad la brten mdzod/ brda rtags de 'dra yin no/ ma brjed sems la zungs shig: dgos ched rmad byung yod do: ces gsungs so: yang bdag cag rnams 'ja' lam la zhugs te phyin pa'i rgya mtsho chen po sngon sangs nge ba dpag tshad dang bral ba zhig gi pha ri'i ngos la sleb tshe ri bo 'od zer nor bu

zhes bya ba gser gyi phor ba kha sbubs pa lta bu'i rtser sleb tshe 'ja' zer gur khang gi dra mig 'khrigs klong lha mo rma bya chen mo lus po thams cad thig le'i mdzes pa bya ltar kyang miskad smra shes gsungs dbyings snyan pa zhig dang 'phrad tshe 'di skad gsungs so:a ma:smon lam rten 'brel bzang po:tshogs shing dus la bab pa'iḥlha lus nor bu lta bu'i dona'agrub bde ba'i myu gu:thugs mchogs sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab 'gro 'dul rdo rje:dpa' bo nus ldan gling pa:'di ru 'byon pa ngo mtshar:nga ngo khyod kyi shes sam:lha morma bya chen mo: phyi ltar khro gnyer 'bar ma:nang ni pad+ma chags spyod gsang ba bde skyongs dbang mo:'gro 'dren gdul bya skyong mdzad:drin chen mgon gcig ma ma sridagasum gsal ba'i me ma nga rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum gcig:zhal ta tshig gsum bshad do:g.yu 'brug gsungs dbyangs snyan po:rtogs pa'i gdengab dang ldan pa:brtul zhugasagadengs tshad thob pa'i:rigs mchog shes rab nyi ma:bstan pa'i sgon me sbor la:chos brgyad bya ba sbongs mdzod nges med ri la phyin nas:sgrub tshug g.yel med zungs shig

rnu: ljon bzang 'dabs 'bras ldan pa: rgyal po'i sras mo'i zlos gar: lto 'gros zhon mi ḍak+ki: kun bzang bde chen dbang mo 'phrad pa'i tshe chos dpal bskyed rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po: blo gros shes rab bzang po'i: kar bsgyur rigs kyi myu gu gsal byed nyi ltar 'bar ba'i pad+ma shes rab thogs med: dam grib skyon dang bral na: 'groba'i bde skyid spel 'ongs: sku la gegs mang mchis kyang dmar po lha lngas skyobs srid: ba gor be+e ro tsa na bstan pa'i gsal byed sgron me: ye shes rol rtsed brgyur ba'i rtogs bsgom gdengs dang ldan paḥ rigs ldan dharmā'i sprul bsgyur: pad+ma 'od gsal snying po: bar chad rkyen mang brgal na: pha phog bu la 'dom zhing: skal ldan bsam yas 'drenapa'i:ngo mtshar skyid kyi nyi ma: thig le rnam gsum 'dzom skabs mkha' 'gro dga' ba'i tshal dang: dkar po bde skyongs 'dabs ljongs bkra shis tshal gyi long par: zab gterabadud rtsi'i rgya mtsho: bsnyen bsgrub tshad dang ldan na: sku gegs 'phral rkyen byang zhing: mdzad 'phrin yar zla ltar 'phel bstan pa rdo rje snying pos: las ldan bsam yas 'dren no

dbang phyug mda' lnga bstan tshe: 'jigs med brtul zhugs skyongs lags tshogs drug rgyan gyi rol pa shar tshad kun tu bzang po: chos dbyings regs pa gcer byung: blo 'dasarnal 'byor khyer 'dra: srid pa gsum na dkon no: pha nor bu la sbyin gyis skal med sgod du ma zag chos kyi bka' bab dam pa:rnal 'phyor dharma ku mud: 'du 'bral med para'agrogs na: 'gro don bsam yas 'byung ngo ral na rang gzhan gnyis la: mkha' 'gro bka' chad 'byung ngo: dus 'tshams rnam pa bco brgyad: re re bzhin du ra tsa: bse mos cho'aphrul ston no bzlog brgyur mkha' 'gro'i lung byang: snying nas gces par zungs shig: khyod dang ye shes rig sku: 'du 'bral spu tsham med do: ma brjedanus ldan rdo rje yang yangathugs la zhen 'tshal: zhes gsungs nas gar brgyur brda thabs mang du mdzad do: de nas yang phyin tshe na kun mthing gsal kyi khrod na dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyi mi khyabapas bro gar 'khrab cing rol mo sna tshogs sgrogs la 'di skad mgrin gcig tu gsol to: e ma: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i: mkha' 'gro dga' ba'i tshal slong: 'ja' zer

rlu: sprin rlangs dra gur:'od zig gzhal yas khang dbus: bde stong zas la spyod cing: zab mo'i chos sgrar 'dud nas phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtsho: 'phags pa'i dgyes pa bskang ngo: pha gcig pad+ma ka ra'i:rnam 'phrul nus ldan rdo rje: gnas 'dir byon pa ngo mtshar nged cag mkha' 'gro gling nas yun du bzhugs sam mi bzhugs: dpa' bo grub pa rtsal lags: gsungs ba'i lan du bdag gis gsol ba:e ma:skyes nas tshe rabs kun tu: lus sems bskyed pa'i drin chen ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho:zhal ras mngon sum gzigs pa'i: rten 'brel mtshan ma bzang po:ngo mtshar skyid pa'i gzhi ma a ho dga' 'o skyid do: de ring 'dug pa'i dus min: lus kyi nam phug mi thub: skye ba 'phos ma thags par gnas 'dir nges par 'ong ngo: lam sna khyed kyi drongs mdzodaX zhes zhus pa'i tshe kun gyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad do:e ma: gangs can bod kyi yul na bstan pa'i sgron me gsal ma : der 'din 'dud sde mang tshogs:khyad par gsang sngags bstan pa:nyi ma'i snying po ltar gsal:bshad bsgrub 'dzug pa'i ba dan sngags skyes rnal

'byor mang 'tshogs bla med zab gter rgya mtsho'i:dgongs rgya klong mdzod bkrol ba'i:gter 'dzin skyes bu bsam yas dmus long 'gro ba'i tshogs la:zab gsang pha phoga'adom zhing:bde skyid lang tsho ston pa'i:dpa' bo gar rgyas dbang phyug:chags med don gyi rnal 'byor:mdzad phrin thugs bskyed dag pa'i sku drin gso bas yon du:ga ṇatsakra'i mchod sprin:dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bul loḥlnga drug bdun gyi gar la:lha dar 'ja' lam gdongs nas:mi min mkha' 'gro bsu yongs:gnas 'di'i tshogs dponamadzad pa'i rten 'brel che ba zhu legs:zhes zer nas phyi ltar bza' ba'i tshogs:nang ltar bdud rtsi'i tshogs:gsang ba bla med kyi tshogs rnams bdag la ston cing gus 'duda'adzum pa'i nyams mang po bstan no:bdag gis tshogs rdzas rnams rol bas phung khams skye mched rtsa rlung thig le'i lha tshogs rnams la dgyes pa bskang ngo:denas yang phyog tshe rinapo che las grub pa'i thang chen po dpag pa'i tshad las 'das pa 'od zer mu med pa 'phro ba sman sna dang me tog mang po'i kheb pa de yi dbus su khrus chab yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rdzing

phyi bu dkar la sngo mdangs chags pa:mtha' thams cad rin po che'i sgrom gyis bskor ba:dri bzang sna tshogs kyi ngad pa g.yo ba:de la lha dang klu dang dril bum gyi bu pho bu mo bsam gyis mi khyab pas khrus byed cing gar brtse ba zhig mthong ba'i tshe 'di dag rnams ci zhig yin snyams pa'i tshe na de dag gi nang nas dril bum gyi bu dkar po g.yu yi la thod can zhig na re a ho:dpa' bo bshad pa rdo rje 'khrul bral sngags skyes dbang po:gang 'ong 'dod pa ci zhig:ma lus gsung bar zhu'o:zhes zer ba'i lan du bdag gis smras paḥ kye rdo las can skal bzang pho moḥganas phyir gang phyir 'ong lags:nga ni 'dzam gling phyogs nas:gangs can bod kyi yul ljongs:mdo khams rgang drug rgyud nas:dpal ldan brag lha mgon po:mdun ngos gser ldongs 'dabs kyi: gnubs sngags grub rigs dam paḥlcags mo'i rus khams 'chang ba'i:nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal yin:gnas 'dir 'ong ba'i las don 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i:man ngag zab mo tshol phyir: bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang:spyan sngar 'khod la 'ong lags zab gter bcu

gsum chos sgo: ngo mtshar rmad byung dang 'phrad: slob 'bangs chos bdag tshogs la: gang 'dul gdams pa sprod kyang: rno so de tsam mi 'dug: byin rlabs ya mtshan che ba'i: rno sozab mo bsgrub 'ongs: byams dang snying rje rgya chen: chung ngu'i dus nas yod kyang: gzhan la phan thogs ma byung: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i thugs bskyed: smon lam bog 'don zhu yongs rgyas par bshad na zad med: mdo tsam de ltar yin no: zhes smra tshe yang dril bum gyi bu de na re tshem bdoskyed phun tshogs zhing 'dir 'gro 'dren dpa' bo khyed dang: de ringamajal ba ngo mtshar: dga' bde tshad med 'bar song: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa: gang can bod kyi yul nas: 'phags mchog dri med rgyal po: yi dam byas la snying po: dungaphyur bsgrangs ba'i mthu yis: gnas mchog 'di ru phyin no dad pa mos gus yod kyang: tib 'dzin bsgom ma shes pa'i: 'phags pa'i lha zhal ma mthong: 'di nas bag chags dri ma: brgyad ldan chu yis bkrus la: lha mchog sprul pa'i rjes bzungs bsags sbyangs sprel gsum 'grub nas: sa bcu lam lnga bsgrod la: gu ru'i zhabs pa da 'khod dgos: khyed

rtsi ni las smon ldan pas: da lta nyid nas bla ma'i: spyan sngar 'khod 'gro bu mchog: ces zer la thams cad kyi phyag mang du 'tshal lo bdag nyid kyang khrus kyi rdzing bu la zhugs nas khrus byas tshe bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams rab tu 'bar ro: de nas yang phyinatshe thang de bsgrod mtshams ri skas ngog la slebs tshe bya gser ltar ser ba dung ltar dkar ba g.yu ltar ljang ba be+eḍūr+yar ltar sngo ba: byi ru ltar dmar ba: 'ja' ltar kha dog sna tshogs pa mang po lus rtse 'jo khrig khrig ngag glu dbyangs 'ur 'ur sems bde stong chal chal 'phur lding byed pa dang: sman su ta si ri: 'chi gsos bum pa: ka la dbe rgyan: 'ur tsha sha leb sogs mang po spud pa: me tog kusum dmar ser ka ri dkar po: lan+ta ljang sngon ri sha dmar sgrug li rum ya dri ngad 'phro ba sogs mang po'i kheb pa: shing ljon bzang ya pa la dkar po dpal sgrogs ljang sngon: 'dod 'byung ljang ser: dpal brtsegs sngo nag: 'bras spud ljang nag sogs la dar dang dril bu g.yer khas mdzes par spras pa la: su ta sa yum: 'ur zang: ya mye sha phug tig sner sogs kyi thog bu bcas pa mang

po rgyas shing mdzes par 'phyang ba dang: gzhan yang ma rmos pa'i lo thog lda mye: chur tho: sug tha: wa le bha shwa dza 'bru la sogs yal 'dab mdzes pa mang po'i tshal yod pa'i dbus su pad+ma ka dh+wa la zhes bya ba 'dab ma stong ldan dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs chags pa'i steng du lha bu dkar gsal 'ja' sham can gyi stod g.yog bse ru'i lngags pa'i byas shing rat+na mang pos sku lus brgyan pa dar dkar po'i la thod byas shing zal bu ljang sngon g.yas g.yon du 'phyings ba phyag g.yon pa'i pad+ma dkar po thugs gar 'dzin pa g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag brgya 'gro ba 'dul bar mdzad cing zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs shing zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa mtha' bskor du lha dang lha mo dril bum pho mo brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung phyur grangs med pa'i bskor nas la las phyag 'tshal: la las bskor ba byed: la las maṇ+ḍal phul: la las mnyam par bzhag la las bzlas pa bya la las mchod sprin stobs: la las chos sgra 'ur la las 'ja' lam la zhugs nas 'phags pa'i mdun du 'gro ba mthong tshe: bdag gi lha bu de la phyag dang bskor ba maṇ+ḍal phul

dru nas 'di ltar gsol to:kya ste las skal ldan pa'i bu mchog rnams: rjes su 'dzin pa'i thugs rje can bka' drin bsam mi khyab pa yis:lha gcig bdag la dgongs su gsol:'di dag ci phyir gang las byung: bzang ngan khyad par yod dam med:'phags pa'i gdul bya yin nam min:'khor bar ldog gam mi sdog lags:ma lus bdag la gsungs du gsol: zhes zhus tshe lha bu de nyid kyi zhal nas:kya he las dang skal ba ldan pa'i rig mchog nus ldan rdo rje:bdag la legs par gson dang: nga ni lha yi bu mchog dam pa 'od dkar phreng ba:'phags pa'i phrin las sprul pa:'gro ba gang 'dul mdzad phyir:'di ru rnam par 'ongs ngo:mtha' 'khor tshom bu mang po:'jig rten mi skya pho mos:sgog bcad spangs ba'i sdom bzungs:yig drug dung phyur bzlas shing 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug yid la mos shing dad pa'iḥstobs kyi dbang med 'dir bsgrod 'on kyang bskyed bsgoms ting 'dzin lam gnad sbyangs bsgrod med pas: da dung 'phags zhal mi mthong: bdag gi thabs dang cho gas: lam lnga rims kyi bsgrod nas

lha mchog spyan sngar 'god lags: 'di dag ngo bo mnyam nyid lam la mtho dman mang yod: don gyi 'di ru sleb tshe bsam bzhin 'gro don mdzad las: las kyis phyir mi sdogago de lugasathugs la bzhag nas: 'dzam gling bod kyi khams su gsungs mchog yi ge drug ma'i: chos bskor snang ba bsgyur dang: 'brel tshad don dang ldan no: ma brjed nusaldan rdo rje: zhes gsungs so:de nas yang bdag gis zhus paḥyinamaḥ bka' drin brjod las 'das pa: ya mtshan med byung sprul pa 'phags mchog 'phrin las bzang po skyabasachen ye shes nyi ma bdag la legs par gsan 'tshalaX gdams ngag tshig nyung don 'dus byin rlabs ya mtshan che ba man ngag zab mo gsungs mdzod zhes zhus tshe lha yi zhalanas: slo ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrīḥ o ni skye med chos dbyings: ma 'gags snying rje chen po: ṇi:yi bsdus pa'i 'gro rnams: pad dkar chags kun bral nas ste tog lhums su zhugs la thugs mchoga3 gi dbyangs sangs: 〉ཿyis 'khor ba dong sprugs: byin rlabs dngos grub bang mdzod 'di 'dra'i gdams zab dkon no:o ni chos kyi sku dang ma zhes longs

rnu spyod rdzogs sku:ṇi yang chags bral sprul skuḥpad ni ngo bo nyid dbyings:me ni 'gags med rig sku:hūṃ ni mi 'gyur rdo rje trī ni dus gsum bde gshegs:rgyal kun thugs kyi yangs snying bzlas pa'i dbang thob sgrib dag:mkhyen gnyis ye shes 'bar ro:ma ni lha 'dren pad dkar ma ni lha min rnam 'dren ṇi zhes mi dbang spyan gzigs pad ni byol song gnas 'dren:me ni yi dwags las sgrol:hūṃ gis dmyal ba'i gnas stong hrī yis 'khor ba ru log 'gro bar rigs drug 'dul ba'i:gdams ngag yid bzhin nor bu:gzhan gyis 'dran zla bral lo:ma ni rgyal kun dgongs pa:ma gzhi stong pa nyid dbyings ṇi yang mkhyen gnyis rig pa:pad ni chags thog med pa:me zhes gsal 'grib blo bral / ni dus gsum 'gags med:trī yis rjen par mthong ngo:'di 'dra'i nyams len zab mo:gzhan gyis 'gran zla bral lo:3 mi 'phags pa'i sku dbyings:ma ni 'brel ba thob tshad:ṇi zhes thugs rje'i zin nas:pad ni bag chags bral la:me ni yang dag 'grub nas:hūṃ ni ldog med dbyings su:hrīḥyis zhing gi mched do:

dbang po rno rdul med par: 'brel tshad 'dren pa'i lcags kyuX gzhan las khyad par 'phags so zla ni gdod ma'i ye gzhi: ma ni rin chen gter mdzod: ṇi yang dus gsum 'gyuramed pad ni mngon gsum mthong ba: me ni byin rlabs 'bar ba: / ni kun la bstims dang: hrīḥyis 'brel tshad sangs rgyas: 'di las lhag pa'i man ngag: tshig nyung don 'dusami dgos: ma brjed sems la bzungs nas: skye bo bzang ngan bar ba kun la legs par ston dang: byin rlabs khyad par 'phags so: the tshom yid gnyis mi dgos: ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: zhes gsungs so: de nas 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan them rkas lta bu'i lam la zhugs nas byin tshe rin po che dung gi ri dkar gsal 'od 'bar ba 'ja' sprin sna tshogs 'khyud pa de yis rtse mor sleb tshe rin po che shel dkar gyi gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta bab bang rim 'khyud mo 'khor yug dang bcas pa: rin po che sna tshogs kyi mdzes par spras pa pad+ma'i dpyangs pa 'phur ba 'dod snam dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljag gu rnams gyis mchod sprin mtha' yas pa stob cing gar

rnu 'khrab pa dang: 'khyams iṇ+ḍa ni la'i chags gdab pa'i steng na byang chub sems dpa' chags thogs bral ba dri ma med pa: rdo rje snying po: don yod zhags pa sbob pa mtho ba: dpa' mi zhus pa 'gro ba rnam 'dren: brtul zhugs chen po rnams kyi sku mdog dkar po longs sku'i rgyan chas can bse ru'i lpags pa pad+ma'i do shal 'ja' yi rkangasham brkyang bskum sna tshogs mdzad cing g.yas na pad ma dkar po g.yon pas yid bzhin nor bu 'dzin pa rnams mthong tshe dad pa dang mos gus 'bar bas 'di skad zhus so: e ma rang don ye sangs rgyas kyang thugs rje brtse ba chen pos: dmus long 'gro ba skyob pa'i: dri med byang chub sems dpa': las ldan mched brgyad gson dang: gdams ngag thugs kyi yang zhun: byin rlabs zab mo stsol mdzod: ces zhus tshe byang chub sems dpa' mched brgyad kyi 'di ltar gsungs so: e ma las dang skal ba ldan pa'i rigs bzang nus ldan rdo rje: yang cig tshur la gson dang snang srid 'khor 'das gnyis su: btags pa'i chos khams rgya mtsho bden med stong nyid rol pa: mtha' bzhi bral ba'i rang klong

gsal snang 'gags med chen po: rten 'brel lugs 'byung bkod pa: don la bden gnyis dbyer med: lam khyer snying rje brdal khyab ris med byams pa chen po: dga' chenasdang chen bral ba: ro mnyam btang snyoms tshad med blo 'das ye shes gsang lamaḥ yang yang gnad du bsnun na: rtogs pa'i nyams rtogs zab mo: 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhagathob yongs: gzhan don rlabs chen mdzad na sku skyes bstan don blang ngo: 'jig rten chos brgyad dor na 'tshubs slong mang po dben yang: brag phug zhwa ltar gyon na: sgrub tshugasalegs par zin no chags med 'khor ba spang na: 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng las rgyal lo: bzod pa'i go cha bgos na: zhe sdang dgra dang bral lo: nges med ri sul 'grims na 'grodon rlabs chen 'grub po: yi dam thugs rje chen po: brten na byin rlabs 'byung ngo: bzlas pa 'bru drug bsgrangs na rdo rje'i gsungs mchog 'grub cing gzhan snang dge labaskul lo ting 'dzin rtse gcig bsgom na: nyams rtogs yon tan 'bar ro: khe nyen che ba'i zab gter bka' lung bzhin du brten 'tshal: rten 'brel ma brtags rang

rlu: 'grigs byung na ngo mtshar gnas so: chos ldan dam tshig ldan la: zab pa'i snying nor sprod lags: chos spyod re 'ga' mchis na: gdams pa dbyer med sbyin dgos: zas ngo nor la ma re: dman byams bu la gtad dgos: gti mug nyal 'dod che naḥ 'gro don 'grub dus mi 'ong: chos brgyad 'du 'dzis brgyag pa'i zhes sbos dman sprang mi skyobs: kun bstod bzod re 'thug po'i: thugs ngo khyog dus mi yo sa: gzhan don 'grub pa lta ci: grags 'dod yag rtsi'i che na: rnam dag dam chos mi 'grub: blo mang bya blo rgod na yid bde skyid dus mi 'byung ci nus zhal ta bzhin du bsgrub na bde skyid nyi ma: khyed la nges par 'char ro de lugs thugs lo zungs shig: rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje zhes gsungs so skabs 'dir zhus len me tog phreng ba yod kyang re zhig la gu bye: de nas yar gshegs tshe tshad med zhi ba chen po'i sgo zlum la 'khyil ba nas zhugs nas nang du phyin tshe 'od zer dkar po bkrag mdangs gzi brjid bzod par dka' ba'i dbus su 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po dri med pad+ma dkar po mtshan dpe'i lang tsho'i

'byud pa gangs kyi ri bo la nyin phyed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa lta bu zhal 'dzum spyan dngas ba: dar gyi chas gos lnga dang rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis spras pa: yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs sgrogs shing 'gro kun sgrol ba'i dgongs pa can: sku mnyen lcugs 'khril ldem sogs tshul dgu'i lang tsho'i mdzes pa: phyag dang po gnyis kyis pad+ma dang lcags kyu 'dzin paX 'og ma na shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas 'dod 'byung nor bu bsnams pa: pad+ma'i thod gdengs dang rtse phran hūṃX yig mtshan pa dang: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa de yi g.yas su sras nor bu 'dzin pa g.yon du sras mo gsang sngags 'dzin maḥ mdun du byabhe chub sems dpa' grangs med pa'i sprin 'phro ba mthong tshe bdag gi rgyud la mi phyed pa'i dad pa: yid ches kyi mos gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'khrungs nas gsol ba 'di ltar btab so: e maḥ bskangs mang gongasanas sangs rgyas kyang:thugs rje brtse ba chen po yis: 'gro ba 'dren mdzad dpa' bo che ye shes gsang ba'i nyi ma can: ma rig mun pa sel bar mdzad: dmus longs sdug bsngal mtshor bying rnams:

྅ btang snyoms gru bo'i sgrol bar byed: dug lnga'i 'dam du tshud pa la: byams dang snying rje rlan phab pa: mtha' med 'gro khams rgya mtsho las: sgrol ba'i dam bca'i mthu mnga' ba: yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: bka' drin brjod 'das rgyal ba'i sras dri med pad+ma dkar po nyid: brtse ba chen po bdag la dgongs: bdag ni las dang skal ba ldan: khyed zhal mthong ba ngo mtshar che: 'gro khams rgya mtsho dong sprugs shing: smin grol byin rlabs gsang ba'i mdzod: gdams ngag thugs kyi yang bcud cig: gnang ba'i bka' drin stsal du gsol: zhes zhus tshe: thugs rje chen po'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so e ma phyogs smon las 'phro dus 'dzom pa'i: 'gro 'dren mchog gi pho nya ba: dpa' bo nus ldan 'dus pa stsal: gson dang gdams ngag tshigs gsum bshad: bskal pa mang po'i gor rol nas: rang don byang chub brnyes na yang: 'gro ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin can: mazong tshe snyig rje'i 'dor ma phod: dmyal ba'i zangs chen kha lo bsgyur: 'khor ba dong nas lan mang sprugs: da dung srid gsum ma stongs bar: 'gro ba'i

don las 'da' mi bya las ldan thams can rnams par 'dren:rtsol dang rtsol med drangs nges lam:gang la gang 'dul de ltar byas:'brel ba thob pa'i sems can ni:bskyedabasgom dmigs pa ma shes kyang:bdag gi thugs rjes rab zin nas zhing mchog 'di ru dbugs dbyung 'gyuraḥgasungasamatshog yi dza/drug ma zhes:snyan pa'i sa gsum khyab pa yis:chos kyi de nyid zab pa'i bcud:ma bslab shugs la rang grol 'byung sgod la bzang ngan yod ma yin:dad dang mos par rab bskul na gces pa'i bu ngus ma'i mi bzod de bzhin bdag kyang zhing 'di nas:dbang med de yis spyan sngar 'khod:dbang bskur lung bstan byin rlabs shing:'pho ma thag par 'di ru 'dren:de phyir skal ldan khyod nyid kyis:g.yel ba thang lhod med pa dza bdag bsgom snying po bzlas pa na:'gro don mkha' dang mnyam par 'ong bar chad g.yul las rnam par rgyal:gsung mchog yi ge drug ma ni grags stong sngags su gyer ba na:tshor tshad byang chub sems rgyas theb:de phyir thos grol zhes su grags:'phags mchog yid la bsgom pa dang:snying po dgongs pa'i phug bcug

(3 nas gtad med ku yang ngang bzlas na rnam par byang chub dran grol grags: sems ni 'phags pa'i thugs sgog la: gtad de snying po lus la sbyar: rtsal sbyangs rgyas gdab byas na rgyal: btags pa'i grol ba rnam par grags: 'dod yon gang shar gang snang ba: 'phags pa'i sku ru las khyer gyis: rnam par reg cing nyams myong dge:de phyir reg grol zhes su grags: pad+ma dri med dkar po'i sku don yod zhags pa'i gzu sa sngags rgyud: 'ja' 'od zig le 'bru bdun bkod: mthong tshad grol ba bla na med ma bsgom chos lta zab pa'i bcud: byin rlabs gzhan las khyad par 'phags skal ldan pho mo thams cad kyis: 'dun pa zhing khams yid la gyis: ma yengs 'phags pa'i skur bsgom la: gsol 'debs 'bru drug bzlas par 'bod: dge lam sdig pa'i ma gos na zhing 'dir skye bar the tshom med: bslu ba med do sa ma yā: ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje'i zungs ces gsungs so: gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnam gnyis dang 'khor mang pos mgrin gcig tu: a ho thugs rjelilcags kyu 'bar ba'i: 'gro ba thabs kyi zin

shing:gdams ngag bdud rtsi lta bu'i:las ldan pho mo smin mdzad:zab gter bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho:chos bdag bu la 'doms pa'i grub brtes nus ldan rdo rje:zhing 'dir 'byonapa ngo mtshar 'gro don dus la bab kyis:g.yel med brtson pa drag po'iX bshad sgrub 'du sgo btsug nas man ngag sbyin la mkhas na:'brel tshad don dang ldan no:sangs rgyasathugs kyi yang snying:mag ngag yi ge drug ma:rgyun du yi dam mdzod dang:'gro don brin las 'byung ngo:da dung 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi spyan sngar tshul bzhin 'khod nas:zhus lenagasal bor mdzod dang phan bde'i langs tsho rab rgyas byin rlabs dngos grub thob po:ma brjed snying gi nor bu zhes gsungs so:skabs 'dir 'phags pa'i zhal nas gsung ba'i dmar khrid zab mo gnang yang chos bdag me tog bzang po ma byung bar du gu khya de nas yang 'ja' lam du zhugs nas bar khang gi nang du sleb tshe thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas pad+ma dkar po g.yon pas yid bzhin nor bu 'dzin cing longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis mdzes par spras pa

snyi gsang ba'i yum dang 'khril pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa 'od dang 'od zer mu med pa 'phro ba de yis mdun du byang chub sems dpa' mang pos garastabs brgyur zhing mchod sprin stob pa:lhag pa'i lha sku de 'jal ba'i tshe mos gus tshad med pa zhig 'khrungs nas bdag la 'di skad gsol do:e ma:mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga'abadag:'gro 'dren thugs rje'i bdag nyid:skyabs gcig gsang ba 'dus pa:g.yel med bdag la dgongs mdzod:smin grol zab pa'i gdams pa:snying phyung lag mthilabakod pa'iX dam chos bdud rtsi'i zeg ma:gnang ba'i bka' drin stsol legs:zhes zhus tshe 'phags pa'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung so:e ma tshe rabs las smon 'brel ba'i sngags skyes bu mchog gson dang:gang snang bde ba chen po:shar tshad 'phags pa'i rol pa:sdug bsngal ming tsam ma mchis:bde gshegs thugs kyi gsang lam:thugs mchogaye shes snying po g.yel med brtson pas zung la nyams len tshags su dzad mdzod:rang rtsar bzhugs pa'i gnyug ma:spangs thob bral ba'i gshis lugs ji bzhin mngon du

gyur nas: ngang las cham bzhag mdzad 'tshal stong nyid nam mkha' yangs paḥ 'od gsal spro bsdu bral ba' gshis lugs bde chen rgyal po'i: dgongs pa mngon du byung nas yengs med brtson pa'i bzung mdzod: gtad med ku yang blo bde'i: su 'grogs shes pa dga' sangs: snang ba yangs sangs brdal ba: nyon mongs 'bur la 'joms pa'i: nyams len rang thog rgol dgos: dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas: gcig 'dus sems nyid rnam dag: 'phags pa'i la ru bzhugs pas: lam khyed re ltar rems shig: sgra grags bzang ngan sna tshogs: don la sngags kyi rol pa: 'bru drug thugs kyi snying po rgyun tu bsgrangs na legs so: bdag ni gsang ba 'dus pa: rgyal kun spro bsdus gzhi ma: su yi thugs dam byas na: bde gshegs sras su 'gyur ro: snang ba ma 'gags lha sku: stong gsal yum dang 'khril sbyor: dran rtog 'khor gyi rol pa: gnyis med ngang du la bzla: 'byung 'jug rlung gi rta la: 'bru drug spro bsdu byas na: 'phags pa'i byin rlabs mchog sdud: the tshom mi dgos skyid pa: tha lam so skyes yongs kyis: sems 'di bcos pa gal che:

྅ byams dang snying rje bskyed nas: dgra gnyen chags sdang med pas: btang snyoms rtsal sbyangs rem cig: dge sdig che chung mi gtso: bsam pa dkar nag la rag chos rnams 'dun par gnas na: dad pa dag snang bskyed dgos: 'khor bar snying po med na: rmi lam yul la ma 'khrul: bshad pa tshig la mkhas kyang sems kyi gzhi rtsa nag na thams cad dug tu 'gyur ro: nyal bzhin dge chen bsam na: phrag dog ru nga sbongs la: gzhan gyis dge tshogs mthong tshe: rjes su yi rang gyis shig: dmyal ba'i gting rdo bsam na: chos gral dbang gral 'tshangs nas: dam tshig chol rnyogs spyod dang: bskal par thar dus mi 'ongs: nag po bdud zhig bsam na: kha lta stong 'khyams byas nas: dge sdig las 'bras khyad gsod: 'khor bar dal med g.yeng na: kla klo mu stegs 'dra'o: yang dag bsgom par 'dod na: lta ba yes nas 'bebs shing: spyod pa mas nas 'dzegs la rangagasal ye shes brkyangs nas rgyal ba'i sras po yin no: 'khrul ba ru log bsam na 'jig rten chos brgyad dor la: 'di snang zhen med brdul zhugs: gnad du brten na lags

so: bstan pa'i 'gro don dgongs na: rang la ci mi bsnyam shing: gzhan phan don gnyer blo yis: gang la gang 'dul mdzad na: 'khor ba dongs nas sprugs so: zab mo'i gter laspyod na: nor gyi skal ba med do: 'phung 'tshengs nus pa'i man ngag: mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin brten na: rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub po: de dag sems la zungs dang : nga dngakhyod gnyis 'du 'bral: skad cig tsam yangs ma mchis dus drug ma brjed yid la: bsgoms nas snying bo bsgrangs shing: gsol ba phur tshug gdab na: bu la byin gyis rlobs so 'brel thog ma lus rnam 'dren: zhing khams 'di ru 'god pa'i: rten 'brel che ba yod do: snying nor nus ldan 'dus rtsal: thugs la de ltar zhog lags: ces gsungs so skabs 'dir zhus len lnga bcu pa yod kyang re zhig la gu khya: de nas yar la bzhengs nas yang thog gi pho brang la phyin tshe chos sku snang ba mtha' yas mnyam bzhag tshe bum 'dzin pa longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis mdzes par spras pa yum gos dkar mo dang 'khril sbyor rol ba 'khor rgyal ba rigs bzhis bskor ba dang mjal tshe bdag gis zhus pa rkya

gyi ho: dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyiḥ mnga' bdag snang ba mtha' yas: rigs bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas pa: bdag la rnam par dgongs mdzod: smin cing grol ba'i gdams pa: tshig nyung don 'dus gsung ba'i: yang yang zhu ba phul lo: zhes zhus tshe snang ba mtha' yas kyis zhal nas: e ma: rigs mchog nus ldan 'dus rtsal: legs pa ra bdag la gson dang: skal mang ye thog gong nas: kun bzang thugs rjes zin pa'i snang byed bu mchog gsum paḥ mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas snang mtha'aX rigs bzhi'i mched dang bcas so: khyed ni bdag gi gdung 'dzin: thugs sras pad+ma ka ra'i: rgyal tshabs nus ldan rdo rje: bdag dang 'phrad pa skal bzang: smon lam las 'phro ldan no: zhal da dzig 'gal bshad do: mi skya pho mo kun la dgos med sgyu ma rmi lam: don med 'jig rten bya bzhag: che bzhag chung bskyur dgos pa'i zhal da yang dag mdzad nas: blo sems bsgyur ba'i chos 'khor: bskor dang 'brel tshad don ldan: sngags skyes las ldan rnams la a nu zab pa'i man ngag: ston la bde stong bsgom dang: rtsa rlung thig le las su: rung

ba'i grub 'bras mngon gyur: mos ldan rtag 'dzin can la: thabs chen bskyed rim bstan nas ting 'dzin gcar phog bsgom la: rnam bzhi'i rig 'dzin thob pa'i: rgyu 'phrul garal brtson mdzod: dad dam mos gus can la: zab mo'i dbang mchog bskur nas: byin rlabs gcar phong ngo sprad nyams myong las ldan mang ngo: 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yod do rtogs gom gdengs tshad ldan la: ji bzhin rig pa bstan nas: rang byung ye shes mjal ba'i rtog grol dus mnyam mang 'byung: bdud sprul bcu gsum 'byung 'gyur zab mo'i gdams bcud ma shor: kha ngan 'chol tshig ma sgrogs: rang sar klod dang dben yongs: mi med ri la song nas pha chos bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rang gis bsnyen sgrub byas nas:gzhan la legs par ston dang: 'gro don rgya chen 'byung ngo: gzhan yang gces pa'i man ngag: zab lam rdo rje snying po: tshul bzhin khyod la bstan noX da dung spel ba'i dus min:chos bdag rat+na pha la: 'byung tshe de la gtod dang: 'gro don bsam yas e ma ces gsungs so: skabs 'dir rgyal ba rigs lnga da zhus len bar do'i drug khrid zab mo yod kyang

gyi re zhig gu bye: de nas gzhal yas khang rtsa ba'i shar gyi glo 'bur nang du phyin tshe de na thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol 'khor byang sems dang bcas te bzhugs pa mthong skabs phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la 'di ltar gsol btab so: kyi hoḥ chags bral thugs rje'i gter chenaḥ 'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'iḥ ye shes rig sku dam pa: bdag la mkhyen brtses dgo sa 'tshal: khams gsum 'khor ba dbyings sgrol: man ngag bcud 'dus gsung ba'i: bka' drin dam pa stsol lags: zhes zhus tshe 'gro ba kun grol gyi zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa la: e ma: sngags skyes nus ldan rdo rje zab pa'i man ngag bshad na: g.yel med thugs la 'jog 'tshal: khyab brdal nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba yongs la: byams dang snying rje gdangs bskyed: gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor na: rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon: zhog na ngo mtshar che'o: snang ba'i gzugs la zhen na: rmi lam sgyu ma'i bslu bzhin: snyan po ci yang med na me lceb mar me 'gags bzhin: thar ba'i lam srog ma gcod grags pa'i sgra la zhen na g.yar rnga'i skad kyi nga ro: brag cha stong

pa'i bslus na: ri dwags pi waṃ sgrar zhes: rngon pa'i dug mdas gsod 'gyur: thar lam gnad srog sdud: sgom pa'i dri la chen na: ku mud tshal chen g.yo ba'i mdangs len metog zum tshe: 'bu phran srog dang bral 'gro de bzhin tshor stong dri yi: don med thar lam ma dgag: myang ba'i ro la zhen na: bza' btung bu ram myang 'dra dper na nya mo lcagasakyu'i: sha la rol na srog 'gags: de ltar 'dod yon re ba'i: thar lam rin chen ma gcod: myong ba'i reg byar zhen na: glang chen 'dam la phyin tshe: thar ba'i dus skabs mi'abyung: de bzhin gos la g.yeng na: zab mo'i lam srog 'gags 'gro des na 'khor ba'i chos la: skyo ba skye nas dben rir: bde ba'i lus sems ngal bso: gnad kyi gzerabadun rgyas 'debs: thun min stong nyid snying rje: zung 'jug ye shes bsgom nas: sdug bsngal gru bo che las: bdichen po ṭa la nas ma gyur 'gro rnams khod dang: bdag gi bumachog yin noḥ 'gro 'dren mdzad pa ngo mtshar: sku skyes 'byon pa don ldan ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: zhes gsungs so: 'demiskabs su gzung 'dzin rang grol gyi man ngag tshig

rnu: nyung don 'dus zhig gsungs yang re zhig la gu h+ye:de nas lto yi glo 'bur nang du phyin tshe thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mjal ba'i tshe bdag gis phyag dang bskor ba byas la gsol ba 'di ltar btab so:e maḥmun pa'i dmus longs 'gro ba:thugs rje'i lcags kyu'i 'dren pa'i:'phags mchog sdug bsngal rang grol:brtse ba'i bdag la dgongs mdzod:'gro kun rmongs pa'i lam las:bzlog pa'i gdams pa zab mo:gang zhig ci nas gsung 'tshal:zhes zhus tshe thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gyi zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te gdams pa 'di ltar gnang ngo:e ma mtha' med 'khor ba'i gnas su:dbang med rang khar spyod cingaḥsdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i non pa'i rmongs pa'i byis pa rnams ni:'dren thabs sus kyang dka'o:'on kyang gang can bod yul:bdag gis sprul pa'i sprelusgrol ma'i brin las brag srin:thabs shes khyims thabs zungs la:mi bu rigs drug skye nas:bza' rgyu ma rtes bkres skoms:ltog pa' sgog dang bral ba'i:dus bab spre'u nyid

kyang: skad cig 'phags pa'i spyan sngar: 'khod la gsol btab 'bras bu: thabs shes sras tshogs bcas pa: bkres skom gdung bsal phyiraḥ 'bru sna drug po blang nas: bod kyiphyogs su 'thor la bdag gi smon lam rgya chen: btab pa'i gsos sman 'khrungs te: bde skyid dpal la spyod do: de phyir smon lam dbang brgyur: sprul pa'i gnas su 'dug pa'i 'gro don khyed kyi mdzod dang: gdams pa zab mo sbyin no: 'khor ba dong sprugs nus so: zhes gsungs la nyid sgrubs thabs byin rlabs che ba: dngos grub myur ba 'brel tshad 'drenapa'i gdams pa zhig gnang yang re zhig dgongs pa'i sang du gu bye: de nas nub kyi glo phur nang du phyin tshe thugs rje chen po yang gsang bla med sku mdog dmar gsal pad phrenga'adzin pa yum dang 'khril sbyor rol pa longs sku'i brgyan chas rdzogs shing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spro bsdu mdzad pa 'khor byang chubasems dpa' rigs 'dzin paṇa grub rgya mtsho bzhugs pa'i mdun du sleb tshe bdag gas phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas la gsol bar 'di ltar btab soX kye ma ma rig gsum gyi

྅ mun gling:tshud pa'i dmus long 'gro ba:thar lam gru gzing thob phyir:gdams ga thugs kyi yang zhun:bdag la gsung bar zhu'o:zhes zhus tshe thugs rje chenapo yang gsang bla med kyi zhal 'aca ma pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsung so:e ma:byamasadang snying rje'i dbang phyug:grub brnyes nus ldan rdo rje:legs par bdag la gson dang 'khor ba rgya tshad che yang:ngar 'dzin gcig gi cho rol:phung khams 'dod yon bkod pa:sems nyid bde ba'i cho 'phrul:rnam rtog lug brgyud mang po:las rlung 'dzin pa'i chorol ma brtag bden grub ltar snang dpyad na ye stong rol ba dbyings dang ye shes zung 'jug:rnal ma'i gshes lug gcer byung:bsgom med rig pa'i ye shes:dus gsuma'apho 'gyur bral bar:rang gsal rang shes chen po:g.yel med rtag tu skyongs dang:mkhyen gnyis 'od brgya 'bar ro dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa:lag mthil bkram payin no:las skal ldan la sbyin dgos snod min dag la gsang rgya:rlub phyogs tsam yangs ma bsgrags:khyed ni las spron mthu 'dzoms:bstan dang 'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun

gyis grub par 'gyur ro: mdzad phrin mtha' ru phyin tshe dpal ri pad+ma'i drung du: bde chen ye shes thob po: de ma thob pa'i dus kun: 'bral med bdag gis byin rlabs zhalagazigs lung byang ston yongs: the tshom yid gnyis mi dgos: zhes gsungs shing skabs 'dir rdzogs rim rlung gi 'khrul 'khor zab mo gnang yang re zhig dgongs pa'i dbyings sugu bye: de nas byang gi glo 'bur nang du thon skabs thugs rje chen po phyag na pad+ma sku mdog dkar po longs sku'i rgyan can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung mdzad pa'i 'khor du byang chubasems dpa' grangs med pa bzhugs pa zhal mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab so:tshunam mun pa'i smag rum 'thib par: dmus ma ngas 'grob mgo rmongs: las 'bras blang dor mi shes: skyabs med 'gro ba yongs la: phan pa'i bdud rtsi lta bu: gsal byed shes rab nyi ma: sbar ba'i man ngag snying phyung: gdams pa zabamo gsung mdzod: zhes zhus tshe thugs rje chen po phyag na pad+ma nyid zhal 'dzum dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pas 'di skad gsungs so: yinam: skyonas tshe rabs kun tu thugs

rnu bskyed smon lam dag pa'i: 'gro 'dul nus ldan rdo rje bdag dang 'phrad pa skal bzang: ma yengs lags par gson dang rgya mtsho mtha' dbus bral klongs ru sbal long ba gang mchis: blang dor shes rig mig med: de 'dra mthong na snying rje: rmongs pa bkol spyod myong zhing: sna tshogs rogs gzir la rgyu 'bras sdug bsngal spyod rnams mthong na sha tsha snying rje: chags sred khyims thabs bzung nas: phan tshun 'thabs mo yug spyod: du:kha rig gyis nyo rnams: mthong nas snying rje skye byung rtsed mo byis pa'i chos ni 'ja' dang ku mud tshal la: chags 'dzin bden par bzung 'khrul: de 'dri mgo rmongs mthong tshe: sha tsha snying rje skye byung: le lo 'du 'dzi'i thang la: rnam g.yengs rta pho rgyugs nas chos brgyad 'du 'dzi'i bslus pa'i: 'gro mazong snying rje skye byung: chags sdang gru bo'i nang nas: zhen 'dzin g.yul la spyod bzhin: nyon 'khrul rmongs pa'i blo can: dbang med srog dang bral ba'i: las ngan rnams mthong snying rje: tsha grangs me chu'i gzir zhing bkres skoms 'khyag ltog blo rmongs: 'thab rtsod char sdang g.yul la: zhugs pa'i tshogs mthong

byams dang: snying rje dbang med rdol byung: blo ldan ya rab rnams ni: gnas ngan de ru ma rmongs cis kyang 'jag rten 'khor ba'i: dgos med blo sbyangs rem ya don med 'du'adzi'i lam du bag med rnam g.yeng ma byed: la dang bla ma yi dam: ma dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho: rtag tu bsnyen bsgrub mdzod dang: grub 'bras mngon du 'gyur ro: rtags mtshanagazhan la ma smra: zab gter bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho: chos bdag bu la ston dang: rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis: grub pa'i dge mtshan 'char ro: gsungs mchog yi ge drug ma'i chos bskor gzhan snang dge la: sbyor ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs na: ya mtshan dge legs 'bar nas: nga yi zhing du 'khod yongs: thugs dam ma yengs bu mchog: man ngag semasal 'chongs shig: ces gsungs shing theg dgu'i lam rim tshig nyung don 'dus zhig gsungs yang re zhig gu h+ye: denas shar lto'i gru chad nang du sleb tshe thugs rje chen pad dkar phreng ba sku gdog dkar po longs sku'i chas can zhabs skyil krung 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas te bzhugs pa mazong tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal bcas de

rlu gsol ba 'di ltar btab so: kye maḥ gcong rung ya nga'i g.yeng sa: 'dor ba mun gling nang du: 'phyan pa'i skye 'gro sems can: ma lus 'dren pa'i gdams ngag tshig nyung don 'dus zab mo stsol ba'i bka' drin zhu'o zhes zhus tshe thugs rje chen po pad dkar phreng ba'i zhal 'dzum thugs brtse ba dang bcas de 'di ltar gsungs so: e ma:las ldan 'dus pa rtsal legs: gus pa'i tshur la gson dang: dad pa'i 'khor lo rin che snying rje yid bzhin nor bu: bsam gtan btsun mo dam pa: dran shes bag yod blon po nyon mongs rab 'joms dmag dpon: brtson 'grus rta mchog shug ldan: 'khor ba rab bsgral glang chen: gces pa'i rgyal srid sna bdun: man ngag sems la brten 'tshal thugs rje'i 'gro ba skyobs pa'i: bsil zer gdugs chen 'bar ba: chos kyis phyogs bcur char 'bebs: snyan pa'i dung dkar rgyang grags: 'dod yon chags pa bral ba'i dri bral pad+ma dkar po mkhyen gnyis ye shes rgyas pa'i: 'gro 'dul dpal be'u dam pa: phyogs ris bral ba'i btang snyoms kun zlum bum pa chen po 'gro ba 'dul ba'i chos

'khor: gang 'dus ston pa'i gser nya: nyon mongs gdungs pa sna tshogs: bsal ba'i rgya mtshan dam pa: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i: chos 'khor rtsib stong ldan pa: brda rtags bkra shis mchog brgyad: man ngag sems la brten nas: gzhan don rlabs chen mdzad 'tshal sna tshogs rgyan gyi rol pa: rjes gzigs rang grol me longs gzungs 'dzin bdud kyi gnyen po: bdag med shes rab yungs dkar: las ldan smin cing grol ba'i: zag med bdud rtsi dkar po: 'gro ba'i dug gsum nad sel: lha waṃ sman gyi dwangs ma khams gsum dbang du sdud cing: chags bral li khri dmar po: 'brel tshad dben gnas bsgrod pa'i: ya mtshan rdzas mchog ku sha: rmongs chags re ba skong ba'i: myang grol bkra shis bil ba: gang 'dul zab pa'i man ngag: snyan pa'i chos dung dkar po: bkra shis rdzas mchog rnam brgyad rang nyams dang sbyar snying po: yang yang len la 'bad 'tshal ma brjed thugs la zungs dang phyi ltar yangs hang ltar la: nang gsang man ngag zab mo yin no nus ldan rdo rje: zhes gsungs so:skabs 'dir 'phags pa'i zhal chems zab mo

kyi yod brgyad re zhig gu rgya: de nas lho nub kyi gru chad kyi nang du sleb tshe thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis longs sku rgyan can 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas te bzhugs pa dang mjal ba'i tshe bdag gis zhus pa kye ma: ma rig 'khrul ba'i 'gro ba dmus longs nyams thag sde tshogs thugs rje lcags kyus bzungs ba'i man ngag zab mo gsung 'tshal: zhes zhus thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di ltar gsungs so:e maḥ chogs smon sngon sbyangs 'phros sad: las can nus ldan 'dus rtsal: zhing 'dir 'byon pa ngo mtshar: gson dang zhal chem bsgo 'o: snang ba lha yis rol ba sgra grags sngags kyi rang bzhin 'gyu 'phro thugs kyi ye shes: ro mnyam kun bzang dgongs pa: g.yel med rtags tu lam khyer dag mnyam dgongs klong yangs par: rtog tshogs ji ltar sharayang: ye shes rig sku chen po'i: rgyas 'debs dag par grol lo: zhe sdang dgra bgegs byung yang byams dang snying rje'i rtsal sbyongs lam grogs zab mor shes nas: chags sdang pham rgyal

ma rtsod: rtse gcig chos la mos yang: nyin gcig chos brgyad dgos pa'i: dbang med rtogs pa mched do: bdud kyi cho rol yin pas: rang sar gcod pa man ngag lha dang bla ma bsgom nas: rtse gcig dben pa brten kyang: skabs thog zug ngu can gyis dgra 'dul gnyen skyong bya bar zhugs 'dod dam sri'i cho 'phrul: de yang rang sar bsgral dgos gzhan phan snying rje chen po gdul bya rjes su skyong yang: nyin gcig nga rgyal che bas: dman sprang sku rtsar mi thon: mtho rlom nyal dga' che zhing bshad sgrub than du brtsi ba: de yang bdud kyi bar chad: rang bab chen por bshig dgos: thob thang snyan grags che ba'i: brgyags te lugs gnyis skyongs shing ma nyan gze re chen po: dgra la rgyal pham mang rtsod 'dren la lta stangs byed cing: gshin par gsur bsngo mi mdzad: e bstod i sbyin snyam pa'i re rlom chags zhen chen po: rnam g.yengs ngang la dus 'da': de yang dam sri'i bar chad: yin pa dbyings su gzhom dgos gcod pa 'drer 'dzin che ba: bud med sdig la rngams shing: bya btang 'du 'di mang ba: bla dpon thob thang mtho ba: sku skyesachos brgyad

rlu dga' ba: dam sri'i bar chad yin pas: bdag med chen por gcod dgos 'jig rten 'khrul snang bkod pa'i blo ma brid la gdangs skyongs: gnad rnamasasems la 'chong shig ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: zhes zer gsungs so: skabs 'di lung byang gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba yod kyang re zhig la gu h+ye:de nas nub byang kyi gru chadakyi nang du sleb tshe thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi longs sku'i chas can yum gsang ba ye shes dang 'khril sbyor mdzad pa: 'khorabyang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul gsol ba 'di ltar gdabs so: kye maḥ ma rigs 'khrul ba'i mun khang bag chags 'tshubs ma'i klong du mgo rmongs byis pa ma lus: bde chen dbyings su bag pheb: ngal bso'i gdam pa zab mo man ngag snying dang 'dra ba: ci nas gsungs bar zhulegs: zhes zhus pa'i thugs rje chen po bder gshegs kun 'dus nyid zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nas 'di ltar gsungs so:e ma: regs mchog nus ldan 'dus rtsal legs

par bdag la gson dang:gangs can bod kyi lha skar:'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang:yid la lan gcig dran pas:lha sku 'bum phrag bsgom dang:'dran zla med pa ngomatshar snying po yi ge drug ma:snyan pos lan gcig brjod dang: bzlas pa sa ya 'bum phrag cha tsam mi nye ngo mtshar:byams dang snying rje zung 'jug 'phags mchog thugs kyidagongs pa:yid la lan gcig dran dang:ting 'dzin mos bsgom brgya phrag:stong gi char yang mi phod:snang ba 'phags pa'i sku dza yid la nges par shes pas lan gcig dgapa dran na:na rags gnas su mi lhung grags pa sngags kyi rol pa:gsungs mchog yi ge drug ma'i:sgra ru legs par go na:'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi 'joms mo 'gyu 'phro rtogasatshogs bsam yas: 'phags mchog thugs kyi rol par lan gcig shes pa tsam gyis:mun pa'i smag rum bral lo: lha sgom sngags bzlas mang po: mi shes sgo mang bya ba'i gcig po 'grub dus mi yongs:de phyir mi skya pho mo:kun gyi skal ba'i lha gcig:'jig rten dbang phyug bsgom la:'phro rgod blo rjes ma 'brang:gsol ba dung dung thob la lus

rlu kyi ba spu gzings tsam mig nas mchi ma 'gril ba dad mos tshad med bskyed na: skad cig 'du 'bral med par: byin rlabs rjes su bzung nas: dngos nyams rmi lam kun tu: zhal gzigs lung ston dbugs dbyung: nam zhig 'phos pa'i tshe na mngon sum spyan sngar 'ongs nas gnas 'dir khrid par ze tshom: yid gnyis mi dgos nges pa de lugs gzhan la ston dang 'gro don rgya chen 'byung ngo: ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: zhes gsungs shing yi ge drug ma'i phan yon zab mo gsungs kyang re zhig la gu h+ye: de nas byang shar gru chad kyis nang du sleb tshe thugs rje chen po ngan song dong sprugs zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dkar gsal longs sku'i cha byed can yum dang 'khril sbyor rol ba de yis mtha' 'khor du byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal zhe sa dang bcas te 'di ltar gsol ba gdab po: kye ma: rgyal kun ye shes rdo rje 'gro 'dren pho nya chen po: skye ba tshe rabs kun tu: lhag pa'i lha / myur ba'i: 'phags bdud 'jomasardo ngasadus mchog ngan songs dongs sprugs: dri bral rol rtsal

dus bde chen rgyal po: yang gsang bdud 'dul du 'gro ba'i nyi ma: dri med nusaldan rdo rje'i dugasu'o pad ma dkar po: gnyis med ro mnyam chen po: bdag la legs par gson dang:zhal chem man ngag zab mo: snying dang 'dra ba gsung ba'i: sku drin dam pa stsol lagasaḥ zhes zhus tshe thugs rje chen po ngan song dong sprugs zhal 'dzum shing thugs brtse ba dang ldan pas 'di skad gsungs so: e ma: skye ba tshe rabs kun tu: dad mos byams brtse ldan pa'i 'gro 'dren mchog gi pho nya: rig mchog nus ldan rdo rje: ma yengs bdag la gson dang: zhal ta tshig gsum bshad do ma brjed rig par rgyas thob: rus rigs bzang por rlom nas gzhan las khyad par 'phags bsam: nga rgyal de tsho spang na nga yi bu chen yin no: kun la dag snang sbyangs shing: log lta'i dgra bo bsad nas mos gus nyi ma shar na: nga yi bu chen yin no: mdzes sdug 'dod yon bkod pa: zhen 'dzin dgra bo bsad nas dgos med rgyud la skye na: nga yi bu chen yin no: 'gro rnams pha ma'i rol bar: gnod sems dgra bo bsad nas: btang snyoms byams pa skye tshe nga yi bu chen dam pa: 'gro

snyi ba'i skyabs mgon gyur pa'i:rdzun sems bslu 'dod bcom nas:bden zhing drang por smras na:nga yi bu bla sgob mthun pa'i sde ma:gnod sems phra ma bcom nas:legs par mthun du 'jug na nga yi bu pha bsad nor rkun 'phrad kyang zhe sdang tshig rtsub bcom nas drang por don ldan brjod na:nga yi bu 'du 'tshogs khrod la bsdad kyang:ngag 'khyal ku re bcom nas 'dod chung bzlas brjod brtson na:nga yi bu 'dod ster sman can mthong yang gsod sems dgra bo bsad nas snying rje'i sgog skyob mdzad na nga yi bu mi med 'dod dgu'i longs spyod:mthong yang rku sems bcom nas:sbyin gtong gnad la 'bad na nga yi bu lha mo mdzes sdug mthong yang:mi tshang tshags spyod spang nas tshul khrims rnam dag bsrungs na:nga yis bu chen rgyal sa bzang po thob kyang:rngam sems bcom nas dag pa'i nyes brgya lnga bcu bsrung na nga yi bu nor gyi mnga' dbang 'byor yangs chags bral byang chub sems dpa'i spyod lam sdom ba bsrungs na:nga yi bu chen dar gos ras 'am mdzes kyang gcer bur rtsa rlung thig ler gnad bsnun bde

drod 'bar na nga yi bu nyon mongs 'bur 'joms byed cing: rtsa khams mdud pa grol la: a nu'i dam tshig bsrung na: nga yi bu phun tshogs gzhi bzung ting 'dzin: khog phub las bzhi'i gzhung bsrengs: lha sngags chos skur mthong na: nga yi gdan gsum lha ru shes shing shes 'jug gnad la sbyor nas rtsa ba yan lags bsrungs na nga yibu chen dam pa: lta ba'i gdar sha gcod cing: sgom pa'i 'od gsal skyongs nas bog 'don spyod pa byas nas: nga yi bu chen dam pa: yin pa med pa'i lta ba: min pa med pa'i bsgom pa mnyam nyid dam tshig bsrung na: nga yi bu chen dam pa: zab gter klong rgyal bkrol zhing: man ngag rang nyams dang sbyar: zab bcud bu la gtad na: nga yi bu byams dang snying rje zab mos: sku tshe bshad sgrub mdzad nas: 'jig rten chos brgyad bor na: nga ya bu zas ngo nor la mi re: chags 'dzin 'dod sred chung zhing: mos gus dag snang che na: nga yi bu phyi nang gsal sgrib mi mnga' nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas la 'ja' lus 'od sku 'grub na: nga yi bu chen dam pa: 'brel ba thob tshad kun gyi:rgyud la thar lam thob nas: tshom

myi bur zhing 'dir 'tshogs na: nga yi bu ma brjed rig pa'i rdo rje: ma yengs nyams len skyongs mdzod: ma zhabrul 'gro don mdzad nas ma rig bzhi la sangs ste:ma lus skye 'gro dang bcas: ma 'gor tshe 'dir byon lags: zhes gsungs la man ngag snying gi nor bu gsung yang gzhan la ston rab med ha ha de nas yang bltas tshe bar khang gi nang gsang 'dus kyi g.yas g.yon mdun ngos gsum gyi log la 'ja' zer thig le 'khrigs pa'i dbus su thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong dang: rigs 'dus bcu gcig zhal don yod zhags pa phyag drug pa rnams 'khor byang chub sems dpa' mched brgyad re'i bskor ba rnams bzhugs pa dang mjal ba'i tshe bdag gis gsol ba 'di ltar btab so kye maX ma rig 'thibs pa'i rgong sbubs: sdug bsngal gsum gyi mnar ba'i: pha ma 'gro ba ma lus thar ba'i man ngag zab mo: ci nas gsung bar zhu'o: zhes zhus tshe thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas 'od zer bye ba brgya phrag drug bcu 'jig rten gyi khams su spros pa las ngan songs gi 'gro ba mang po sgol bar mdzad do: 'od

zer tshur bsdus byin rlabs gzi phyin rab tu 'bar ro: de nas 'di skad gsung so kyenyo rigs bzang nus ldan rdo rje: bskal mang 'gro ba'i mtha' laḥ zad pa'i dus ni med do 'gro 'dul mdzad pa rmad byung: 'khor ba ma stong bar du: thabs dang thugs rjes skyongs dgos: dam bca' rnyel du mi rungs: bdag gis 'khor ba dong nas lan gsum dkrugasanas slar yang: zhing 'dir phyin nas gzigs pa'i: sngar las lhag pa'i 'gro khams: mang por 'dug pa mthong nas: 'gro mtha' zad pa'i dus med: snyam pa'i skyo ba skye nas: dmabaca' cung zad nyams pas: dbu tshal stong du gas tshe rgyal ba 'od stong 'bar ba'i: bdag lus 'di ltar byin rlabs: spyan las bskal bzang sangs rgyas: phyag gis 'khor lobasgyur rgyal spyan las sgrol ma dkar sngon: thugs ga'i gu ru pad+ma: 'gro ba'i don du spros so:ngo mtshar mdzad pa rmad byung bsgrangs na zad mtha' med do: de dag thugs la bzhaganas: zab pa'i smon lam 'di nyid g.yel med dus drug brjod dang: pha nges byin gyis rlabs so: yi/ma ho 'dinas lto 4phyogs rol grangs med mthar dri bsungs sman spos

gyi ngad pa g.yo ba'i zhing rin chen sa gzhi rgya khyon dpag tshad bral: bde 'jams yangs ba'i zhing der skye bar shog: khrus kyi rdzing bu yan lag brgyad dang ldan:gser gyi bye ma g.yu yi ne'u seng brdal: bya rigs du mas chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs: ngo mtshar bde skyid zhing der skye bar shog lha dang mi 'am ci dang dri za sogs: mjes pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo bsam yas pas khrus gar brtse zhing bde skyid nyams dga' spyod bsil ldan gtsang ma'i zhing der skye bar 31ga: chags bral ge sar 'dzum ldan stong gis 'byud nyon mongs bcung nad 'byin pa'i sman sna bkra ro brgya nus ldan 'bras bu kha dog ldan: dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhing der byang chub shing la lo 'dabs myu gu rgyas: pañca li ka yang srab 'jam pa'i 'khyud: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i mchod sprin glu gar sgrogs: bde chen kun 'byung zhing der ma chags skyon bral pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i steng: 'gro 'dren sprul pa 'od dkar rab 'gyed kyis 'brel thog bskal bzang byang sems rig 'dzin la: zab mo chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa'i: gang 'dul dag pa'i zhing der paṇa grub rgya

mtsho la las mnyam par bzhag: re 'ga'i 'bru drug chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs kha cig mchod bstod phyag dang maṇ+ḍal spro: gsang sngags snying po'i zhing der skye bar shog: 4zer 'od lam mdzes pa'i kha dog bkra iṇ+ḍalis gzhir mnan nem bteg na spar byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i 'phro 'du rol: dri bral dga' chen zhing der skye bar rin chen shel gyi gzhal yas khru bzhi pa: tshad med sgo dang mkhyen gnyis sang skar bkra sna tshogs rgyan dang rta bab bang rim mdzes: 'od gsal dag pa'i zhing der skye bar 'dod rnams mchod pa'i lha mo'i rtse gar bsgyur: phyi nang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'khrigs kun tu bzang po'i mchod pas bder gshegs mchod ngo mtshar lhun grungader skye chags bral ge sar thabs shes nyi zla'i steng 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje'i mnga' bdag ni dri med pad+ma dkar po gzi mdangs 'bar: rang snang dag pa'i zhingagayas na 'gro 'dren sras mchog nor bu 'dzin g.yon na lha mo gsang sngags bcud skyongs ma rang mdangs ma 'gas byang chub sems tshogs spro tshom bu rnam dag zhing der

rlu phyogs bzhi'i glo 'bur dag ba'i gzhal yas dbus 'gro ba kun grol sdug bsngal rang grol dang yang gsang bla med phyag na pad ma sogs: 'gro 'dren dag pa'i zhing der rang rang 'khor tshogs bsam mi khyab pa la zag med ting nge 'dzin gyi chos sgra sgogs: bde legs dpal gyi nyi ma gsal bar bskyed: rang gsal dag pa'i zhing der gru chad mdzes pa'i rin chen mig mang la: pad phreng rgyal ba rgya mtsho bder gshegs 'dus: ngan song dong sprugs byang sems 'khor dang bcas: rmad byung 'gro 'dren zhing der de steng lhun grub 'gags med rang gsal zhing longs spyod rdzogs sku gsang 'dus yab yum la: dag grol byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor: bde stong 'gags med zhing der skye 'khor ba dong sprugs stong phrag spyan phyag mnga' skal ldan smin mdzad 'phags mchog bcu gcig zhal: ngan song 'jigs skyobs don yod zhags pa'i skur 'og min rang gsal zhing der yang thog 'od gsal bde stong zhing khams dbus: chos sku'i ston pa sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: dbyer med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs bzhi

la skye 'gags med pa don gyis chos 'khor bskor spros bral yangs pa'i zhing der skye bar shog 'gro ba skyobs mdzad 'phags ma tā re yum gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron ma pad+ma 'byung las can dag pa'i rig 'dzin tshom bu 'khrid: bla med sprul ba'i zhing der bdag la bzang ngan las kyi 'brel ba yi: mi gtsang sgyu ma'i g.yar khang bor ma thag: las snang sdug bsngal skad cig nyid la bcom: ri bo po ta la ru skye khams gsum rigs drug dmus long 'gro ba yi:rgyud la byang chub sems kyi sgron me sbar: las dang nyod mongs sdig sgrib bag chags sbyang: 'phags mchog thugs rje'i zhing der de ma thob pa'i sems can thams cad la: lha mchog nyid kyis rjes bzung byin rlabs shing las ngan srid pa'i rtsa ba drungs 'byin nas: ri bo gru 'dzin zhing du skye bar shogaḥ o ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrīḥ tabya thā pañca tri e baṃ bo dha na ye swā snya ci mang bskyal lo: 'di ltar ma yengs dad pas: smon lam dus drug bskyal na: tshe 'di 'phos ma thag par: zhing 'dir skye bar 'gyur ro: the tshom yid gnyis mi dgos: mi skya pho mo kun la 'di nyid rab tu sgrogs shig: byin rlabs rno so che 'o

rlu ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: zhes gsungs so:skab 'dir thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyis lkog yig le'u bdun pa dang don yod zhags pa'i ngo sprod gab pagacer byung zab mo gsungs yang re zhig dgongs pa'i klong du gu bye de nas phar bltas tshe 'ja' zer stong gi gur khang gi dbus su rje btsun sgrol ma dkar sngon dang: gu ru yidabazhin nor bu bcas bzhugs pa mjal tshe bdag gis gsol ba 'di ltar btab so:kya ma:thugs rdze mnga' ba'i bdag nyid gu ru yid bzhin nor bu:'gro ba'i sdug bsngal selamadzad 'phags ma rje btsun tā re: bdag la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs: las ngan srid pa'i sbubs las: nges par grol ba'i man ngag skyid sdug srid pa'i legs nyes: malus gsung bar zhu'o: zhes zhus pa'i tshe gu ru rin po che'i zhal nasaX kya ho nyes dang nus ldan rdo rje:chu ngu'i dus bzung da bar: 'du 'bral skad cig med par: bdag gis rjesasu bzung nas: nyams rtogs yon tan nar bskyed: rig pa tshad la pheb so: rgyal kun dgongs pa'i yang bcud lkog yig snying byang zab mo: yang yang bshad par byas nas: da ni

blo dang ldan no: 'jig rten chos la ma zhen: zab gter 1nga rgya bkrol nas: chos bdag bu la legs gtad: 'gro don rgya chen 'byung na khyod nyid 'byon pa don dang: ldan no snyingagi bu mchog: bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum: yi dam dgongs pa 'dus pa mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes: rang nyams sbyar nas bsgom na: rtags mtshan khyad par 'phags so skye nas tshe rabs kun tu: 'bral ba med do rig mchog: ma brjed shes rab nyi ma: zhes gsungs so: de nas sgrol ma dkar sngon gnyis kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsungs so e ma nus ldan rig pa'i rdo rje: yengs med bdag la gson dang: zhal byang lung bstan zab mo: rgyas par g.yu lo bkod par: 'phags ma nyer gcig drungs nas: dris len zhimor mdzod dang: srid gsum rnam par gsal la: gnas skabs mthar thug don kun: gegs med ngang gis 'grub po: spangs blang thabs la ma zhen: rgya stag grogs su ma brten khyi nag 'dabs su ma mang 'dod yon chos la ma zhen: zab gter bkrol la ma sob: gdams ngag sbyin la ma zhan: shi mthar tshe sgrub ma sob: de dag thugs la zhog mdzod:

gyi gzhan yang 'phags pa'i gsol 'debs 'di nyid rtag tu brjod dang: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol la: nyams rtogs yon tan rab 'bar: de phyir 'phagasapa'i zhing dang: gzhal yas bkod pa lha rnams: yid la lam mer gsol la: snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas te: e ma bye skal mang gong nas ye sangs rgyas pa'i skuḥ ma chags dribral pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan rdzogs 'gro ba'i mgon chos sku snang mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs: thugs rje chags pa'i btang snyoms gru char 'bebs byams dang snying rje'i 'od zer stong 'bar nas: dad ldan gdul bya'i myu gu smin mdzad pa'iḥ longs sku gsang ba 'dus la gsol shes rab spyan las 'dren pa sangs rgyas stong thugs rje'i phyag gis 'dul mdzad 'khor lo bsgyur: brtse ba'i lcags kyu'i 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: spyan ras gzigs dbang sku la gsol ba 'debs: rmongs pa'i 'gro la chosakyi nyi ma gsal: gdul pa'i blo sbyong tshad med zhags pas bcings: mtshan tsam thos pa ngan 'gro'i g.yang las sgrol: don yod zhags pa'i sku la gsol dri bral shel ltar dkar

ba'i gzi mdangs can:sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad cing:ye shes gsal bas skal ldan ma lus 'dren:'gro ba kun grol mdzad la gsol ba sdug bsngal chu bo'i gnyer ma la g.yeng zhing:ma rig gsum gyis rmongs shing dug lngas gzir:ngan song rgyur spyod 'gro rnams 'dren mdzad pa'i sdug bsngal rang grol sku la gsol byi rus mdog can bde stong zung 'jug sku chags pa'i 'gro ba bde chen sa la sbyor:nyon mongs 'dam rdzab khrod las rab sgol ba'i yang gsang bla med sku la gsol tsha grang bkres skom rmongasapa'i sdug bsngal sel:dbus phongs 'byor rgud las dang nyon mongs skyobs:ma chags dri bral ye shes gsang ba'i sku phyag na pad+ma'i sku la gsol ma chags dri ma'i skyon rnamasakun dang bral:zung 'jug rig sku de bzhin nyid kyi dpal rgyal kun thugs rje'i gter chen 'gro ba'i mgon:pad dkar phreng ba nyid la gsol ba 'debs:blo rmongs byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams:bde chen dga' bzhi'i char gyis ngal bso mdzad:rnam dag 'du ma byas pa'i dbyings su 'dren rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku la gsol thugs rje'i mkha' la ye shes nyi

gyi ma rgyas: ma rigs 'gro sgo'i pad mo zlum pa phye: rtogs pa'i gzi byin skad cig nyid la 'bebs: bde gshegs kun 'dus sku la ngal ba don med 'khor ba dus 'da' rnams: 'phags pa'i thugs rjes nges 'byung skyo shes bskyed: byams pa ting 'dzin rtsol med rdol nas dkrol: ngan songs dong sprugs mdzad la gsol dgos 'dod char 'bebs yid bzhin nor bu 'dzin gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgog 'dzin bde chen yum tshogs brgyad rang grol byang chub sems dpa' brgyad: yab yum 'khor dang bcas la gsol 'jigs brgyad g.yul bzlog 'phags ma tā re'i sku: nyams rtogs rab bskyed rje btsun sgrol ma dkar bod kyi skyabs gcig gu ru pad+ma 'byung lam 'dren 'od dkar 'gyed la gsol bdag sogs deng nas skye dang tshe rabs kun: lha mchog khyod kyi thugs rjes rab bzung nas: las ngan gzungs 'dzin rtsa ba drungs 'byin cing ye shes rig pa mkhyen gnyis sgo 'bar nas: snang ba lhar rdzogs sgra grags sngags su dag: 'gyu 'phro byams dang snying rje'i rtsal 'bar nas: 'brel tshad bzang ngan skye bo kun dang bcas: tshom bu

gcig tu ri bo gru 'dzin zhing: rmad byung ngo mtshar bkod pa'i gzhal yas dbus: lhun grub thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa'i drung: 'khod nas 'gro khams dong sprugs nus parashog: 'di ltar gsol ba btab na: 'phags pa'i rjes su 'dzin zhing: sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i mtsho las bde dge po ta la rtsa ngo mtshar rdzogs sangs rgyas so: the tshom yidaganyis mi dgos: zhes gsungs so: 'di'i skabs su phyogs bcu nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams kyis rol mo sna tshogs bsgrags la rigs kyi bu khyodakyis 'gro khams rgya mtsho dong nas sprugs shing slar zhing 'dir 'byon par mdzad du gsol: zhes gsungs la slar yang 'phags mchog pad+ma dri med dkar po'i spyan sngar 'khod nasagasol ba btab pa: kye ma deng dus 'jig rten yum na: nad mug mtshon gsum 'khrugs cing: mi snyan mi bde'i sgra las: dge ba'i tshig gcig ma mchis: da ni zhing khams 'di na bsdad nas phyir mi ldog go 'phags pa'i rjes su bzungs mtshal: zhes zhus tshe 'phags pa'i zhal nas a ye las ldan bu mchog gson dang khyod kyid sprul ba'i dgos

6 ched: 'jig rten rgud pa gso phyir: 'khor ba'i kha dpon ma yin: thams cad chos la spyod na 'dren pa'i ston pa mi dgos: sdug bsngal gzing pa 'khrug pa'i 'dul byed dus la bab pas: rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing nas: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bsrungs skyabs: mkha' 'gro dam can bran bkol gu ru'i dbang bskur lung gnang zab gter pha phog sbyin la: bod khams skyobs phyir bkrun no: 'di ru sdod pa'i dus min: de 'dra'i bsam spyod ngan pa: sems can rang ga ma ltar:bdag gis bka' gsang bsgrub nas: zhal chem gong nas bsgo ltar: ma g.yel nus ldan rdo rje: zhes gsungs tshe 'phags mchog mi dgyes 'dug snyams nas 'di skad gsol to kye ma: bdag dang 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon: byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung gnas: da ni nges par nga 'gro thugs rje byin gyis brlabs pa'i: smon lam bdag la stsol cig zhes zhus so: 'phags mchog zhal 'dzum thugs brtse ba chen po phyag g.yas rang gi mgo la bzhag nas 'di ltar gsungs so: 'o rigs kyi bu khyod kyi thugs rgyud la byams dang snying rje

ting 'dzin zab mo 'khrungs nas chos min gyi bya ba la blo mi 'jug par shog cig: 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bya ba rgyab tu bor nas zab mo'i chos gter la longs spyod par gyur cig: yang dag pa'i lta ba rtog nas chags sdang gzung 'dzin gyi ri bo rmings nas bgyil bar shog cig: lam stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug tu bsgom nas rig pa'i nyi ma yongs su gsal bar gyur cig: spyod pa dran shes kyis rgyud bsdam nas 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyi chos 'khor bskor nas rgyud la byang chub gyi sems rin po che ngam ngam shugs la 'byung bar shog: chos dang zas nor gos longs spyod sogs kyi dngos po'i 'brel ba thob pa'i sems can thams cad thar ba'i lam la 'god nus par zhog cig: sku mthong ba dang mtshan thos pa yid la dran pa sogs kyi gang zag de dag gi rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon zhog nas khyod kyi gdul byar gyur bar shog cig: zab mo chos gter nyams su blang zhing bsnyen bsgrub mdzad pa bshad sgrub gyi legs rjes mnga' ba gsungs bri ba sogs kyi thugs rgyud la nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'khrungs nas rnga yab dpal gyi ri la phyin par sgo ga

rlu cig: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis de ltar du 'grub par gyur cig: 3sna dhu ru dhu ru dhu ru dza ya mu khe swā hāX zhes gsungs so: de nas mar la 'ong skabs gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol ljon bzang lo 'dab rgyas pa'i rtsar sleb tshe dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos khri bdun phyi brdar mchod 'bul maṇ+ḍal spro zhing 'dug: 'di ci yin smras tshe dpa' bo zhig na re: 'jig rten khams nas 'gro don rdzogs pa'i skyes bu sa man+ta bha tra: 'gro 'dul rtsal: rtogs pa'i rdo rje: ye shes nyi ma: chos dbyings rdo rje: nor bu don 'grub: byams pa rang byung sogs 'byon yongs dgos pas chas ga bsgrigs pa yin zer ro: de nas 'phags pa'i gsol 'debs brjod bzhin par rang yul du sleb tshe sna ba mched tshe mnal sad do: e ya de ltar dri bral pad+ma dkar po yi zhing gi bkod pa ngo mtshar dga' ba'i gnas: thos tshogs rgyud kyi dgongs pa ngas mi shes: 'gal ba byung yang rmi lam 'khrul snang bkod: snyan ga ldeb sbyor mdzes chos bsre bsla bral: rnam rtogs blo yis dpyad pa'i skyon ma gos: 'grigs sam

'thad dam snyam pa'i the tshom grol ma bcos rang rdol gdams pa 'di dag brtsams:su ma mgu yang ban spyon zhe blo bde dengs dus gter min gter 'dra mang na yang:ngo mtsharazhing gi bkod pa'i lo rgyus dang:gter gyi btad rgya 'byung tshul zab pa'i sgo:yid ches skye ba'i los rgyus bsnyad rgyu dkon:de dag mthong na ngas 'di ya mtshan che:chos brgyada'adod pa'i re ba gang yang med:mi mos pa la phyogs tsam bstan pa min:dad ldan re ba skongs shing tshogs gnyis kyis bsags sbyangs spel gsum bsgrub pa'i zhing sar bstan zas ngo nor la rngams nas btsong ba min:dad ldan re re'i rgyud la thar lam gyi:sa bon yang dag e zhog bsam nas bkod 'phags pa'i las smon mthu yis phan thog 'byung zog po zer yang bsam rgyu chos las med:gter rdzun zer yang zab chos dbang med rdol:mi ngan zer yang gzhan blo dmigs ma myong:blo mang zer yang mthun mor 'gal ma shor sob rgan zer yang rang rig bor ma myong:sprang po zer yang chos brgyad mgo ma 'khor:su ma mgu yang ban spyon zhe blo bde:rgad po kun nyi'i gnas tshul 'di 'dra yin:dad ldan

྅ slob bu rnasam kyi thugs nyams bzhes 'di bzhengs dge ba'i mar gyur 'gro rnams kun ri bo po ta la ru skye bar re ga: zhesapa 'di yang sngon smon lam las kyi 'brel ba'i chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang chos bdag 'gyur med rgya mtshor dar dang rin po che'i sgod 'byu yis bkang ba dang slob bu pad+ma rnam rgyal gyi dar dang rtse rgyal rdo rje ldem sgo thabs shes nya zla nor bu dang bcas pa rin chen gnyis pa'i mdzes par byas pa dbang lnga'i cod paṇa bkra shis la rdzas kyi phra can sogs dang bcas te yang yang bskul ba dang / khyad par du 'gro ba' dal rten 'phags pa'i zhing bkod bzhengs pa'i dam bca' ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su mthong ba dang / slob bu chos gsal ye shes chos grags rnams kyis bskul ba dang / khyad par grogs mo rat+na sa ra'i yang yang bskul ba don dang ldan pa'i phyir du sprul minganusaldan rdo rjes phab pa dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ legs so/ sarba masgo la/
(ཿ dag snang lasaḥrdzogs pa chen po gnas lugs gcer mthong bzhugasaḥ

rtsi brdal khyab rang byung ye shes la phyag 'tshal loḥ rnam par rtog gsum rkyen bzhi'i cho 'phrul du sna tshogs snang yang de ltar rang bzhin med mdod ma'i gshisalugs spros dang bral ba rtsa 'khor 'das chos rnams rdul tsam grub pa med yod min med min ngo rang thugs rje'i 1nga bcing grol las 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i zhal 'dusam byas pa mkha' mnyam yangs pa'i gshis blo bral so so rang rig rjen pa'i yulaḥ sa ma yāX gzhi rgyud ngos bzung ba'oX rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid kyi 1nga yangs par rol pa 'gags med cir snang 'khor 'das chos snang ba nyid na stong pa'i bdag nyid de snang stong zung 'jug sus kyang dgags sgrubs med mnyam nyid don la yid ches gdengs rnyed na srid pa'i 'khor lo bcom pa'i man ngag yinaḥ sa ma yā snang stong zung 'jug tu la bzla ba'o sgo lnga yul lnga cha mnyam la bzhag deḥ kun gzhi rnyogs ma'i rgong sbubs las gton nasaX rang byung ye shes ther la phud mkhas naX sems kyi gsang ba gzhug ma'i ye shes mjal dwangs snyigs skabs dbye gnas yun don la bltaḥ gsal cha sangs cha har

gyi sangs zang thal skyongasaX 'gyu tsam rjes med grol cha shin tu gnad dad pa'i mthu'i drangs mos gus rjen pas bskulaḥ thugs yid dbyer med 'di ni zab pa'imachogaḥ sa ma yāḥ ma rig rgong nga'i sbubs 'byed pa'oX rnam rtog 'tsho skyong byed pa ngal ba'i rgyuḥ bde gsal mi rtog skyongs ba sems kyi 'phrangaḥ shes pa dbyings thog bzhag pa'angaphyi gdang tsam btang snyoms lung ma bstan gnas 'bras bu chung ched 'dzin spu tsam yod na sems kyi g.ya'aX stong cha ched du mi bton rig cha gtsoX rnam rtog mthar 'ded mi bya grol cha gnadaX rnams shes had gsal mi dmigs sangs cha phyungs de lta na phyir blo bral kho na gnadaḥ sa ma yāḥ srid pa'i drwa ba gcod pa'oX brjod du med do spros pa'i mtha' lasa'adasaX bsam du med do dmigs pa'i shom ra dbenaX blta ru med do yul las rnam par 'das dpyad du med do sems kyi 'ching rgya grolaX bsgom du med do dran 'dzin shub nasabatonaX dmigs su med do yid chos zag pa boraX kun yin cha mnyam blo bde yangs pa'i klong dmigs gtad bral ba khyab brdal gcig gi klong re dogs mi dmigs bde ba

chen po'i klongaXspros kun bral ba 'od gsal zang thal klongaḥbasam gyis mi khyab sgro btags bral ba'i klong ngo rang thugs rje ris med bde mnyam klongaḥ'ub chub gtinganang dbyings ka dag klongaḥmatshan ma rang grol kun bzang khyab brdal klongaX gnyen po mi dmigs dran bsam bral ba'i klongaX bag chags ming med kun gzhi'i g.ya' daspangs bya rang dag rig ngar rjen pa'i slongaḥstong la 'gags med snyoms 'jug dben pa'i klong gsal la mi 'phro gzugs khams grol ba'i slong rig la mi 'dzin 'a sems grol 1ngaXdabang yul shes pa cha mnyam phyam brdal klongaXrtsol sgrub rtsis gdab bya bral nyal chog klong 'bad med gdeng bzhi'i drod tshad thob pa gces sa ma yāXltar mnyam pa'i don bstan pa'oḥm byas lhun grub dag snang dad pa 'phelaX rtsol sgrub dben par sa lam nyam rtsal rdzogs gsar byung nyam kun rang zhig rang grol nas bu kun bzang bla ma'i sa la 'khyolaXyang dag chos sku mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas kyiXrtags rnams lhun grub gzugs sku'i 'gro ba 'dul 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa ma

phyi 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāX 'bras bu gtan grol gyi sa bstan pa'oḥ 'bum phrag rgyud kyi bdag mo ral gcig mar bka' 'di gnyer bcol g.yel med thub par srungs drod 'dzin gdul zhing skal ldan smin cing grol 'brel tshad don ldan 'od lus mngon gyur teḥ sku dang ye shes chen por dbang bsgyur shogaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhesapa 'ang snying nor mun sel dang sgrub brtson mthar phyin nas yang yang bskul ngor/ 7 sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bdud 'dul rol pa'i rdo rjes spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lo/
rluḥ zab pa'i gnad kyi zin bris 'bru 'grel du bkod pa don gsal sgron me zhes bya baḥ

rlu: khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa dpal mgon bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo gang 'chad bya rdzogs chen gnas lugs gce 'di la don gsum lasaḥ klad don/ gzhung don/ mjug don no/ dang po la/ mtshan don dang / mchod brjod gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzungs 'dzin yid chos kyi spros pa nga nyid kyi dbyings su dag pa dang / de nyid kyi ngang las lhun grub 'og min gyi gnas dang dus ston 'khor chos phun sum tshogs par snang zhing / so so ma yin tha mi dad par brda snyan brgyud kyis tshul las:chos kun mnyam nyid ye sangs rgyas par rdzogs pa chen po dang / 'khor 'das gnyis chos su bcos bsgyur ba byas pa'i yin lugs chen poḥm gshis kyi gnas snyags smra bsam dpe brjod kyi yul las 'das mod kyang don brgyud dgongs pa'i gzi byin gyi mthus bzhugs chul ji bzhin pa gcer bur byung nas chebyung nas rjen par mthong ba'i man ngag gi yang zhun 'di nub par phang zhing gdul bya tshogs smon las 'dzoms kyi slad du gsal bar byas nasa'adir bzhugs par byas so/

rnu ba bsgrags shing bka' drin dran phyiradagos ched gsum dang ldan par bstan pa'o: gnyis pa ni/ gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings rnam kun mchog ldan gyi bdag nyid can de yi 'khor 'das ye mnyam du brdal zhing khyub pa dang / rang byung ye shes kyis gzigs pa phyogs dang ris su ma chad par lhun grub bum pa sku'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa la ngo mtshar yid ches glo thub dang ldan pas lta ba mjal phyagu phul zhing gnyis su med par 'tshal lo zhes thugs yid bsres la snod rung du gnas nas gdul bya yongs la phrin las 'jug pas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'jog pa'i don no/ gnyis pa la/ gzhi lam 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ thog ma'i spyi gzhi 'dus ma byas par lhun grub ye mnyam chen por bcing grol med par bzhugs mod kyang glo bur 'dus byas 'phral gyi rkyen ngo bo la rmongs pa'i bdag nyid gcig pu dang / 'od gsal la rmongs pa'i lhan skyes dang /rig pa ye shes ma rmongs pa kun btags zhes rnam par rtog pa tsam gsum du mched la/ gzhi ma rmongs kyang lam rmongs pa rgyu'i rkyen dang / rtog pa tsam pa bdag po'i rkyen dang /

rang ngo la dmigs pas rkyen dang / yul phyir 'khor ba de ma thag rkyen dang bzhi'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i cho 'phrul du ngo bos yul gyi 'khrul gzhi gnas te ngang mdangs skudang ye shes nang dbyings su nub pa dang / rang bzhin gyis sgod bcud kyi 'khrul gzhi byas te rang mdangs rang 'od la bsdus te phyi mdangs su mched pa dang / rig pa sems kyi'akhrul gzhi byas te stong gsal mdangs lnga shes rig gi rwa bar nub nas 'od lnga ris chad du snang zhing rim par 'thas te 'byung ba dwangs snyigs phyes nas sna tshogs chos khams rgya mtsho'i snang ba 'gags med du snang la/ shes pa dwangs snyigs phyes nas sems rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad du 'byung la dug lnga'i rtog pa me lta bu las rnam rtog bde sdug bar mthams cad me rtag ltar bsam mtha' yas par snang na yang / don du med snang stong gzugs tsam las 'khrul ba'i snang zhen de ltar rang bzhin gyis grub pa med la: gdwod ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po'i zhal ras sam gshis snyags ma bcos pa'i ngos na spros mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yi bdag nyid can de mā gzhi la 'khor ba ma grub 'khor ba

blu: gzhi la 'char rung / 'das pa gdos por mi dmigs rten 'brel tsam du blos dmigs pa ste/ don la chos thams cad rnam pa kun tu rdul phran nyag ma'i tsha tsam yang grub pa med te/ yod pa min te ye grol kun bzang / med pa min phyir 'gags med rgyan rdzogs/ ngo bo stong pas rtag pa'i mtha' grol: rang bzhin gsal bas chad pa'i mu med/ thugs rje'i gzigs pas gnyis 'dzin rgya grol/ 1nga chen nam mkha' de ltar yin no/ zhes pa ltar na ma bcing pas na su spyol te mtha' de gnyis las 'das pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yin lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i zhal ras sam dkyil 'khor yang dag pa ste rgyu rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas pa/ gdos mtshan las 'das pas mkha' ltar dag pa/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pas mnyam nyid chen po/ phyogs dang ris med klong chen yangs pa'i gshis de ni gzhi'i bzhugs tshul ste/ 'di ni spyo yid las dben cing 'dzin pa dang bral bas ye gnas so so rang rig pas shes rab chen po' mthong ba dang ldan pa'i ye shes rjen pa'i spyod yul yin pas ji skad du/ sla bas yid ma ches pa sems kyi gsang / bla

ma'i man ngag stobs kyis mthong bar shog gsungs pa ltar/ don brgyud dgongs pas byin rlabs can gyi bla ma dam pa la brten cing ltems rkyang med pas mos gus dag snang gsol btab thugs yid bsre ba sogs kyi mthu la brten dgos pas na dam tshig de las ma 'da' zhes par sa ma ya/ zhes pas chings kyis bcing la gzhi rgyud ngos bstong ba'am don khrid bshad pa'o/ gnyis pa la/ sbyi'i go don dang / khyad par ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ da lta lam dus su sna tshogs 'khor 'das kyi chos khams rgya mtsho gzhi las ma g.yos bzhin tu gzhi snang mched tshul ni/ rang bzhin yin lugs kyi cha nas spros med ye mnyam chen po gdod ma nas stong chen khyab cing brdal ba ka nas dag pa nyid snyi mkha' klong rgya khyon yangs par sna tshogs sku ru shar kyang sku la gdos mtshan ma grub grags stong sngags su shar yang sgra mtshan rang bzhin gyis ma grub/ rtog tshogs thugs su bzhugs kyang ris chad blo ru ma grub/ phrin las 'khor 'das shar kyang rang bzhin gshis la ma grub/ yon tan ye sangs rgyas pas gsar sgrub 'dus byas su ma grub pas na rol pa 'gags med kyi chos ni
