kyi dag cing lhar shar yang shar grol ris med cir yang snang na'ang snang stong zug 'jug chen po ste 'khor ba spangs med gzhi la dag mnyam 'das pa sgrub med lam la 'ub chub thams cad mnyam brdal chos nyid kyi yo lang nyid du rang shar rang grol la thal bas snang ba nyid na stong/ stong bzhin pa nyid du na snang ba 'gags med du mched pa'i bdag nyid can du bzhugs pa yin twe/ stong pa las 'das de snang/ snang ba bcad shul gyi sto pa ltar min par/ de gnyis phywang 'jug chen por bzhugs pa las snga phyi bar gsum du stsas kyung dgags sgrub bcing grol byas pa med pas na/ snang stong dbyer med mnyam pa nyid kyi don ji bzhin nyid la ngo 'phrod par byas nas de'i ngang bskyangs shing yid ches par sa bzung nas gdeng nges par rnyed na lam dbu ma'i dgongs pa ste srid pa bag chags kyi mdud pa'i bcing pas rten 'brel gyi 'khor lor don dam spros bral du bcom pa'i zab lam bla na med pa'i man ngag yin te/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha'i/ theg pa chuja ngus chos 'di la/ the tshom tsam yang za mi 'gyur/ the tshom tsam zhing za gyur na/ srid pa hrul bor byed

par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar snang stong zung 'jug gi don la mnyam par bzhag pa las ma 'da' zhes pas sa ma ya/ de'i phyir na chos thams cad snang stong rnyang 'jug tu la bzla ba'i thag gcod par byed pas don khrid bstan zin pa'o/ gnyis pa la/ lta ba dang/ bsgom pa/ spyod pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar/ dbu ma'i ltab ltar snang stong zug 'jug la go ba gshis phyin pa thob nas myong ba cung zad kyang yod nges par dgos la/ de yang phyi snang stong nam mkha' mngon gyur tsam yin gyi/ don nang gsalastong sems kyi rang zhal 'tsho dgos pas de yang dbang po sgo lta po cha mnyam la bzhag cing ris su ma chad par gnas nyams gsal por byung ba dang / snyal 'dod yon lha cha mnyamal bzhag tshe ma 'gags par der 'dzin dang bral bar sang nge shigs se khrol ler gnas de/ yul thun ne+e ba sgo yul la sang dngas ma thon pa yid yin gyi shes rab ma yin/ shes parmongs 'thum gsal rig grol ngar dang bral ba de shes pa gcer mthong tsam yin gyi rig pa ma yin kyang / dang po der brten nas gdod dngos gzhi 'byung dgos kyi/ da dung kun

rnu gzhi rnyogs ma'i rdul dang ma bral pa phra gsal ba'i kun gzhi 'di la gzigs nas mthar thug du 'jog pa mang yang / rang lugs la gsang ba gting gsal rigapa'i rang zhal mjal phyir/ shes rab gyi phyi gdang la mi blta bar nang du zhal kyu tsam pa zhig gis ye shes kyi mthong phye zhing / kun gzhi'i rtong sbubs las bton nas rig pa'i yeshes ngo bo stong la ngar cha dang ldan pa rang bzhin gsal la sangs cha yang 'dzom pa thugs rje rig la grol cha phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing bying rmug 'thib pa ma bsal rang grolal 'gro ba'i yud tsam pa de rig pa 'bras sne'u lta bu gsung ba de yin gyi/ 'di la rang byung ye shes ther la bud ces kyang zer/ gnyug ma tha mal gyis shes pa rjen rnar 1da pa yinate/ thabs la mkhas pas mos ldan la dgongs brgyud byin rlabs kyi drod tshad 'byung ba'am/ tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs kyi mthu la brten nas 'byung ba yin na'ang rung la/ don dusems ma yin la sems las gzhan pa'ang min par re sems skyu gsang ba dus gsum gyi gsang ba dus gsum 'khrul rtog tha mal gyi shes pa dang / sgom nyams dbang skyes blo yi

shes pa gang yang ma 'dres pas bzhi cha gsum bral gyi rig pa gnyug ma'i ye shwes nang dbyings gting gsal gyi shes rig mjal ba yin la/ 'di dus ngar dwangs grol gsum dngam bral bar gnas yun thon la der 'dzin gyi nyams ma skyes pa na tshogs yul rig pa'i rnam ldan du shar la yid chos kyi mun pa'i gzhi mi tshug pas na nyi ma'i ngos na mun pa btsalakyang mi rted pa ltar rig pa'i ngos na ma rig pa mi mnga' bas dwangs snyigs kyi skabs rang shugs la dabhe zhing 'byed pa yin pas/ de lta'i lhag mthong rig grol gnyis ldan de yunathung grangs mang du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshangs bar goms pas mthu la gnas pa'i yun mnyam rjes 'dres pa nyin mtshan 'od gsal 'khor yug la 'char gyi bar de don la lhodadwangs grol gsum 'dzom par yang yang blta dgos/ bsgom med gsungs na'ang yengs 'khrul med pa zhig la bya yi/ 'khrul 'byams su song ba zhig yin na sems can thams cadartogs ldan du thal lo/ gsal zhes pa'ang yin gsal nyams can zhig min par ye shes gting gsal la bzhed pa yin/ sangs ba yang sgo lnga rtog med la sems rtog med kyis

rlu: bltas tsam min par rmongs sgrib bral ba'i shes rab kyi srog dang ldan pas mkhyen gzigs kyi sangs cha 'dzoms pa zhig yin dgos so/ stong nyams mi rtog zun po hār sangs la bor nas rig pa ngo bo ye grol/ rang bzhin rang grol/ thugs rje shar grol la 'gro ba'i zang thal bar med gyi shes rig de ngo 'phrod nas ngang skyongs kyi bar lta ba yin la/ 'dir 'gyu brtswam yod kyang g.yo ba med pa dang / shes tsam pa ngang mngon gyur du lags kyang 'dzin pa rjes med la bor nas/ snga phyi bar med shar grol cha mnyam du 'gro ba zhig yin pas shin tu gnad che bas gsang ba chen pa'o/ don dam chos nyid kyi bden pa'i rang zhal de dad pa'i mthu'i dungs ba'i/ bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma dam pa la ltems rkyang med pas mos gus rjen pas bskul nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la 'drongs dgos pas thabs kyi rgyal po de rnam pa kun tu rje btsun dam pa'i thugs dang rang gi yid dabher med du bsre ba ste 'di ni man ngag zab pa'i mchog tu gyur ba yin pas/ de yang yas mas gyi brgyud pa kun 'dus o rgyan rje dang bla ma rin po che gnyis rnams

dbyer ma mchis pa la gsol ba 'debs cing rnal 'byor la 'bad pa las mi 'da' bar bskul bas sa ma swā dang / 'dinim rig rtong nga'i sbubs 'byed pa dang yang dag pas ltab rtogs par byed pa'i don khrid bstan pa'o/ gnyis pa la/ bzhag thabs dang / rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi bzeng bston pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lar stong 'dzin gyi mdud pa dmal ched 'dzin che ba dang / sdug btsur a 'thas kyi dran pa brten pa dang / shes pa bzo med tsam skyongs ba sogs mang yang / de dag ni ngal ba 'bras chung yin phyir mkhas pa dgagis 'char gzhi'i rigs cha skyong rgyu las rnam rtog 'tsho skyongs byed pa la don rtsa chung gsung bas na ngal ba'i rgyu ru mngon 'dug ste/ 'khrul rtog tha mal gyi shes pa dag dgos pa'iphyir ro/ res bde nyams 'bol le ba myong zhen can/ res gsal nyams zhen bcas zhen med sna tshogs pa dang / res mi rtogā rmug po gsal dwangs mi byed pa rtog bcas rtog medadang / res stong nyams rtsub nyams mtha' yas par 'char kyang de dag dam par mi 'dzin/ ched du mi spangs/ spang gnyen mi sprad par gang yang thugs 'phrad rjes med la bzhag pas

gyi rang zhig rang yal la 'gro ba yin/ de dag dam par bzung nas rtsom na mi rigs ste/ sgom nyams tha mal gyi shes pa grol dgos pa'i phyir na/ de dag skyongs ba ni sems snyi 'phrang chen po'o/ yang phyi dbyings nam mkha' stong pa la/ nang dbyings dbang po'i zhes pa stong gsal/ gsang dbyings yid shes dngas gsal dbyer med du bsres nas de thog tu bzhag pa'ang snga ma rnam pa lam byed dang 'di yang rnam pas ngo bo lam byed dam shes rab gyi sgyi gdangs tsam skyong ba yin gyi/ rig pa'i nang dbyings mtsho ba ni ma yin rgo/ phal cher btwang snyoms lung ma bstan par lus ste sgo yul shes pa cha ma mnyam: kun gzhi'i rmongs g.ya' ma sel/ rig pa'i gsal dwangs ma thon shar grol rjes med la ma song bar gnas nyams phyal chad de ba bying rmug gi rtsi dang ma bral bar sgom pa dag la ni 'bras byu snyeng la gud dogs so/ yang nga yi lta ba ni mtho sgom 'di ltar bu'o/ ya mtshan che snyams pas ro stod gzeng ba/ rgyag brod pa/ dpe cha'i go rtog dang bsdur ba dpyad ra byed pa ni lha mthong sgrib byed gyi dri ma yin pas ched 'dzin spu tsam yod na sems snyi g.ya' ma

dag pas blo bral rang bzhag gi nyams len ni ma yin no/ res rtog pa ma 'gyus pas stong zhen phyam me ba/ blo bde ba/ myong rgyu'i gsal cha cung zad yod pa re 'char na'ang / de ched du mi bton par gnyug ma'i rig cha zang ma de ga rkyong ba ni gtso shin tu che'o/ phal cher gyis rnam rtog la skyon du blta yang de ni mi dgos par/ shar cha ji tsham mang yang / sku gsum de tsam mang bas/ gang shar shar du chug la shar grol ris med du thong / gang 'gyu 'gyu ru chug la 'gyu bar rang sar zhog gang dran dran du chug la dran pa byung rgyal la thong / gang bsam bsam du chug la dpyod pas rjes ma mthud dang las dang rnam smin bsogs par mi 'gyur bas na rnam rtog la rtsis gdab dang bcas bcos mthar 'ded bcing bkrol gang yang mi byu bar bzhag pas shar spyol ris med kyi cha ru phyin 'gro ba gnad gsang ngo/ de la sgo lnga la mi dmigs/ rnam shes la mi dmigs: had po stong pa la mi dmigs/ gsal ba yid shes la mi dmigs par bzhag pa ste/ bsam dang bsam bya rab tu spangs nas su/ bsam med bu chung bzhin tu gnas bya zhing / zhes dpal sa ra ha pas bzhag thabs

blu: bstan pa ltar bltar med lta ba nam mkha' ltar du bzhag pa dang / sgom med sgom pa rgya mtsho cog bzhag dang / rtsol med spyod pa man ngag cog bzhag dang / blo 'das rig pa 'bras bu cog bzhag tu bya ba la sangs cha phyungs brjod pa yin la/ de lta na snyir yid dpyod blo yi rnam pa med par so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi 1 bral de kho na nyid du rtogs pa ni gnad che shos zhig yin phyir/ sgom phyogs dris lan las/ de phyir dbang po ma 'gags par/ shes pa yul dang ma 'dres na/ dbang skyes blo yi rnam pa med/ de ni sems las 'das pa yi/ rig pa blo 'das chen po ste/ dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ gshegs shul yin no snying la phur/ zhes gsungasapa ltar chos sku kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa de bzhin nyid las ma 'das zhes pas sa ma swā dang / theg tshogs blo yi nyams len kun rdzob srid pa'i drwa ba mtha' dag gcod cing chos nyid rang khar gnas pa ngang bzhag blo 'das su la bzla ba'i don khrid bstan pa'o/ gnyis pa la/ blo 'das kyi yon tan spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag srid gsum ka dag gi dgos pa bshad pa'o/ dang po ni/ lta

ba'i yin lugs shes rig zang thal ma bcos pa 'di ka mtshan ma tshig gi lam du brjod du med mod kyang ngo rang thog tu sprad pa'i brda thabs mtshon tsam nyid du bstan par zad do/ci'i phyir na blo yis rdul ma 'dres pas med pas dang / dran 'dzin gyi shub nas bton la gcer bur byung bas gcig pu dang / yin pa'ang med de khas len sgrog grol/ min pa'angamed de ye grol dag mnyams so/ bsgom pa'ang med de dmigs gtad kya kyu'i 'phrang grol/ mi bsgom pa'ang med de 'khrul rtog rang zhig la song nas rig pa rten med du shar/ spro sapa'i chos dben te tha snyad kyi sgrogs grol/ stong dang mi stong phyam brdal la song / snang dang mi snang zang thal la bor te mtha' kun las 'das pa'i phyal ba/ bsam pa'i rgya grol nasabyar med la song nas gang du ngos bzung med do/ dmigs pa'i stod phur phyungs te kun rtog gyi shom ra gang gis kyang dben pas bcing med grol med du song / blta ru med do zhes phyi nang gi gzung 'dzin nang gsal la nub te gnyug ma'i ye shes gnyis chos kyi yul las rnam par 'das pa'o/ gnas 'gyu'i shan 'byed dang mngon lkog 'gyu ba'i rtsis gdab

rnu: thams cad dang bral ba na daphywad du med/ zhi bar gnas pa'i nyams dang bde gsal mi rtog pas khun pa mtha' dag bor bas ses kyi do zhes pa dang / 'ching rgya spyol la/ lhag ger sngags med gsar du byung ba'i 'du byas kyi shes pa ched du bton nas bsgom du ci yang med do/ de bas na dun 'dzin phra ba tsam gyi ma gos par dpyod shes kyi shub nas btwon pa zhig nges par dgos/ klong chen yangs dogs bral ba chos nyid kyi gshis su ye babs rang chas su lhun grub bum pa sku'i rgyal srid la/ kun nyon ma rig pas dmigs pa tsam gyi ni ci yang mthong ba dab darngas sgyu mjal rgyu ma grub cing mad da/ ca' phyir na yid chos kyis zag pa bor ba la de'i yul du ma gyu pa'i phyir ro/ rdzogs pa chen po'i ye shes kyi nyi ma klong nas shar bas rig pa rang snang gi blo can zhig yin na/ rin po chemi gser gling du byin pa dang 'dra mtshungs bar gang snang thamasacad rin chen 'ba' zhing las sa rdo phal ba btsal kyang mi rnyed pa ltar/ gang snang rig pa'i yo langs/ gang shar ye shes kyi cho rol du sad de thams cad kun tu bzang po' dgongs klong nyag gcig gi rang

zhal yin pas spangs blang dang dgag sgrub bsal bzhag mi dmigs pas cha mnyam pa'o/ yid ma ches pa med cing mchog 'dzin grol ba/ blo mi bde ba med par kud yangs nyal du lags pas na/ rje mi las/ shugs 'byung gnyug ma'i ngang du bde/ tshogs drug rang sar bzhag pas bde/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes gsal bas bde/ yid kyi 'gro 'ong chad /bde/ gsungs pa ltar snang ba yang khrol le/ shes pa sang phyam mer gnas pa'i klong dus bzungs ba yin phyir/ grub chen sha ba ri pas/ rlung ni mi bzung yid ni mi bcing bar/bcos shes pa bu chung lta bur shog: gsungs pas na lta ba nam mkha' klong yang de 'dzin gyi blo bral zhing zang thal klong nas shar ba/ bsgom pa 'od gsal 'khor yug bying 'thib pa'i rdul dang bral ba/ spyod pa 'ja' tshon lta bu shar ba gdos mtshan dang bral bar rang shar rang grol la song nas phar dmigs gtād ma byas/ tshur btang bzung dang ba ru dbyer med khyub cing brdal bar gnas pa ste/ khyab brdal chen po re dogs mdud pa grol/ zhes pa ltar cha mnyam rig stong zang ma gcig gi 1nga du/ snyems byed kyi ba

myi pos re rtogs dang 'dzin stangs phra ba tsam gyis mi dmigs par gsang ba'i dgra gsum ye grol du btul/ gnas pa'i bdud bzhi gshis grol la btang / bag chags kyi gnas drug yul med la sangs nas bde ba chen po' 1 du gnas thub dgos so/ gnyis pa la/ khams gsum yongs grol dang / srid gsum ka dag gi dgongs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ theg tshogs blo yi grub mtha' dang / sa lam gyi spros pa bsam mtha' yas mod kyang / de kun gang gis bcos bslad 'dzin rtsol dang bral bar 'jog dgos kyi/ 'og ma'i lam la mi rig rig pa'i gnad yod pas phyir ro: gabhe la blo yod de la kun gzhi yang yod/ gang la rnam shes yod tsa na gzugs kyang yod/ gang la yid yod pa na 'dod pa'ang yod pas/ nges par 'khrul ba rang sangs ba'i 'od gsal gyi 'khor yug za ma thal byung rig pa'i klong du gnas pa zhig yin nges pa ste/ bsam sgyus mi khyab cing sgro btags kun rdzo ba kya bden pa lam du byed pas blo bral ba'i 1 so so rang rig pa' ye shes kyi spyod yul yin pa'i phyir ro/ ngo bo'i stong gdangs la bltas pa'i gzugs

med pa'i khams mi grol te/ngo bos yul gyis 'khrul gzhi byed pa dang / rang bzhin gyi gsal gdangs la bltas pas gzugs kyi khams mi grol ste/ de'i snod bcud kyi 'khrul gzhibyed pa dang / thugs rje yi gdangs 'gyu la bltas pas 'dod pa'i khams mi grol ste/ de'i sems kyi 'khrul gzhi byed pa'i phyir ro/ de lta na mod gdangs thog la rtsal ma yin par/gshis thog tu rtsal shar grol la song nas khams gsum yongs grol gyi dbyings su ris med bde mnywam klongs yangs su skyong ba'o/ des na 'khor 'das 'ub chub kyi thum par gting gsal phra ba'i ye shes shes rab kyi nang dbyings rig pa ka dag gi klong chen por yan pa'o/ blo yi mtshan ma sems yul rang spyol la thal ba'i kun bzang skye 'gags med pa'i dgongs nyams kyis srid zhi ming med mnyam sbyor khyub brdal gyi klong mtshan ma bcing grol las 'das pa'i chos sku'i dgongs pa skyong ba'o/ mnyam bzhag gi nyams len gang zhig la gnyen po dran pas mi 'chor bas dmigs pa yod na/ spangs bya 'khrul rtog yod kyi de ma yin te/ tshogs brgyad kyi dun bsam dang phung lnga'i dri ma bral ba'i 1nga dag

myi mnyams yin pa'i phyir ro/ lhag par don gyi kun gzhi la nam mkhar gnas pa'i g.ya' dang/ bgu chags kyi kun gzhi la las sna tshogs pa dmigs gzhi 'am rgyu chags na'ang dngos snang ming med mod kyang 'khor ba khams gsum gyi snod byed pa dang / phra gsal ba'i kun gzhi g.yo ba'i rta dang 'phrad nas 'khor ba'i rten byed pa dang / tshogs pa sdud pa'i kun gzhi yul shes thug 'phrad dang / yul dbang shes gsum thug 'phrad kyi dbang gis 'khor ba'i bdag don las gsum byed pas de dag la dmigs pa dag ni srid rtse sgom cing 'bras bur re bas nyams len ste/ de bas na kun gzhi'i 'chang rgya bag chags sna tshogs pa'i g.ya' dag pa chos sku gting gsal gyi klong nges par rtogs dgos so/gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gzhi gnas chos sku'i rig pa 'gags med du shar ba/ zhen med du rol ba/ rten med la grol yod pa 'di ka ngo bo stong la ngar cha dang ldan pas stong pa spyod bying rmug 'thib kyi snyangs byu rang dag dang / rang bzhin gsal la sangs cha 'dzom pas 'khyil 'byams rmug po'i spangs bya rang grol/ thugs rje rig la grol cha 'dzoms pas las dang

rnam par smin pa'i gol sa 'gogs pa ni rig pa ye shes kyi ngar gdangs rjen pa'i stobs kyis rang 1nga der sangs bar 'gyur bas na/ stong la mi dmigs 'gags pa med pas snyom 'jug gi srid pa ka nas dag cing dben pa'i klong dang / gsal kyang shin tu dwangs la rnyogs pa med par rten cing 'brel bar mi 'phro bas na baphywags khams gsal byed dbang po'i srid pa rnam par dag cing spyol ba'i 1nga dang / bag chags kyi sprin rgya gol sgrib mi mnga' bar rig pa ye shes kyi rtsal 'bar la rlung rlung su mi g.yo zhing sems su mi 'dzin pas na 'dod pa khams kyis srid pa'i bag chags sems pa ming med du spyol ba'i klong ste srid gsum ka dag gi rtogs pa zhig yod na rnam pa kun tu 'bad par rigs/khams gsum gyi rgyu sgrub pa'i nyams len tsam ni dbang phyug chen po 'dod pas rgyal bu go sa chung ngu rtsol bar zad do/ gsum pa la/ rtsol med don gyi spyod pa dang / shugs 'byung rgyun gyi spyod par brtson pa gnyis la/ dang po ni/ de lta'i rang bzhin spros bral rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs dpe med bsam brjod dang bral zhing / dbang po snyal lnga shes pa

blu rnams go ma 'gags rgya ma chad/ phyogs su ma lhung bar cha mnyam nas sgom rgyu'i zhen pa dag lta sgom gyi sgog las grol/ nges shes nang nas skye/ skye mkhan yul med du song / bzang ngan rtog pas phan gnod las 'das/ btang snyoms lung ma bstan gyis mgo ma bskor bar dbyings rig phyam brdal la song ba'i klong rtog na gol shor nor gsum dang bral ba'i spyod pa yin mod kyang/ gang zag rims kyis ba dag la go myong rtog gsum yod kyang / phal cher ni shor gol nor gsum gyis 'phrang du tshud pas de yang /nyams len rgyas 'debs su shor ba/ stong 'dzin la shor ba/ zhi gnas dran med had por shor ba/ lhag mthong gnas 'gyur dpyod pas blor shor ba/ mnyams rjes kyi la shan phyin ci log tu shor ba dang / yengs med dang sdug btsur a 'thas kyis bcing shor ba/ gnyug ma'i shes pa zhabrul rtog rgyun gyi char yid gtad bya shor ba/ sgom med blo las 'das pa btang snyom lung ma bstan du blta shor ba/ gang shar shar grol la skyongs rgyu 'khrul rjes nar mar 'byams shor ba rnams kyi 'dzol bsal rgyu dang / de bzhin du/ nyams bde la gol

na 'dod lhar skye/ gsal ba la zhen na bzugs kyi lhar skye/ mi rtog pa la zhen na gzugs med kyi lhar skye bas gol sa bsal dgos/yang lta b.lingang gshis la sgo ra ba dang / lamadu shor ba/ gnyen por shor ba/ rgyas 'debs su shor ba ste de dag gi mtshang 'don cing shan 'byed ma nor bar bla ma dam pa'i zhal khrid ltar ram mi rgan gyis byis pas rtsed mo labalta ba ltar snang med spros bral gyi ngang du nyin mtshan bar med du la bzlo bar byas pas lhag mthong gi rtsal rdzogs te/ gnas 'gyu dran rig bzang rtog ngan rtog ji lta bu 'char yangarig stong blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i 1nga du btsan sa zin pa zhig nges par dgos kyis/ 'di dus rtogs pa ri rgyal lta bu'i dus ste rtol sgrub dang chas gdab gang yang med pas nabyu bral nyal chog gi klong la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ de lta'i rnal 'byer ba ni lus tha lam ba ltar snang yang sems chos sku bya rtsol dang bral ba'i dgongs pa la bzhugs pas snang sridabla ma'i dkyil 'khor gang shar ye shes su cham brdal sa lam byar med lhug pa 'khor 'das ye grol gyi klong nas 'bad med kyi gdeng chen po rang rig chos skur rtogs pas sangs

gyi rgyas thog rlom gyi re ba dag pa'i gdengs dang / yul med zang thal mthong bas 'khor bar lhung dogs bor bas gdengs/ thams cad chos skur shar bas 'bras bu rtsol sgrub dang bral ba'i gdengs/ kun gzhi ka nas dag pas sa lam sbyangs bsgrod dang 'jigs pa bor bas gdengs ste bzhi'i drod tshad mngon du brtes pa'i gnas skabs su bstan pa dang / sems can gyi don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung zhing mthar lus kyi 'ching rgya bor ma thag par sangs rgyas thob par byed pas lta spyod lam du khyer bar byed pa ni shin tu gces so/ gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i yon tan mngon tu ma gyur gyi bar du bla ma dam pa la brten nas sgro 'dogs gcod mkhas par bya ba dang / thugs yid dbyer med bsre bas mthu la brten nas nyams len yun thung grangs mang du byas la sgom rtsal rdzogs pa zhig gal che/ gzhan yang phyogs med la dad pa dang dag snang / rtsol med kyi snying rje dang byams pa/ bden med du rtogs pa sgyu ma dang rmi lam ngo shes pa lta bu chos brgyad kyi bya ba ro snyoms su bskyur ba/ gegs sel bog 'don gyi man ngag la ma rmongs pa/ ni gnad yin no/

dang po nyams len gyi sgo mthong tsam nas kha pho mtho ste mi dang ma 'phrad par bcad rgya dam po byed pa dang / sdug btsir a mthas can gyi sems 'dzin dam pos 'ching ba dang / lha bsgom la rtsol ba sngags bzlas la g.yeng ba rtsa rlung la 'bad pa phyag skor la re ba kha ton la 'bad pa/ sbyin sogs la brtson pa/ bslab sbyangs la gol ba thams cad/ chos nyid rang bzhag gyi don la cung zad 'gal bas/ sdug po rin gyis nyos nas ngal ba lhur len byas pas/ spyod pa rtsol bcas 'og mas yul du 'go mi 'khor ba/ bya ba zin pa'i mi bzhin du blo yangs khrol le/ shes pa sangs phyam me/ snang ba zang thal le/ ma bcos chos nyid rang khar yan pa ni ngang las mi 'da' bas spyod pa ste/ don de las ma 'da' zhes pas sa ma swā dang / rtsol sgrub spangs blang gi 'dzin rtsol gyi gzeb tu ma tshud pas mnyam bzhag mkha' ltar mnyam pa'i don dang / rje thob 'od gsal du kha sbyor bas snang srid bla mar 'char bas bskyed rim dang / thugs yid gcig 'dres zab mo'i rdzogs rim kyi spyod pa dang bcas pa'i don khrid bstan pa'o/ gsum pa 'bras bu ni/ de ltar lta sgom

spyod pa'i mthu la brten nas/ mnyam par bzhag pas 'od gsal rjes thob dang 'dres/ de'i rgyun nyin mtshan yengs 'khrul med par ma byas rig stong zang thal /na gyi dkyil 'khor/ lhun grub 'du ma byas par rlung sems kyi spros pa dag/ sku gsum ye shes kyis rol par snang / chos nyid don gyi lta ba la brtan pa thob nas 4 'am the mi tshom pa'i gdengs chen po gong 'phel du son/ rtsol sgrub yul gnyis kyi mtshan ma dben par chos nyid la zad/ thams cad rig stong bzhengs bzhugs ba/ go phyong gi nyams dang sa lam rtags kyi yang rtser 'phel/ nyi zla mkha' la shar tshe mun pa btsal kyang mi rnyed pa ltar chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba lhug par rtogs kyi rtsal rdogs pa ste/ tshogs sbyor mthong sgom gyi spangs rtogs gsar byung gi nyams thams cad kun kyang rang snang rims par rang klong la zhig rangartsal la thim nyon sgrib phra rag thams cad rnam par dag nas/ mi slob pa'i yon tan gyi lam rtse'i 'bras 1 kun bzang sprul sku bla ma'i sa la 'khyol bar shes sgrib

mtha' dag dang bral nas lus rgya zhig ma thag par bum nang gi nam mkha' bum pa chag pa dang lhan cig byi'i nam mkha' dang dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur pa ltar/ gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings nang gsal dpyod byed kyi shes pa dang bral ba'i gzhen nu bum pa'i skur yang dag par byang chub pa'i chos sku mngon du gyur bas na lus rdul phran du dengs/ sems chos nyid du deng ba zhes kyang bya'o/ phal cher ni mngon par rdogs sangs rgyas pa'i tshul sgyus rtags/ gdung zhugs su sbar tshe 'od gyen bsgreng rtsib gug sgra 'ur ba dang / thugs chom g.yo ba la 'phar ba/ ldeg pa rab tu ldeg pa/ zer zlum 'khyil dang / ljon shing lta bur 'khrigs nas chos skur byang chub pas gdung rigs lnga dang / longs skur rigs lnga'i phyag rgya zhi ba khro bo/ sprul skur ring bsrel bsam mi khyab par 'byung la/ de lta bu'i rtags rnams lhun gyi grub par/ chos sku'i sprul pa re zhag 'khyang yang / longs sku dang sprul sku'i phrin las gzugs kyi skya'i bkod pa rnam gnyis gyi 'asto ba sems can gyi khams rgya mtsho lta bu la/ gang la gang 'dul gyi thabs du mas khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs shing mdzad pa

gyi dang phrin las chags thogs dang bral bar mthar snyin par 'gyur ro/ da lta'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa thob par byos la ma g.yel cig ces pas sa ma lha dang /mthar thug 'bras byu gtwan spyol sgyu sa dang yon tan bstan pas rim pa'o/ gsum pa mjug don la/ bka' gtsig gis rgyas btab pa dang / smom lam gyis gtad rgya mdzad pa/gdul zhing skal ba bzang por bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyir rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'byum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis dang / bye brag gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i rgyud bco brgyad snyi bdag mo ru gnyer byang gtad pa'i yul ni ral pa gcig ma ste skye med kyi dbyings su ral 'bru 'khyil zhing / gzigs pa'i spyan gcig khrag ltar khol ba/ rngams pa'i tshem gangs ltar gcig la/ bskyed pa'i nu gcig bdud rtsi'i gtams pa/ bsgod pa'i rkang gcig chos skur sbyor bar byed pa'i 'khor 'das kyi a phyi gcig mar/ rang rig bla ma pad+ma rgyal po'i dgongs brda snyan brgyud kyi chu bo gcig 'dus bka' gtsig gi rgya bsdam zhing / gsang chen a mas mkha' gsang du rol ba'i mtshan bdun ldan 'di rtag par mel ces

skyongs zhes gnyer bcol la/ chos kun sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar chos nyid don dam dag grol rol pa chen po'i gzi byin rnam par kun tu g.yel med du dbobs la/ skal bzang bde gshegs snying po'i gdung rigs su gyur bas zhing sa la kun bzang thugs kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod la nyams med thub par srungs shig zhes zab pa'i phyag rgya btab cing bkas gtad pa lags so/ gnyis pa ni/ chos 'di'i snod dang ldan pa ni gces rgu cog bzhag du byed cing chos brgyad mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin tu dor la 'dod sred log lta le lo shes chung zhing dad pa dag snang mos gus g.yo zol med par bla ma'i bka' ltar nyan cing sgrub pa zab mo lhur len la spro zhing snying rus sdug sran che ba man ngag gi nying khu lon nas rang byubhe ye shes ngo 'phrod cing byin drod mi yal bar 'dzin thub pas gdul bya tshogs smon las 'phro bzang po'i zhing sar smin pas skal ba dang ldan pa phun tshogs mtshan gyi grangs ldan la rang rang rigs kyi tshom bu bsam yas dang bcas pa dbang gis snyin cing rtogs pas spyol nas bzang ngan las kyi 'brel ba thob tshad 'khor ba mtha' can du gyur de

phyi don dang ltan pa dang / rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pas skal bzang dang las smon gyi bskul ba thams cad rab 'od sas zang thal/ 'bring phung po rdul phran/ tha na'ang 'chi ba 'od gsal kha sbyor ba'am/ chos nyid ma pang bu 'jug srid pa sprul pa'i 'khor lor grol bar mngon du gyur twe/ gzugs sku gnyis gang rung dang / de'i ye shes kyi 'dug pas 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur te sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan rgya chen por 'god nus pa'i mnga' dbang bsgyur ba la chags thogs dang bral bar shog cig ces pad+ma rigs kyi rgyal ba de nyid kyi thugs bskyed rgya mtsho'i smon lam mdzad nas las ldan rgyal tshabs la gtad rgya mdzad pa'o/ yin pa med pa'i lta phyogs/ min pa med pa'i sgom phyogs/ zung du 'jug pas spyod phyogs gsum gyi dgongs pas chings kyis bcing bas na sa ma yā dang / mi zad sku yi rgya ste chos dbyings nam mkha' mdzod gter gyi gzhi dang / mi 'gags gsung gi rgya gter gyi nges tshig dang mtshon dpe yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu dang / mi 'khrul thugs kyi rgya ste gter gnas chos rgyal sprul pa'i sku dang de'i mdzad pa phrin las rnam thar bsam

mtha' yas so/ gang yang rung ba'i bsgo skal min par/ o rgyan nyid kyi sku dngos sam byin rlabs sprul ba'i dgongs pa'i rol mtshor chos thams cad bum nang gi mar me ltar rmongs med bzhugs kyang / rten 'brel gnas dus gdul bya 'phel 'grib rtags kyi tshul la dgongs nas sbas bkrol sna tshogs thabs la mkhas dgos pas gu rgyu gsang ba chen po'i rgyas btab pa dang / phyi nang gsang ba'i zab bcud gsungs rnam pa thams cad pas don mtshon brda yig gi rnam par bzhugs pa brjod bya rjod byed kyi don thams cad yongs su 'dus shing thim la ma rmongs pas cha nas dang / thabs shes dbyer med snang stong zung du 'jug pas don nisnyiXzhes pas bstan no/ gsum pa ni/ zhe sku phreng du mar 'brel ba dang ldan pa dag gi nang nas 'ang snying nas bla mar dad mos che zhing don dam 'phags pas nor rnams rang ngo 'phrod pas phywan pa sel tsam byub kyang de tsam sgrub la mi gzhol ba dang / sgrub pa phyogs re ba la cung zad brton pas sngags 'chol mthar phyin zung nas gnang dka' ba mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod yang nas yang du 'dod sred kyis bskul bas mos ngor/ nang don

snyi gyi rtogs pa'i nor 'byor kyang gzhan gyis mi mthong bas sbas thabs kyi tshul can rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ba gzung 'dzin gyi bdud bzhi 'dul zhing chos nyid sgyu mar rol ba'i he ru ka nus ldan rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro'i gas mdzod nas bsgyur zhing spel ba dge zhing legs par gyur te bkra shis 'phel bar gyur cig sarba zhes rnam pa thams cad kun tu dge mtshan yon tan gyi dpar rab tu rgyas pa'i slad du maṅga le/ zhes pa'ang mkhas dam pa dkon mchog blo gros kyis tshig zin zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor gteraston rang gis tshig nas 'gros su bkod nas rmong blun dag la phan phyir bris pa dge legs 'phel/
snyi dag snang ye shes rol pa las: rnam dag g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams kyi mthong snang dri bral me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

blu: na mo ar+ya tā re dṛ na mo: rgyal ba kun yum 'gro ba'i mgon dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa skyobs: 'jigs pa ma lus bsal mdzad pa'i: 'phags ma lha mor phyag bgyi'o/ bdag dang ma 'ongs 'gro ba rnams: log pa'i lam las rab brgal zhing: tshogs gnyis bsags sbya spel ba dang: dngos grub bde brlag 'grub pa'i byir:'phags ma'i zhing bkod zab mo bri: dad dam ldan pa'i slob tshogs kyis dad rten zhing sa bzang por yin mos gus dag snang ldan pa yis: mchod dang bkur sti byed par 'tshal: de yang bskal pa shing khyi'i lo'i zla 8 tshes 15 bzang po la gnyid 'od gsal du phyogs skabs phyi nang zang thal bar med 'od gsal khyab brdal nam mkha' yang pa'i ngang la dal gcig 'byams su klas so: de yi ngang las bar snang thams cad 'ja' 'od thig le rab tu 'bar ba'i drwa gur 'khrigs pa'i dbus nas lha yi bu dkar po dar dkar gyi la thod can rin po che sna tshogs rgyan spud pa: 'ja' sham dang dar dpyangs me tog gi phreng ba mdzes pa: g.yas na gser gyi rdo rje dang g.yon na dngul dkar gyi me long bsnams pa: zhal

zhi 'dzum bag gi mdangs dang ldan pa shel gyi gri chung sked la bsten pa: sag lhum 'ja' khra mnab pa 'od dang 'od zer mu med pa 'phro ba zhig byung ste 'di skad zeraro e ma: rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje: bdag la legs pa gson dang: mi min rang snang dag pa'i: zhing khams g.yu lo bkod pa ngo mtshar dga' ba'i gnas mchog: yodapa'i mjal 'gro e 'dod: mos na nge rang chas 'gro: zhes zer ba la bdag gis lan smras pa kye ho gson dang lha yi bu mchog: nyon mongs 'dam rdzab khrod na: bying pa'i blodaman bdag kyang chung ngu'i dus nas bzung ste: lha snang dag pa'i 'khor lo: bsam yas legs par shar ro deng 'dir g.yu lo bkod pa'i: zhing khams mjal rgyu grub na:ngomatshar skyed pa'i gnas chen: da lta nyid nas 'gro lags zhes zhus tshe shar lho'i phyogs 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan lhug ma lta bu bskyang ba la zhugs nas nged rang gnyis phyin tshe yul glingabasam gyis mi khyab bsgal nas rgya mtsho'i 'gram gser gyi phye ma brdal ba'i khrod na gser gyi rta mchog mdzes sdug chog mi shes pa la byis pa brgya stong bsam gyis mi khyab pas

bskor nas rtse gar 'jo stabs 'phrul gyin 'dug: bdag gis zhus pa lha yi bu mchog lags: byis pa 'di dag gis gser gyi rta pho la rtse 'jo byed pa sogs ci yin zhus tshe: lha bude na re: gson dang nus ldan rdo rje: rin chen rta pho mdzes pa: khyed kyi sku yi mtshon dpe: 'gro'i lding sna tshogs byed tshul: nges med 'grim dgos brda rtags: gser gyi sbu phran mdzes pa: zab mo'i chos gted 'doms tshul: byis pa ming pos bskor ba: nyid kyi gdul bya yin no: brda rtags bkod pa bzang po: ma brjed snying gi bu chen: zhes gsungs so de nas yang phyin tshe rgya mtsho chen po brgal skabs gling na rin po che'i mkhar mdzes pa'i nang na glang po che thal skya yid du 'ong ba zhig nyal ba la lha mi mang pos 'dod yon bkod pa spung nas 'dug: mtha' 'khor bdud dang srin po sha zan 'jigs rngam can mang pos bskor gyin 'dug: mtha' 'khor 'od nag 'thug pos bskor ba'i nang na re 'byams nag po hal dug zer ba zhig gi kha gdangs mche bzhi ngoms pa mthong ba'i tshebadag gis zhus pa: lha yi bu mchog lags: bkod pa 'di dag ci yin brda thabs yin no lags zhus tshe lha bu

gyi de na re:kye ho:gson dang nus ldan rdo rje:rin chen mdzes pa'i mkhar ni:rang khyims gnas mal rol pa dar 'bol sna tshogs brtsegs pa sku skye gdan sa mthon po:glang po rab rgyas nyal ba:khyod lus mtshon pa'i dpe yin:'dod yon mang po stobs pa:kun gyi rtsi bkur mchod tshul:zhen na gti mug rmongs pa'i:dud 'gro'i ngang la 'da' ba'i:brda tshul de 'dra yin no:mtha' 'khor rgya sog bdud dang:srin po mang pos bskor ba:nye gnas chos brgyad rol gar:spyod na sdug bsngal kho nas:ra bzhin ngang las ma 'das:ngan song rgyu yi brda rtags:mtha' ma mun nag 'thibs shing zhe sdang sbrul gyis 'khyud pa ma rig ngang la nyal na:sdug bsngal gsum gyi gzhi ma:thar lam gcod pa'i dam sri:tshe gcig g.yeng ba'i bslu rtags:mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung la:chags sdang dgra bo'i bslu brid:tshe 'phrang bar chad mang ba'i:brda rtags de 'dra yin no:spang bya 'jig rten chos brgyad:dor rgyu dgra 'dul gnyen skyong:blang bya lam ldan rjes 'dzin:bsgrub tu zab gter rgya mtsho:dgos pa mkha' 'gro'i brda lung man ngag lta bsgom zab

mo: gces pa'i rang byung ye shes: brten tu dben gnas ri khrod: dor bya nyon mongs 'du 'dzi: brtag pa rang gi rgyud 'di: zin tu 'dod yon zhen med sgrub mtha' shi la gtug na: bde legs dpa' 'bar e ho: ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: zhes gsungs so de nas yang phyin tshe dwangs gsal rgya mtsho yongs su bsgrod nas pha ri'i ngos su sleb skabs shing ljon bzang 'dab 'bras ldan pa ko shi ya: gser gyi snying po sa la brten: g.yu 'dabs bzang: lan+ta su ri: sha larnye sogs mang po la dar sna tshogs kyi rgyan 'phyang pa dril g.yel mang po'i chos sgra snyan pa gzhan yang shing la brten pa'i thog bu zi ya ma: 'bru le kha shu tor rkang: sur kro: cha lan+ta sogs ro brgya ldan pa mang pos mdzes pa: bya ku lan+ta: re skegs bzang po: 'jol 'debs bde: chos sgra sgrogs sna tshogs dga': yid mdzes bzang po sogs du mas rtse gar 'phur lding sna tshogs byed pa dang: khyad par shel gyi brag ri yid du 'ong ba la rgyab brten mdzad pa'i drang sgong zhig gis lha klu dri za grul bum mi 'am ci mang po la zab mo stong pa nyid kyi chos 'khor bskor bar 'dug go: de nas bdag

( gis lha yi bu la zhus pa:kye lha mchog rgyal ba'i sras so lags yul 'di gang yin drang sgong 'di'i ci mdzad pa dang 'khor mang po gang nas 'dus zhus pa'i tshe lha bu de na re:kye hogason dang nus ldan rdo rje:zhing ni dag pa mkha' spyod:gnas mchog g.yu lo bkod pa rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad rgyan ldan dag pa'i rol pa:byarigs sna tshogs bsam yas:zab mo'i chos sgra 'ur ro:sher gyi brag ri 'bar ba dri bral mchod sdong bzang po:der brten drang sgong 'di yang:rang snang rin chen phun tshogs 'gro ba'i don chen mdzad 'dug:lha klu'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho:'phags mar 'brel ba'i skye bo las rmon mthu yis bsdus so gang 'dus chos 'khor bskor nas:zab mo yangadag lta ba:mngon gyur bsgom pa'i stob kyis:sa lam yongs rdzogs bsgrod nas:'phags ma'i zhing la grol 'gro:dgos pa de dag yin no:ma yengs thugs la 'jog 'tshal zhes gsungs so:de nas drang srong nyid kyi spyan sngar 'khod la 'di ltar gsol ba btab po:kye ma:'dza ba lo ngas kyi skyabs gcig 'jig rten rgud pa sel mdzad:zab mo chos

kyi snang bas:gang 'dul mdzad pa skyong ba'i drin chen dpa' bo chen po:bdag la legs par dgongs 'tshal:'gro drug khri mun gnas nas:yang dag sangs rgyas sa la:tshe lus gcig gi grol ba'i:nyams len zab mo gsung ba'i thugs bskyed rmad byung zhu 'tshal:zhes zhus tshe drang sgong bde ba'i 'byung gnas kyi zhal nas:kye hoX tshogs smon las 'phro bzang po'i:mthu dang rten 'brel phun tshogs:yang dag rnal ma'i gshis lugs:mngon gyur dpa' bo chen po:nus ldan rdo rje gson dang:man ngag zab mo snying 'dra'i:gdams pa khyod la bstan no:ma brjed snying la bstims shig:e ma:snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams:bden med rgyu ma rmi lam:'dzin bral stong pa nyid dbyings:bdag med ye shes rol bar:blo thag gcig tu gcod do:rang gsal don gyi gnyug ma:dran rig ye shes 'gags med:zang thal dri ma med pa:rgyal kun thugs kyi yang snying:zab gsal gnyis med bsgom pa:rang byung rtsol bral spyod lam dran shes bag yod rgyud bsdam:'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i:thabs la rnam par brtson zhing:smin grol gdams pa'i gru tshugs:

gyi zab mo'i chos gter rgya mtsho:skal ldan bu la 'dom cing:bsnyen sgrub gong ma'i mdzad spyod:dben pa'i gnas su skyong 'tshal:byams dang snying rje'i rlabs kyis ngan song dong sprugs thabs la:'da' med rtag tu brtson 'tshal:gnad las g.yel ba med par:rang bab skyong mdzod bu mchog:nus ldan rdo rje'i dgos 'dzod:ces gsungasaso:de nas yang yar la phyin tshe bar snang thams 'ja' sprin thig le drwa gur 'khrigs pa'i 1nga nas bde stong bdud rtsi'i sbrang char zil dngar 'bebs pa'i dbus na ma dang mkha'a'agro nyi rdul 'khrigs pa lta bu'i bro 'khrab gar byed glu sgrogs mchod sprin sna tshogs bshams la snyan pa'i mgrin gcig gis 'di skad gsol do:chagam:spang 'u nga g.yu mdog gitshal na:ku mud mdangs 'dzum gyi lang tsho:spyod 'dod rkab drug gi bung ba:sbrang rtsi len pa la spro yang:nam phug thub pa ni mi 'dug:ston gyi rgyal mo kho sleb yong:thang chen g.yuljang gi khrod na:lo tog 'bru drug gi tshal rgyas:spyod 'dod skye bo'i tshogs mang yang:nam phug thub pa ni mi 'dug:khu 'phang sad ser kho sleb yong:skye bzhi mang bsdus kyi khrod na

dal 'byor rin chen gyi gru bo:'dod 'byung yid bzhin gyi nor bu:dam chos sgrub 'dod tshogs mang yang:nam phug thub pa ni mi 'dug:'chi bdag bdud pho kho sleb yong:skyid pagaser ljongs kyi 'dabs na:gsang sngags bstan pa mchog rab rgyas:zhugs 'dod rnam g.yeng mkhan mang yang:nam phug thub pa ni mi 'dug:mtha' mi kla 1 kho sleb yong:mdokhams rgang drug gi zhol na rdzogs chen nyi ma ni shar 'dug:bsgom 'dod chos brgyad mkhan mang yang nam phug thub pa ni mi 'dug:mi rtag sgyu ma'i mdangs bstan yong:skubazhi'i gangs ri yi 'dabs na:mang tshogs slob 'bangs kyi sde rnams:zab gter spyod mos kyang rnam g.yeng:nam phug thub pa ni mi 'dug:pha gcig rnga yab la chas 'gro:chosabadag nyin snang gi khrod na:mos can zab chos re spyod kyang:nam phug thub pa ni mi 'dug:bstan pa'i gnas tshad kho rdzogs 'gro:mi min o rgyan gyi yul na:bde stong dga'abazhi yi char 'bebs:spyod 'dod rigs bzang gi bu chung:sgyu lus nam phug ni mi thub:gshegs tshe zhing 'di la sleb yong:ngo mtshar dga' ston gyi tshogs 'khor:skal bzang bu

gyi khyod la gus phul: bzhes nas zab gter gyis 'gro khams: dong sprug nus pa zhig smon no: zhes gsungs shing byi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bdag la stobs byung: ngo mtshar dga' ba'i a la la ho e nya: zhes brjod nas rol bas bde stong tshim pa drug ldan gyi nyams rab tu 'bar ro: de nas yang phyin tshe ri de'i sked pa 'ja' gur rab tu 'khrigs pa'i khrod na lo paṇa rig 'dzin byangs sems nyan rang mang po'i 'du ba skar ltar 'khrigs pa'i khrod na tshogs dpon grub chen lu hi pa dang: gtso bo rje 'bangs rgyal ba byang chub dang: ngang byung dpal gyi rgyal mo btsun gsum gyis zab mos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyin 'dug: bdag gi lha bu la zhus pa: kye lha phrug yid bzhin nor bu snang ba 'di ka ltar yin lags zhus tshe: lha bu de na re: kyi ho gson dang nus ldan rdo rje: zhing 'di dag pa mkha' spyod: gsang ba 'od gsal bkod pa: lo paṇa rig 'dzin byang sems nyan rang 'du ba rab 'khrigs: tshogs rje tshogs 'dzin tshogs bdag: ngo mtshar bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor: mjal ba tshogs smon las kyi rnam par yang dag rgyus bskyed: las can

khyod 'dra ma gtogs: gzhan gyi spyod yul ma yin ma brjed rigs bzang skye mchog ces gsungs so: de nas bdag gis phyag dang bskor ba rgya chen po byas nas zhus pa: kye ho:thugs rje 'gro ba skyong mdzad pa'i: bka' drin mnyam med bdag gi mgon: ye shes gsang ba'i nyi ma can mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs su gsol: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po lasaḥ sgrol ba'i gdams zab thugs kyi bcud tshig nyung don 'dus gsung bar zhu zhes pa gsol tshe grub chen lu hi pa'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so: a ho:ka dag stong chen gyi dbyings na: lhun grub rang gsal gyi bkod pa: ngo mtshar dag mnyam gyi zhing khams: gtad bral 'dzin med kyi rol pa: rang snang nus ldan khyod gson dang: 'di snang 'jig rten gyi bkod pa: legs byang ye shes kyi dga' ston: nyes 'khrul 'khor ba yi gting rdo: mjum mo'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na: grol gabrul bu khyod la rag las: 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba yi khrod na: 'dzin bral gnyug ma yi rtsal sbyongs: blo rmongs chags sda gis bslu brid: mdzub mo'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na: grol

(3 'khrul bu khyod la rag las: rnam rtog 'khrul 'byams gyi bkod pa: gsal khyab rig pa yi rgyan no: sems 'dzin rgong sbubs la brgyal 'gro: mdzub mo'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na: grol 'khrul bu khyod la rag las: srid gsum 'gro ba yi khrod na spros bral chos sku ni mtha' yas rmong pa'i kun gzhi de rtsal 'gags: 'dzum mo'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na: grol 'khrul bu khyod la rag lus: ma rig 'khrul snang gi sbubs na ye grol kun bzang ni 'bral med: ma rtog 'khrul ba'i tshe 'ching ngo: mdzub mo'i gar bsgyuradang 'dra na: grol 'khrul bu khyod la rag las: zab gter bdud rtsi yi dpal las: bshad sgrub 'gro don ni ngo mtshar: 'jig rten chos brgyad ni gol sa: mdzub mo'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na: grol 'khrul bu khyod la rag las: sku skyes 'gro don du byon na gang 'dul chos 'khor te ngo mtshar: grwa nog chags sdang so yi mug: mdzub mo' gar bsgyur dang 'dra na grol 'khrul bu khyod la rag las: gcug lag dgon sde yi khrod na: 'gro 'dul mdzad pa ni ngo mtshar chos brgyad zad med dag mgo rmongs: mdzub mo'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na:

grol 'khrul bu khyod la rag las: gos dkar lcang lo yi khrod na: zhen med rnal 'byor khong ngo mtshar: dko kha grong nyul tsho skugs log: mdzub mo'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na: grola'akhrul bu khyod la rag las: ngur spug dge 'dun gyi khrod na: byams dang snying rje can ngo mtshar: tshong pa nor lngan la gad dro: mdzub mo'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na: grol 'khrul bukhyod la rag las: khyod slob 'dus sde yi khrod na: zhen med bya btang mkhan ngo mtshar: chos brgyad bze re can mgo rmongs mdzub mo'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na: grol 'khrul bukhyod la rag las: mi nag skye bo yi khrod na: chos byed bzlas brjod can ngo mtshar: sdig rgan mi dge mkhan skyugs log: mdzub mo'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na: grol 'brul bu khyodal rag las bu khyod yang dag la brtson nas: bstan 'gro'i don chen te rdzogs mthar: nga yi drung 'di la 'khod dang: dpon slob thugs dgongs te ro gcig: 'byung 'gyur yidaganyis dang bral lo zhes gsungs so de nas yang rgyal ba byang chub kyi zhal nas: kyes gache na dang reg pa mchog nasaldan: rtse gcig bdag nyid la dgongs 'tshal: 'di

( bde phyi skyid kyi man ngag: gong ma'i rnam thar la yod do:'khrul snang dgos med kyi zhal ta: brag gzeb sgom pa la 'dri dgos:chos brgyad rnam g.yang ni mdo medaḥ sngar 'das so nams la gzigs mdzod:'dod yon zhin 'dzin la don med:rmi lam gar bsgyur dang 'dra 'o:nyon mongs 'du 'dzi des dgos med: dgra gnyen nges med la gzigs 'tshal:bya blo mang po rang mi 'grub:mdo med blo nogs la dpyod dang:gzhan don rtsol med du skyongs na:rgyal ba'i sras mchog de yin no: zab gter 'chad sgrub la brtson dang:'gro don ngo mtshar ba'i gnas so:gdul bya smin grol la rem dang:'od gsal rtogs pa rang don ldan:stong nyid snying rje yis skyong dang:ma gyur 'gro ba la bde ster 'brel tshad don ldan gyi thabs mchog:rmad byung gsang lam la brten 'tshal zhes gsungs so: de nas ngang byung rgyal mo'i zhal nas:e ma rtogs pa phul phyin gyi rnal 'byer:rigs mchog nus ldan rje gson dang:'dod yon sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa:ma zhen mi dor ba'i gnad skyong: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa:rtsol bral bde chen gyis spyod

'tshal chags sdong rgyal pham gyi sgo mor: chags 'dzin zhen bral du la zlos: dman sprang gdams zab la 'du tshe: che mthong rab spang zhing rjes bzu : zas nor rgya chen re spungs yang: gdams zab gsang rgya can ma shor: 'dod can chags sred can byung yang: mkha' 'gro'i snying bcud rnams ma sbyin: spyod lam thams cad kyi skabs su: lta bsgom ting 'dzin dang ma bral: gang 'dod slob tshogs kyi sde rnams: byams brtse'i lcags kyu yis bzhugs 'tshal: 'brel ba gang thob kyi skye 'gro: dag pa'i zhing khams la bkod pa 'i: rten 'brel che ba de smon no: zhes gsungs so: de nas yang yar phyin tshe ri bo g.yu mdog dri bsu sbos kyi ngad ldang ba: me to bṛ la dasto sing hā lho: bsil chab spro: gur ta rku: zi lhang marnya kur sha ras ta sogs mdzes pa mang pos kheb pa dang: sman gyi rig byed dhi la ha:rnam par rgyal ba rin chen pha la:dri bsung ngad ldan ro la ya me:nus pa tshang: mig mang du mobakra la sogs pa mang pos mdzes pa dang ri de yi dbyibs nor bu gcig pa lta bu'i rtse la 'dod 'byung ratā 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang g.yu dang be+eḍūr+ya'i kha bad mdzes pa khyams

rtsi 'dod rnam mig mang bkra ba la mchod pa'i la mo kha dog phyogs mdog 'dzin cing rtse gar rol mo sna tshogs sgrogs pa dang: khyams shel gyi chag gdab pa'i steng na lha dang lha mo dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod sprin mtha' yas pa stobs gyin 'dug phyi rim rin po che' gzhal med khang nyi shu'i mdzes pa ra bskor ba: de dag gi bar bar la khrus kyirdzing bu: me tog gi ra baḥ lha shing gi tshal: bya rig sna tshogs pas chos sgra sgogs pa: ri dwag mang pos rtse 'jo byed pa sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan pa dang: 'ja' 'od da thigale me tog gi char rnam pa kun tu 'bebs pa zhig mthong tshe bdag gis zhus pa: kye: rtsol med lha yi bu mchog lags: zhing dang gzhal yas khang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'dod rgu'i bkod pa 'di rnams ci ltar yin lags zhus tshe: la bu de na re: kye ho: gson dang nus ldan rdo rje: zhing 'di g.yu lo bkod pa: bde skyid ngo mtshar gnas chen dbus phyogs 'phags ma'i bzhugs gnas lhun grub rang byung gzhal med dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod sprin: rmad byung rnam par spros so dri bral khrus chab brgyad ldan: bsil ldan ljon

bzang sna tshogs: snyan pa'i chos sgrogs bya rigs: mdzes pa'i gar byed ri dwag: gzhan yang 'phags ma nyi shu'i:ngo mtshar zhing bkod shar ro: khyod ni tshogs smon las 'dzoms gzhan gyi spyod yul ma yin rje btsun snyare'i tshogs kyi: drung byon zhus lan gsal bor: mdzod dang don gnyis lhun grub: ces zer ro: de nas shar sher gyi gzhal med khang ginang du 'ja' zer 'od gur gyi klong der 'phags ma dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo shin tu mdzes ma dbu sgra zor cog pad+ma'i phreng bas bcing zhing phyag g.yas me longagayon snang gsal 'dzin pa dar dpyangs ljang sngon rat+na'i phreng ba sum rim dar dmar po'i sham thabs dang 'ja' khras mdzes pa zhabs tsog pu bsnol ma khrung khrung dkar po'i khri larol pa zhig dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po: e ma: rgyal kun thugs rje'i dbang phyug: mkhyen gnyis ye shes rab 'bar 'phags ma dbyangs can lha mo: mkhyen brtse nus par rab dgongs: deng dus gter 'chang mang yang: bzang ngan dbye bsal mi shes rmongs pa'i blo dang bral ba'i dus gsum

྅/ kun gsal lung byang:legs par bdag la gsungs 'tshal:zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal nas:hi bo zhe ma yengs gache na dang skyes mchog:brda tshig cung zad bshad do:shar phyogs smar gyi lung par:'gro 'dren mchog gi pho nya gu ru'i brin las sprul pa:dharma dhartu badz+ra:de 'brel don dang ldan no:thos tshogs g.ying ba'i 'phrang bsal:zab mo' nges don bstan na:'gro don rgya chen 'byung ngo:lho phyogs gtsang gi 'dabs ljong:gsang sngags dga' tshal gling na:sku skyes garma kairti:'brel tshad don dang ldan no:'gro kun rnga yab zhing bkod nub phyogs gser gyi 'dabs na:sku skyes 'gro 'dul bzang po:pad 'byung zab gter mnga' bdag:rten 'brel sna kha ral bas:'gro don gang yang mi 'byung nub phyogs rdo stod lung par dpal seng badz+ra pa ṇi:sngags pa 'gro ba nyams 'dren:'brel tshad don dang ldan no:zab gter bdag po ngan pas:mkha' 'gro'i bka' yi chad pas:'gro don chung ngu tsam mo:byang phyogs smar gyi gzhi 'dzin dbang chen rgyal mchog sprul pa:badz+ra zhig po rtsal gyis:zab gter sang rgya bkrol yang:

'gro don las smon mthu yis: zhing der rgya chen mi 'byungs: mi ring de dang nye 'tshams: gter spyon sbas pa'i rnal 'byor: rtogs ldan rigs pa rang shar: cho rigs rgyud tshopas: 'gro ba 'dul la dbul lo: chos brgyad g.yeng bar shor na: 'phral rkyen khug pas bsdu 'o: lho nub rdo snyi'i phyogs na: pad 'byung sprul pa brte: 'dum khrod dug chus lasgrub tshug ri la zin na: 'gro don brdul zhugs gdengs ldan: gnas der sur+ya'i mtshan 'chang: grub spyon sbas pa'i rnal 'byer chags sdang dug mnga' bral na: 'gro bsnye skyid spel 'ong: mtsho rgyal mi yi zol tshul: gnas des nye phyogs mtshams na: sa man bha dra'i mtshan 'cha : zab gter dgongs rgya grol ba'i: 'gro 'dren mchog gi pho nya:'brel ral bas mi 'dod gli mo sna tshogs 'byung ngo: nub bya rong smar rdo yul: grub rig zab gter bdag po: ku mud bī dza'i mtshan 'chang 'brel tshad thar ba'i lam ‘ mi ring de yi nye phyogs: lang gro'i sprul pa badz+ra: 'gro 'dren mchog gi pho nya: 'brel ba'i skye 'gra'i rgyud la: stong nyid snying rje'i rgyas 'debs: byang shar rnga yul ska ljong: r+sha

rlu: sprul pa'i skyes bu brte'i mtshan 'chang mkhas grub: 'brel tshad rnga yab gli 'god: de dang mi ring nye phyogs: dge ba'i blo ldan dam pa budha'i mtshan 'chang skyes bu: dgongs gter chos la spyod cing: 'brel tshad don dang ldan no: nyag gi lung pa'i phyogs na gnubs ban sprul pa'i skyes bu: pad+ma rnams rgyal zhes dang: dka' ba'i mtshan 'chang gnyis kyi: rang skal las ldan mang po: bde chen zhing la bgod do: mi ring sa yi phyog na: 'gro 'dul ldan ma'i sprul pa: skyes mchog ngag gi mtshan dang: prasnye'i mtshan 'chang sku skyes: 'brel tshad thar ba'i lam 'god: gra yul rdza lda'i phyogs na: pad 'byung sprul pa'i sku mchog: mun sel ye shes nyi mas: gang 'dul gdams pa'i char 'bebs: 'brel tshad don dang ldan no: yar stod rdza rgyal phyogs na: pad 'byung thugs rje'i 'od zer: ga ga a bh+ya'i mtshan 'chang mkhas grub brdul zhugs gdengs ldan:'brel tshad rnga yab gling du: dbang med btsan thabs 'god do: yar stod kong po'i phyogs na: khrag 'thung nus ldan rdo rje: 'gro 'dul bsam gtan gling pa: brtse chen pad+ma bīr+ya

o rgyan sna tshor rang grol:chags med byang chub rdo rje:khong rnams 'brel tshad don dang ldan no dag pa'i zhing la nyam par 'god par 'gyur ro:gzhan yang gter 'chang bsam yas: dang po bstod snga ma byed:mtha' nas nyi ltar gsal 'ong:de dag 'brel du rung bas:khyod la legs par bstan ni:ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje zhes gsungs so de nas yang phyin pa'i rin po che gser gyi gzhal med khang gcig gi nang du 'phags ma bsod nams mchog ster sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu dar dang rin po che'i rgyan rdzogs pa:rat+na'i sgog zhu can g.yas nor bu mig drug g.yon gter bum 'dzin pa zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyis glang po che dkar po'i gdan la rol pa 'ja' zer 'od thig gi sang na bzhugs pa dang mjal ba'i tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po: kye ma 'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor ltar: re ba ma lus skong mdzad:'phags ma bsod nams mchog ster:mkhyen brtses bdag la dgongs mdzod:skye rtags las kyi bzang ngan:zab mo'i gter la spyod tshul:'gro don brin las ji 'dra mthar thug grol skabs nam yin:

྅ zhal byang lung bstan gsung mdzod:ces zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di ltar gsungs so:e ma reg mchog nus ldan rdo rje:ma yengs legs par gson dang khyod ni las smon mthu ldan:gangs chen bod kyi yul 'dir bstan pa'i gsal byed sgron me:grub bsnyes khye'u chung lo tsā:dpal chen khro bo lod kyis 'bral med byin rlabs mdzad do phyes su zab gter mnga' bdag:'gro 'dul grum gyi mkhar nag:rtogs pa'i gdengs dang ldan zhing:zab mo'i gter la spyod do:brtul zhugs mgon po rdo rje:gdug pa thabs kyis 'dul lo:mkhas grub he pa chos 'byung:thugs gter zab chos 'doms shing 'gro mang bde la 'god do:thabs chen lha btsun sngon mo:'brel tshad don dang ldan no zab mo'i chos gter 'doms la:'gro don rgya chen mdzad do:bal yul tshong dpon bzang po:ma ṇi don 'grub zhes byas bshad sgrub bstan pa mang 'dzug:khyad par rten gzhi mang po:zhig gsos mdzad pa rab brkyang:khyad par de phyogs sngags 'chang:karma kirti zhes bya'i:grub 'bras mngon du 'gyur ro:de

rjes lha ldan phyogs su: pad+ma ma ṇi bha tra nyams rtogs yon tan rab 'bar: don gyi rnal 'byor zab mo: drag bzhad bdud 'dul rdo rje: bstan pa'i gsal byed sgron me dam sri'i gnya' non dpa' boḥ 'gran bral gar gyi dbang phyug dpal chen bdud 'dul rol rtsal: chags thog dri ma kun bral rgyal kun dgongs pa'i mdzod 'dzin 'brel tshad rnga yab zhing 'god de rjes mdo khams sgang gi gsel zhol rdo rje khro lod zab gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i: chos kyi nyi ma gsal bas bye ma'i grangs kyi skal ldan rnga yab dpal rir bkod do: de yi gdung 'dzin sku sprul skyes mchog shesarab nyi ma 'gro ba'i dpal du shar ro: de rjes sprul pa rim lnga zab gter mnga' bdag 'byen no las ldan grangasamed 'dren 'gyur sangs rgyas stong rtsa rdzogs rjes: mos pa mtha' yas bar du: gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don kun: 'bad med lhun gyis grub 'gyur rang gsal zhing khams dbus su: ye rdzogs sangs rgyas thob po: ngo mtshar sku yi phreng ba: bsgrangs na zad mtha' med do: mdo tsam bshad na de'o: ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: mdzad pa lung las byung ltar: dbye

rlu bsal gnad las ma 'da': 'gal rkyen med pa'i gnas su: zab mo'i sgrub la sbyor 'tshal yang snying thugs kyi dgongs bcud: dus rnams gnad la sbyor 'tshal 'gro 'dul mdzad pa rmad byung: byams dang snying rjes skyongs 'tshal: thugs rje lcags kyu 'bar bas las can ma lus 'dzin 'tshal:nyon mongs dug lnga'i 'phrang las: rab rgyal brtul zhugs mdzad 'tshal: zab gter bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho: bshad sgrub bsgom la brtson 'tshal ma dang mkha' 'gro'i brda las:'da' bar ma byed bsrung 'tshal:chos brgyad bya bzhag mang po rang gsal ngang la gzhom mdzod: dus min 'gal rkyen sna tshogs: lha bsrung mthu yis gzhom 'tshal: de dag thugs la zhog dang:dgos ched rgya chen yod do zhes gsungs so de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che sna tshogs kyi gzhal med khang gcig gi nang du 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam rgyal sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum longs sku'i chas rgyan can g.yas mda' dar dang g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyis sha dkar g.yu yis lus rgyan can gyi khri

la rol ba dang mjal ba'i tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba 'di ltar btab po: kyi ho:tshad med thugs rje'i bdag nyid:'chi med tshe yimanga' bdag:dus gsum rgyal ba'i yab yum chen 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam rgyal: brtse ba chen pos dgongs mdzod:gter gnas gang dang gang yin rdzas gter ci tsamayod kyi chos kyi gter kha gang tsam: spangs blang zhal chems zab mo:legs nyes gsal ba'i lung byang zhal ta tshigs gsum zhu legs: zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhala'adzum pa dang bcas te 'di ltar gsungs so: yigam:chogs spyod las 'phro dus 'dzom: zab gter gsang ba'i mnga' bdag: dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje bdag la legasapar gson dang:man ngag mdo rtsa bshad do:yar stod kong po'i phyogs na: zab mo'i rdzas gter lnga dang:chos gter rim pa bcu yod: yar lung phyogs na gter gsum phyag rdor gnas su rdzas gter: rtse re da gsham du gter gsum: gu ru'i gsang phug thugs gter: yang ldog phug par gter gnyis: rnga yi gab phug gter gsum:dhi

dru: yi gsol khang rdzas gter: brag lha mgon por gter bzhi:ldong lngar gter kha re re brag dkar phyogs na gter gnyis:rma yul rdzas gter gcig gcig:sa mdo bcu gsum kun la: rdzas kyi gter kha re re:la la sa yi gter kha: re 'ga' chu yi gter kha kha cig me yi gter kha:'ga' zhig rlung gi gter khaX la la nam mkha'i gter kha: re 'ga' rdzas gter rnam pa:kha cig dag snang gter bcud:'ga' zhig dgongs pa'i klong gter:rnam rol ma 'gags du ma:dus dang dus su 'bebs yong:zhal byang lung bstan dus tshig:rang rang bka' gsang ltar du:lag len theb par mdzod cig:'gro don rgya chen 'byung ngo:gter dang 'phrad pa'i bu la:zhal ta tshig gsum bshad do 'jam rtsub lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul:sna tshogs zug rngu mang 'byung: gang yang bdag med rtogs pa'i:lta ba'i gzir la gzhom mdzod:phung 'tshangs nus pa zab gter dper na dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu len par brtsam na:yang na dug gi phung po:legs na nor bus dbul sel:zab gsang de dang 'dra'o brda tshig mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin:ldan na bde

legs dpal 'bar: gnad las 'da' bar gyur na: mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung ngo: gter bdag 'ong dang mi 'ong: gang zag khyod la rag las: dper na gangs seng dkar mo'i: 'o ma len par 'dod na: rtsol phod thabs mchog bzang po rin chen gser gyi snod dang rnam par ldan na bdud rtsi 'chi gso'i sman gyis 'tshang ngo glen pa u tshug can gyis gdong lnga 'gugs dus mi srid: bdud rtsi 'dzin pa'i gser gyi: snod bzang yal bar gyur na rin chen srog dang bral la bcud rnams dbyings su yal 'gro zab mo'i dam pa'i chos kyi: snod mchog rung dang mi rung: gang zag khyod la rag las: 'dam khrod yin bzhin nor bu mthong na 'dod rgu lhun grub ma mthongs nyon mongs g.yul 'phyan de bzhin zab pa'i chos gter: bshad sgrub legs byas nyi mas: dngos grub rnam gnyis rtsol lo rnam g.yeng ngang la 'da' na: gser kling phyin nas stong log chos bdag 'ong dang mi 'ong: gang zag khyod la rag las: 'bor ba'i rgya mtsho che las rig pa'i nyi ma sbar ram: mun pa'i gling du 'da' 'am yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa 'tshams: gang 'dzin khyod

phyi la rag las: chos brgyad g.yeng la 'khrul dang: tshe gcig ri khrod 'grim pa: legs nyes gang ltar byed kyang: gang zag khyod la rag las zab pa'i chos gterabasgom dang: 'dod yon nor gter rtsol ba: dus gcig 'byung bar mi 'gyur gang bsgrub khyod la rag las: khe drag bu lon skyed 'phelaḥ dgos med byams dang sbyin gtong:snod gcig me chu mi 'phrod gang rtsol khyod la rag las: yul gcig khrims dpon byed dang: dpe med 'gro don mdzad pa: dus gcig 'byung bar mi 'gyur: gang byed khyod la rag las: blo thag rang gi gcod dang: rkyen dbang gzhan dang bstun pa: mnyam du 'ong bar mi nus chos mthun byed dang mi byed gang zag khyod la rag las mkhon 'dzang chags sdang che 'am: thams cad ro snyoms 'jog pa: dus gcig 'byung bar mi 'gyur: rnal 'byor brtul zhugs ldan dang mi ldan khyod la rag las gang snang dag par shar dang: mi nyan bze re sna tshogs: lhan rgyas 'byung bar mi 'gyur gang byed khyed la rag las: khyu mchog gangs seng byed dam dman pa'i ku kur zhugs pa mnyam du 'byung bar mi 'gyur: ci

byed khyed la rag las: khyung gshog rgyas pa mkha' lding: dman pa'i rtsal drug mi rdzogs: bzang ngan gang ltar byed kyang: bu mchog khyod la rag las: gzhan don nam mkha'amanyam dang: 'dzin pa'i rol gcig brdung ba don la 'dra sa med do: gang bsgrub khyod la rag las ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: dgos pa rgya chen yod do: zhes gsungs so denas yang phyin tshe rin po che pad+ma ra ga'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma rigs byed lha mo sku mdog dmar gsal chags khro 'dzum pa'i nyams canazhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gcigs pa smin ma me ltar 'bar ba rus pa'i rgyan drug dang stag sham dar dpyangs me tog gi phreng ba rat+na'i mgul rgyan thod rkamadabu rgyan dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phur ba: phyags g.yas pad+ma'i lcags kyu dang g.yon pad+ma'i mda' gzhu 'gengs pa bsnams pa zhabs gnyis phyed 'gying gis me khyung dmar po'i khri larol pa 'ja' zod me dpung 'khrigs klong bzhugs pa dang mjal ba'i tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po: kyeho khams gsum sred pa'i dpal

gyi la:dbang thob ye shes rig sku:'phags ma rigs byed dbang mo:mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs mdzod:gangs chen bod kyi yul 'dir zab gter ji tsam yod do:thams cad 'don par 'gyur ram:bsdam grol gnyis ka yod med zab pa'i lung byang gsung mdzod:ces zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di ltar gsungs so:e ma zab gter rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag:dpa' bo nus ldan 'dus rtsal:ma yengs legs par gson dang:dgos pa'i man ngag bshad do gangs can bod kyi khams su:'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i rgyal pos:sangs rgyas gnyis pa spyan drangs:dpal gyi bsam yas lhun grub:lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i:rgya chos ma lus gdan drangs bod khams chos kyi sgron me:nub med rtag pa'i dpal bzhag bskal ba'i rgud pa sna tshogs:gso ba'i zab gter bdag po:bka' gtad smon lam dang bcas:'jig rten khams gsum bzhag go:bod khams spyi la dgos pa'i:snying gter nyer lnga rgyas btab:dbul phong 'byor rgud skyob pa'i:'dod 'byung nor bu'i gter gsum:bod khams yun

du bde phyir: bla gter nyi shu rtsa lnga: bton na rgyal khams phung ngo:bstan pa'i sgron me gsal phyir:snying thig mkha' 'gro sgog bcud:rgya can bcu gsum sbas so:mu dge'i 'jigs pa skyob phyir:rin chen 'bras bu'i gter bdun nad yam mgo 'phang bcom pa'i klu snying sgog gter gsum mo dmag 'khrug gzing pa 'jom pa'i:mtha' brtsan dpa' gter mang sbas:'di dag 'don mi rung ba'i:bcud gter rgya mtsho yin ni:bkrol na nad mug mtshon 'khrugs 'jig rten khams kun phung ngo:bstan pa'i rgud pa gso ba'i:chos gter brgya dang rtsa lnga:'gro ba'i bde skyid spel ba'i:bsrung bzlog sgrub skor stong sbas:kha mkhas lce gnyis 'jom ma'i:snying thig nyi shu rgyas btab bdud dang dam sri brlag pa'i:bi to ta ma brgya rtsa:byad phur ngan sngags 'jams pa'i:bzlog sgrub sum cu rtsa bdun:dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i bstan srung drag sngags bdun brgya mtha' mi kla klo 'joms pa'i:rdzas sngags sbyor sgrub lnga lnga smin grol zam pa 'dzug pa'i:dbang dang bskyed rdzogs bdun brgya:las ldan 1sgol b.ligadams pa:man ngag drug

( bcu drug stong: legs nyes gsal ba'i me long:zhal byang brgya dang rtsa brgyad:'gro ba'i snang ba bsgyur ba'i:rdzas gter bye ba sa ya:gdug dka' 'dul ba'i bsgo skal: spyo gter bcu gsum rgyas btab: sngon smon las 'phro dag par:ngo mtshar gter brgyad sbas so: ma rig 'gro ba 'dren pa'i: zab chos lngam tshan bcu bkod: ma bsgom chos lnga mchan 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i:skye bdun sku sha mang sbas:ngan song dong nas sprugs pa'i:man ngag mang po gter bkod nad yams zug rngu gzhom pa'i bdud rtsi sman gter mang po: dus min 'chi ba 'joms pa'i:tshe rdzas a yi rgya can rten 'brel phun tshogs can la:mdzod lnga gsang ba'i rdzas gter dag pa'i rtsa mdud grol bar:ye shes gsang ba'i gter bkod:mtha' bral lta ba yangs par mi 'gyur dgongs pa'i gtes sbas:grub 'bras mngon du gyur la:nam mkha'i mdzod gter bsam yas:sa tshug yul dbus skyob pa'i: sngar 'byung gter rigs bye ba: gangs ljong bod yul skyob pa'i: phyi'i gter stong phrag drug bcu:'gro ba'i dpal du sbas so: de 'don gter ston

bsam yas:dus dang dus su 'byung ngo:zab pa'i rdzas gter mang na:chos kyi 'gro don nyung phugazhan blo bde yang don chung:thugs gter dgongs gter mang na:bstan pa'i'agro don bsam yas:dag snang chos sde'i phyug na:srid gsum gsal ba'i lung thob:brtul zhugs 'gro ba mang smin:brgyud pa drug gi byin rlabs:rten 'brel 'char sgo tshangazhing:gcus dkrugs gab gnad bsal ba:pad ma'i pha chos zab mo thos tshogs rtog pa'i blo yis bslad na byin rlabs 'od yal rang rkang bslad med lhug pa:don gyigadangs zab rab snyan:gnyis 'gros mdzes chos bslad na byis pa'i blo dang 'dra'o yang snying dam pa dgongs gter snyigs ma sa yi gter kha:byin rlabs dgongs pa'i rgya che yun la rdzas kyi ring gyur:khyod kyang mchog gi gter kha bsam yas dpal la dbang ngo rdzas la re ba ma che:'gong pos 'joms pa'i dus mchis:chos brgyad grags 'dod chebs gzhan blo mig sngar mdzes pa'i ched 'dzin de tsho nyam thag snang srid brda dang gdams pa:shar cha dgongs brda'i rol pa gzigs stangs tsam gyi sa gter chos kyi de

rnu: nyid shar na:ngo mtshar spro ba'i gnas so:ma rig rgo nga'i sbubs las:mkhyen gnyis ye shes rtsal rgyas:rgong rgya grol ma thag tu: brda dang chos kyi mdzod la:phyogs med mkha' ltar rgyas pa'i:rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje:ma brjed thugs la 'jog 'tshal:zhes gsungs so:de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che g.yu yi gzhal med khang mdzes pa'i nang du 'phags ma 'jigs byed ma sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum khro 'dzum sgeg pa rus pa'i rgyan dang gzigs sham dar dpyangs rat+na'i phreng ba thod pa'i dbu rgyan dar sna'i cod paṇa sogs mdzes par brgyan pa phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon 'khor lo 'dzin pa shadas gnyis chu glang gi gdan la rol pa 'od dang 'od zer mu med pa 'phro ba zhig dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po:kye hoḥmakhyen brtse mnga' ba'i bdag nyid:'gro 'dren mchog gi pho nya: rgyal yum 'jigs byed lha mo:ye shes gsal ba'i dgongs mdzod: bdag gis zab gter bton nas bsnyen sgrug gang du byed dgos:'gro don ji ltar 'byung ba'i: lung byang zab mo

gsung mdzod: ces zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so: yinamaX snyenas che rabs kun tu: zab gter chos la spyod pa'i: las dang skal babazang po'i: rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje: ma yengs legs par gson dang zhal ta tshig gsum bshad do zab pa'i yang snying dam pa: dpal chen khro lod sgrub sde myur lama'aphags ma'i chos skor bsnyen sgrub tshad dang ldan par mkha' 'gro'i 'du ljongs tshal nas: zhagabargyar dam rgya bcad na: rtags dang mtshan ma 'byung ngo byin rlabs rno so khyada'aphags gnas der gtum drag rgyal po: 'phags ma ye shes mtsho rgyal: sgom bzlas lung bzhin brten dang rtags mtshan nges par gsal lo chos bdag mang po' grub 'bras yang dag mngon du 'gyur ro: shar phyogs snyare'i gnas su: 'phags ma nyer gcig bsgom zhing: bzlas brjod tshad dang ldan na:drod rtags khyad par 'phags shing bzhan don rgyachen 'grub po: de phyogs rdza spang khrod kyi sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam par dpal chen phrin las bsnyen cing zhag brgyar dam rgya bcad na: 'grub rtags khyad 'phags 'byung ngo

rlu: bdud sprul mang po 'gum 'gyur: shar phyogs brag dkar rdzogs su: sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo: mas ra ba'i tshe sgrub: dri med pad+ma dkar po: rat+na'ithugs dam gong 'og: zhag brgyar bsnyen bsgrub bsgom na phyi nang shesang ba'i drod rtags ya mtshan khyad 'phags rmad byung: 'gro don ngo mtshar 'byung 'gyur: rma yul gnas kyilung par: bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho: 'bod sbad las la brtson na lus dang grib ma ltar du 'grogs nas phrin las rab 'byams: rtsol med yin bzhin 'grub po: khri shogasnying po'i gnas su: gsol 'debs tshig bdun bzlas pa: bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol na gu ru'i 'bral med rjes su: 'dzin zhing byin gyis brlab so: sku gegs 'phreng kun selalo: rigs gsum mgon po'i gnas su: rta phyag khyung dang seng gdongs gu drag sgrub sde dgu dang: yi dam gshin rje'i tshogs rnams: bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol na: byin rlabasadangos grub 'byung zhing: bar chad ma lus byang la: don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub so: khams kyi tsā ri'i 'dabs su: zab pa'i chos gter ma lus: bskyed bsgom bzlas

dmigs 'grub na: bar chad g.yul las rgyal de: don gnyis rtsol med lhun grub: rba gnas gsang ba'i phug par: gu ru zhi ba'i bsnyen sgrub: bde stong rtsa rlung zhag brgyar brtul zhugs spyod na grub 'bras: rtags mtshan mngon du 'gyur ro: thang shing dben pa'i gnas su: gsang ba ye shes zhing 'tsho rta nag ku ru kul+le'i: bskyed bsgom ting 'dzin brtson na: grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong ngo 'jig rten dbang phyug gnas su: zhi ba'i sgrub sde ma lus: bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'byel na: 'gro 'dul mthu dang ldan no: rgyal mo tsha rong 'dabs su: skabs de'i chos sde gsum po: bsnyen cing sgrub la 'bad na: dngos grub zab mo 'byung ngo: brag lha mgon po'i 'dabs su: bstan srung drag sngags bsgrub na:kla 〈liganya' non gyur nas: snyan grags phyogs bcur khyab poX yar lung phug gsum brten zhing: gsang lam nyams su blang na 'ja' lus 'pho chen 'grub po dung gi ri bo'i 'dabs su: dbang chen chos sde'i zhal phyes: bsnyen tshad gnad la brtson na rtags dang rten 'brel dge 'ong: kong phyogs ci 'grub sdongs nas: bka' rgya'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye: zab

kyi ba'i man ngag bsgom na: 'gro don bsam yas 'grub po: de ltar tshad du 'khyol na 'gro don phyogs bcur 'byung ngo: snyan grags nam mkha' mthar khyab: sku tsheyar ngos zla ltar gos dkar ral khul 'dus sde ngo mtshar bkod la 'byung ngo: brda tshig legs nyes ru mo ma brjed snying la bstim dang dgos ched sna tshogs yod do: nus ldan rdo rjer gtad rgya: zhes gsungs so: de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma gzhan gyi mi thub ma sku mdog sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi btsugs pa smar smin las me 'bar ba dar dpyangs mgo phreng seng sham rus rgyan thod pa'i dbu rgyan sogs mdzes pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga dang g.yon 'khor lo 'dzin pa zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur stag gi gdan la rol ba 'ja' dang 'od zer me ru 'khrigs pa'i dbus nas bzhugs pa dang zhal mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar du btab po kyeho 'jigs brgyad dbyings su bsal la dngos grub 'dzad med stsol ba'i: 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi

thub: mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs 'tshal bdag gi zab gter rgya mtsho: bkrol nas sbyin rung chos bdag: gang yin ci tsam 'byung 'gyur: lung bstan zab mo gsung 'tshal zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so: e ma las dang bskal ba ldan pas: skyes mchog nus ldan rdo rje bdag la legs par gson dang:dbye bsal chos bdag bshad do spyir na zab gter rgya mtsho'i: chos bdag stong dang brgya yod rtsa ba'i chos bdag lnga brgya yang gsang bdag po brgya rtsa mdo tsam khyod la smos kyi zab gter rgya mtsho'i mdzod la: dbang thob dharma ku mud: 'bru yi skyes mchog saṅga'i: skye rtags brtul zhungs dbang po: gzhan gyi 'gran bral 'byung ngo: gsang ba snying khrag bdag po: tshig gis bskul ba'i bu lnga: rjes 'byung skyes bu bcu gsum: sgra thos gang zag rnam gsum: las ldan gzung ma gcig bcas: bka' lung ltar du 'byung ngo: rang skal gdams pa gtad dgos: bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin mdzad na rtags mtshan khyad 'phags 'byung ngo: zab gsang phrin las lam khyer: bdag po rtsa ba bco lnga: yan lag rnam pa

rnu brgyad dang: brtul zhugs ral khur gsum 'byung chos skal sbyin zhing bsgrub na grub rtags khyad par 'phags so: drag po khro lod bstan 'dzin: pad+ma'i mtshan 'chang bcu gsum maṅga'i ming can rnam lnga: bī dza'i rtags 'chang rigs brgyad: dus su rnam par 'byung ngo: rang skal spro la dben par bsnyen sgrub mdzad na rtags mtshan: ngo mtshar yid ches 'byung ngo: 'chi med tshe gsang 'dzin pa'i: skye bu sa ra'i ming 'dzin: rigs ldan bcu drug 'byung ngo: bstan srung drag sngags 'dzin pa'i: ral khur a bya'i ming can: las ldan bcu gnyis 'byung ngo: zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i: bstan pa rin chen 'dzin pa'i: skyes chen dben ri brten mdzad: gangs seng lta bu bcu gsum: 'dam khrod dug chu dor 'gro nyon mongs smag gi khrod nas: dug lnga rgyan du shar ba'i: rma bya lta bu'i bu lnga 'jigs bral 'brel tshad don ldan: rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i: g.yu 'brug lta bu'i skyes chen: rnam pa bco brgyad 'byung ngo: byad sgrub nyi ltar gsal lo: 'khor ba'i rgong sbubs klong nas: 'dab drug gshog rtsal ldan zhing: phyi rgya grol ma thag tu: mkha' la gnam

'phang gcod pa'i rigs rgyud bu gsum 'byung la: snyan grags mkha' ltar rgyas 'gro: na bun g.yu ljang khrod nas: phan bde'i gru char 'beb cing 'gro rgya'i ge sar zum pa gsal byed skyes bu nyer lnga: bstan pa'i gsos su 'byung ngo: ral khur dkar po'i mdangs 'dzin: snying rje'i lcags kyu 'chang zhing: yul drug ltad mor 'gro yang: zhen 'dzin gtinganas chod pa'i: skyes mchog rnam pa bcu gcig: 'gro ba'i dpal du 'byung ngo: bam ri thod pa'i mkhar nas: bsam bzhin 'gro 'dul pho nya zang thal dri bral bu brgyad: 'byung la sgron me sbar ro: rgya mtsho chu la brten yang mi g.yeng gdams pa shes pa'i: rigs ldan pho nya drug bcu: bstan pa 'dzin phyir 'byung ngo: rtags dang rten 'brel ming rus rang rang lung byang ltar du: mi basmu 'byung ngo de tshe: rang skal gdams pa sbyin la sgrub tshug lung ltar zung dang: 'gro don rgya chen 'byung ngo: rten 'brel ya mtshan che'o: khyad par skabs kyi dgos don pad 'byung thugs rje'i 'od zer: skyes mchog ku mud ma ṇi: rdo rje rigs kyi dpa' bo: bstan 'di'i bu mchog dam pa: mtsho rgyal gsung gi 'od zer: skyes mchog bibyu

phyi ming 'dzin: rin chen rigs kyi dpa' bo: bstan 'di'i bu mchog dam pa:cog ro sku yi 'od zer: skyes mchog ku mud dharma pad+ma rigs kyi dpa' bo: bstan pa 'di'i bu mtshog rong sngags nyi ma'i 'od zer: skyes mchog kun bzang ming can: las rab rigs kyi dpa' bo: bstan 'di'i bu mchog dam pa: gnubs ban brte'i 'od zer:skyes mchog sa ra'i mtshan 'chang: sna tshogs rigs kyi dpa' bo bstan 'di'i bu mchog dam pa: lha dpal thugs rje'i 'od zer: skyes mchog stobs kyi mtshan 'chang: brtul zhugs rigs kyi dpa' bo: bstan 'di'i bu mchog dam pa:rdo rje bdud 'joms 'od zer: skyes mchog ga ga'i ming can sangs rgyas rigs kyi dpa' bo bstan 'di'i bu mchog dam pa: 'gro 'dul dpa' bo bdun pos: gdams pa nyams su sku nga dang ltas mtshan khyad par 'phags so: nyid kyi brtse bas bzung 'tshal: gzhan yang dz+nya na sa ra'i sprul ba yar stod phyogs na: pad+ma'i mtshan 'chang ḍak+ki: tshe gcig sangs rgyas dpa' mo: bstan 'di'i las kyi gnyer thob sher dkar rdo rje mtsho yi: sprul pa tsha rong phyogs na: dharmā'i

mtshan 'chang ḍak+ki:'khor ba dbyings sgrol dpa' mo:bstan 'di'i las kyi gnyer 'dzin:'od 'chang sprul pa rat+na:sa ra'i ming can ḍak+ki:bde stong gar gyi dpa' mo:bstan 'di'i las kyi gnyer 'dzin:shes rab dpa' mo rnam gsum:zab mo bstan pa skyongs ba'i pho nya mchog tu bsngags so:gdams pa 'di nyid sbyin nas:bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol na:rtags dang rten 'brel dge yong dbye bsal lag len ma nor:brda byang sems la zung dang:dgos pa rgya chen yod do ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje:zhes gsungs so:de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che mchong las grub pa'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma gzhan las rgyal sku mdog dmar spug zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa dar dpyang rat+na'i phreng ba gzigs sham 'ja' rkang rus rgyan thod skam dbu rgyan sogs mdzes pa:phyag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon mchod rten 'dzin pa shadas gnyis gar bsgyur seng ge dkar mo'i khri la rol pa 'ja' 'od zer gsum mu med pa 'phro ba dang zhal mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po phul la gsol ba 'di

(3 ltar btab po kye ho: bar chad g.yul las rab bsgral: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol mdzad: 'phags ma gzhan las rnam rgyal thugs rje'i bdag la rab dgongs: bdag gis zab gter spyod la chos min bdud sde gang 'byung bar chad bsal thabs ci yod: zab gsang sbyin mi rung ba'i: snod ngan gang dang gang yin: dbye bsal lags len brda byang: ci nus gsung bar zhu 'o: zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so: a ho: las dang skal ba ldan pa'i: rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje: bdag la legs par gson dang: snod min sde tshogs bshad do sa phyogs dar kyi yul na: dge btsun thos pa'i nor ldan: skyes bu bcu gsum 'byung 'gyur: de la zab chos ma sbyin: ma smar yul kyi phyogs na: skyes chen rdo rje'i ming can: bcu gsum bstan la spro yang: da skabs 'dul dus min pa'i: gsang rgya zab mo bsdam dgos rnga yi zab gsang mchod 'chang: girti shwa ra garma: smon log bdud sprul yin pas: rlung phyogs tsam yang ma bsgrags 'dzi yul bongs thung lus rgyas: sa ra dha dza ku mud: sku yi dgra ru

'gyur srid: de la zab bcud ma sbyin: gser ljongs ra dza'i sprul pa: kirti pha la ma ṇi brnya maṅga rat+na: shā ra ku mud brgyad do: smra mkhas gling mo sgrogs kyang: phyogs su nye bar mabyed: gdams bcud zur tsam ma ston rta yul rang phyogs 'dzin pa'i: nirma sa pa she: ka ra dam sris brlabs pas: yang snying zag tu ma re ra: sde phyogs rdza rgyud yul dbus: midrag gol sa mtho ba: cho min rig pa cor chung: sna tshogs zug rngu mang 'byung: de la gdams ngag ma shor: bdud sprul kirti'i ming la: zab mo mthu sgrub ma shor se phung a yu'i ming la: zab gsang snying khrag ma sbyin rdo rgyud bya lag can dang sprel mgo mthu yi ming 'dzin: blo gtad 'khri shing dor dgos ra tsā bā su'i ming can: zab pa'i dam srir 'gyur bas: bsrung ma'i rno la drangs 'tshal: btsan dmar pudhe'i ming la: 'brel ba tsam yang ma bzhag: grub rigs gter tshul 'chang ba'i: zog po pha la'i ming dang: ma ṇi shā ra dha dza kirti ya na burnya'i: ming can dag la rlung tsam bsgrags du mi rung bka' rku: 'brel tshad dmyal bar 'gro'o: zhing blon dpon gyi tshul 'dzin: brte garma gnyis kyis: rang yul

༷/ dmag jag dgra zlas:mi bde'i go skabs ston no ta ra u pa'i skye rtags:dz+wa la pa pā ru pas:mi 'dod sna dgu 'khrug slong:se phung gdugs dkar ming can:mi rta brgya rtsa'i sgog gcod:skyes can mang po'i gshed 'gyur:phyi ma rdo rje'i dmyal bar:zug rngu bzod med myong dgos:bar brgyad ga ga'i ming dang a bya'i ming 'dzin bcu gsum:bstan la 'du bar ma byed:byang phyogs ral khur khyu nas:a lags pha la badz+ra:karma dh+wa dza bibyu nor sbyin mgu bar gyis la zab chos phyogs tsam ma ston:nub phyogs sngags mang khrod nas:a lags grub 'bras can dang:sa ra lak+ta ka ra:su kha ni dza ku mud the'u ring dam sris brlab pas:zab mo'i chos gter ma bzhin:rtse mang ra yi phyogs na bon skyes rdzu 'phrul mthu thob:mon bdud sha mgo'i sprul pa:'brel tshad dmyal bar 'phen no:bar chad bdud rigs sna tshogs:bsgrangs na bsam kyis mi khyab:bzlog byed seng ha ḍak+ki rdul brlag rdo rje khros pa:'joms mdzad gu ru khro lod:gsod byed bstan srung rgya mtsho thabs mchog bdud gcod zab mo:kun grol brtul zhugs ro snyoms:

phan byed dngas len man ngag:bstod smad tshig gis ma bsre:phyi tshul gces spras brkyang yang:nang don man ngag ma re ra:ma brjed sems la zung dang:dgos pa rgya chen yod do:nus ldan rdo rje'i dgongs mdzod:ces gsungs so de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che sbur len gyi gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma nags khrod lha mo sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis sbyan gsum zhi 'dzum khro gnyes sgeg pa dar dang rat+na rus pa'i rgyan sna tshogs spras pa:phyags g.yas shing lo dang g.yon gri gug 'dzin cing shadas gnyis gar bsgyur gyis sha za'i gdan la rol pa 'ja' zer sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang bskor ba maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di btab po kye hoḥ'agro ba'i 'jigs tshogs gzhom zhing phan bde'i gru char spel ba'i:'phags ma nags khrod lha mo mkhyen brtse nus pas rab dgongs bdag gi tshe dang chos la:bar chad ji ltar 'byung dang:skyob byed bsrung bzlog gang dgos:brda byang zab mo gsung 'tshal zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di

gyi skad gsungs so: e ma: tshogs smon las 'brel bzang po'i: 'bras bu yul du sad pas: rnal 'byor nus ldan rdo rje: legs par bdag la gson dang: zhal ta tshigs gsum bshad do: spug po dung so can gyis: stag la phra ma 'gyed nas: mi snyan sku ma sgrogs yang: ro mnyam brtul zhugs dgongs mdzod: gnam sa byi ba'i zhon tshe: 'du 'dzi rnam g.yang cham zhog: bsnyen bsgrub dam rgya mdzad na: bar chad g.yul las rnam rgyal: glang dmar rwa rtse brdar skabs: ma nyes la yog 'byung 'gyur: dbang drag shan pas bzlog go: sa stag nga ro g.yo skabs: dam sri 'joms phyir rdo rje'i: zab sgrub 'dzug na dge'o: mgyogs rtsal rgyu ba'i sna la: re 'byams bzlog pa khyung nag: dkar po'i dbyar lnga'i sgra 'byin: nye phyogs dgra 'dres 'tshe bas: mi bde'i la yog 'don no: de 'joms 'chol khros rgyal po: lto 'gros dkar po nyul tshe: dug rlangs khyi la phog 'gyur: lo gyon bsnyen sgrub gal che: chu las cang shes g.yo tshe: zug rngu sna tshogs 'byung ngo bzlog byed drag mo mched gsum: rlan la g.yang mo lug rol: kha tas sgra ngan 'byin zhing: phe phejag

gis bsu 'o: bzlog bsgyur ma mo bcu gnyis: yal ge'i ri dwags rtse skabs: glang la dug mda' phog srid: 'joms byed rta mgrin nag po: zhag brgyar bsnyen sgrub dam bca':'phur ldan shing la brten tshe: khu byug ro ga'i drag gzir: bdud gcod zab mos bzlog bsgyur: ngur zug gnyis kyi lang tshor: ma nges brtul zhugs skyongs shing: zab mo'i gnad don bsgom na: bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro: mche ldan rwa gnyis 'grogs tshe: bsrung rim thugs sgrub chen mo: lha gsol gdugs dkar khri bzlog bkra ba rna ring sdeb tshe byad phur g.yul ngo 'khrug nas: nad mkhon jag chom mang 'byung: bzlog bsgyur seng ha ḍak+ki bsrung rim badz+ra pa ṇi: rkyen sel ma hā gu na mchod sgrub dmar po lha gsum: skad dang mig stor 'grogs skabs: chos brgyad bslu ba 'byung ngo chags sdang rtsod pa'i 'phrul 'gyed: g.yo ba de dag bzlog byed gu ru zhi ba nyid dang: 'chol khros bde chen rgyal mor ga ṇa tsakra 'bum phrag: re re'i brngan pa gtong zhing: sun bzlog rdzong chen btang na: bde legs 'bras bu 'byung ngo: mgyogs phyor gros kha sdeb tshe ra tsa'i rkyen snang che 'byung: bzlog

blu: byed gu ru drag po'i: sgrub pa chen po'i zhal phye rtsal gshog g.yo lding byed dus dgon gnas mang po 'dzug 'dod blo sna zad med shar yang: dam bca' dgos med dran 'tshal: zab lam phag mo'i bsnyen sgrub g.yel med gnad la sbyor 'tshal: mche ba 'khor lo'i sna la: nang dbyen dge 'dun zhabrug pa'i: mi bde'i la yog 'ur zing: sna tshogs 'joms byed drag bsgrub dmar nag me phreng gtad 'tshal: dbyen bsdum mchod rten bzheng ngo sder mig zung gis 'khrud tshe: 'ja' lnga'i mdangs kyi lho mon: mi min mkha' 'gro'i zhing du: bsu nas dga' ston byed 'gro: srung rim sun bzlog gal che: 'dzum drug mchong rtsal mgyogs sdeb: de skabs 'o sgod khrag bskyil glang chen rab 'bogs khri dang: yi ge brgya pa bye ba: sa twa dung phyir bsgrangs na: gegs snang de la brgal 'gyur: shing pho 'brug gi mjug tu: dpa' bo 'gro ba'i nyi ma: rnga yab gling la bsu 'gro mgo rmongs sems can nyam thag: de rje rigs sras gnyis kyi mdzad spyod yab gyi rjes skyongs: bstan pa'i rgud pa bsal nas pha gcig pad 'byung drung du 'byon 'gyur yid

gnyis med do: ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: dgos pa rgya chen yod do: dbye bsal srung rim thabs la: ma 'da' snying gi bu chen: zhes gsungs so: de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che mutig gi gzhal med mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mdzes 'dzum cung zad khro nyamasachag pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan bcu gsum dang me tog gi do shal mdzes pa phyag g.yas be con dang g.yon pas rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gyis bya ka lasang ga'i khri la rol pa 'ja' zer thig le 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du btang nas zhus pa:kye he ged gsum g.yul lasarab rgyal 'dod rgu'i gru char 'beb cing: 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal: mkhyen brtses bdag la dgongs mdzod: srid pa'i legs nyes sna tshogs: gang 'byung 'gro ba'ibade skyid gsung ba'i bka' drin stsol lags: zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas 'di skad gsungs so: kye ho thabs dang thugs rje zab mos 'gro
