rlu: ba gang 'dul chos ston gdul bya brtse bas skyongs mdzad: nus ldan rdo rje gson dang sna tshogs 'gro ba'i legs nyes: bshad na bsgrangs mtha' med do 'on kyang mdo tsam smra'o: shar phyogs seng lding nags klong: rgya stag dmar po'i mchong rtsal: lto rgyud rkyang la bstan nas: nga ro'i sgra chen 'byen no: mi bde'i khrag char slong skad: byang rongs ral khur khyu la: sdig pa'i tshang khang bcas te: mgul gyi phreng ma bsgrangs srid: mi mdzes skad ngan 'byin no nub phyogs rma bya'i zlos gar: 'ja' 'byil mkha' la yal 'gro: gos sngon mu khu'i sde yis: lha ldan bcom la chas srid: me yi ngad pa g.yo skabs: snang mthas skyob la ci cha: lho phyogs gcan gzan ngar ma'i: mche ba kun la ngom yong: tshe zad ra sde'i dpung 'joms: 'on kyang kho rang dug mdas: dbyings su sdud la cha med: shar lha'i spre'u rtsed mo 'jang gi yul la bsgyur 'gro: mi rje gsum gyis sa bor dge la skyabs su chas 'gro: lho nub glag mo'i bde ga drug ke la rnam par ngoms tshe: dar thag la thod yal nas: mkha' las khrag mda' 'bebs so mi bde'i nad yam go 'khrug:

na spyang khyu yis: ser bo'i bla zog 'phrog nas: yul lha'i zhabrug rtsod ldang ste rjed pa'i gos dkar bskon zhing 'da' med lcags gyis bsdam 'gum byang shar ba dus drug sa la brdab nas srid pa'i legs nyes mang 'byung rgud pa sna tshogs ya nga: stod nas gangs seng dkar mo'i: g.yu ral phyogs su dkrugs la: mdangs la 'gro rta bdun lhug mas 'geb cing: gsal byed mun pa'i bsgrib 'gyur: smad nas khro yi ril bu: sa khams 'byung ba g.yo tshe gser la legs nyes ston no:brdar nas: 'go yi lan tshwa zhu la: srin po'i sa 'dzin byas nas gsod gcod shan pa'i las 'gyur a yul dug gi shing skye: sen mo lcags kyu rno bas: rwa dza'i com te: rang srid ming med byed 'gyur: sabha me rlung 'tshubs mas: 'jig rten rgud pa slong nas: nges med nad yams 'khrug la: sum 'gyur mkha' la yal 'gro gi sna la: lcags kyi skru gri 'khor nas: sdug bsngal rtsod pa'i ngad ldang: bde mchog dpal las skyob srid rā bzhi'i mun gling 'ga' la: smon log bdud sprul bu

gyi yis: skabs thog mi bde'i la yog: 'byung 'gyung srid pa'i legs nyes ma nges sna tshogs 'brug slong: mtsho chen sngon mo'i 'dabs su ra tsas brlab pa'i skyes bu: bcu gsum yul gyi sri dra ldang nas dug gzer slong 'gyur: gser thag lha yis bsu yong: kla kle'i rdzas sngags sbyor bas cho rol sna tshogs bsgyur ba: bdud kyis brlab pa min nam: rgang bzhi'i 'jer so re la bse mo'i dug g.yos 'phrul nas: mngal khrag 'byung ba'i la yog: ma bde'i go skabs 'phrul 'gyur re 'byams srin bus bskor nas: dmar g.yos sdig las 'gyed cing: sems can mgo bskor thabs mang: 'brel tshad dmyal bar 'phen pa'i: de 'dra'i las la ma zhugs gser ldongs mi rje gsumagyis: rang srid chas la gnod pa'i: bya ba legs nyes sna dgu: mi 'dod mi 'tshams ston no: gdung 'dzin dharmā pā la: re zhig dam sris brlabs na: sngon mo mtsho dkrugs rdub srid: rnga phyogs sbrul mgo'i las kyis: lnga stong khrag gi 'dam la: mgo rmongs a thang chad nas: zug rngu ya ma brla'o rma bya'i zlos gar bsgyur nas: kla yi tshang khang dkrugs te

sde gsum phung thabs brtsam zhing: mnar med gnas su ya nga: grub min ha la ma rgyu nyag gi phyogs nas 'byung la sde brgyad dbang du bsdus te: 'thab mo dmag la gzad do chos min g.yul gyi sgo 'phar: skye bo'i mo gzugs ston zhing: bud med pho las brtsam pa brnyes sngags spyod brkyang ba: sngags nag grong yul 'grims pa sngar min cho rigs sna tshogs: gar bsgyur snyigs ma'i rang mtshang: ston pa'i ngo mi mchar ro: dge spyod sdig 'dor mdzad spyod: brkyang na ngo mtshar che lags: ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje dgos pa rgya chen yod lags: zhes gsungs so: de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che zang gyi gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i na du 'phags ma nor ster lha mo sku mdog gser btso ma: lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum gnyer zhi tshul chags pa dar dang rat+na rin po che'i rgyan dang nor bu'i do shar 'phyang ba 'ja' sham dang nyi ma'i thod gdengs bkrag 'bar ba'i mdzes pa: phyag g.yas gter bum dang g.yon 'bras snye bsnams shing zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gyis 'dod 'jo'i ba dkar gyi khri la rol pa 'ja' 'od zer gsum mu med pa 'phro ba zhig

rlu: dang zhal mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po:kye ho 'gro ba'i re 'dod skongs shing:dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i:'phags ma nor ster lha mo:mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs mdzod:sbas yul gser gyi yul gru:gnas skabs mtha' dmag dben yang:de tshul rtags dang mi rtag:srung bzlog rim 'gro gang dgos brda byang lung bstan gsung 'tshal zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nas 'di skad gsungs so:e ma las dang smon lam bzang pos zab mo'i gter la dbang ba'i rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje:ma yengs legs par gson dang:rten 'brel brda tshig bshad do:sbas gnas gser gyi yul gru:'phags pa'i smon lam mthu dang:srung ma'i stobs kyis re zhig:dmag jag mtha' mi dben yang:da ni lta spyod ngan no:phas zer bu yis mi nyan:nye ba phan tshun 'thab mthon:btsun pa'i gosanag bsgo zhing mi skya'i dmar mdog 'chang ngo bud med dmar las byed la skyes pa'i ltar skra 'phyang ba:dman choms jag las 'gyed cing:phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun dkor

'phrog: sgrub pa gnyen po'i'abras bcom dge btsun sngags pa'i nor rku lci ba'i zas ngan de za sde 'khrugs nang dme 'gyed cing: btsun ma lus rgyas nal gsod dge btsunagri ru 'gum mo gcod pa ro bshal gol 'gyur: sngags pa grong chog 'dre brdung: bla sprul dme gzhi bca' ba: bya btang chos brgyad mang ba: pha spun nang 'thab mtshon 'debs bshas lug grangs med phab nas: sha khrag gser ltar nyo tshong: sdig pa'i zas gos byed do: g.yo rgyu basmu sems kho nas: ngang la dus 'da' rnam g.yang: sngar med gsar khrima'adzug nas lha srung g.yel ba'i dus 'byung: rje la 'bangs kyis brdo'o rgyu 'bras drang por mi ston: kha zhon tshod ma blta skabs: drangs bden 'jam dul che na: kun sdang dmodabor btsan 'dzug: khrel med lang la shor na: thams cad ya rab brjod 'dug: de yi rjes su 'brang ngo: bdud kyi rta pho 'phrogs la: btsan gshed bla zog rku zhing: sngon mo'itshangs khang dkrugs 'gyur: bya ba de 'dra brtsam na: lha srung byin rlabs yal lo: dam can nus mthu nyams 'gyur: yul lha'i rno nus rdul te mi 'dod sna dgu 'byung ngo: rgya 'dre'i

snyi: ngad rlangs rab g.yo: nam mkha' dmar nag sprin 'khrugs: sa gzhir nad yam rab 'phro bar snang thog ser gur 'khrigs: 'byung lnga'i brda bsnol rtsub 'gyur: mtha' mi dbus su 'byur ro: chos mdzad skyes bu kun gshegs: bkra mi shes pa'i ltas mtshan: bod yul thams cad khyab 'gro rā dza bse mo'i yul 'dzin: shi tshad 'dre ru 'gyur ro: gson rnams srin po dngos 'dra: skyid pa'i nyi ma nub 'gro: sdug bsngal mang po 'khrug 'gyur: de dag bsal bar 'dod na yul gyi rje bo rnams kyis: khrims srung bya las gtsang ma: chos spyod dam tshig sdom 'dzin: rku rgya jag khrims zab mo: dmag 'khrug g.yul las kun spang: ri rgya klong rgya bsdam zhing: dge bcu rtag par spyod do: srog gcod spang la bshas tshongs: dor nas srog bslu 'bad dgos: mi skya pho mo yongs kyi: sngags kyi cha lugs 'dzin cing bden drangs spyod pa bskyangs laḥ bzlas brjod dge bar brtson dgos lha srung ma hā ka la: khri gsol snyigs dus skyobs pa'i: lha lnga las kyi pho nyar: ci 'grub yang yang gsol 'debs bsangs gsol rlung rta grangs ldan 'byung po

gsur dang chang bus: brngan pa rgya chen gtong ngo: badz+ra gu ru'i dar mdung: phyogs mdog ri la phyar ro: sa mdo'i dam sri'i mgo la bdud 'dul thugs rten rab bzhengs ra tsa nyul ba'i lam la pad+ma bka' yi thang yig gu ru sku gzugs bcas te: legs par yongs su brtsam mo sa mdo'i 'dre srin rgyu sar bdud 'dul 'bar ba'i gzhung bsrengs dam sri mnan bskrad brtsam mo dgon gnas 'dus sde rgya mtshos: rdo rje'i rdzong chen zhal phye: bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol zhing: bsrung gsol zab mor rab brtson ya rab lha rigs rnams kyis: pha phyes brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes: nub med bzang por brtson na: re zhig rkyen las rgyal 'gyur: gnad gsang zab mo de dag: ma brjed thugs la bsten dang dgos ched zab mo yod do: rigs mchog nus ldan 'dus rtsal zhes gsungs so de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che in+t+ra ni la las grub pa'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma bkra shis don byed sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes 'dzum blta ba'i chog mi shes pa dar dang rat+na rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs 'phyang ba

gyi me tog man+ta ra ba'i rgyan mdzes shing: phyag g.yas me tog 'thor la g.yon bkra shis dung dkar 'dzin pa zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gyis cang shes dkar po'i khri la rol pa 'ja' zer sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po: kye ma: bde skyid lang tsho 'bebs shingaḥ 'dod dgu'i gru char stsol ba'i: 'phags ma bkra shis don byed: mkhyen brtses bdag la dgongs mdzod: bdag gi 'dabs su 'byor ba'i skyes bu shes rab sgogs med: skye rtags phreng ba ji ltar: bar chad yod med gsal thabs: brda lung zhal byang gsung mdzod: ces zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nas 'di skad gsungs so: kye ho: sngon smon las dang rten 'brel: bzang po'i 'bras bu dus sad: rnal 'byor nus ldan rdo rje: ma yengs legs par gson dang: brda byang zhal ta tshig gsum nges par bshad do zung shig skye dang tshe rabs bsam yas bsgrangs na zad mtha' med do: mdo tsam khyod la bshad do: gu ru pad+ma'i zhabs drung: 'khod pa'i lha lcam pad+ma: mi

'tshams tshe dus byas so: sngon smon rten 'brel bzang pos 'khor ba mtha' can gyur to: las sgrib re 'ga' sbyangs phyir: yar lung kong po'i sa 'tshams: mdog sdug bu mo bco lnga: ku ku smad 'drad gsum mo de rjes mdog gzugs sdug tshul: myang ral mchog gis rjes zin: de nas skye gsum brgyud rjes bu mo spre'u ma pa shes rab rtsal sgo 'gags med: chos dbang nyid kyis rjes su: 'dzin la byin gyis brlabs so: de rjes pad+ma las 'brel: zab mo'i pha gter 'phrad kyang: 'gro don gang yang ma 'byung: de 'phos chos kyi nyi ma: dri med 'od zer pyon nas snying po'i chos 'khor bskor 'gyur: de rjes rin chen gling pas: zab gsang bsgo skal gsum rnyed: de rjes pad+ma gling pas 'brel tshad rnga yab rira'agod: de rjes klong yangs rdo rje: zab mo'i chos gter 'phrad 'gyur: 'gro don bsam mi khyab po: de rjes rin chen bzang po: sngags 'chang pra dz+nya rasmi: mthu stobs burnya maṅga rtsal rgod ra ga rasmi blo bzang bzod pa rgyal mtshan chos byed sur+ya sidhi dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rje gzhan yang bsam mi khyab po de rjes gsang sngags rdo rje pad+ma 'gro

rlu: 'dul gling pas: 'brel tshad rnga yab zhing bkod: zab gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i: bstan pa'i sgron me rab sbar de rjes li yul chu shod: blon chen lak+shi ka ra kong phyogs garte badz+ra byang rong sngags skyes dz+nya na: snyi yul pha la mkhas grub: zhing 'dir shes rab thog med: thugs dgongs lta ba mtho la mkhyen pa'i blo mtsho rab rgyas: chagasabram shes rab zab mos 'gro ba gang 'dul mdzad do: 'on kyang dgos pa'i zab don: lnga gsum drug bdun bzhi gnyis: gsum brgyad tshe chos gnyis la:kag mang mchis pas srung bzlog: lha gcig pad+ma kā ra srog gi gta' ru brten nas: bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin mdzad la: grib sel bzlas chog zab mo rdo rje'i go khrab bsgo 'tshal: pha chos tshe sgrub gud sbas: chags med yi dam mdzad 'tshal: gzhan yang lung las byung ltar: spang blang rim par brtson dgos:'on kyang dkor kha grong la:rnam g.yeng dug zas ma spyod: yarab grub pa'i 'bras bu: ji bzhin mngon du gyur tshe: spyod lam gzhan dang ma bsre: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i chos la zhen 'dzin chags sred ma che: 'jin rten chos brgyad yul la: re

'dod phug tu ma bcug: nyon mongs dug lnga'i 'phrang la ma zhen mi dor skyong 'tshal: skang drug bung ba 'du tshe: zab gsang gdams pa sbyin 'tshal: sgrub gnas zab pa'i yul du bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin byed dgos zab pa'i dgongs gter rgya mtsho rnam dkar bkrol la ma snga: bcud ldan 'phags pa'i nor bdun: snying gi dkyil du 'chang dgos: zabagasang rdzogs pa chen po'i: bstan pa'i sgron mer 'gyur ro: thos tshogs g.yeng ba bor dang: rtogs pa'i dgongs klong grol 'gro:dka' tshag bor la skyid pa'i: ro nyal mdzod dngasngon smon sbyangs 'phro dus su sad do: bar chad lam sel tshig bdun bdud gcod nyams su longs dang: phyi nang bar chad sel lo: dbang drag shan pa dme na dbang phyug drangasgong rgyal po brin las pho nyar bsngags so: rgyal dgongs gsang ba'i yang bcud: g.yel med nyams su long dang: rtags dang rten 'brel dge'o: ces gsungs so: de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma dgra dpung 'joms mdzad sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba

rdzu: bzhi gtsigs pa khro gtum 'jigs su rung ba dar dang rat+na rus pa gzigs gi sham thabs mgo phreng sogs kyi mdzes par brgyan pa: phyag g.yas tho ba g.yon phur bu 'dzan cing shadas gnyis gar bsgyur gyis gzig gi gdan la rol ba 'ja' 'od me dpung 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btabs so kye nyo gzung 'jin g.yul ngo bzlog cing: skal ldan rjes su 'dzin mdzad: 'phags ma dgra dpung 'joms mdzad: bar chad dgra bo sgrol byed gnod byed bgegs tshogs 'joms pa'i tho lum zab pa'i man ngag: brda byang legs par gsung 'tshal zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so: ki dhi be+e ra we las smon rten 'brel 'phro sad: rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje: legs par bdag la gson dang: zab pa'i brda byang bshad do: 'jang 'dul mi yi zol can ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags: the'u ring ma hā'i ming can bse rag shrī'i rtags 'chang las ngan dam sri mched zung: ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags: sa

srin sme ba'i do shal: gling mo shar bkra 'dzin pa: phung byed 'gab 'dre zung ni ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags: ma 'dre mche bzhi 'dzin pa: grong rgyug ral pa dmar po: rgyamatsho dkrugs gzhi thugs ste: ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags sprel gzugs nad skyal 'dzin pa: ra mgo so phur lcags bsdam: nad yams spel ba'i dug zung: ngan sngagasagrub pa'i las bsngags: ral khul rā tsas brlabs pa mig dmar sku yi chas 'dzin: 'gro ba sdug sbyor gzhi ma: ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags: shan pa lag dmar ralakhur khrims med sdig rgyal de wa: skye 'gro ngan gtong zung ste: ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags brnye ra rnga can dang: 'dre mo sma ra dmar po: dug gi skyal ba zung ste: nganasngags grub pa'i las bsngags 'thab mo gtong ba'i skra dmar: mche bzhi 'dzin pa'i bdud mo mi bde'i go slong spun gnyis: ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags: wa la dugasbrul mgo gsum: dbang phyogs lcags mche sder can: phung sri ngan gtong mched gnyis ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags: bro dmar kwa pa mig gsum: mgo 'phyangs sor mo

zhi bcu gnyis phung brlag gtong ba'i zung ste:ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags stag par phub bu bkra ba:lte ba sme hom ldan pa:nus mthu mi bde ston thung:ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags:rdo ba mig phug ring ba:byis pa co tho dkar po:than 'gyed kla kle'i bu gnyams:ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags:gla mchu mig rtsa dmar po:khyi gzugs rna sba can te:yul phyogs bkra mi shes zung:ngan sngags grub pa'i las bsngags:blo stobs mi dge'i 'byung gnas sabha lcags kyu 'dzin pa:legs nyes 'tshubs slong gzhi gnyis:ngan sngags mkhan gyi skal ba:'byung po sbrul mjug can dang:dam sri bya yi mgo can:ngan sngags phung 'byed rtsa ba:ngan sngags mkhan gyi skal ba mtha' mi bya 'phru can dang:glen pa ku ku'i mgo bo:bstan dgra blo 'phrul zung bcas:ngan sngags mkhan gyi skal ba:phag dkar ldem ldem mkhun zhing:lcags sprel dkar mo'i mtshon 'gyed:ngan gtong mi mthun sde gnyis:sngags mkhan grub pa'i las bsngags:khyi dkar mtshe bzhi brdar ba lcags kyi bya ni blo rgod:mi mthun nyes pa'i sde zung:ngan

sngags mkhan gyi skal ba:lug dkar dbyen ma mkhan dang:glang nag rwa rtse brdar ba rgya stag mche bzhi ngom pa:ngan sngags mkhan gyi skal ba:zangs kyi mche ba can dang lcags kyi spu gri brdar ba:nang 'thab gtong ba'i dam sri:ngan sngags mkhan gyi skal ba:ra tsa drug phrag gsum gyis:mi 'tshams gnod rgol ston tshe:gcod yul spyo rgyud zab mos rang sar gzhom pa man ngag:bse mos glo bur co 'dri:dus dang skabs skabs ston yang:man ngag bdud gcod zab mos:dbyings su gzhig pa mdo rtsa:legs nyes cha ma cho rol:ston pa'i phyi nang bar chad:dbyings su gzhig pa'i don ni:zab lam phags mo'i chos sgo:phyi dgra brlag pa'i tho lum:dpal mgon ma hā ka la:bdud 'dul rdo rje gzhen nu:sra brtan gu ru drag po:nang dgra 'joms pa'i thog mda':dbang drag shan pa dme na sgog 'dzin drag mo mched gsum:rno myur sha za ḍak+ki:gsang dgra 'dul ba'i spu gri:bdud bzhi rtsad gcod gdams pa:mi shig lta ba'i rang mdangs:gzhom med rdo rje pha lam:gnyis 'dzin rū tra 'joms pa'i bdag med shes rab ral gri:ma 'gags lhun grub ye

gyi shes:rang gsal gnyug pa'i dran rig:yengs 'dzin zhen med chen po:rnal ma'i gshis lugs dam pa:rang sal skyong ba man ngag:ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje:dgos pa rgya chen yod do:nyams len gnad la sbyor 'tshal:zhes gsu sa so:de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che zi khyims las grub pa 'i gzhal med mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma khro gnyer can sku mdog ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsags pa dar dang rat+na rus pa stag gi sham thabs can gyi phyag g.yas thod dbyug dang g.yon bhan+ta 'dzin ching zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gyis gtum po dom gyi khri la rol pa 'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i dbus su bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btabs so: kye ho gdug pa thabs kyis 'dul zhing:brtse chen lcags kyu mnga' ba'iḥ'aphags ma khro gnyer lha mo:mkhyen brtse'i bdag la dgongs mdzod:bstan gzhi dgon gnas thams cad:bde skyid legs nyes ji ltar:'byung ba'i brda byang zab mo:ci nus gsung bar zhu legs:zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal

'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di ltar gsungs so: e nam hi ra we: skye dang tshe rabs kun tu: tshogs smon las 'phro mdzom pa'i: rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje: bdag la legs par gsan 'tshal: brda byang tshig gsum bshad do: ma nor gsal bar zungs shig: shar phyogs dz+wa bha la yi: thang de rgya hor khra 'gyur: rnga yul dgon gnas gsum por: dam sris mang tsam 'gyur srid: ska ldongs chos sde zab mo: mi grangs gsum la dge'o: byang sogs dgon gnas che ba: dam sris steng 'og 'gyur srid: ral khur sngags kyi sde la ngan sngags phyir la zlog nas dus kyi bstan pa stongs ba'i: mo bde'i cho rol 'tshubs so: rma yi gnas kyi 'tshams na: gsar 'dzug dgon gzhi dar ro: rmar gyi sa 'tshams 'dzin pa'i bstan gzhi dgon gnas mang po: ra tsas skabs skabs mnar yang: pad 'byung sprul pas skyob srid: rdo yi sa la brten pa'i: bstan dgon 'dus sde rgya mtshor: chu 'jigs shor ba sngags ldog dme mkhon bshad grwa sdig rtsod gser ljongs dung dkar g.yas 'khyil: rā dza'i lag na thog srid gsang sngags bstan pa'i ge sar: 'ja' tshon mkha' la

dru: yal srid: byams mgon mig mang ru mo: 'gab 'dre'i 'dzin la ci cha: lug la the'u ring gnas bca': bag ni srin po'i sos 'dzin: rgya yul mo 'dre'i tshang 'khrugs lha mgor dam sris glag blta rtse mo sabha'i bslu brid: snyi yi ser ba sbungs mtshams: sna tshogs nyi ma nub na: glo bur yam nad g.yo lding: stag rdzong rang lugs rnal 'byor: du ma 'khrug ba'i skabs mchis: rngam rtse me tog bzang poX legs nyes rma bya'i gar 'dra: yang rdzongs rā tsa'i 'byud pas mi bde'i la yog sna dgu: dus dang dus su 'byung ngo: gzhi ma sad mda'i bzung ste: sa khang yul bud 'gyur srid: shug la the'u ring dpon rgyal: 'byung nas bstan ma gnod 'tshe: mi 'tshams sna tshogs 'gyed do: 'jang la sabha'i me yis: dus su ming tsam 'gyur srid: rtsang ma'i mdo sna'i bstan gzhi bla sprul nang dbyen 'gyed nas: gzing mo'i ngang la dus 'da': seng ge ming la 'chang ba'i: bstan gzhi bdud kyi 'khri nas: mi 'dod sna dgu 'byung ngo ra yi lung pa'i gnas su: mi 'dod sna tshogs 'byug cing: dmag chom jag las byed nas: lha bsrung byin rlabs yal 'gro ra

bzhi'i dgon gnas cha shes: bdud dang ra tsas sa 'dzin: dmags rtsod jag chom 'brug slong: ru gzing rgol ba 'byung ngo: lha ldan ngang mo'i phyogs kyiX bstan gzhi dgon gnas sna tshogs: rgya dang po lhang sog gis g.yo ba sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur: bshad na zad pa'i mtha' med: de tsam rigs pa'i dpyod la: bsrung rim lha gsol gnad gsang: bi dhe'i lo sgrub zab mo: gu ru'i zla sgrub tshad ldan: tā re'i bsnyen bzlas bskyed sgom: ma hā ka la khri gsol: tshogs bsags spyon gtong gnad brten: snyigs dus skyob pa'i lha lnga:bsnyen cing snying po dar la 'dogs nas phyogs la brdar ro: sa mdo'i dam sris sna la: bdud 'dul thugs rten bzhengs nas: ki la'i bsnyen sgrub tshad 'khyol: sa mig bdud sgo brgya la: gu ru'i sku gsung thugs rten: zung 'jug brgya rtsa bzhengs na: skyid pa'i nyi ma shar ro gnas skabs bde legs dpal 'bar: ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: dgos pa rgya chen yod do bstan pa'i rgud pa gso phyir dgongs pa'i 1nga du bstim 'tshal ces gsungs so: de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che mchong las grub pa'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing

྅ yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma rab tu zhi mdzad sku mdog dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi 'dzum chags pa'i lang tsho bkra ba dar dang rat+na rin po che'i rgyan du ma'i mdzes par spras pa phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gyis sgeg bzang gi khri la rol pa 'ja' zer 'od thig 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po: kyes 'jigs chogs ma lus zhi mdzad: thugs rje 'gro ba skyob pa'i: 'phags ma rab tu zhi ma: brtse bas bdag la dgongs mdzod: bdag gi 'dabs su 'byor ba'i: skyes bu 'od gsal snying po'i skye rtags las kyi phreng ba: sna tshogs ji ltar 'byung tshul: bsrung rim bar chad bsal thabs ma lus bdag la gsung mdzod: zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so: e le ni wa re: rig mchog las kyi rdo rje skyes bu nus ldan 'dus rtsal: mkhyen pa'i blo yi gsan 'tshal: brda byang tshig gsum bshad do skye rtags las kyi phreng

ba bsgrangs na zad pa'i mtha' bral mdo tsam spros so ma brjed sngon chad thub pa'i spyan sngar: dgra bcom kun tu dga' ba: dag pa'i zhing khams mang nyul: spu rgyal btsad po'iyul 'dir: sangs rgyas gnyis pa byon nas: chos kyi sgron me sbar tshe rgya bod bstan pa'i zam 'dzug mkhas mchog be+e ra tsa na brtul zhugs nus mthu thob pa'i: rgyal ba nag po'achol spyod: gangs ljongs puṇ+ḍi 'od zer: gser yul bsod nams dpal ldan: brtul zhugs sbyin pa rgya mtsho rtag lung rat+na ma ṇi: rgyal tshab ga ga rat+na: kong phyogs tshul khrimasarin chen: sde phyogs 'tsham chung pa ṇi grub chen zhi ba 'od zer lho rgyud mkha' mnyam gling pa: 'gro 'du la pad+ma'i mtshan 'chang: skyes mchog pad+ma 'od gsal 'gro 'dul brtul zhugs gling pa: bar chad g.yul las rgyal na zab mo'i gter la dbang zhing: 'gro ba ma lus 'dul la: bstan pa'i sgron me sbar ro: zil gnon nus mthu che'o: gzhan las khyada'aphags 'gran bral thugs dam gsang ba'i mthil gcig: ma hā gu ru rat+na: rin chen gling pa'i zab bcud gsang rgyas nyams su len no: yi dam rta mgrin nag po: dpal chen

cas badz+ra ku ma:chags med yi dam bya zhing:bsnyen sgrub rtags them gtong ngo:bde bskyed mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal:snying tig gsang ba'i nyams len:'da' med sgog la brten mdzod:bar chad rkyen snang sel phyir:lo bzhin tshig bdun bzlas pa 'bum phrag dam rgya byed 'tshal:dam sri dgra bgegs sgrol phyir bstan srung dmar po lha gsum:grub rtags mngon gsum 'byung bar:bsgrub nas rgyun gsol chags med:mdzad pa rmad byung brten dgos:byad bzlog seng ha ḍak+ki:tshe bskyed man+ta ra ba:srog 'dzin gud sbas zab mo:dpal spel nor rgyun lha mo klong rdol 'jam dpal smra seng:de dag bsnyen sgrub tshad 'byel:phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags mtshan:dngos su ma byung bar 'bod:'dod yon rgyu ma'i chos la:zhen 'dzin phug su ma bcug:re drog gnyis 'dzin 'phrang la 'jo 'gegs rnam rtog ma mang:dgra 'dul gnyen skyongs bya bar:chags sdang 'dun ma bskyur mdzod:dkor kha drong chogs 'dre brdung:dmar las shan pa ma byed:'du 'dzi gol sa rnam g.yeng:'jig rten 'khor ba ma bsgrub:dug lnga had por shar yang:gnyen po'i 'bur

'joms byed dgos:grwa tshang ser sde mang yang:'khon 'dzing gzhi yin dor lags:bud med 'dzes sdug mang yang:sdug bsngal 'byung gzhi ma mang rta phyug nor lug mnga' thang dal med brel gzhi bor dgos:las ldan slob ma 'du tshe byams brtse'i lcagasakyu'i 'dzin dgos mtho la ngo bstod mi mdzad:dman la khro tshul spang nas:brtul zhugs zab gnad brten dgos bar chad g.yul las rgyal na:bdun cu rtse mthong tsam nas:rnga yab dpal gyi ri la:tshom bu 'bum phrag bcas nas:zung 'jug ye shes thob po:ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje dgos pa rgya chen yod do spang blang lag len theb na bde skyid nyi ma shar ro:mi basmu mkha' 'gro'i lung byang:sems la zungs shig snying nor:zhes gsungs so de nas yang phyin tshe rin po tshe in+d+ra ni las las grub pa'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma 'bar ba'i 'od can ma sku mdog dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum khro 'dzum zhi sgeg rdzogs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang mgo phreng spras pa:phyag g.yas me dang g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa zhabs gnyis gar

myi bsgyur chu srin gyi gdan la rol pa 'ja' 'od me dpung 'phro ba zhig dab mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po phul gsol ba 'di ltar btab po: kye ho gzung 'dzin dbu mar bsregs shing: mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba'i: 'phags ma 'bar ba'i 'od can: brtse bas bdag la dgongs mdzod phyis 'byung 'gro 'dren pho nya: 'brel ru ji ltar 'byung ba'i: brda byang tshig gsum gsung mdzod: ces zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nas 'di skad gsungs so: e ra bhi ma we: gson dang snying gi bu chung rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje'i bdag la legs par gson dang zhal ta tshag gsum bshad do: phyir na deng sang snyigs dus: zab gter bdag po mang yang: dbye bsal shes pa dkon no: de phyir mdo tsam bshad do: shar phyogs sngags kyi yul gru: bde tshal dga' gling bco brgyad: skyong ba'i brnya dharma: ka ra brtul zhugs 'chang mdzad gsum de guru'i sprul pa 'brel du rung ba yin no: sngags nag pa sham badz+ra: phyug po rat+na pha laX srin pos brlab pa'i skyes bu: dam sri de tsho ma brten: rma yul lung pa 'dzin pa'i: rnal 'byor

sur+ya ma ṇi: skyes mchog tshul khrims bzang po: bstan 'dzin ye shes rdo rje: 'brel du rung ba'i rnal 'byor: dbon po byams pa rin chen: mi drag garma rgya mtsho blo ldan pradz+nya gu ṇa kha sems phyogs tsam ma bsre: rmar phyogs sangs rgyas rdo rje bkra shis blo gros rgya mtsho: ngan dbang ye shes gzhon nu: gu ru'i rnam 'phrul kho na: 'brel tshad rnga yab rir 'god de phyogs dud 'gro'i ming 'dzin sngags nag rdo rje'i ming can: grub thob ru pa ri ta: than 'gyed sur+ya'i ming can mi drag sa ra'i ming 'byor: blo ming stobs kyi ming rnams gter gyi cha lugs 'dzin yang: 'brel tshad dmyal bar 'gro'o: rdo yul kirti'i ming 'dzin: dz+nyā na dang ni bsam gtan: brnya'i ming dang pa she: shrī'i ming can pha la: spyod pa chalachol mang yang: 'brel chad ngan song gzhi ma: de dag phyogs la ma nye: gzhan yang pad+ma'i ming dang: sna tshogs bzod pa'i mtshan can rigs bzang klu yi rtags 'dzin gu ru'iphrin las cho rol: gser ldongs dgon gnas bdun nas: bstan 'dzin sku rgod bcu gsum: 'byung la legs nyes ma brjod: la la dam sri'i rigs yin: 'ga' zhig rigs

rlu: bzang bu mchog:de phyir ro snyoms 1da 'tshal gter 'dzin pad+ma'i mtshan dang:skyes mchog rat+na'i rtags 'chang:blo gsal shes rab bzang po:ka cog be+e ro'i sprul pa 'brel tshad rgyud la phan thog:de min bu yug ltar 'tshubs:thams cad ro snyoms cham zhog:snying phyogs dam sri'i sprul pa:gter tshul bco lnga 'byung zhi :mkhal khung ku ku'i tshul gyi:sme sha dmar smug yod srid:'brel tshad dmyal bar lhung ngo:skyes bu dman pa'i tshul gyis grub mchog rig 'dzan bcu gsum:de dag gu ru'i pho nya:skyes bu 'brel chad don ldan:rigs kyi bu mchog yin no:hor yul ra bzhi'i phyogs na:ra tsas brlabs pa'i skyes bu:bcu bdun gter tshul 'chang ba'i:zog po dmag las 'gyed pa'i:sha bkra can dag rab ming:'brel tshad ngan song gzhi ma:dran pa'i sprul pa dharma:'o bran dpal gyi rdo rje:dpal seng chos kyi rdo rje:btsun pa'i cha lugs 'dzin cing:'gro ba'i bde skyid spel lo 'gran bral de dag brten dgos:ser po'i gos mdog 'chang zhing:blo rgod dug lnga 'tshubs pa'i ga zag bco brgyad 'byung ngo:brten na gdug rtsub che

ba'i: bya mang blo rgod rigs dor: zog po g.yo rgyu can rnams:tor la bces spres che zhing: chags sdang rang khar spyod pa'i: mngon lkog mi mthun g.yo rgyu'i: 'gro la bslu sems chernams mkhas pa'i dpyad na go sla: bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa: mdzad spyod zhi dul che ba snying rje gtong phod ldan zhing: bsnyen sgrub dben ri snyogs pa: zab gsang 'doms lamakhas shing: 'gro don bsam yas 'byung ba blo ldan rnams kyi rtogs so: dman pa'i legs nyes mi shes: legs nyes de dag bsal phyir: zhal chem khyod la bsgo'o: ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: dgos pa rgya chen yod do: dbye bsal lag len ma nor: zhes gsungs so: de nas yang byin tshe rin po che byu ru'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma dpag med gnon ma sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum khro gnyer chags pa dar dang rat+na rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang: phyag g.yas rgya gram dang g.yon ba dan bsnams pa zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gyis shang shang gi gdan la rol ba 'ja' 'od me dpung 'phro ba dang zhal mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po

dru phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po: kye hoḥ sna tshogs thabs la mkhas kyang zab mo ting 'dzin ldan pa'i: 'phags ma dpag med gnon mdzad: mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs mdzod: zab pa'i chos gter rgya mtshos: 'gro don 'grub dang mi 'grub: zhal byang tshig gsum gsung ba'i: sku drin dam pa stsol lags: zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so: dhi ra e waṃ la haṃ rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje: legs par bdag la gson dang: gdul bya 'gro don phrin las: zhal ta tshig gsum bshad 'tshal byang phyogs rong sngags grub pa'iḥ bstan gzhi zab pa'i yul du: zab gsang bstan pa bskyang na: 'gro don bsam mi khyab po las ldan bye ba'i grangs bcas: rnga yab ri la 'god 'gyur: lho dang byang gi yul du: zab gter bstan pa rin chen: bshad sgrub 'dzin skyong mdzad na las ldan gdul bya 'bum phrag: bco brgyad dpal gyi ri la: 'god 'gyur the tshom med do rdo stod skal bzang dgon du: gzhi bcas bstan pa bzung na las ldan brgya phrag rgyud la: rin chen snying po 'dzud do dag pa'i zhing la

grol srid: 'on kyang sku la gegs mang: bar brgyad phyogs su chos kyi sgra chen yongs su bsgrags na: las ldan sum bcu rtsa gnyis: dpal gyi ri la 'god srid: 'on kyang bdud sprul rnams kyis bar chad gling mo 'don no: thams mkhas mdzad pas bsal dgos: ska ldongs bde ba'i tshal du rgyu 'bras theg chen chos kyi sgron me rab tu sbar na las ldanamang po'i rgyud la: thar ba'i sa bon zhog go: bkra shis rdzongs chen 'dabs su gnas bcas bsnyen sgrub mdzad na: 'gro don chung ngu tsam mo: gser 'dabs yul la gnas shing snying po'i bstan pa rin chen: skal ldan tshogs la bstan na: las can nyi shu rtsa lnga'i kun bzang dgongs pa skyongs 'gyur: rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong phyogs: bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad na: 'gro don 'brang tsam 'byung ngo: las can ku mud praṅge'i: sngon sbyangs dus su sad do: rdo rgyud stod smad phyogs nas: las can lnga bcu tsam la: phan thog rgya chen 'byung ngo yar stod gangs ri'i 'dabs su bstan pa rin chen bskyang na: zab gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i: rang lugs skyongs ba'i rnal 'byor: brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga mkha' 'gro'i mthu yis

( 'byung ngo gang zag las can stong phrag:rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon:zhog nas 'brel ba don ldan:gzhan yang brda byang zab mo'i:bka' ltar 'go gser sogasakyis:rang rang srog shing khyad 'phags:ma nor bsgom bsgrub 'bad cing:bskyed bzlas tshul bzhin 'grub na:bde skyid nyi ma shar ro:rgud pa sna tshogs zhi gyur:sgog shing gzhanal ral na:nyams pa'i phung rgud 'byung ngo:rang gzhan kun la nor dbul de phyir mgo rmongs kun gyis:shes rab mig zum phyes la:bsten pa'i tsit+ta ma nor:snying po gnad du thong na:dgos pa rgya chen yod do:mi bslu mkha' 'gro'i brda byang rim pa lnga yi rjes su:tsit+ta lho nub phyogs 'gro:de nas grangs bdun skabs su:mig 'bras mi min yul khyer blang dor shes rig long ngo:zab mo'i rten gzhi brgya dang:nyi shu rtsod pa'i 'joms mo:gser mdog gos kyi lang tsho:'ja' lnga mkha' la yal lo:rtsi bcud 'bras bu sna tshogs bco brgyad than pas bcom nas:dbul phongs rgud char 'bebs so:mtha' mi dbus su rdib la bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bar du:mtshon cha khrag char 'bebs so:dug rladas stong

gi sgo 'phar: phyes nas nad yam rim tshogs brgya yi bar du 'khrug la: sa steng skye 'gro ming tsam: dus ngan che lo bcu pa'i mtshang ngan sna tshogs bstan cing: sdug bsngal ngang la dus 'da' bag chags srid pa'i btson khang: nyon mongs 'dam rdzab gnas su: mgo rmongs so so'i skye bo: skyabs med mgon dang bral ba: nyam thag zug rngu can rnams mthong na kye ma kye spyod sha tsha yi mug ga chad: snying rje'i gnas su 'dug kyang rang rang las yin ci bya: thugs ngal ma mdzad snying nor: don rnams ma brjed rigs mchog dpa' bo nus ldan 'dus rtsal thugs la yang dag bzhags nas: don gnyis mthar phyin mdzod lags: zhes gsungs so: de nas yang phyin tshe rin po tshe sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma lha mo rma bya chen mo sku mdog dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes 'dzum lang cho'i 'khyud pa: phyag g.yas bum pa dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa rma bya'i thul pa can dar dang rat+na rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis mjes par spras pa zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gyis rma bya'i gdan la rol pa 'ja' 'od

rlu thig le 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po: kye hoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum: shes rab phar phyin ye shes sku: 'gro la 'dren mdzad thugs rje'i bdag rma bya chen mo mkhyen pas dgongs: bdag la legs nyes srid pa'i brda: tshig nyung don 'dus gsung bar zhu: zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal nas: e dhan ni la re gson dang rigs kyi bu mchog: rnal 'byer nus ldan rdo rje khyod la brda byang zab mo sngon nas bstan zin de ltar: nyams len gnad du tshud mdzod: khyad par 'di snang bya bzhag zin pa'i dus ni ma mchis: da nas 'phro 'tshams chod la: zhen med btsan sa zungs mdzod: tshogs drug sgyu ma'i snang ba: rmi lam gar dang 'dra mtshungs: snying po lon dus med pas: dgos med chogs shes brten mdzod: nyon mongs dug lnga'i dgra bos ma bslu'i nyin par mi srid chags sdang phug thub med na: nyon mongs rjes su ma 'brang: dkon kha grong chog nyul na: baspu zas snum po yod kyang: brgyag spro tshim dus mi srid da nas grong chog bzhag 'tshal:

'jig rten chos brgyad brtsam na:zin dus grub skabs mi 'byung sgo mang kheb par mi 'gyur thams cad ro snyoms 'jog 'tshal:mi med dben pa'i yul na:nyon mongs 'du 'dzi bral song:skyid pa'i ro nyal chog go:de 'dra byung na ngo mtshar:rgyal kun dgongs pa'i ye shes:gcer byung ngo sprod theb nas:gom 'dres tshad dang ldan tsheḥrtogs pa'i nyi ma shar ro:zab gter gsang ba'i zhal phye:gdul byar chos 'khor bskor na 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i rten 'brel che ba yod lags:zhes gsungs so:de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che gser gyi gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma mi pham rgyal mo sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum 'dzum mdzes sgegs pa'i rnam 'gyur can dar dang rat+na rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang me tog gi phreng ba 'phyang zhing phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon ka pā la bsnams shing zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gyis khyims bya'i gdan la rol pa 'ja' 'od zer gsum 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po:

phyi kye ho:rdzu 'phrul thog pa med cing:dus gsum gsal sgrib bral ba'i 'phags ma mi pham rgyal mo:mkhyen brtse'i bdag la dgongs 'tshal:bde stong phyag rgya ḍak+ki:skye rtags las kyi phreng ba:ji ltar yin pa'i lu byang ma lus gsungs bar zhu'o:zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so:e nan ni dha la reng:gson dang las ldan skal bzang:rigs mchog nus ldan 'dus rtsal:ma yengs legs par zungs dang:zhal ta tshig gsum bshad do:skye dang tshe rabs phreng ba:bsgrangs na zad mtha' med do:mdo tsam khyod la bshad na:o rgyan yul gling dbang mdzad:rig bzang 'od 'chang bzang mo:za hor yul gling 'dzin pa'i:chos byed dz+nyā na dī wi:rgyal po ni sha ru pa'i:tshong dpon bu mo dharmā dbang chen dharma rā dza'i:sras mo maṅga'i mtshan 'chang:li yul skyes mchog rim lnga:zab mo'i chos la dbang byed:rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan:bskyed bsring su kha sirnyi:chos rgyal mu tig btsad po'i sras mo sa le sman dang de rjes yar lhung phyogs su:chos mdzad bidu de wi:ko po'i sgrub gnas brgyad la:

'brel ba'i bud med skyes bzang:rigs rus dbang po gtsang ma:sde phyogs chos rgyal sras mo:pad+ma 'am ni bde ba'i ming can khams dwangs skye gtsang:'dan phyogs brte can snyare'i la khang zhing sar:mchod pa bkur sti'i gnad tshang:byang rong sngags kyi yul du:grub brnyes badz+ra rak+ta drag po'i mthu la dbang 'byer dge slong skye bzang pa'i:'bras bu ngan 'gro'i mnar ro:de rjes kha ches yul phyogs pak+ṣi dpon gyi tshul 'dzin:khrims las sna tshogs brtsam mo:kong phyogs pad+ma sa ra:dge ba'i blo ldan chesgrib sbyongs gnad la 'bad skabs:cung zad ral ba'i rkyon 'byung rgyal mo'i 'dabs su rkarma bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin zam btsug bod yul dharma pha la pad 'byung spru'arjes zin:sngar gyi las sgrib 'ga' byang zab mo bdud gcod 'dzin pa'i:ma cig brtse bas rjes bzungs:mkha' 'gro 'od kyi dpal mo rten 'brel chos la rtsal sbyangs phyogs dz+nya na ta re:dge ba'i blo dang ldan no dbang phyogs yul gyi rjes 'dzin:brag btsan srid pa'i dbang mo brtul zhugs dga' bzhi'i 'gros mkhas:da skabs las kyi

rnu: rgya kun bzang bde chen dbang mo:sngon smon rten 'brel las kyis:zab gter phyag brgyar bsngags so:tshe rabs las sgrib sbyang phyir pad dkar gdan gnas pa tā'i:bzlas pa 'bul phrag bskyal zhing:snying po ca 'grub bsgrang ngo:tshe rabs lhag pa'i lha skal:ma hā gu ru rat+na spyi bo'i gcug tu bsnyel la:gsol 'debs yi dam bya'o:rje btsun 'phags ma tāXre:gtan gyi skyabs su 'chang la:snying po dung phyir bsgra ngo /dri med pad ma dkar po:rgyun du yi ge drug ma:dung byir bsgrang na 'phral rkyen:ngan pa ma lus zhi nas rtags dang rten ga'abrel dge'o:'phral rkyen las kyi khug sna:rab 'joms dbang drag dme na tshe 'dzin 'chi med lha gsum srog skyobs sgrol ma dkar mo:dpal bskyed ku ru kul+le/g.yul 'joms bdud gcod gdams pa:gegs bsal lam sel bsam lhun:tshad du 'khyol na dge'o:so gsum lnga bdun dgu la:nad gdon rkyen gyis mnar ro:'joms byed phur pa brten 'tshal/zhe gnyis bzhi drug brgyad la:nad gdon rkyen gyis gzir re:'joms mdzad 'phags ma tāḥre:bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol lo

'dod yon rgyu ma'i rdzas la:chags zhen 'khri ba gcod do:nyon mongs dug lnga'i 'phrang la:bsrung sdom zab mo brten dgos:mi kha pra mchu gling mo:chags sdang phra mar ma nyan le lo 'du 'dzi'i ltad mor:ma zhen rang tshugs zin dgos:blo rgod tha mar spyod lam:bag med skyong la ma dga' dga' sdug spre'u gar bsgyur chol rnyogs tsab tsub sbo la sems nyid rnal ma'i don la:mnyam bzhag sgom pa'i stobs bskyed byams dang snying rje zab mos:'gro ba gang 'dul brtson dgos:rtsa rlung thig le sgom nas:bde chen dga' bzhi sbar dgos:nyams len rang byan tshud nas:don gnyis lhun gyis grub mdzod:ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje:dgos pa rgya chen yod lags:zhes gsungs so:de nas yang phyin tshe rin po tshe sher gyi gzhal med khang mjes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma ri khrod lha mo lo ma gyon sku mdog ljang ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum zhi 'dzum chags pa 'i rnams 'gyung dang ldan par dar dang rat+na rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang pad+ma'i do shal 'phyang ba phyags gnas rma bya'i sgro mdangs dang g.yon g.yu yi ga'u 'dzin pa zhabs gnyis

myi gar bsgyur gyis ne tso'i gdan la rol pa 'ja' 'od me dpung 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba 'diltar btabs so: kye ho nyon mongs sdig sgrib sbyongs shing mkhyen gnyis ye shes 'bar ba'i: 'phags ma ri khrod lha mo: mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs mdzod: las ldan skyes burnams kyi: mdzad spyod legs nyes spyod lam ma lus gsungs bar zhu 'o: zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma ri khrod lha mo'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so: e ma gson dang rigs kyi bu mchog: rnal 'byor nus ldan 'dus rtsal: thugs rje'i bdag la rab dgongs: brda byang tshig gsum bshad do: 'bru ban chos kyi 'byung gnas: skye dang tsherabs phreng ba: 'du 'bral med pa'i sras mchog: bsgrangs na zad mtha' med do: dgos pa rgya chen rim gro: nyams len brten bya bshad na: blang dor 'du 'dzi'i 'phrang la: spangalen bya bzhag ma brtson: bze re blo rgod thabs mang: 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i snang ba mthun 'gyur ngang la 'jog 'tshal: zhen med dpa' gdangs skyong mdzod: gang shar ye shes

rol gar: 'dod yon sgyu ma'i snang ba: btang snyoms ngang la chams zhog: bde chen phag mo'i nyams len gsang sgrub brten pa'i bde drod: me ltar 'bar bar 'gyur ro: ḍāk+ki bde chen rgyal mo: brten na rtsa rlung thig le: nyams myong yon tan 'bar ro ma hā gu ru rat+na: bsnyen na dngos grub thob po 'chol khros rdo rje khro lod brten pas bdud dang bgegs bacho ga: ḍāk+ki rigs byed dbang mo: bzlas pas khams gsum dbang sdud: bstan srung drag mo mched gsum: bsgrub pas dgra bgegs g.yul bzlog: sbu gri dmar po lha gsum: gsol na bstan dgra drungs 'byen: rten 'brel nyes sel bzlas na: phyi nang bar chad sel lo:rdo rje 'bar ba'i rdzong mkhar: brten na 'phral skyen g.yul rgyal: tshe 'dzin lha gsum bskyed na: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob po: bdud bzhi rtsad gcod bsgom na: gzung 'dzin g.yul las rab rgyal: ka dag lhun grub bsgom tshe: rig pa'i nyi ma 'char ro: 'ja' lus mchog gi sa zin: yengs med zab gter rgya mtsho brtson pa'i nyams su blang na: don gnyis lhun gyis grub po: 'gro don blo rtse rgod po: bya btang brtul

( zhugs yang brtson:nges med bsam spyod sna tshogs:chos kyi bar chad yin pa'i:de yi lam du ma shor:chos bdag tiṣ+ṭha sa ra:bcu gsum 'bral med 'grogs pa'i:ma hā gu ru zhi ba:bsgom pa'i nyams rtogs rab 'bar:yi dam 'chol 'bros bsgrub na:bdud kyi 'phrang las grol lo rdo rje'i rdzong mkhar brten na:ra tsa'i la yog zhi'o:gsang sgrub nyams su blang na:nyams rtogs yon tan rab 'bar:drag mo mched gsum gsol na phrin las kun 'grub dgra sgrol:dbang drag shan dmar bsnyen na:gegs med yid bzhin 'grub po:sha za ḍāk+ki gsol na dgra bgegs ming tsam med pa ra:brlag 'gyur the tshom med do:zab gsang de nyid bsgom na:rtogs pa phul du phyin la:nyams myong yon tan 'bar ro rang gsal 'gags med bskyang na:rnga yab ri la phyin no:chos bdag ku mud ma ṇi:stobs ldan kun bzang ming dang:blo ldan dz+nya na badz+ra:bkra shis phun tshogs stobs can:de dag rnams kyi dgos rim:gu ru zhi ba nyid da :dpal chen rdo rje 'bar ba bde chen dz+nya na wa ra:bstan srung ral gcig shan dmar:las kyi pho nyar rab

bsngags zab gsang bdag po mdzad na:sngon smon rten 'brel dag pas rang bzhan don gnyis 'grub la:tshom bu stong phrag bcas te:rnga yab dpal gyi ri la:ston 'khor dgongs pa ro gcig:dam tshig ral bar gyur na:mi 'dod sna dgu 'bebs shing:mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung la tshe la gegs mang mchis so:de bzhin chos bdag rnams kyis:rang skabs pha chos zab mo gtad bzhin nyams su blang na:'di phyir phan bde 'byung ngo:nyams na tshe bsod dpal dang:'bras bu brlag par 'gyur ro:the tshom yid gnyis byung na:lag tu long dang gsal lo ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje:dgos pa rgya chen yod do:zhes gsungs so:de nas yang byin tshe rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du 'phags ma 'od zer can ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum 'dzum sgeg khro nyams cubhe zad chags pa dar dang rat+na rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang pad+ma'i do shal mdzes pa phyag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon nyi zer bsnams pa zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gyis phag gi khri la rol pa 'ja' 'od thig le

༷ 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang zhal mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab so: e ma: rgyal ba kun yum 'groba'i: skyabs gcig 'phags ma lha mo: rigs 'dus 'od zer can ma: mkhyen brtses bdag la dgongs mdzodaḥ zab pa'i rten 'brel sgo 'byed bkra shis che ba'i brda byang: zabapa'i bden brjod gsung 'tshal: zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs so: e ma: las dang smon lam ldan pa'i: rigs bzang nus ldan rdo rje legs par bdag la gson dang: zhal ta tshig gsum bshad do: bkra shis skyid pa'i nyi ma: 'dzam gling tha gru kun khyab phyogs bcur brdal ba'i 'od gsal lha lam yangs parabardal shog: na bun g.yu mdog khrod nas bsil ldan bde ba'i sbrang char: 'bab nas ku mud zum pa: 'od 'khyug rab rgyas smon no: lha rdzas tsan dan khrod na: g.yu byug gsung dbyangs snyan pa'i: bde skyid dam pa'i sgra yis sa gsum khyab par gyur cig sra brtan brag gi khrod na grub bum phru gu'i rgyang glu: bya tshogs kun la snyan pa'i dbyangs des bde

legs 'byor rgyas:rgya gar bsil ljongs g.yu khrod:skyid pa' ku mud tshal na:rma bya mdangs 'od bkra ba:'gral bral skye bos blo brid:tsha gdungs sel ba' khrus chab:bde ldan bsil chab khrod na:mdangs bzang ngang ngur sna tshogs:gar bsgyur rab mdzes ngo mtshar:dri bral gangs ri'i rtse na:gdong lnga'i dbang po 'gying zhing:dma' ba'i gcan spyang zil gnon:sgra dbyangs kun khyab ngo mtshar:g.yu ral dkar mo'i 'o rgyun:rin chen bum par bskyil yod:gser min snod la mi chags:las can khyer spyod nyams spro:mdangs ldan 'od thig bkra ba'i:gsos sman ha la nag po'i:rtsal drug bkrag zer rgyas so:nyon mo sa rgyan rdzogs e ma:ku mud dri bsungs khrod na:rkang drug mja pos gar bsgyur:gsos sman sbrangs rtsir spyod pa'i:gser sbrang dri bral ngo mtshar:lha lam yangs pa'i gur nang:nga ro'i sgra skad gad sa kyis: blo dman byams pa sgrag mdzad rigs bzang bu mo nyams dga':'od lnga'i 'khyud 'khor klong na:nub med rang byung nyi ma: kun gsal sur+ya'i dbang po:srid gsum 'gran zla med do:thugs rje lcags kyu rno bas:'gro blo thabs kyis

snyo bzung nas:bde stong gru char 'beb pa'i:dpa' bo khyed ni ngo mtshar:dgongs pa chos sku'i klong na:lhun grub pha nor zab gter:gsang chen rgya mtsho spyod pa'i:grub chen khye'u chung lo tsā ngo mtshar skyid pa'i gzhi legs:skyid pa drug gi thang la:rdzu 'phrul cang shes zhon nas dmus long lam sna drangs ba'i shes rab nyi ma ngo mtshar:2phags pa'i nor bdun ldan cing:tshad med snying rje rab byung:rtsa khams mdud pa grol ba'i:bde ba'i rdo rje e ma:stong chen lta ba yangs par:'dzin med rig pa lhun zhugs:rtsod bral spyod lam zhib pa'i:sa man sur+ya ngo mtshar:'od gsal rdo rje snying po:zab lam gsang ba snying khrag:dag snang yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas padzod:zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig rtsol bral nyams snabhe chos skor:gnyug ma mi shig don gyis:'gro khams dong nas sprugs mdzod:gzhan yang rmongs pa'i 'gro blo:mkhyen gnyis shes rab 'od brgyas:rab gsal rnga yab dpal rir ston 'khor dgongs pa ro gcig tshom bu gcig tu 'tshogs pa'i:rten 'brel che ba de phul:ma brjed

nus ldan rdo rje thugs la yang dag 'jog 'tshal: zhes gsungs so: de nas yang phyin tshe lhun grub rang byung gi gzhal med khang gi nang du sleb tshe 'ja' 'od thig le mu med pa 'phro ba'i dbus su 'phags ma rjes btsun myur ma dpa' mo sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum mdzes rab tu sgeg pa dar dang rat+na rin po che'i rgyan legs par spras pa :phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya'i tshe bum dang g.yon thugs garasngagat+pal bsnams pa zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gar gyis g.yu 'brug la zhon pa gzi brjid bzod par dka' ba rig bdag snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs pa dang: g.yas logs kyi 'bur nang la sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo lha mo'i cha byad can tshe bum dang mda' dar bsnams pa g.yon ngos su sgrol dmar khams gsum dbang sdud longs sku'i chas can g.yas lcags kyu g.yon nor bu 'dzin cing 'ja' 'od zer gsum mu med pa 'phro ba gsum dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab po e ma: dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i pho nya: ar+ya

gyi myur ma dpa' mo:tshe 'dzin yid bzhin 'khor lo dpal bskyed tā re dmar mo:mkhyen brtse nus pas rab dgongs:bdag la gdams ngag tshig nyung don 'dus zab pa'i man ngag ci nas gsungs bar zhu'o:zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma myur dpal lha mo'i zhal 'dzum thugs brtse chen po'i ngang nas 'di skad gsungs so:e ma las smon rten 'brel gyi bskyed pa'i:rigs bzang nus ldan khyed gson dang:zhal ta tshig gsum zhig smra'o:ma brjed rig dbyings su bstim 'tshal:sna tshogs chos khams kyi snang ba ma brtags bden grub ltar snang yang:dpyad na dngos po rang mi 'dug:nga bdag sems rtog gi rol pa:yul med zang thal du 'dug go:'dod yon lnga ldan gyi bkod pa zhen yul dngos mtshan gyi stong ngo dag pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams:ma rig 'khor ba yi bkod pa:sems 'dzin blos btags kyi rol gar don la mtshan ma ru ma grub:dge dang mi dge yi snang ba:'dor ba'i sgon pa tsam yin no zhen med rang bab tu klod lags:sna tshogs med pa dang stong nyid:ngo bo nyid dbyings su 'ub chub:mkha' mnyam byang chub kyi

sems 1nga dbyings ye 'bral med kyi rol pa: gcer byung mngon gyur zhig mdzad 'tshal gtad med byung rgyal gyi rang bab: shug 'byung gang shar gyi ye shes: 'dzin rtsol rtog dpyod dang bral ba'i sku gsum mnyam brdal du la zlos: gnas 'gyu'i shan 'byed kyi ma 'brel mngon lkog 'gyu ba la ma gol rnam rtogs 'dzin pa dang bral lo: yul snang nub pa'ang ma yin: tha lam rang gsal gyi shes pa dran rtog 'gyu ba dang bral ba'i: yang nge seng nge bar 1da 'tshal: blo 'das rgyal kun kyi dgongs pa: sems med mtha' ma yi shes pa: thim la ma rmugs pa'i dran rig: rang shar gsal stong zung mnyam brdal klong chen dgongs pa de skyongs mdzod snying rjes gdul bya rnams skyoja zhing: dag snang phyogs med du brdal lo: nyon mongs 'bur 'joms su bshig la: chen med dpa' gdengs te zin cing: brtul zhugs rang bab la klod mdzod: lta spyod sgom pa yi man ngan bog 'don thabs mchog la brtson mdzod: lhag pa'i yon tan rnams 'phel lo: ma brjed rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor: zhes gsungs so: de nas yang bdag gis gsol pa: kyi: rgyal ba kun gyi yum

43 gcig:'gro 'dul phrin las ma 'a bdag:thugs rje brtse bas bdag gi bdag la mkhyen pas dgongs mdzod gsung mchog tā re bzlas na byin rlabs phan yon ji ltar:'byung ba'i lo rgyus gsung 'tshal:zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal nas:'di skad gsungs so:e ma:rigs mchog rgyal ba'i sras po:rnal 'byor nus ldan 'dus rtsal:mkhyen brtse'i bdag la rab dgongs:snyi po bsgrangs ba'i phan yon:mdo tsam khyod la bshad do:sa ni rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs bcud yongs 'dus:tāḥni 'phags ma nyer gcig:re yis dgos 'dod char 'bebs:ltaḥni 'phags ma'i thugs srog:(ཿni 'gag med ye shes swā ni las nyon sdig sgrib:hāXyis zhi zhing stongs 'gyur:oṃ ni sku yi dbyings so tā ༷ni 'phral rkyen sna tshogs re yang 'jigs pa bcu drug:hūṃḥni 'phags ma'i thugs rjes:hūṃ gis 'bral med rab skyongs:swā yis mi mthun phyogs kun:hāḥbarjod dbyings su zhi'o:ma ni 'gags med gsung dbyang sa:tāX ni tshe dang bsod nams:re ni dgos 'dod longs spyod:te:zhes 'phags ma'i la mos:hūṃ gis dngos grub

kun stsol:swā yis 'phral rkyen sna tshogs:hāḥbarjod stong par grol lo tshe ni 'khrul bral thugs 1nga:tāḥni 'phral byung rnam rtog:re yang gzung 'dzin 'khyang ba:rtaḥni 'phags ma'i thugs dang hūṃ ni dbyer med zang thal:swā ni dus gsum 'khrul rtog:hāḥni dbyings rig 'bral med:tshe ni dgongs pa klong chen:tāḥni rigs pa'i ye shes:re ni zab gter rgya mtsho:teḥni 'phags ma'i sgo 'byed:swā yis 'gro khams rgya mtsho:hāX yis dbyings su sgrol lo:tshe ni 'phags mi'i gdungs so:tāḥni rigs rgyud 'gro drug re ni khamasagasum gnas ris:hūṃX ni 'phags mas rjes bzung swā yis sdig sgrib kun sbyongs:hāḥyis dbyings su sangs rgyas:snyen ni'aphags mchog thugs chen tāḥni gu ru pad+ma:re ni rdo rje gzhon nu rtaḥni rje btsun sgrol ma:swā ni snyigs ma'i 'gro ba hāḥni thugs rjes skyobs po oṃ ni ga ga ma'i ye shes:tāḥni rtsa rlung thig le re ni bcu drug 'gros kyis:rta ni dga' bzhi'i ye shes:swā ni bzung 'dzin dri ma:hāḥyis dbyings su zhi'o:tshe:ni ting 'dzin rnams gsum:tāḥni gsal ba gsum gzer:re ni sgog sdom gzer bzhi:nya:ni sgog

gyi gi snying po: swā yis bag chags kun sbyongs: hāḥyis rig 'dzin bzhi thobasnye ma ni zang mdog dpal ri: tāḥni ri bo gru 'dzinaḥ re ni nub phyogs bde chen: rta:ni g.yu lo bkod pa: swā ni 'brel ba thog tshad: hāḥyis zhing rnams la 'god: tho ni sku lnga'i rang bzhi: tā re ye shes lnga ldan: tut+ta re yis yang dag: mchog gi don rnams ston no: tures nad gdon bar chad: 'phral rkyen ngan pa zhi la tshe dpal bsod nams tshos 'phel: swā hā gnyis 'dzin 'phyang ba: sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig bzhin: stong gsal ngang la 'byams klas: 'phags ma gtso 'khor yongs kyi: thugs mchog yang snying yin no: zab mo'i dngos grub nye'o: mi skya pho mo kun gyis yi dam 'di la mdzad nas: gsol ba lhang lhang btab na: thugs rje nye ring med do: bzang ngan ris chad blo bral: 'phral rkyen g.yul ngo 'joms la: bde skyid lang tsho spel lo: nad yam dus 'khrug 'joms shing: rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod 'gyur: de phyir snyigs dus skyob pa yi: lha lnga spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur: bsnyen sgrub gsol 'debs g.yel med brtson: de yis dbang dang dngos grub thob: phyi

nang 'phral skyen ma lus zhi:the tshom med do sa ma yāḥbaden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal:ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje legs:zhes gsungs so: de nas yang zhus pa:kyi:bka' drin mnyam med dam pa 'gro 'dren 'phags ma lha mo:mkhyen brtses bdag la rab dgongs:sku nyid 'khor dang bcas la gsol btab dngos grub myur ba:rkyen sel bsam pa 'grub pa'i:man ngag zab mo gsung mdzod:ces zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pas 'di skad do:e ma ho:'di nas lho phyogs ri bo grub 'dzin gya:mdun ngos rtaX las byung ba'i zhing khams ni: g.yu lo bkod pa bde chen ye shes dal: lhun grub zhing khams mchog la gsol ba 'debs:rin chen sna tshogs rtsig pa 'od 'bar brdal:phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bkod pa dang:lha klu mi yi longs spyod bsam mi khyabaḥngo mtshar bkod pa'i zhing la gsol ba 'debs:khrus kyi rdzing bu yan lag brgyad dang ldan:dri bzang me tog ljon bzang 'bras bu dang: bya dang ri dwag chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs: ya mtshan khyad 'phags zhing la gsol ba 'debs: rin chen sa gzhi mnan na nem pa dang

྅ btegs na spar la bde mjam khod snyoms yang bdud rtsi sbrang char zil ma rtag tu 'bebs:yon tan mtha' yas zhing la gsol ba 'debs:gzhal yas khang dbus sna tshogs rat+na'i khri:mi 'jigs byol song gar bsgyur rol ba'i steng:ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' zer gur khang 'khrigs:gsal khyab bde ba'i khri la gsol ba 'debs:sku ni mi 'gyur zang thal in+d+ra'i mdangs:'gag med gsung gis 'gro la chos char 'bebs:'khrul bral thugs kyis yid bzhin re ba skongs:rje btsun sgrol ma yum la gsol ba 'debs:thugs rje brtse bas 'gro la dngos grub 'bebs:phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad g.yul ngo sel tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed:bka' drin mnyam med rje la gsol ba 'debs:gzi brjid 'od 'bar bco lnga'i zla rgyas 'dra:'od dkar mtha' yas phyogs bcu kun tu 'gyed:rmongs tshogs 'gro bye'i mun pa mkha' ltar sangs:dbyangs can wa mo'i sku la gsol ba 'debs:dbul phongs 'byor rgud bsal ba'i rat+na bzhin dgos 'dod char ba phyogs rnams kun tu 'bebs:sgrub mchog rnal 'byor

yongs kyi re ba skongs bsod nams mchog stsol sku la gsol ba 'debs dus min 'chi ba'i mtshan ma dbyings su bsal 'gyur med tshe la mnga' brtes rdo rje'i gzhi:mi shig a yu'i dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i:gtsug tor rnam rgyal sku la gsol ba 'debs:ma chags pad+ma ra ga'i mdangs 'dzin cing:khams gsum dbang sdud thabs mkhas phyag rgya bsgyur:'gro la 'dod pa'i re skongs dbang gi lha:ku ru kul+le'i sku la gsol ba 'debs phas rgol dgra yi dpung tshogs 'joms pa dang:'phral rkyen rgud pa ma lus dbyings su bsal:'gro ba thugs rje'i skyobs pa'i bka' drin can:'jigs byed lha mo'i sku la gsol ba 'debs:byad phur rbod gtong rdzas sbyor ngan pa dang:chags che nyams nga rmi lam ngan pa sogs sor chud bde chen ye shes bskyed mdzad pa'i:gzhan gyi mi thub sku la gsol ba 'debs:phra min mu stegs kla kle'i cho rol dang:rgyal bsen gdug pa'i bar chad g.yul bzlog cing:sdug bsngal kun las skyob mdzad rje btsun ma:gzhan las rnam rgyal sku la gsol ba 'debs tsha gdungs gzir la bsil ba'i lang tsho ston: grangs lhag

blu: mnar la bde drod rab tu 'bebs: gang gdul der snang rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum: sing lding nags kyi sgrol mar gsol ba 'debs: sku yis 'dod khams gsung gis gzugs kyi lha: thugs kyis gzugs med kha lo dbyings su bsgyur nus mthu yon tan stong gi dpal mnga' ba: 'jig rten gsum rgyal sku la gsol ba 'debs: gru gzings gnas mal them skas sna tshogs dang: zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i char ba 'bebs: mchog thun dngos grub rat+na'i gter chen po: nor rgyun lha mo'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: gzhi bde lam bde 'bras bu bde bar mdzad: bsam pa lhun grub bkra shis char ltar 'bebs: snyigs ma'i rgud bcom rdzogs ldan lang tsho 'doms: bkra shis don byed sku la gsol ba 'debs: phyi dgra mtha' dmag nang dgra dam log rigs: gsang dgra gnyis 'dzin rū tra ma lus pa'i: dpa' rkongs gdug pa tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin: dgra dpung 'joms mdzad sku la gsol ba 'debs: 'bar ba'i spyan mig glog ltar rab rdeb cing: rngams pa'i nga ros dug gsum log rtog 'dul: bzod dka'i gzi brjid dus

mtha'i me ltar 'bar: khro gnyer can mdzad sku la gsol ba 'debs sha za ro lang gdon rnams 'joms pa dang: gcan gzan rgya mtsho srin po rims nad sogs: zhi mdzad zla ba'i 'od ltar bsil zer can: rab tu zhi mdzad sku la gsol ba 'debs: dmar ser 'char kha'i lang tsho phyogs bcur ston: ma rig mun pa mkha' ltar dag sangs nas mkhyen pa'i blo gros stong gi zer dngar 'bebs: 'bar ba'i 'od can sku la gsol ba 'debs: srid dang zhi ba'i sgo 'phar phyag rgyas gnon: dpag med rmongs pa'i skye 'gro kun 'dzin nas bde chen ye shes mkha' la rab rgyas 'debs: dpag med gnon ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: 'khor ba rjes 'dzin bag chags rkyon dang bral: las ldan bu rnams thugs rjes brtse bas skyongs: bka' drin srid pa gsum na zla med pa'i:rma bya chen mo'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: rigs sngags rbod gtong byad ma'i g.yul las rgyal: nyon mongs bdud kyi 'phrang lam kun bsal nas rnal rgyal spyod pa'i skal ldan rjes su 'dzin mi pham rgyal mo'i sku la mo'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: 'gro ba'i rims yam 'dzams ma thams cad

gyi 'joms:snyigs ma'i 'gro ba ma lus rjes su 'dzin:'jigs pa bcu drug rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i ri khrod lha mo'i sku la gsol ba 'debs:'dud cing mos pa 'i gang zag pho mo yi:'phral snang jag chom rkun ma'i 'tshe ba skyobs:lus sems bde ba'i lang tsho rab ston pa'i:'od zer can ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs:tshe bsod lha 'dres bskus 'phrog yal zhing 'thor:chad dang ral gas sor chud tshe dbang stsol:'chi med rig 'dzin sa la rab sbyor ba'i:yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku la gsol ba 'debs:khams gsum sridapa'i zas nor longs spyod dang:'dod sgu'i phywa g.yang rat+na ma lus pa:sgrub la char ltar 'bebs pa'i bka' drin can sgrol dmar dbang gi sku la gsol ba 'debs dus gsum sa ler gzigs pa'i spyan mnga' ba:chags thog dri ma bral ba'i ye shes can skye 'chi 'gyur med dag pa dbyings kyi lha:longs sku rje btsun tā rer gsol ba 'debs:stong gsal 'dzin med ye shes gsang ba'i klongs 'khor 'das ro mnyam spang blang bral ba'i thugs:spros bral 'gag med don dam ston pa mchog:chos sku yum

chen mo la gsol ba 'debs:mi 'byed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya tu:gang la gang 'dul sprul pa bsam yas 'gyed:las ldan ma lus bde chen zhing la 'god:rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab la gsol ba 'debs:gsung mchog 'gags pa med pa'i ye shes sku:rmad byung thabs kyis 'gro ba gang 'dul mdzad:chags med byu ru'i lhun po lta bu'i sku:rigs bdag snang mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs:dran pas 'jigs brgyad skyob pa'i tā re ma:smon pas dgos 'dod re ba ma lus skongs:bsam pas mchog gi dngos grub rab stsol ba'i:'gran bral bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs:mos gus ldan pas gnyis gsum bdun brjod na:'dod pa thams cad myur du thob par byed:bgegs dang 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams rang sar gcod:gdul bya'i skyabs gcig ma la gsol ba 'debs:lnga brgya snyigs ma'i dmus long 'gro ba la:thugs rjes yal bar mi 'dor rjes su 'dzin:las ngan 'phrang las sgrol ba'i yum gcig ma:sngon gyis dam tshig can la gsol ba 'debs:rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma ston 'khor bcas:yid kyis gsal gdab mosagus

( drag po yis:gsol ba rtags tu 'debs pa'i gang zag la 'phral rkyen phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol:'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug rgol ngan thul:tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed:mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs nad yam mu ge bzlog:zas nor longs spyod dgos 'dod char ltar phob:tshe dang chos la bar chad mi 'byung zhing:lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol ba dang:rtsa rlung thig le dag rdzogs smin nas su:g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing du skye bar shog skyes nas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog:rmad byung sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren par shog de ltar mos pas bskyal na byin rlabs dngos grub thob po:bsam pa ma lus lhun grub:the tshom yid gnyis mi dgos:gzhanayang rkyen sel gsol gdab 'di nyid yang yang brjod 'tshal:snye tā re dzobatsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can ar+ya tā re nyer gcig gtso 'khor bcas:gsol 'debasabu la brtse bas rjes su zungs:'jig brgyad g.yul bzlog 'phags ma'i zhing du drongs ces pa ci 'grub bzlas na:gegs sel bsam pa lhun grub:the tshom yid gnyis mi

dgos: gzhan yang gsol 'debs zab mo ni: yo tā re: po ṭa la yi gnas mchog na: bzhugs pa'i rje btsun tā re ma: 'khor dang bcas la gsol ba 'debs phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs bskyed 'jigs tshogs 'phrang las sgrol ba dang 'phags ma'i zhabs drung skye bar shog: ces brjod gegs 'phrang rkyen sel: bsam pa lhun gyis grub po nyams rtogs yon tan rab rgyas don gyi sangs rgyas 'grub po ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: dgos pa rgya chen yod do: ces gsungs so de nasayang bdag gis gsol ba gdab pa: kye ho dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum chen 'phags ma rjes btsun tā re: mkhyen brtses bdag la dgongs mdzod: nyid kyi zab sgrub man ngag khyad 'phags byin rlabs ldan pa: ci nus gsung bar zhu'o: zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te phyi nang gsang ba'i zab sgrub tshig nyung don 'dus byin rlabs khyad 'phags zur bkod du bris na legs par 'dra snyams nas gab pa'o: de nas rje btsun sgrol ma dkar dmar gnyis kyi zab sgrub re re gsung kyang re zhig gu h+ya de nas bar khang gi

blu: nang du yar phyin tshe rin po che sna tshogs kyi khri pad zla nyi ma'i steng gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar longs sku rje btsun thugs rje'i dbang phyug sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis sbyan gsum phyag zhabs kyi spyan zung re bcas bdun mdzes par bkra ba dar rat+na rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya la sdon bzang 'dabs ma snyan thad du dgyes pa'i steng ral gri sngon po dang g.yon thugs gar brten pa las pad sdong 'khrungs shing yid bzhin nor bu mthing gsal mdzes pa zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyis gdan la rol pa 'ja' zer 'od thig mu med pa 'phro ba zhig dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po phul la gsol ba 'di ltar btab so kyehorgyal kun thugs rje'i mnga' bdag:'gro 'dren mchog gi pho nya:'phags ma longs spyod rdzogs mdzad:thugs rje'i dbang phyug dgongs mdzod:bdag la zhal gdams zab mo:gsung ba'i bka' drin stsol lags:zhes zhus tshe 'phags ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nas 'di skad gsungs so:e ma:rigs mchog nus ldan 'dus rtsal

mkhyen brtses bdag la dgongs mdzod: shin tu zab pa'i man ngag: tshig nyung don 'dus zab mo: tshig gsum bshad do gus pas: nyon la brtson pas zungs shig: shar phyogs dziyi yul na: gnyis kyis 'khrug pa'i ru 'dzing: re 'byams srin pa'i mche bas la yog zug rngu mang ston: gser ldan 'od stong rgyas pa dbang ldan phyogs nas baglu brid: midamar zhal lce 'don pas: legs nyes sna dgu ston no: rong phyogs sma ra can gyis: gling mo drug phrag ston la: mi bde'i la yog 'don la: zug rngu sna tshogs nyams thag rma smara'adu ljongs khrod na: sngar med rgya yi dmag 'byung: ra tsa'i grong mkhar chags srid gling mo'i sa rma snar la: pad 'byung sprul ba'i bstan gzhi: sngar med gsar du 'jug go:lcags kyi rang byung phur bu rno ngar nus pa ldan pas dam sri'i sde la gzir nas: grong tshogs re 'gag 'joms mo ma bu rdza yi khrod na: sngar med gu ru'i sprul pa gsum gyis 'gro donabyed do: sku ljongs 'du gling khrod ngos: dam sri'i dgon gzhi 'dzug nas: legs nyes sna dgu 'khrug 'gyur: mi bde'i rtsub 'gyur sgong ngo: rtsang ra khrod kyi mda' na: gshin rje'i

dru: gnyen po'i mkhar rdzongs: pad 'byung sprul pa'i mngon yongs: brag dmar rten gyi rdzongs snar spre'u'i gar bsgyur thabs kyis rma bya'i zlos gar ngoms nas:bde ba'i gad mo mngon yong: rgya stag bkra ba'i yul gling: dam sri'i brlabs pa'i dpon gcig: 'byung nas mi mthun dug g.yos: cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston no: ngang gi thang chen dpal la: the'u rang bla shing 'khrung ngo: gcod byed ral gri ngar ma: dpa' mo' lag na thog nas: drungs 'byin bde ba'i dar la: bkod na dge legs rab 'bar: dbang chen e yi dal khang: 'bum brtsigs zab mo'i gzhi la dpal chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i btsan rdzongs brten pa gal che: g.ya' gangs byed ma'i phyogs kyis: srin nag mgo bo gsum pas sa mtshams gar gyi gzhi la: 'chol khros sgrub zab shar na: skyid pa'i nyi ma ngo mtshar: sgra tshig snang ba'i glu dbyangs: gar bsgyur 'ja' yi ru mo: dpal gsum ne+e tso'i skad la:bzang ngan bslad kyi ma bsre: re 'byams ngar ma'i sna la: lcags kyi spu gri 'khor nas: yul lnga mi bde'i 'khrug slong: 'joms mdzad brag lha mgon po: gnad du gzir ba man

ngag byed mos lang tsho ngoms nas: ya ya'i bzhad skad 'byung zhing: sasta'i zhabrul 'khor bskor tshe: rdo rje'i rdzongs mkhar 'dzin dgos: dri za'i la yog 'dor zhing: srin gyi mche ba brdar nas: rigs ldan skyes tshogs yal skabs: pad+ma drag pos rab bzlog: ḍa ma ru yi gzhi la: sngon po g.yu thig bab nas: dmar po'i mdangs bzang 'phrog tshe rje btsun tā res rab skyobs: lang tsho ldan pa'i sdon bzang: gser mig ra tsas bslus nas: srid pa'i legs nyes 'byung skabs: ma hā gu ru'i skyob dgos: brtan pa'i sa bzungs byed cing gnyis 'thung bdud la bab nas: mi bde'i cho rol 'khrug tshe pad+ma dkar pos skyob srid: rnga rlangs nam mkha'i dpal la: rtsi bcud bum pa bshams nas: drug phrag bcu gsum ltad mor 'dus tshe snang gsal sgrol me'i: 'od zer phyogs bcur khyab 'gro: ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje: dgos pa rgya chen yod phyir: sems la brten dgos dpa' bo: zhes gsungs so skabs 'dir 'phagasam longs sku'i zab sgrub tshig nyung don 'dus lta khrid zab mo re zhig la gu rgya: de nas yang phyin tshe steng khang lhun grub rang byung gi gzhal med

blu: khang mdzes shing yid du 'o ba'i nang du phyin tshe chos sku yum chen mo sku mdog gser gyi lhun po lta bu zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum 'dzum mdzes sgeg pa dar dang rat+na rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyi mdzes par spras ba zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa phyag dang po gnyis kyi mnyam bzhag mdzad pas pu sti bsnams pa g.yas kyi 'og ma'i me tog 'dzin pa'i khar ral gri mdzes pa: g.yon gyi 'og ma'i pad+ma'i yu bar 'dzin cing 'dab ma snyan thad du gyes pa'i khar dga' 'khyil yid bzhin nor bu'i mdzes pa bsnams shing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad zla'i khar 'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po phul la gsol ba 'di ltar gdab po: kye ho dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyis: ye shes dbyings sku 'gro ba'i mgon: skye med gsang ba dbyings kyi lha: chos sku yum chen bdag la dgongs:zab gsang mchog gi man ngag bcud:myur lam snying po gsung bar zhu zhes zhus tshe chos sku yum chen mo'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nas 'di skad gsungs so: e ma:tshogs smon

las 'dzoms gyi bu chung rigs bzang nus ldan khyed gson dang man ngag don 'dus zhig bshad do:brtson pas nyams su re longs shig:'di snang gar bsgyur gyi rol pa:sgyu ma'i 'khrul snang gi bslu brid:'dod yon lnga ldan de mngon yang zhen med rang tshug nyid 'dzin dgos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pas:sems can kun yid la gnas kyang:ma rtog dmus long du gyur rnams:shes rab zum pa rang phyes mdzod nyag gcig grwa zur dang bral ba'i brdal khyab chos sku yi dgos klong:'khor 'das mnyam brdal du 'dug go:bsal bzhag rtsol sgrub dang bral song:bdag med shes rab kyi ral gri:rdo rje rnon po yis bsnams nas:phyi nang zang thal du gcod na:gnyis med mnyam nyid kyi rol ba:ma rig mun sel gyi nyi ma:rang gsal phyogs kun la shar nas ro mnyam ye shes kyi 'char sgo:'gags med ngo mtshar ba'i gnas so:bde stong zung 'jug gi gshis lugs:dga' bzhi'i 'gros rim dang sbyar nas lhan skyes ye shes kyi bkod pa:gcer byung zab don la brtson mdzod:snang ba 'od gsal gyi bkod pa:grags pa 'gags med

gyi kyi rang sgra:chos nyid rtsol bral gyi ye shes:'ub chub spros bral de mthong mdzod stong chen nam mkha' yi sang ni:rgya tshad phyogs lhung dang bral song kun gsal g.ya' dag pa'i ga sa lugs smra bsam yul tshogs las rab 'das:'di zhes dngos po yang dben la:rnam rtog 0〈spyol ba yis ma bslad:dus gsum mnyam brdal gyi rig pa:ji bzhin rjen byung ba de ko:ngo mtshar skyid pa yi gzhi ma nyams len rang thog du tshud mdzod bdud bzhi dam sri yis nye zho:'phral byung rkyen snang gi g.yo ba:ga byung thad rdol gyi rol bar zang thal rtsol med du gcod mdzod:ma brjed rig pa yi bu chung:nyams len gnad thog tu tshud nas:dgos pa rgya chen re 'grub pa'i:smon pa'i 'bras bu ni de tsam zhes gsungs so:skabs 'dir chos sku'i zab sgrub dang bdud gcod mkha' 'gro'i gad rgyang zab mo gsung yang re zhig la gu khya:de nas g.yas phyogs kyi nam mkhar 'ja' zer 'od klong na gu ru a tsar+ya dang g.yon ngos su 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs gnyis bzhugs nas zab mo don gyi chos 'khor bskor gyin 'dug:de nas mar 'ong bar brtsam tshe

nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi'i khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsungs so:na mo gu ru hūṃ 'pho 'gyur bral ba dusagasum sangs rgyas dang: byang chub sems dpa' rig 'dzin drang sgong sde: bden tshig grub pa'i dpang po thams cad la: gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi mtshungs med lta ba'i mi ngoms dpa' bo yis: gang 'dul chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas ston: bzang ngan las kyis 'brel ba'i skye bo kun:ngo mtshar dag pa'i zhing du skye bar shog: ma dag sdug bsngal bzod dka' khur len zhing:nub med las kyi 'phel kha bskyed bsring ba'i: mgo rmongs las kyi bsdus pa'i sems can rnams: 'phags ma'i thugs rje'i zhing 'dir skyes bar shog:tsha grang bkres skom blun rmongs chags sdang g.yeng dug lnga'i las 'bras chud mi za bas mnar dmus long byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams:gang 'dul sprul pa'i zhingasar 'dren par shog: log spyod bdud dang ra tsa dam sri'i rigs: mtha' mi kla 1 mi rung rdzas sbyor mkhan du ru ka yi sde tshogs tshar bcad nas: sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs

snyo bcur rgyas gyur cig: de 'dzin dge 'dun 'dus sde rgya mtsho rnams: khrims gtsang thugs mthun bshad sgrub 'du sgo spel: skye bo'i tshogs kyang de ba bcur spyod nas: tshe 'phos dag pa'i zhing du skye bar shog: nad yam 'byung po'i dug gzer sna tshogs dang: gdon rgod ma rung chags che nyam nga'i bdag: ltas ngan cho 'phrul bkra mi shis pa kun: zhi nas rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog: sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gdung 'dzin rigs mchog rnams: zab mo'i pha nor dpal la dbang bsgyur zhing: 'chad rtsod brtsam gsum bshad sgrub bstan pa'i gzhis: 'dzam gling tha gru kun tu khyab par 37ga: gnas skabs 'jigs pa bcu drug 'phral rkyen zhi: tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang yon tan rgyas: lha 'dre mi gsum chos kyi dbang du bsdus: bstan dgra ming med bde zhing skyid par shog sgrub po rnams kyi nyams rtogs yar zla bzhin: gong nas gong 'phel phyi nang g.yul las rgyal grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po thon snyan grags kun khyab 'gro blo dge sbyor shog gnyes pa rnam gsum chos kyi bya ba byed: sdom pa gsum gyi don la gzu bor

gnas:shes rab gsum gyi rtogs pa klong rdol nas:gdod ma'i mgon po'i rgyal sa zin par shog:dus gsum 'khrul ba'i rjes 'brang blo dang bral:yul gsum snang ba rmi lam rang mtshang rig bzang ngan bar gsum ro snyoms gnad la bslab:sku gsum rgyal ba'i btsan sa zin par regag:dus gsum las gyur 'gro ba sems rnams:khams gsum srid pa'i btson khang las bsgral nas dbyings gsum 'gyur med gnyug ma'i mkha' dbyings su:zungs 'jug gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par shog slar yang gdangs kyi 'khor ba ma stongs par dbyings las ma g.yos sprul pa sna tshogs kyis:gang 'dul 'gro ba'i srid mtsho rab bsgral nas:nang dbyings gdod ma'i gzhi thog grol bar shog:de ltar mos pas bskyal na:gang 'brel las smon ldan rnams:rang snang dag pa'i zhing du:mngon par sangs rgyas thob bo:the tshom yid gnyis mi dgos:pho mo dad can kun la:'di 'dra'i myur lam ston dang:bde chen g.yu lo bkod pa'i:dag pa'i dbyings 'dir 'god 'gyur:ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje dgos pa rgya chen yod lags:zhes gsung shing rol mo sna tshogs

rdu sgrogs so: de nas mar 'ong skabs rin po che'i khri dang ldon shing lo 'dab rgyas pa'i tshal na btsun ma dz+nyā na tā re blo gsal pradz+nyā tā re: shes rab sur+ya tā re: dad ldan darma tā re sogs kyis bro gar glu dbyangs sgrogs shing 'di skad zer ro: a ho: gtad med bde chen yangs pa ni: ku yangs blo bde skyid pa'i ngang: rtsal ldan shes rab rta pho ni:'gros ldem myur mgyogs ya mi nga: mi g.yo chos sku'i dngas klong la: rnams rtog mtshan ma'i rkyon dang bral shar grol dus mnyam dgongs pa la: der 'dzin rjes gcod dri ma bral: lta ba nam mkha' yangs pa la: thugs reg mtshan ma'i rkyon dang bral rang byung ye shes nyi ma la: gsal sgrib ma rig smag las 'das: byar med dben pa'i nyams len la nyon mongs 'du 'dzi'i rkyen dang bral: zab gter mdzod 'chang skyes bu la: chags sdang nyer len phyogs ris bral: sangs rgyas thugs kyi dgongs pa ni: gzhan du ma tshol rang rtsar rdzogs gnas lugs don gyi dgongs pa la grol dang 'khrul ba gnyis su med: bya bral shug 'byung rgya yan la: phyogs dang khro 'du ga la rlom: 'dir snang rgyal ba'i dgongs klong

la: sangs rgyas sems can ro mnyam ngang gtad med zang thal skyongs shig bu: zhes zer ro: de nas yang mar 'ong skabs 'ja' thig gi klong na skyes bu 'od dkar gyi na bza'alhug cing rat+na'i rgyan gyis mdzes par spras pa g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya dang g.yon sher phreng 'dren pa zhig bzhugs pa dang mjal tshe bdag gis zhus pa kyeho rgyal ba ye ngas kyi sras po: rigs mchog nyid kyi ci mdzad gdams pa tshig nyung don 'dus zab pa'i man ngag stsol cig: zhes zhus tshe 'phags pa'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs so: a horigs mchog snying gi nor bu mos pas bdag la dgongs mdzod: zab pa'i man ngag dam pa: tshig nyung don 'dus bshad do: bdag ni 'gro 'dren byang sems: jo bo a ti sha yin: ngo bo ye sangs rgyas kyang: rang bzhin thugs bskyed dag pas: gzhan phan 'gro don byed do: gdul bya dad mos ldan tshad: dag pa'i zhing khams gsum du: legs bkod thabs la brtson pa: yin no rigs mchog nus ldan: gang dag pha ma'i tshogs la: snying rje phyogs med rab brdal: btang snyom gru bor gzhug nas: bde chen zhing la bsgrod pa'i

rlu thabs mchog zab mor brtson dgos:zab gter klong rgya bkrol nas:phan bde'i gru char dbab la:don gnyis lhun grub mdzad pa:brkyangs na ngo mtshar che'o ma brjed dpa' bo 'dus rtsal:ces gsungs so:de nas mar rang khyims du sleb skabs mnal sad do:bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams yang lhag ger 'bar bar 'dug byung ngo e ma de ltar ngo mtshar zhing bkod a dar+sha:dgongs pa'i 1nga rdol rmad byung gas gsum daphyid:ma bsam bzhin du shug 'byung rang rdol 'khrungs:rmi lam tha mal 'khrul rtog lamachis so:nyams chung rgad po' gnas tshul de ltar ro:'dod yon rdzas la re mi baglu sems brag:zas ngo nor la btsong ba'i rtog ma zhugs chos brgyad 'ur mo'i bya bar zhen pabor:dad ldan pho mos bsags sbyang zhing sar bkod:mkha' khyab brdal ba'i sems bskyed dka' na yang:rin chen ljon bzang phan bde zhakhrungs ba'i phyir:snyigs dus skyob pa'ilha gsum zhing bkod kyi mthong snang rab gsal yin bzhin nor bu brtsam deng dus zob rdzun mkhan gyis sa steng gang:mi nag skye bo'i mtha' mi'i cha lugs spyod:lha dang srung

ma'i byin rlabs dgongs la yal: rgud pa sel mdzad yid bzhin re skongs sgrubs: bod khams srin gyis bskyang yang sus mi go dus gsum kun tu bka' drin zla med pa'i sa rgyan chen po pad dkar tā re la: mos gus dag snang dbang med mi skye 'am: bdag gis skyabs gcig gu ru rin po che nyin mtshan rtag tu dad mos gdung ba'i dran: sku drin bsam na dbang med mchi ma rdol: gom pa 'degs 'jog gu ru'i phyogs su shor: ma dag log spyod rin chen gling pa rnams: bu la mtho dman nor la hab thob bral btsan po'i khrel med rang gi ci 'dod chog: sdug bsngal rin gyi ma nyo grogs po rnams: rgya yi sgo gter sog gi tshang khang dkrugs: bod kyi sna kha lcagasakyu rno yis 'drongs: khrel med rkun po lang la ma shor zhig: chos khrims sdom dgos bde skyid bcom 'gro thang: rgad po gzung 'dzin gong sbug dal gnas yang nam phug mi thub dpal rir pha khyim 'gro: rgya bod khrims la yar zhu mi dgos kyang: dmus long 'gro la brtse ba'i kha chems yin: thos nyung bze re can gyis rkyon tshig brjod: mnga' thang mtho bas phrag dog phra ma 'byung: bdud rgan dpon

gyi pos 'joms skad smra na yang:ro snyoms rnal 'byor dga' sdug ma mchis:'di ltar bri la re 'dod gzhan med kyang:ma hā gu ru rnga yab dpal ri nas:snyigasama'i bde skyid spel la bdag bskrun pas:g.yo rgyu med pa yongs su rdzogs pa bkod:kha tshig ma bsrung spyod ngan lam bsgrub na:ci byar zad do rang thog yog med yin:mos pa'i gang zag dad ldan pho mo rnams:cha lugs ma bsgyur sngar gyi rang lugs skyongs:bsam spyod ma mang dkon mchog gsum la gtod:chos kyi sgrub mtha' shi ba'i dus la gtug:blolhag med pa'i bde ba'i 'dun ma skyongs:ma brjed sems la zungs shig slob bu rnams:de ltar bzhengs pa'i rab dkar dge ba 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum bsags yod rnamadakar kyis:bzang ngan 'brel thog sems can ma lus pa:dag pa'i zhing la skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig:ces 'di yang rang gi grogs mo rat+na sa ras dar dang bri gzhi re ga dkar bcasanan tan gyis yang yang bskul ba dang:chos gyi bdag po pad ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho chos bdag 'gyur med rgya mtsho slob bu ye shes dad ldan smon sems chos gsal
o rgyan pad don rang shar byang chub sogs kyi yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra snyoms las mkhan nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa dge legs 'phel: sarba maṅga lam̐/
snyi dag snang ye shes rol pa las: dag pa zangs mdog dpal ri'i mthong snang sku gsum zhing bkod zab mo bzhugs so:

gyi ma hā gu ru la na mo: bskal pa chu mo bya yi lor hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nub mo nyams 'od gsal dang 'dres pa'i skabs su nam mkha'i dbyingasanas 'ja' dmar po zhig bdag gi mdun thang du brkyangs pa las mkha' 'gro sngon mo rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa zhig byung nas bro gar byed cing 'di skad gsungs so:e mi min mkha' spyod dbyang na: gzung 'dzin mtshan rtogs bral yang: sngon smon dam bcas dbang gis: skal ldan skyong bar byed 'ong: nga ngo khyod kyi shes sam:shel dkar rdo rje mtshozhes: mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal thugs las sbrul mdzad pho nya yin jo: phyi nang gdos bcas ma grub: nang du kun rtog bral lo: gsang ba gzung 'dzin dben ya:yeshes gcig labakod tshul: ldog pa mang du mchis lags: gsal sgrib mtshan ma mi mnga': sku dang ye shes rol pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan: brjod dang bsgrang las 'das so:grub chen 'aprog mi lo tsa: gti mug ro nyal ma byed 'od gsal ngang la bzhag 'tshal: lta bsgom spyod dang ma bral: gang shar ye shes skyongs mdzod dbyings thig bkod pa sna tshogs

rnu: brda dang dpe ru shar tshe:rnam dkar legs par phab 'tshal:'dod yon sgyu ma'i chos la ma spyod 'khor bar 'chang yang:'jig rten chos brgyad dor la brtul zhugs spyod pa bogs dbyung nyon mongs dug lnga'i bkod pa:ma spang mi zhen dgos lags:pha cig gu ru'i drung du:bu khyod 'gro bar e 'dod:mos pa yon na byon dang nga yis bsu ba byed 'tshal:zhes zer ba'i lan du:bdag gis smras pa a he gson dang ye shes mkha' 'gro:chung ngu'i dus nas bzung ste:skyabs gcig ma hā gu na dad mosalhag par byung ngo:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam yas:dngos nyams rmi lam kun tu:zhal gzigs lung bstan sna tshogs:bslu med dus su 'byung ngo:ma bslab sngon sbyangs las 'phro'i:gsal khyab zhi gnas gnad dang stong chen rig pa'i lta ba:ma bcos ye bab bsgom gnad:rtsol bral shugs la shar legs nga yis bsam pa ltar na:rang snang zangs mdog dpal ri:rang rig pad ma 'byung gnas rang shar brda dang dpe cha rang la rnam par rdzogs yin:gzhan na tha dad med mod:dngos mtshan sangs rgyas sa min:snyam pa'i

shar cha snang byung:zhes pa'i zhu ba phul lan gnang ba:e ma:skal bzang skyes bu gson dang:ye dag chos sku'i 1nga na:sku dang ye shes zhing khams:rang la ye nas rdzogs kyang ngo bo mthong bar dka' 'o:rang nyid gcig pu grol thabs:sems nyid rig pa'i ye shes:pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid du la bzlas mnyam par bzhag na:tshol bya log na ma grub log 'khrul gdul bya skyong na:zhal gzigs lung bstan gal che:zab gter klong rgya bkrol na:dngos nyams rmi lam snang ba:'od gsal dbyings su yal la:dag pa'i zhing khams bkod nas:ston pa pad 'byung drung du:gdams ngag gab don zab gnad dris lan gsal bor mdzad 'tshal:'gro don gdul bya las can:gu ru'i bka' lung bzhin dgos:de phyir dpal ri'i gnas su:'byon na lam grogs byed ya:de min bdag ni 'gro'o:ces zer:bdag gi smras pa:kyi ho thugs rje brtse ba'i mnga' bdag:bka' drin mnyam med dam pa:a ma dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro:bdag la legs par gson dang:dag pa pad+ma 'od kyi lhun grub gzhal yas dbus su:skyababasamachog sangs rgyas gnyis pa

blu ston 'khor dag pa rab 'byams mngon gsum 'jal rgyu grub na de la spro ba ci dgos: 'gro 'o da lta nyid du lam grogs khyed kyi mdzod dang pha yi drung du phyinalags: zhes zhus tshe lto nub mtshams nasa'aja' dkar po zhig bdag gi mdun thad du byung ba la brten nas mkha' 'gro ma de nyid sngon du phyin bdag de yi rjes su 'brang nas song ba'i mod la bod yul thams cad mthong yang phyin pa'i tshe na bal po'i yul sogs yul gling bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig dang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gru thams cad gsal bar mthong ngo: de nas song tsa na mtha' 'khob kla kle'i yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa brgal nas mtha'i rgya mtsho dpag tshad grangs med pa bsgod nas mtshon cha gzeng pa lta bu'i ngos su be+eḍūr+ya'i skas lam du phyin te bltas pa'i tshe shar gyi brag ridakar po dgung la rnyegs pa bcu gsum mthong ba'i rtsa bar thod pa'i sku mkhar dkar po bcu gsum dang yul gling bcu gsum pa mthong ba'i tshe na bdag gis zhus pa: ye shesakyi mkha' 'gro ma lags yul gling 'di dag gang ga yul lags zhus tsa na rigs kyi bu yul 'di dag ni shar phyogs srin
