po chos la dkar ba'i yul yin:de yang dbus srin yul laṅga pu ri:shar 'dod rtse:lho gser gdong:nub 'dab bzang:byang rog pa rtse:shar lto gsang chen:sto nub 'dabasam 'dzin nub byang dga' ba che:byang shar rog bzang 'dabs:shar stod srid pa bde tshal:nub smad rde ba ri bkra:byang stod dgyes pa dga' rtsal:lho smad bi ri brdal te srin po'i yul de dag go:gling bcu gsum ni:laṅga gling:rtse gling:gser gling zangs gling:pa tsa gling:gsang ba gling dga' byed gling bde chen gling:bkra shis gling:bde tshal gling:bam ri gling dga' byed gling:chos byed nyi ma gling rnams zer ri bcu gsum ni:zhi byed bkra shis dung ri dkar po yang zer:yul gling 'di dag nitso rgyan rdo dze+ethod phrenganyid kyis chos gsungs snang ba bsgyur lus sogs srin po ltar yang spyod pa ni dam pa chos la sbyor ba'i rig 'dzin sha stag go ces gsungs yang phyin pa'i tshe shar gling bcu gsum po'i mtha' bskor dri bzang mtsho yi 'khor ba dang:de rgyab lto phyogs su brag ri ser po dgung la snyegs pa dgu mthong ba'i rtsa ba nasathod pamisku mkhar ser po dgu dang yul gling

྅/ dgu mthong mod la: bdag gis zhus pa ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'a1sna ma lags: yul gling 'di dag gang gi yul lags zhus tsa na: rigs kyi bu 'di dag ni lho phyogs srin po yon tan dang nyams rtogs rgyas pa'i yul yin de yang bshad na: dbus srin yul bam ringasgod mkhar shar a tsa ya na'i mkhar: lho 'jog pa rna: nub bsi na rū tra: byang lag pa ri:shar lho 'dzi na yan: lho nub ri bī yan: nub byang 'ga' la ya: byang shar su pu tra zhes grags gling dgu ni: bam ri ma na ya'i gling: su bhan+t+ra de wā'i gling a shwa ra sur+ya'i gling: ma ṇi pa ṭi ga ṇa'i gling ni rin dhe bha ya'i gling: su mun bho dha'i gling: tsadza'i lakya'i gling ma ru rtse bzhad pa'i gling: gu ṇa ga ya sa ṭi'i gling rnams zer: ri dgu ni: rgyas byed yon tan gser ri ser po yang grags: yul gling 'di dag ni 3 rgyan rat+na thod phreng nyid kyis chos gsung snang ba bsgyur nus srin po ltar snang yang spyod pa ni gsang sngags kyi lta spyod rnam par dag cing rig pa 'dzin pa' sa la sbyor ba sha stag go: ces gsungs: gling dgu po mtha' brag ri ljon shing rgyas pa'i mtsho yis bskor ba'o: de nas

yang phyin pa nub kyi phyogs na brag ri dmar po gnam la zug pa dgu yi rked par thod pa'i sku mkhar dgu dang:'dabs na yul gling dgu dang bshan pa'i grong khyer bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mthong ba'i mod la:bdag gis zhus pa ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma lags:yul gling 'di dag gang gi yul zhus tsa na rigs kyi bu 'di dag ni nub (1gas srin po sbyor sgrol la mkhas pa'i yul yin:de yang bshad na dbus srin yul ko kha thang dmar shar chags spyod:lho 'dod rtsal:nub mdzes byed:byang du ṇa 'dzin:shar lto 'ur ba:lho nub nir wa:nub byang tir ga byang shar lam sto dha zhes mdzad du grags gling dgu ni:'bar ba'i gling:'khrugs pa'i gling:su ya'i gling:pu ṭi ga'i gling:bskyod pa'i gling:ni ni la ṭa'i gling dza ri ṭa yi gling rme dur ṣa'i gling:mdze dur ya'i gling rnams grags pa yin:ri dgu ni dbang byed 'bar ba me ri g.yo zhes kyang grags:yul gling 'didag ni o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng nyid kyi brtul zhugs zab mo'i chos gsungs snang ba bsgyur lus srin po ltar yang gsang sngags sbyor sgrol phun sum tshogs pa la spyod cing rig 'dzin gyi

rdzu: sa la sbyor ba sha stag go: ces gsungs pa dang: gling de dag gi mtha' yi sgrol byed shan pa sna tshogs kyis bsad bcad dmar las byed cing ha ha rgod pa: de mthar brag ri dang mtsho dmar nag khrag ltar khol ba dag gis bskor ba'o de nas yang phyin pas byang gi phyogs na brag ri ljang nag mkha' la gzeng ba dgu yi rked par thod mkhar sngo ljang dgu dang: 'dabs na yul gling dgu dang gdol ba gnod sbyin pho mo'i grong khyer bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mthong ba'i mod la: bdag gis zhus pa ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma lags yul gling 'di dag gang gi yul yin zhus tsa na: rigs kyi bu 'di dag ni byang phyogs srin po brtul zhugs la mkhas shing gdul pa'i yul yin: de yang bshad na dbus srin yul bshan lags ljong:shar rngams spyod: lho 'jigs byed:nub g.yo ba byang dga' tshal shar lho ru ṇa: lto nub drag rol:nub byang su ri tra byang shar ru ru tra zhes grags pa'o: gling dgu ni dhu na ha'i gling: su yan tsa'i gling rab tu rngams pa'i gling : 'jigs byed ya ma'i gling g.yo brkyong lding ba'i gling: bzhad mo ga yi gling

sgra skad 'don pa'i gling:drag gtum khros pa'i gling: brda skad drag po'i gling ngam ru na gnod sbyin gyi gling zhes grags pa yin zer: ri dgu ni:drag byed bsgo grags: yul gling 'di dag ni: yo rgyan garma thod phreng nyid kyis sbyor sgrol zab mo'i chos gsungs snang ba bsgyur lus srin po ltar yang gsang sngags brtul (pa la spyod cing rig 'dzin gyis sa la sbyor ba sha stag go: ces gsungs pa dang: gling de dag gi mtha' na sgrol byed shan pa dang gdol ba srin po gnod sbyin kyis bsad bcad gtub gsum byed cing ha ha dang pāṭa pāṭa sgrogs pa: de mthar brag ri dang mtsho rak+ta lta bur 'khyil zhing rba rlabs bskyod pas bskor ba'o:pas: ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma lags: yul 'di dag gi srin po sku'i bongs tshad spyod pa dkar nag thams cad ci'i phyir: gu ru gcig gi mdzad ngan ci las byung ba yin lags zhus tshe: ḍasko'i zhal nas: srin po'i yul 'di dag na yod pa rnams kyang shar gling ba dag bongs thungs zhal gcig phyag gnyi

྅ 'dzum sgegs pa: spyod pa dkar zhing yang dag pa'i lam la mos pa'o: ci'i phyir zhe na: chags med zhi ba chen po'i 'dul ba'i don rtags pa'o: lto gleng ba rnams kyi srin po bongs che ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum zhi ma khro 'dzum sgegs pa: spyi bor na rig bdag dmar po gtsug phud bcing pa'o: sha rgyas mdog bzang 'od 'bar ba lta spyod rnam par dag cing nyams len mchog la brtson pa: ci'i phyir zhe na med byung rgyas pa chen pos 'dul ba'i don rtags so:nub gling gi srin po rnams sha rgyas bongs tshad 'thug pazhal gsum phyag drug khro 'dzum sgegs pa: ral pa gyen brdzes thod skam dbu rgyan mi lngags g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs sbrul chun mgo phreng 'phyang pa lta spyod brtul zhugs la gdung zhing nyams len la rnam par brtson pa: cung zad rtsub 'gyur che ba ci'i phyir zhe na rab 'bar dbang gi 'dul ba'i don rtags so byang gling rnams kyi srin po gtum zhing sgeg pa zhal phyag rgyan tshul nub dang 'dra la khro zhing bzhad la gsod gcod la rnam par dga' ba ci'i phyar zhe na brtul zhugs drag po'i 'dul ba'i don rtags so:shar 3 srin po rnams

dkar gsal snying rje tshad med dang ldan pa: lto yi srin po rnams dkar ser byams pa tshad med dang ldan pa: nub kyi srin po dmar nag dga' ba tshad med dang ldan pa: byang gi srinapo rnams dmar spug ljang nag sngo nag brtul zhugs dang ldan pa 'di dag phyi rim gyi gser gling yin zhes zer: de nas yang phyin pas rgya mtsho sngo dngas nge brgal nas pha ri la phyanatshedung ri dkar po gnam la zug pa rtse mo lnga can rtsa ba gcig pa: der brten pa'i thod mkhar sum rim nor bu tog mdzes pa:nang na srin po dbu lnga dang phyag bcu pa la srin po phomo mang po'i chos nyan pa: mtha' 'khor thod mkhar yul gling bsam gyis mi khyab pa na srin po pho mo rnams mdog dkar po khro nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje'i gtsug phudamadzes pa grangs med pas bro gar 'gyed pa la: bdag gis lha bu dkar po'i gtsug rgyan can 'di yul gang yin lags zhus tshe:ḍasko zhal nas shar srin yul gnod sbyin rdzongs srin rgyal rdo rje bu lnga pas gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'o: 'di rnams chos la dkar pa brtul zhugs la gdung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i dpung grogs byed pa yin: yul gling

gyi dga' ba tshal ri bo dung mdog rtse lnga 'dod dgu'i char 'beb bas zhes grags zer de nas yang phyin pa'i 'phyong ri smug po gnam la zug pa rtse mo gsum pa can rtsa ba gcig pa der brten pa'i thod mkhar sum rim tsit+ta'i tog mjes pa: nang na srin po dbu gsum dang phyag drug khyung gi gtsug rgyan can la srin po pho mo mang po chos nyan pa:mtha' bskor na thod rlon gyi mkhar can yul glibhe bsam gyis mi khyab pa na srin po pho mo rnams mdog ser po khro nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis rat+na'i gtsug phud can grangs med pas dro gar 'gyed pa la: bdag gis 'di yul gang yin lags zhus tshe: ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas shar lho'i srin yul 'dod 'byung rdzongs: srin rgyal rin chen dbu bzhi pas gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor ba'o: 'di rnams chos la dga' ba lta spyod la gdung ba rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i mgon grogs byed pa yin yul gling bde byed tshal ri bo 'phyong mdog rtse gsum dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs pa'i ri zhes grags pa yin zer: de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che gser ri ser po gnam la zug pa rtse mo lnga la rtsa ba gcig tu gnas pa der

ja sum rim lag pa'i tog mdzes pa: nang du srin po zhal gsum phyag drug dbu gtsug siṅga'i gdod pa can la srin po pho mo mang po chos nyan pa: mtha' bskor na gling bsam gyis mi khyab pa na srin po rnams ni mdog dmar po chags nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis nor bu'i gtsug phud can grangs med pas dro gar bdag gis yul 'di gang yin lags zhus tshe: ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas lto yi srin yul 'dod brtsegs rdzongs srin po'i rgyal po rat+na dbu bzhi pas gsang sngags zab ra ba'o: 'khor 'di rnamasachos la dga' ba brtul zhugs la gdung ba rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos dpung grogs byed pa yin yul gling bde byed tshal ri bo gser / 'grub 'bar ba'i ri zhes grags pa yin zer: de nas yang phyin tshe rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i ri gnam la zug pa rtse mo bzhi pa rtsa ba gcig tu gnas pa: der brten rim zhing chen gyi tog mdzes pa nang du srin po zhal gsum phyag drug spyi gtsug tu sdig pa'i gdengs ka spud pa la srin po pho mo mang pos chos nyan pa: mtha'

lu bskor na thod rnyed kyi mkhar can sogs yul gling bsam gyis mi khyag pas na srin po pho rnams mdog sngon po bzhad nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis sngon po'igatsug phud can grangs med pas bro gar 'gyed pa mthong tshe: bdag gis 'di yul gang lags zhus tshe: ḍasko'i zhal nas lho nub srin yul me lha'i rdzongs srin po'i rgyal po 'dodadabu bzhi po gsang sngags zab mos chos 'khor bskor ba'o: 'di rnams chos la dga' ba brtul zhugs gdung ba rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos mgon grogs byed pa yin yul gling dga' ba'i tshal ri bo sngo mdangs rtse bzhi pa phun tshogs 'dod dgu ster zhes grags pa yin zer: de nas yang phyin tsherin po che pad+ma rā ga'i ri dmar gsal gnam la zug pa rtse mo drug partsa ba gcig tu gnas pa: der brten pa'i thod mkhar sum rim tsit+ta'i tog mdzes pa: nang du srin po zhal lnga dang phyag bcu pa rta la 'tsher ba la srin po pho mo mang pos chos nyan pa mtha' bskor na thod mkhar can dang yul gling bsam gyis mi khyab pa na srin po pho mo rnams ni mdog dmar po chags pa'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma'i gtsug phud

mdzes pa grangs med pa'i bro gar 'byed pa mthong tshe bdag gis 'di yul gang yin lags zhus tshe: ḍagi'i shas nas nub phyogs kyi srin yul pad+ma brtsegs pa'i yang rdzongs srinapo'i rgyal po pad+ma dbu drug pas gsang sngags zab mo'i chos 'khor bskor ba'o 'di rnams dam pa'i chos la dga' ba brtul zhugs zab mo la gdung ba rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos dpung grogs byed pa yin: yul gling chags med dga' tshal dang ri bo dmar gsal bde chen dga' ba'i 'od zer brtsegs pa zhes zer: de nas yang phyin pa'i tshe rin po che mu min gyi ri mthing gsal rtse mo bdun pa dgong la snyegs pa rtsa ba gcig tu gnas pa: der brten pa'i thod mkhar bang rim gsum dang mda' dar gyi tog mdzes pa: nang du srin po zhal gsum phyag drug pa spyi bor rma bya dmar po'i gsung dbyangs snyan pa la srin po pho mo mang po'i chos nyan pa mtha' bskor na thod mkhar can dang yul gling bsam gyis mi khyab pa srin po pho mo rnams mdog skrug po bzhad nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyisapa rdo rje ljang gsal 'bar ba'i gtsug phud mdzes pa grangs med pas bro 'khrab cing gar byed pa mthong tshe:

( bdag gi yul 'di gang yin lags zhus tshe ḍak+ki'i zhal nas nub byang gi srin yul pad+ma 'khyil ba'i rdzongs: srin po'i rgyal pobade chen dbu gsum pas lta spyod gsang sngags zab mo'i chos 'khor bskor ba'o: 'di rnams dam pa'i chos la dga' ba brtul zhugs kyi gdengs thob pa rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyi dpung grogs byed pa yin yul gling chags med dga' byed bde ba'i tshal dang ri bo mthing sngon 'dod yon rnam par 'byung ba zhes zer: de nas yang phyin pa'i tshe rin po che irnya ni la'i ri ljang sngon rtse mo lnga pa dgung la mnyam pa rtsa ba gcig tu gnas pa: der brten pa'i thod mkhar bang rim gsum pa tsi ta'i tog mdzes pa: nang du srin po zhal bdun phyag bcu bzhi pa spyi gtsug tu yin bzhin gyi nor bu 'od 'bar ba can de la srin po pho mo mang po'i chos nyan pa mtha' bskor na thod mkhar can dang yul gling bsam gyis mi khyab pa na srin po pho mo rnams kyang mdog ljang ba gtum nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje rgya gram 'bar ba'i gtsug phud mdzes pa grangs med pa'i pro 'khrab cing gar byed pa mthong tshe: bdag gi yul 'di dag gang

bskor ba'o: srin po pho mo rnams dam pa'i chos la dga' ba brtul zhugs dang brtson 'grus zab mo'i gdengs thob pa rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyi dpung groyul gling bde byed spro ba chen po'i tshal dang ri bo ljang gsal gdug pa kun 'joms rno ba'i rtse zhes zer: de nas yang phyin pa'i tshe rin po che shel gyi ri dkar ga pa dgung la snyog pa rtsa ba gcig tu gnas pa der brten pa'i thod mkhar bang rim gsum pa bdud ru tra nag po'i mgo bo bcad nas tog byas nas mdzes shing srin po zhal bdun phyag bcu bzhi pa dbu gtsug tu phag nag ngur ba de la srin po pho mo mang pos chos nyan pa: mtha' bskor na thod pa'i sku mkhar can gyi yul bye

gyi mthong tshe: bdag gi yul 'di gang yin lags: ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas byang shar gyi srin yul gtum rngams bzhad pa rdzongs srin po rgyal po gad po cher sgrogs dbu bdun pa'i gsang sngags lta sgom zab mo'i chos 'khor bskor ba'o: 'di dag rnams dam pa'i chos la spro ba che zhing brtul zhugs kyi gdengs phul du phyin pa rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyis mgon dang dpung grogs dam pa yin: yul gling drag po rab tu gtum pa'i tshal dang ri bo gzugs brnyan 'dzin mdog dkar spyan gzigs bkra ba zhes zer ba yin lags ces gsungs so: skabs 'dir srin po'i rgyal po rnams kyi zhal phyag sku mdog dang 'dzin pa'i phyag mtshan rnams gsal bar yod kyang yig mang dogs nas gab pa'o:zhus len tshig gi lung byang 'ga' re yang gu rgya: de nas yang phyin pas dkar gsal 'o ma'i mtsho dri bsungs sna tshogs 'thul ba can de brgal nas pha ri'i ngos su sleb nas shar du ri dkar po 'od 'bar ba me tog ku sha dkar po: 'dabs bzang smug po: sang kṛ dmar ser: dbang mdog dmar po: 'dabs ldan ljang ku lhun 'thug spud mthing nag sogs

ku mud sna tshogs tshal du brnyil ba: dri bzang gi ngad pa g.yo ba: mthong ba tsam gyi bde ba'i nyams lhag ger 'bar ba: ri de la brten pa'i pho brang byi shel mkhar dgung la snyeg pa nang thod pa'i sku mkhar can gdan srin po pho mo dang nyi zla kha sbyor ba'i steng du o rgyan drag po rak+ṣi ta zhes bya ba zhi ma khro 'dzum gyi nyams dang ldan pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon thod khrag dur brod chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa zhabs gyad stabs su rol ba de yis srin po rnams la bya spyod kyi rgyud sde mang po'i chos 'khor bskor zhing thams cad rig 'dzin gyi sa la bzhugs pa sha stag go: bdag gis zhus pa la gling 'di dag gang yin lags: ḍak+ki'i zhal nas gas bral rdo rje 'bar ba'i rdzongs su grags ston pa rdo rjedrag po rtsal dang 'khor srin po tho mo byams brtse dang ldan pa rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu chos gsang sngags bya spyod kyi rgyud sde mtha' yas pa ston cing yul ni dga' ba tshal zhes zer: grong khyer la mthong na spro zhes grags ri bo 'od 'bar mtha' yas pa'i rtse zhes pa'o: 'di mthong ba yang las dang skal ba re ldan: ces gsungs so: de nas bdag gis o rgyan rak+ṣi ta la zhus pa: kye ho: dus

rlu: gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis:sku yi gsang ba gsum rdzogs gar o rgyan rdo rje drag po stsal:mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen gyis skal bzang bdag la thugs rjes dgongs:las sprib bag chags sbyang ba dang:smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol:zhes zhus tshe gu ru nyid rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i tshul bzung nas khro bo sme bar brtsegs pa dang lag na rdo rje'i dbang lung rgyud sgrubs thabs dang bcas pa rnams gnang byung ba'i mod las thams cad rig pa'i gter sgrom du bzhags la ye shes kyi dbyings su rgyas btab po:de nas yang gsungs pa i:las skal ldan pa'i bu khyod snyan gson dang:gzung 'dzin sems kyi gshis lugs las:shar ba'i sna tshogs snang ba rnams:ye shes chen po'i rol pa rtsam bzla ngang bzhag thag chod gal:rdo rje 'bar ba'i rim pa'i bcud:ma brjed rig pa'i dkyil du sbos da lta spel ba'i dus ma yin:sa bon 'od zer go cha yi:sprul pa lhun grub rgya mtshor gtod:brtul zhugs mchog gi dpal gdengs bskyed:nges med sprel rdzongs 'grim la bzhugs brtul zhugs mngon gyur 'gro don 'byung khyod

ni las dang skal ba ldan: ma brjed gdams ngag sems la zung: nga ni khyod dang 'bral med yin: e haṃ ka phaṭa: ces gsungs so: de nas yang phyin pa'i tshe lho gser ri ser po 'od 'bar ba ljon shing 'dabs stong gyes pa las shing tog su ra: zhum mye: a 'bru: sha dum ta la sogs kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa mang po lhugs pa: gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha sna tshogs pa las chos sgra 'ur ba: skyed mo'i tshal dang me tog ser mdangs dang ldan pa: dri bsung 'thul ba 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa mthong ba tsam gyis gsal ba'i nyams tshad med pa dang ldan pa: ri de la brten pa'i pho brang ser po dgung la rtegs pa nang thod pa'i sku mkhar can gdan du tra pho mo thabs shes nyi zla'i kharatsan rgyan rak+ta rat+na drag po rtsal zhes bya ba zhi ma khro 'dzum gtum rngams sgeg pa g.yas nor bu'i dbyug pa dang g.yon thod khrag bsgoms pa sku la dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs pa zhabs gyad stabs su rol ba'i de yi srin po pho mo rnams la rnal 'byor yo ga'i rgyud sde mang po'i chos 'khor bskor zhing thams cad rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la sbyor ba sha stag go: bdag gis yulagling 'di dag gang

myi yin lags zhus tshe:ḍāsko'i zhal nas 'dod 'byung rat+na 'bar ba'i rdzongs su grags ston pa rat+na yid bzhin rtsal 'khor dang srin po pho mo mkhyen brtse dang ldan pa rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu chos gsang sngags rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sde mtha' yas pa ston cing:yul ni 'dod 'byung tshal du grags:grong khyer ladran na dga' zhes grags:re bo 'od zer sna tshogs pa'i brtse zhes pa'o:'di mthong ba yang las dang skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa yin gsungs:de nas bdag gisatsan rgyan rak+ta rat+na rtsal la zhus pas:kye11dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi:yon tan gsang ba gsum rdzogs gar:o rgyanarat+na drag po rtsal:mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen gyis:skal bzang bdag la thugs rje'i dgongs las sgrib bag chags sbyangs ba da :smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol:zhes zhus tshe:gu ru nyid rat+na yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po tshul bzung nas khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i gshin rje'i 'od zer mtha' yas sgrol mar rab tu brtsegs pa'i rgyud sgrubs thabs dbang bka' gtad dang bcas pa rnams gnang byung ba'i mod la thams cad rig pa'i gter sgrom

du gzhugs chos dbyings yangs pa'i brag la rgyas btab nas ye shes 'gags med gsal ba'i gter bsrung byas la bzhag go: de nas yang gsungs: yi: las dang ldan pa'i bumachog: snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun: sku dang ye shes rol pa: 'khor ba ltar du ma zhen: rdo rje gsum du lam khyer man ngag bdud rtsi'i zig pa: gzhan la zag tu ma shor: dadung spel ba'i dus min: gnub ban bsod nams bzang po'i: skye rtags rig 'jin nye mar: gtan phob legs par gtod la brtul zhugs rig pa'i ngo sprod: byang rong phyogasasu 'byon tshul 'gro don bsam yas e ma: skal bzang nus ldan khyod kyis: ma brjed thugs la zhog lags pha dang bu gnyis 'bral med: dad pa mos gus rem cig a ā phaṭa ces gsungs so: de nas yang phyin pa'i tshezangs ri dmar po 'od 'bar ba sdon shing sna tshogs spud pa me tog puṣ+ṭa dmar po ut+pal la dmar ser: kun dha ka dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa: si la ha dri bsung 'thul ba mang po'i mdzes pa 'ja' zer sna tshogs pa'i gur khang 'khrigs pa: 'di nyid mthong ba tsal gyis mi rtog pa'i nyams tshad

snyi med dang ldan la: ri bo de la brten pa'ipho brang dmar po dgung la rnyegs pas nang thod pa'i sku mkhar can gdan rū tra dam sri bsgol ba'i steng nyi zla'i kharatsa( rgyan pad+ma rak+ṣa zhes bya ba zhi ma khro 'dzum gtum rngams sgeg pa g.yas zangs kyi pad+ma dmar po dang g.yon gri gug dku la brten pa dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs pa zhabs gyad stabs su rol ba de yi 'khor srin po pho mo rnams la thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa bden gnyis dbyer med lhag pa'i chos sku chen mo mngon du byung nas bton pas thams cad rig 'dzin gyi sa la sbyor ba sha stag go bdag gi yul gling 'di dag gang yin lags zhus tshe ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas bsam 'grub pad+ma 'bar ba'i rdzongs su grags: ston pa bde chen 'dus pa rtsal dang 'khor srin po pho mo dad brtson mkhyen dpyod dang ldan pa rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu chos gsang sngags bskyed pa'i rim pa mtha' yas pa ston cing: yul ni 'dod 'byung chags bral pad+ma'i tshal zhes grags: grong khyer ni yid la dgyes zhes grags: ri bo gri ru rtse pa zhes bya'o: 'di mthong ba yang las dang skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa yin no gsungs: de nas

bdag gis o rgyan pad+ma du rak+ka la zhus pa: kya ho dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi: gsung gi gsang ba gsum rdzogs gar: o rgyan pad+ma drag po rtsal: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen gyis: skal bzang bdag la thugs rje'i dgongs: las sgrib bag chags sbyangs ba dang smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol: zhes zhus tshe: gu ru nyid pad+ma chags bral bde ba'i dbang phyug gi tshul bzung nas tan+t+ra bcu gsum gyi dbang lung rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa rnams gtad pa bzhin du mchod bzhin dgongs pa'i klong du rgyas btab la bzhag go: de nas yang gsungs pa yi: las ldan rigs kyi bu mchog gson snang srid 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus chos: lag pa kun rdzob bden par gnas don dam dkor bdun ltar du stong: snang stong ro mnyams chen por bzhugs: nyon mongs ye shes dbyings su brdal: dam rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi'i spyod: bla med gsang ba'i don mi spangs rdo rje'i bla ma brtsi bkur byed sngags gsum phyag rgya bzhi mi gcod yang dag lam zhugs skal bzang brtse: gang shar sku gsum ye shes su phyam brdal de bzhin nyid dbyings

rnu: blta: zab gsang mchog gi man ngag rnams: ma brjed dgongs pa'i klong la bstims: rang rig gsal ba'i sgrom du tshud: da lta spel ba'i dus ma yin: zur ban 'gro 'dul rdo rje yi: sprul pa rkarma ma ṇir gtod: brtul zhugs rig pa'i ngo sprod la: mi med tsha rong gnas su mngog: rang 'bras mngon gyur 'gro don 'byung: las skal ldan pa'i nus ldan gling: ma brjed bdag la gsol ba thob: 'bral ba med do snying gi bu: ces gsungs so: de nas yabhe phyin pa'i tshe byang g.yu ri ljang gsal 'od 'bar ldon shing sna tshogs sbungs: gser gyi phye ma dang g.yu yi ne'u seng dri bzang gi spang ri me tog gis rab tu mdzes pa: gzhan yang ma rmos pa'i 'bras bu su ta ra yirna spud: su yan ṣa ro brgya ldan sogs bza' ba'i rig bsam gyis mi khyab pa mabhe pos kheb pa: phyogs thams cad du 'ja' 'od dang rin po che drwa ba mig mang ris su bris pa skyed mo'i tshal dang bya rig sna tshogs pas chos sgra 'ur ba: 'di mthong ba tsam gyas dga' bde tshad med pa dang ldan la: ri bo de la brten pa'i pho brang in+t+ra ni la las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang rtse mo dgung la rtegs pa

dang thod pa'i sku mkhar can gdan dam sri pho mo bsnol ba'i steng thabs shes nyi zla'i khar o rgyan kurma 'dzu na rtsal zhes bya ba zhi ma khro 'dzum gtum rngams sgeg pa g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa sku la dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs pa zhabs gnyis gyad stabs su rol pa de yi 'khor srin po pho mo rnams rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i chos 'khor bskor zhing thams cad rig 'dzin gyi sa la sbyor ba sha stag go: bdag gi yul gling 'di dag gang yin lags zhus tshe: ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas phrin las mngon spyod drag po'i rdzongs zhes grags: ston pa las rab rkarma rtsal dang 'khor srin po pho mo thugs rje dang ldan pa rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu chos gsang sngags rnal 'byor bla med rgyud sde mtha' yas pa ston cing yul ni bde byed 'bar ba'i tshal zer: grong khyer la mjal na skyid zhes su grags: ri bo 'big byed 'od zer gsum pa'i rtse zhes bya'o: 'di mthong ba yang tshogs smon las 'phro dang ldan pa yin no: ces gsungs so: de nas bdag gis sgo rgyan garma 'dzu na rtsal la zhus pa: kyi to dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las gsang ba gsum rdzogs gar sgo

rlu rgyan garma drag po rtsal mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen gyis: skal bzang bdag la thugs rje'i dgongs: las sgrib bag chags sbyang ba dang:smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol: zhes zhus tshe: gu ru nyid las rab bde chen 'dzu na rtsal gyi tshul bzung nas phur pa rdo rje go khrab rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa phyag na rdo rje brin las kun 'dus rnams kyi rgyud sgrub thabs dbang lung man ngag dang bcas te gnang ba rnams 'gyur med rig pa ye shes kyi klong du rgyas gdab la bzhag go: de nas yang gsungs pa:e las ldan rigs kyi bu mchog: snang srid 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus: gzhi med rtsa bral rol pa: lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med chos sku chen por grol lo nyon mongs ma spangs ye shes:sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin:nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dam tshag:srog gi gta' ru 'dzin dgos:man ngag gsang ba'i mdo rtsa:ma brjed dgongs pa'i klong du rgyas thob ye shes sbubs tshud: da dung spel ba'i dus min:gnyag ban ye shes rdo rje'i: sprul pa pad+ma ma ṇir gtod la rig pa'i ngo sprod:mi med lung par bsgrod nas:lho rgyud 'gro don 'byung

zhing: rang 'bras brtul zhugs mngon gyur: las ldan nus ldan rdo rje ma brjed bdag nyid bsgom dang: dbang dang dngos grub ster cing: 'bral ba med do bu mchog:a ā phaṭa:ces gsungs so: de nas yang phyin pas mtsho sngo dngas nge ba gcig bsgrod: yang phyin pa'i mtsho dmar ldem me ba gcig brgal yang phyin pas mtsho ser kyi le ba gcig gi pha ri la sleb tshe rin po che sna lnga las grub pas ri bo che brjid rtsa ba brtan pa rtsi shing sna tshogs dang: me tog kha dog bkra ba mang po sbud pa:dri bzung gi ngad pa 'thul ba ljon bzang 'dab stong bkra ba dril bu dang g.yer khas mdzes pa de dag las zab mo stong pa nyid kyi rang sgra sgrogs pa: 'ja' 'od kyi thig le'i drwa ba mig mang ris su bkra ba: de lta bu'i klong der rab 'jigs rngams brjed rol pa'i pho brang thod mkhar bang rim dgu pa tsit+ta'i 'phyang pa bsgril ba rgyu ma'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed spras pa: mig 'bras mang po'i bar tshag dang zhing chen gyi ya phub: mi ro'i rgyal mtshan sogs du tra'i phung po las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang nang rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i dal dbus byol song gtso brgyad pad nyi zla ba rgyas pa'i khar

rnu: o rgyan rak+ṣa brnya thod phreng rtsal dmar spug dbu bco brgyad phyag so drug khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs pa: ye shes kyi me dang dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong du zhabs rnams rab tu bsgrad pa: dur khrod chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa: thugs mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dang ldan pa: de yi 'khor du srin po pho mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos sgo mtha' yas pa ston cing: de dag thams cad kyang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la sbyor ba sha stag go 'di mthong ba tsam gyis nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'char ro: bdag gis yul gling 'di dag gang yin lags zhus tshe ḍaskemizhal nas: srin yul lang ga 'dud na dga' ba'i rdzongs su grags: ston pa rak+ta thod phre rtsal dang 'khor srin po pho mo rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu chos gsang sngags phyi nang gsang ba'i rgo 'phar 'byed cing: yul ni bkod pa mdzes ldan: grong khyer la 'dod 'byung dpal zhes grags: ri bo gsal ldan gdengs can 'jog po'i thod du bcing ba'i rtse zhes bya'o dag pa'i snang nyams 'di lta bu ni gang zag sngon smon las

'dzoms dad pa dag snang can gyis spyod yul lo:ces gsungs so:de nas bdagacan rgyan rak+ṣa sgod phreng rtsal la zhus pa:kye he dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi:thugs kyi gsang ba gsum rdzogs gar:o rgyan rak+ta thod phreng rtsal:mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen gyis skal bzang bdag la thugs rje'i dgongs:las sgrib bag chags sbyang ba dang:smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol:zhes zhus tshe:gu ru nyid bhurnya dbu 'bum rtsal gyi tshul bzung nas gu drag gsang chen rgyal po:khyad 'phags rig 'dzin phyag rgya zil gnon:mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che'i zab sgrub:lam rim gsal ba'i them skas rnams bka' lung dbang khrid man ngag bcas gtad rgya mdzad pa bzhin bdag gis yang 'od gsal yang pa'i gter brag la 'gyur med rig pa'i rgyas gdab la bzhag go de nas yang gsung pa:a las ldan snyeng gi bu mchog:gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi snang ba gdod nas grub pa med na:zhen chags 'khrul ba bskyur legs nyon mongs dug lnga dug gsum:chags sdang 'khor ba'i kha dpon:khyod kyang gter ston yin na bshad sgrub legs rjes dgos so:

rlu chos brgyad 'du 'dzi mang po: rnam g.yeng le lo 'khrul 'khor: tshogs drug sgyu ma'i ltad do: ma zhen dben par song lags: snod gcig me chu mi 'phrod gter dang 'phrad pa'i skal bza : 'jig rten 'khor ba ru log: gnas chul gzhan la ma bsre: snyigs ma'i rtsubs 'gyur dus su dad can bu mchog dkon no: kha gsag log lta can mang de la gdams ngag ma shor: thos chuja nga rgyal can dang: bsgom chu 'dod srid 'thug go: blo chung rtog ge ba la: zab gter yang bcud ma shor: mi drag thob thang chen po: bladapon bya bzhag mang po: 'dod sred bka' rgya gtor 'dod de la zab chos ma sbyin: rje bdud bu la ma 'dud: chags 'bar sri la ma brtse: 'du 'dzi dkor la ma 'byams: de dag sems la zung ya: man ngag zab bcud rnams kyang da lta spel ba'i dus min ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su: 'bru ban dharmā ku mud: der gtod 'gro don bsam yas: bu mchog nus ldan rdo rje: rgyun du nga nyid bsgom da : phyi nang rkyen snang sel zhing: mchog gi dngos grub thob po: a e ka phaṭa: ces gsungs so: de nas yang phyin pa'i tshe ri bo

tsit+ta'i dbyibs lta bu'i rked pa na lus med mkha' 'gro yul gling brgya dang nyi shus rtsa brgyad kyi tshogs dpon mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo sogs kyi 'du ba chen po byas pa'i gral dbus su rat+na'i khri mdzes pa zhig snang ba de ru bdag kyang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi rol mo sna tshogs kyi sbir cing bsu ba byas te khri de ru bsdad: de tshe mkha' 'gro ma dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi byung ste mgrin gcig tu 'di skad zer: a ho: dga' 'o skyid do mi min gyi zhing na: 'khrul snang kun rtog sgyu ba ni ma mchis: 'brog ban sprul pa 'dir 'byon pa ngo mtshar: nged cag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon la bzhugs 'tshal: khyo med chags sred zhen rtog de med kyang: sngon smon rten 'brel dag pa yis 'dud do: lha dang snang ba rang sems su mnyam brdal: dag mnyam rdo rje 'chang chen gyi bu la: lus ngag yid gsum phyi nang gi bkod pa: zhen med maṇ+ḍal gsal ba ru bkram nas: rgyal kun phrin las bu mchog la 'bul lo: sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las de bskang ngo ces zer nas phyag mdzad do: de nas mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mos bhan+ta lcang lo can ko ro tsa na skya phyu ru ru byed pa zhig

'u: bdag la gnang zhing 'di skad gsungs so:agam ho gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal sang sku dang ye shes rol par sad:ngang gnas gnyug ma'i ye shes ni don dmardo dze+ephag mo'i zhal:las sgrib sbyor ba'i mngon gsum mthong:dad pa dag snang mos gus bskyed:dgongs pa dbyer med dbang bskur nas:bde gsal mi rtogs nyamasa'abar te lhan skyes dpa' bo' zhal mjal nas shar grol dus mnyams rjen par mthong rnam smin lus rgya bral ma thag:rnga yab rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin re ga de ma thob paragazhal phan gyis:gang 'ashu la 'gro don nus pa dang 'khor ba dong sprugs dbang thob re ga:a ho sarba sernyi a bhi ṣiñca ma.ā:hūṃbye zhes gsungs zhing bdud rtsi zig pa gsumaganang nas sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob byung:de nas gdams ngag snying dang 'dra ba'i salta ba seng galing re sgom pa blo 'das ye shes:spyod pa rtsol bral zab mo gsum gyigand gsang bka' yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu zhig gnang yang re zhigagu rgya:de nas lus med mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'khrigs pa ltar byung nas mgrin gcig tu:yiga.a༄ra bzhi

dbyar gyi rgyal mo:bka' drin che ba e go:spang sngon me tog rgyas pas:mi phyugs skyid pa e nam:lho mon dbyid kyi rgyal mo:gsung dbyangs snyan pa e go:'gro ba'i snang sems spro zhing:bza' btung char 'bebs e nam rta bdun gsal ba'i 'od zer:bkrag mdangs ldan pa e go:'gro ba'i mun pa sel zhing:grags reg skyobs pa e nam:stong gsal nam mkha' yangs pa:rgya tshad bral ba e go snang srid 'khor 'das brgyan cha:ma 'dres yongs rdzogs e nam:lta ba klong chen yangs pa:ye grol yin pa e go:'khrul snang gdod nas ma grub dbyings ye zungs 'jug e nam:sgom pa gcig shes kun grol:shar grol yin pa e go:'gyu rtog rtsis gdab mi dgos phyam brdal ngang bzhag e nam:spyod pa rgyal ba'i myu gu:rang grol yin pa e go:las 'bras blang dor mi rmongs:lta spyod zung 'brel e nam nyin mtshan 'od gsal rol pa:'bral med yin pa e go:rang rig gnyug ma'i ye shes lha dang zhing khams e nam dag mnyam zangs mdog dpal ri:rang snang yin pa e go:snying dbus zangs mdog dpal ri:sems rtog srin yul

༷ e nam:shar cha brda dang dpe cha:snang ba lhar snang e go:ma sring mkha' 'gro rgyal mtsho:'du 'bral med pa e nam:rang snang nus ldan khyed kyi:rang rtsal chos bdag e go:rabhe byung gdams pa spyin la:rang 'bras mngon gyur e nam lhun grub gsal ba'i ston pa'i:gnang thob man ngag e go:snod min lag tu ma stor:rang nyams sbyar ba e nam:rtsa rlung thig le'i khams na:lhan skyes lha rdzogs e go nged tsho lus med mkha' 'gro:dbyings su bzhugs pa e nam:lha mthong 'drosnang ma che:dam sri nyes e go:dag mnyam lam khyer rem dang:bar chad mi 'byung e nam 'jig rten gtam la ma nyan:sdug bsngal ster yang e go:chags sdang ro snyoms mdzod dang:'di bde phyi skyid e nam:sku 'di'i 'gro don rdzogs mthar:nged gling 'byon dgos e go:zag med byang sems ro la:spyod 'dod che ba e nam:kun mkhyen grimed 'od zer:khyed drung bzhugs pa e go:ro snyoms brtul zhugs mdzod dang:khyad 'phag rig 'dzin e nam:spro ba de ring che'o:bcu drug 'bar ba e go:lhum zhugs kun bzang e nam:zung 'jug

sku gsum e ma:phyam brdal spros bral a ho:dbyings rig 'bral med e nya:ces gsungs nas thams cad kyi g.yas su lan gsum bskor ba byed pa la bdag gisa.a haṃ gi lamal 'dun pa bzhag pas thams cad kyisa.a la la ho ngo mtshan che zhes gsungs so de nas yang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma de yi da bzhengs dang pha cigagu ru rin po che'i sku drung dubyon dang gsungs pa la bdag gis lags so zhus nas lus med mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad pa'i smon lam rnam par dag pa btab la de nas phyin pa'i tshe ri bo dkar seradamar ljang rtse mo bzhi pa g.yu yi na bun 'thibs pa dri bzang sna tshogs kyi ngad pa g.yo ba: me tog mang po tshar du ngar ba ldon bzang dril g.yer chos sgra 'byin pa mang po 'phyang ba:dedag gi rtse mo na shar shel gyi gzhal med khang: lho gser gyi gzhal med khang:nub pad ma'i ra ga'i gzhal med khang: byang min+t+ra ni la'i gzhal med khang: sgo dang dbyibs brgyanamadzes pa phyi gsal nang gsal dri med 'od kyis gzhal yas khang mthong ba tsam gyis bde stong 'gyur ba med pa'i ye shes rgyud la bskyed pa'i rang bzhin can mthong tshe bdag gi

gyi zhing khams 'di bzhi po gang yin lags zhus tshe:ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas shar phyogs dri med 'od kyis zhing khams:ri bo mthong na skyid pa'i rtse zhes grags:'di na gu ru bde chen rgyal po bzhugasaḥ'akhor rib/'dzin gyi tshom bu la bka' 'dus chos kya rgya mtsho'i man ngag ster ba yin gsungs:lho phyogs bde chen ra byung gi zhings khams:ri bo gsal ldan gyi 'od 'bar ba'i rtse zhes grags:'di na gu ru khyad 'phags rig 'dzin bzhugs:'khor rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu la dam chos dgongs 'dus bskor bzhi'i chos gsungs pa yin gsungs:nub ma chags pa d+ma 'bar ba'i zhings khams:ri bo ya na gru 'dzin pa'i rtse zhes grags:'di na gu ru 'od zer mtha' yas pa'i rgyal po bzhugs:'khor rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu la dbang chen gsung gi chos sgo mtha' yas pa ston pa yin gsungs:byang las rab grub pa'i zhings khams:ri bo rda na 'big byed pa'i rtse zhes grags:'di na gu ru gtum drag rgyal po bzhugs:'khor rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu la bla med gsang ba'i cho sgor mtha' yas ston pa yin gsungs:de nas yang phyin tshe dbus kyi ri bo mchong gur

phub 'dra dbyibs tsit+ta gzings pa lta bu'i rtse mor pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang shar shel lto be+eḍūr+ya nub pad+ma rā ga byang in+t+ra ni la las grub pa phyi gsal nang gsal dri ma med pa: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta bab bang rim khyud mo dang bcas pa rin chen mang po'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed mdzes pa: gser gyi dril bu dang dngul dkar gyi g.yer kha las dam pa'i chos kyi rang sgra sgrogs pa: shing yal 'dab me tog 'bras bu ldan pa mang po 'phyangs pa bya ka la ping ga: rma bya dang khrung khrung nga ngur ka la ri skeg: ku lan+ta: je tso sogs kyi khrus chab mchog gi jing bu la brtse zhing gar 'khrab pa: ri dwags u yu ra sgeg bzang mdzes spu dga' 'jo bde 'bar sogs kyis bro 'khrab cing rtse mo byed pa khyams rin po che sna tshogs pa'i bar ma be+eḍūr+ya'i cag gdab pa: dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang pos mchod sprin mtha' yas pa phul bar byed pa 'og gi sgo la gser gyi g.yang drung bris pa can de ru gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rdo rje zhig 'dug pa de nyid kyi brda thabs byas tshe mkha' 'gro ma ser mo rus pa'i rgyan cha can zhig byung ste sgo shag

rlu gi phyes nas 'di skad zer a hoḥ rang byung gi rtog pa mngon gyur lhan skyes kyi zhing khams mjal ba: tshogs smon dang las 'phro 'dzoms pa'i: grub brnyes kyi gdung 'dzin dpa' bo: gnas 'di ru 'byon pa ngo mtshar: zhes zer nas me tog sna tshogs pa 'thor ro: de nas bdag dang gnyis rin po che'i them lam du zhugs nas steng thon tshe dri bzang bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'thib cing 'dod snam dmar po'i khyams la mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pas khrus chab gsol ba de dag gis 'di skad zer: e ma: kun zlum chos dbyings bum par yan lag brgyad ldan bcud 'khyil lus la phog pa tsam gyis sgrib pa bag chags dag cing: nyams rtogs yon tan 'bar ro: bu mchog khyod la khrus bgyi:las sgrib dag la grol mdzod: ces gsungs shing bdag la khrus byas pas nyams rtogs yon tan lhag par 'bar ro: de nas shar gyi sgo dkar la zlum la 'khyil ba de snying rje'i rang mdangs lcags kyu'i sne la brten nas sgo zhag gis phyes nas gcig tu 'di skar zer a ho: skyid pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing na: 'jig rten 'khor ba yi ming med: tshogs yul rnam

dag gi rang gdangs:ye shes dbyings klong las sprul pa'i:bdag cag rdo rje yi mkha' 'gro:tshad med snying rje'i rang gdangs mjal ba 'di dag ni ngo mtshar:snying rje'i 'gro don ni 'grub bo:gzhan phan don gnyer la rem rem:brtul zhugs zab don la sbyor 'tshal ces zer nas me tog dkar po mang po 'thor byung:de nas lho sgo ser gsal gru bzhi brjed pa de byams pa'i rang gdangs zhags pa'i brda thabs la brten nas sgo shag gi phyes nas bltas tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ser gsal bcu gsum gyis gar 'khrab cing mgrin gcig tu 'di skad zer:a ho:dga' chen mkha' spyod kyi zhing na:'jig rten 'khrul snang gi ming med:rtog tshogs rnam dag gi rang gdangs:ye shes rol rtsal lasa'agyed pa'i:bdag cag rin chen gyi mkha' 'gro:tshad med byams pa yi chen gyi rang gdangs:mjal ba 'di dag ni ngo mtshar:byams pa 'gro don ni 'grub bo:gzhan phan don gnyer la rem rem:brtul zhugs zab don la spyor 'tshal:ces zer nas me tog ser po mang po 'thor byung:de nas nub sgo dmar gsal zla gam 'bar ba de dga' ba'i rang

rlu: gdangs lcags sgrogs gi brda thabs la brten nas shag gi phyes nas blta tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'a1sna ma dmar gsal rnams pa brgyad kyis bro gar 'khrab cing mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gyer:a ho dga' chen dpal ri yi zhing na 'jig rten 'brul snang ni ma mchis:rnam rtog rang grol gyi rang gdangs:ye shes 'gags med las 'gyed pa'i:bdag cag pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro ni:tshad med dga' chen gyi rang gdangs mjal ba 'di dag ni ngo mtshar:dga' ba'i 'gro don ni 'grub po:gzhan phan don gnyer larem rem brtul zhugs zab gnad la sbyor 'tshal:ces zer nas me tog dmar po mang po 'thor byung:de nasabyang sgo ljang gsal gru gsum rngams pa de btang snyoms kyi rang gdangs dril bu'i bar thabs la brten nas shag gi phyes pa bltas tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gsal rnam pa bco brgyad kyis bro gar 'khrab cing mgrin gcig tu 'di skad zer:a ho bdechen rang byung gi zhing na 'jig rten 'byul snang ni ma mchis:kun rtog rang grol gyis ngang gdangs rtsol bral ye shes las bskyed pa'i:bdag cag las byed

kyi mkha' 'gro: tshad med btang snyom gyi rang gdangs: mjal ba 'di dag ni ngo mtshar: btang snyoms 'gro don gyi 'grub bo: gzhan phan don gnyer la rem rem brtul zhugasazab gnad la sbyor 'tshal ces zer nas me tog ljang gsal mang po 'thor byung: de nas yang ḍasko ma dang rang nyid gnyis 'grogs nas bltas tshe 'od lnga lhun 'grub kyi gzhal medakhang gi sgo zlum la dwangs ba me tog mang po'i mdzes pa de nyid phyes nas bltas pas 'od zer mtha' yas pa'i sgo 'byed pa'i mod la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams shar nas cung zad la rtog med har sangs se brgyal: de las ldang tshe rin po che khri zur brgyad pa ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i kharabade gshegs 'dus zhal gu ru rin po che sku mdog dung la pho tshos bskus pa lta bu dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa sa la bsdig pa: g.yon bhan+ta 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsis bkang ba'i thod bum bsnams nas dbu la sha ba'i mnyen zhu gsol ba: rtse rgyal rdo rje lha mos sgro dang nyi zla'i nor bu'i phra mdzes pa: zhabs sog lhum 'ja' khra mnab cing 'od lnga'i klong na bkrag mdangs bzod par dka' ba

snyi bong tshad mi lus gsum gyi mtho dman tsam pa phod kha za ber chos gos mthing sham rin po che mgul rgyan phreng ba do shal snyan rgyan 'od dang 'od zer mu med pa spro zhing zhal gyis gzi brjed bzod dka' ba de mjal byung ngo de tshe dga' spro dad pa mos gus tshad med pa skye zhing lus kyis phyag grangs med pa 'tshal: ngag gi gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig brjod yid kyi mtho dman gar gtong khyed shes kyi dad pa drag po'i sgo nas 'dun pa gtong: gu ru'i g.yas phyogs kyi gral la rig 'dzin brgyad dang grub chen brgyad cu rnams bzhugs pa g.yon gyi gral na rje 'bangs nyer lnga gter chen brgya rtsa sogs bzhugs pa: mdun na ye shes mcho rgyal: man+ta ra ba shel dkar rdo rje mtsho mkha' 'gro zhi 'od 'bar ma: rin chen gser gyi 'od 'phro pad+ma me tog 'dzum ma: las rab bde chen rgyal mo sogs ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma mang pos mchod sprin mtha' yas pa stobs kyin 'dug: bar 'tshams su sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i yo byad bkram pa bdud rtsi'i sman gyis chogs sgrub mdzad pa'i skabs de rudapa' bo sde bzhi gang chen rnam brgyad

mkha' 'gro sde lnga sogs kyi dkyil 'khor bskor bro gar 'khrabs brda skad sna tshogs 'don noḥ de nas gu ru rin po che la bdag gi zhus pa phyag dang maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po sngon du song nas 'di skad zhus: rje ma hā gu ru rin po che dus gsum sangs rgyas yongs 'dus dpal: 'gro ba'i ma rig mun sel zhing: ye shes snang ba'i sgron ma mchog: 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgol ba'i gru: nyon mongs rkye rgyun gcod pa'i dpal: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan can: dad ldan pho mo yongs kyi skyabs: yon tan brjod 'das mkha' dang mnyam: bka' drin bsam mi khyab pa'i mgon: thugs rje'i bdag la dgongs su gsol bdag ni nyon mongs 'dams byung yang: skye sngon bsod nams bsags pa las: gu ru khyod dang mjal ba spro: da ni 'khor bar mi ldog pa'i: khyod kyi zhabs drung bdag mchi'o: thugs rje zung la byin gyis rlobs: zhes zhus tse gu ru'i zhal nas: a ho: sngags mchog nus ldan rdo rje:dad mos drag po nyon dang: spyir na rgyal ba thams cad: mdzad pa'i 'gro don kho nas dgos su o rgyan nga nyid ngo bo ye sangs rgyas kyang: rang mdangs 'gags med rtsal las:

blu: lho nub 'o ma can gyi:mdangs ldan sidhi dwangs mtsho:khye'u chung ye shes sku can:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i brtse ba:'gags med chos sgo 'byed cing:las can in+t+ra' bho dhis:spyan drangs rgyal srid brkyangs yang:sgyu ma'i yul la skyug log:thabs kyi 'khor ba spangs nas:rgya gar bka' skyongs phug par:mchog gi grub pa thob bo durakhrod brgyad du byon nas:rdzu 'phrul rmad byung bstan cing:'khrul snang 'gro ba smin pas:'phrul mtshan brgyad du grags so:'gro don bsam yas byas so:bod yul mun pa'i glingadu:'jam dpal sprul pa'i rgyal po:gdan 'dren bsu ba byung ngo:sngon smon las 'phro dag pa'i:'byon par zhal gyis bzhes so:lam la bar chad mang byung:gdug pa'i lha srinasde brgyad bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis:dreg can bsam mi khyab pa:rdzu 'phrul phyag rgyas 'gugs cing dam bzhag dkar por bsgyur ro:zab gter bcud re sbyin no:dmaldan skyong ba'i pho nya:sdig spyod sgrol ba'i shan pa:bka' dang tha tshig bsgos nas:phyi rab don du bzhag dgos:sku rten gtsug lag khang dang:nang rten dam chos rgya mtsho:thugs

rten zab gter bcud rnams bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag go las ldan rje 'bangs nyer lnga: rang skal gdams pa sbyin nas bsnyen sgrub dam du byas nas bskal ba ma stong bar du: 'gro 'dren sprul pa 'byung bas: smon lam thob ces bka' bsgos: dus rtags lung byang zab bcud: bgo skal pha phog gtad nas: sgrub gnas dag la sbas so: khyod kyang snga rabs dus su: 'brog ban khye'u chung lo tsā grub 'bras mngon gyur de nyid mchog gter nyi shu rtsa lnga: brtul zhugs don lnga skye brgyud gzhan las khyad 'phags 'byung ngo khyad par rdo rje gro lod de yi gdung rgyud 'dzin pa: nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal zhes: sku sprul mchog ni yin no skye nas tshe rabs kun tu dad mos tshogs smon 'dzoms pas dus chen byung res dang mjal: lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzings bstod: gzhal la mang du ma smra log 'khrul dag gis rdzun du: lam khyer byed pa 'ong ngo rang nyams sbyar ba lag len da dung 'dug pa'i dus min: snyigs ma'i rtsub 'gyur gso phyir: sku skyes sprul bar mdzad na: gdul bya ma rdzogs bar bzhugs nam zhig pha ngas bsu ba: byed pa'i pho nya mngag

rnu: 'ongs:de lugs thugs la zhog 'tshal:ces gsungs pa'i tshe gu ru'i zhabs spyi bor blang la 'di skad zhus so:skyabs mtshungs med pha gcig rdo rje 'chang:sku khyed dang 'bral ba ci'i phyir phod:phyir 'khor ba'i gnas na sdug bsngal che dgos nga nyid le lo 'du 'dzis bslu:blo nyon mongs dug lnga'i dbang du shor:yul chos brgyad gnas la zhen pa che:bdud nag po'i dbang du 'gyur kya srid:'dir sdod pa ra chog pa'i bka' drin stsol:zhes zhus tshe gu ru rin po che'i zhal nas:kye ho regs kyi bu mchog gson dang sna tshogs chos khams rgya mtsho:gzhi med rtsa bral rol ba:sems nyid gcig tu dag mnyam:dag pa'i zhing khams bkod pa:ma ga na grub pa med do:rig pa gcig tu phyam brdal rmi lam 'khrul snang sna tshogs:shar ba'i rang dus nyid nas:sems nyid gcig tu 'ub chub:'od gsal dag pa'i snang ngor:wa dang zhings khams bkod pa:ci ltar gsal ba 'di yang ye shes gcig gi cho 'phrul:log na grub pa med do:de phyir bdag dang khyed gnyis:'du 'bral spu tsam med do:'di ru sdod pa'i dus min:re ba'i 'dzin pa

chod lags: 'gro drug 'khrul ba'i snang ba: sems kyi gshis nyams yin no: don la ye nas ma grub: de lugs gzhan la ston dang: las ldan rnams kyis rtogs so rang rig gsal ba'i rgyan cha: skyon du ma blta nus ldan le lo 'du 'dzi mang po: 'khor ba'i gshis lugs yin pas: bsnyen sgrub brtul zhugs mdzad 'tshal: nyon mongs dug lnga'i cho rol bden zhen rang dgar ma spyod: skyon bltas spang ba min no: ye shes rol bar lam khyer: chos brgyad bya bzhag mang po: grub zin med pa'i cho rol: rang gar bskur la klod thong:mi med brag ri zungs shig: 'khor bar sgyu ma'i grong khyer: gzung 'dzin bdud kyi cho rol: zhen rtogs dam sri'i g.yo ba: log na tshol 'gro mi dgos: rang thog nyid du chod na bdud las rgyal ba yin no: de dbang 'gro dang mi 'gro: gang zag khyod la rag las: rmi lam nyid kyi zhing 'dir: 'dug par ga la chog go: bde ba mchog tu bzungs na: gser sgrog 'bar ba'i 'ching ngo: de don sems la zungs shig 'gro don skyo ngal ma mdzad dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje: dam bca' nyams par ma mdzad: zhes gsungs so: de nas bdag

rnu: gi phyag mang du 'tshal nas zhus pa: skyabs gcig ma hā gu dra thugs rje bdag la dgongs shig: 'khor 'das khyad par gang lags: grol dang 'khrul ba cilags: go rtogs khyad par ci yod: de dag gsungs bar zhu'o: gu ru rin po che'i zhal nas: kyesto snyeng gi bu mchog gson dang ka dag chos sku'i dbyings na: 'khor 'dasagrub pa med do: ye gzhi gdod ma'i mgon po: sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan: khyad chos drug ldan bum sku ci bzhin rig pa'i sangs rgyas: rgyu gsum rkyen bzhi'i dbang gis: med layod par bzung zhing: 'khrul snang bden par bzungs ba'i: ma rig 'khor ba mched do: gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi snang ba: sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig bzhin: sku gsum ye shesadabyings su: gtan srid zin na grol ba: rnam rtog snga ma'i bskyed pa'i: phyi ma'i nyer len gsos btab: bag chags yang yang mthas pa'i: 'khrul snang 'gro ba'i gnas tshul: snatshogs chos khams rgya mtsho: phung khams skye mched dbang yul thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral rig pa gcig gi yo lang kho thag chod na rtogs pa btag tsam kun rtog snang ba

ming tsam don du ma mchis:stong pa nyid kyi rol par: blo thag chod na go ba:khyad par de ltar mchis pa'i: ma nor thugs la zhog 'tshal:zhes gsungs so: de nas yang bdag gis zhus pa: kya:bka' drin mnyam med gu ru rin po che: thugs rje brtse ba'i bdag la dgongs su gsol: man ngag bcud 'dus tshe gcig sangs rgyas pa'i:yang bcud bdag la gnang ba'i bka' drin stsol:zhes zhus tshe bdag la bka' stsal pa:kya ho mos gus dad dam ldan pa'i:rnal 'byer bu mchog gson dang:mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs la:snying dus phyogs dang bral ba'i:tshad med blo sbyong byed cing: bla ma spyi bor sgoms nas:gsol 'debs dbang bzhi blang la: thugs yid ro gcig bsre la: mnyam par ci gnas bzhag pa:sngon 'gro yin pa'i gal che: de nas sgo gsum bab klong:ma gzhi stong pa nyid du rang yan har sangs chen po: 'dzin rtog spros dang bral bar:phyam brdal bzo bcos med par sangs nges yangs nge phyam brdal:'dzin med sa le hrig ge rtse mo byung rgyal dam pa: kun shes kun rig 'gags med:mi gcod mi 'gags mi 'dzin: gang shar yeshes

྅ chen po:lam khyer gnad du bsnun pa:dngos gzhi zab gnad gal che:rjes thob sgyu ma rmi lam:'dzin med zhen bral mdangs skyongs:byams dang snying rje bsgomacing bde gsal mi rtogs nyams dben gol pho ra nor gsum 'phrang bsgral:nyon mongs dug lnga 'bur 'joms:lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin:dam tshig sngags kyi mdo rtsa rgyal ba'i bcas khrims ltar du:legs dpyad spyod pa'i zab gnad:gnad du dril ba yod rtsa:sems la 'chong shiganus ldan: zhes gsungs so:de nas yang bdag gis zhus pa rje ma hā gu ru rin po che:mkhyen brtse'i bdag la dgongs su gsel:bdag ni zab gter dang 'phrad tshe bstan pa'i 'gro don gang nas 'byung:slob 'bangs chos bdag ci ltar 'ongs:de dag bdag la gsung bar mdzod zhes zhus tshe bdag la bka' stsal pa:kyeto/ dad pa dam chig dag pa'i: skyes mchog rig 'dzin gson dang:sngon smon las 'phro'i dbang gi:dus la bab pa'i tshe na zab gter rgya mtsho 'byin dgos:mkha' 'gro lung la brten 'tshal:phug gsum spyo ngas lnga'i gter bcud:mjug ma gsum gyi bgo skal:dus

dang skabs su rted yongs:rigs ldan phyogs nas 'ong ba'i:pho nya drug cu gsham 'god:mchog gi chos bdag rnam bzhi:las ldan lnga bcu rtsa drug:'ja' lus grub pa rnams brgyad:gos dkar ral ba'i lcang lo'i:sde tshan skyes bu lnga bcu brtul zhugs grub pa bcu gsum:'gro don lho byang gnyis nas:'bum phrag bcu po 'dren no:pha ngas 'bral med byin rlabs dbang bskur lung bstan dbugs byung:dus drug bskang tshogs gnad smin gsol 'debs mos gus rem ya:ces gsungs so:de nas bdag gis rjes ma hā gu ru la phyag mang du 'tshal nas maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba:bka' drin mtshungs med 'gro ba'i mgon:o rgyan chen po bdag la dgongs:zeg pa ma lus yongs rdzogs kyi:gsang chen rdo rje snying po la:zab gnad 'du'am mi 'du zhes:gsang sngags dbang gi dkyil 'khor la:rnam grangs ji ltar 'du ba lags zhes zhus tshe bka' stsal pa:kye ho:snying gi bu mchogagason dang:gang zag dbang po'i rim pas:thegs pa dgu ru byung ngo:blo chung byas pa'i sde la:nyan rang bya sems spros so:dbang 'bring brtul zhugs can la:bya spyod

rdzu: rnal 'byor rgyud sde: blo gros spros pa chen por: ma hā ma nu a ti: rnam par bstan pa yin no: ka dag stong chen yangs pa: lhun grub sku dang ye shes: nyid lasamathar thug med kyang: phyogs tsam mthong ba'i blo chung: stsol bcas dga' ba'i dbang 'bring: zang thal rtog pa'i rnal 'byer dbang po'i rim pas dbye'o: dper na sangs rgyas nyidakyi: chos sgo gcig tu gsung yang: rang rgyud dang mthun go ba de phyir mtha' gcig mi 'dzin: mdor na rdzogs pa chen po'i: rnal ma'i ye shes bsgom na: 'dir 'dus gcig rdzogs bla med: tshig cam du yang mi mtshungs don gyi zab gnad 'du'o: de phyir spyi ti yo ga dgongs pa gcer bur byung ba'i: bla med yang ti yo ga 'di 'dra'i bka' gsang zabamo: sus kyang gsung bar mi 'gyur bdag gi sku drin yin no: byin rlabs dbang gi rtsa ba rang rig chos sku rtogs dgos: ngo bo skye med ka dag: nges tshig ma smin smin pa dbye ba spros bcas spros med: sgra tshig a bhi 〉thu 'jug pa gtor blugs gnyis so: bsdus don dbang bzhi ye shes: thabs la bskyur byed ngo sprod: don ni lajug sgo zab mo: bskyed

rdzogs yongs kyi gzhi rten:'di med dngos grub dbul lo:phye ma'i mar khu ci bzhin:theg brgyad zer dang 'dra la:yang tig nyi ma'i snying po:gnad du dril bar rem da :tshe gcing sangs rgyas thob bo:zhes gsungs so:de nas bdag gis gu ru rin po che'i zhabs spyi bor blang zhing dad mos drag po' shugs bskyed la 'di ltar gsol ba gdab bo:kya ma thugs rje brtse ba'i bdag nyid can:bka' drin mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon:o rgyan rje la gsol ba 'debs bdag ni thugs rje'i bzungs du gsol:lus ngag yid sgrib dag pa dang:phyi nang 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang mchog gi dngos grub stsol ba dang nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bskyed rjes su bzung la byin gyis rlobs:'khrul snang grol bar mdzad du gsol:zhes zhus tshe:31 rgyan chen po'i zhal 'dzum pa dang thugs brtse ba chen po'i 'di skad do:e ma mchog gi rig 'dzin chen po:bdag la legs pa ra gson da :zhal gdams tshig gsum bshad do:ma brjed snying la brten cig gang du bsdad kyang sems spro:su 'grogs ba la brtse bskyed mi med lung par spyod dang nga dag lta spyod mthun no:

rlu sgyu ma'i yul la ma zhen:chos brgyad bya ba spo la:ro snyoms brtul zhugs mdzod dang:nga dang lta spyod mthun no:mi rtag 'chi ba bsgom la:le lo 'du 'dzibazhag nas:brtson 'grus zab mo'i gnad skyongs:nga dang lta spyod mthun no:'khor ba zhen 'o ga nges 'byung 'dod chung chog shes brten pa :bya bzhag snyib po bsgrub na:nga dang ltaspyod mthun no:dkar nag dkor ni gol sa:gdul bya long sa spyod nor sa:chags sdang shor sa spongs dang nga dang lta spyod mthun no:kun 'dud nga rgyal chen po:'bangs mngabaze re 'thug go:don med bra mchu spangs dang:nga dang lta spyod mthun no:gnas la nges pa med pa:tshig la cha bzhag bral ba:sems la 'dod pa chung na:nga dang lta spyod mthun no 'gro don skyo ngal med pa:zab gter sgo 'phar 'byed cing:chos bdag bu la gtad na:nga dang lta spyod mthun no:tsab tsub 'ur gzing gtad med:sde brgyad bran du khol ba:chosabaka' mgo mjug tshang na:nga dang lta spyod mthun no:dag snang mos gus che ba:tshogs bsags gnad la brtson pa nyams spro glu mgur byed rnams:nga dang lta spyod mthun no slob

ma brtse ba'i skyongs zhing 'gro ba thabs kyi 'dul ba gdams ngag sbyin la mkhas na nga dang lta spyod mthun no: snod min dbye bsal mkhas shing ye shes 'char tshusgrub pa'i drod rtags thon na nga dang lta spyod mthun no: bstan dgra drungs nas 'byin cing: mtshan ldan dga' bzhi'i gzhur drongs 'dod zhen bskyed rim bstan na:mthun no: yengs med 'od gsal bsgom zhing: bden med lta gdengs mtho ba: 'khrul bral spyod pa zhib na: nga dang lta spyod mthun no/ sgrub mthar shi la gtug cing la gzhol ba: sgom mtha' sangs rgyas 'grub na: nga dang lta spyod mthun no: kha ngo dkon mchog gsum 'a blta: 'dun phug phyi ma don gnyer: blo sna chos la dril na:mthun no: gzhan phan 'gro don 'grub cing byams brtse snying rje'i chen po thos sogs bsgom las byung tshe nga dang lta spyod mthun no: snang ba lha ru dag cing: sgra grasmin pa: dran rtog ye shes rdzogs na: nga dang lta spyod mthun no:gsor 'das rgyan gyi rol ba: shar tshad kun tu bzang po: dbyings da ye shes sbyor na: nga dang lta

blu: bzung ba'i yul snang zad cing: 'dzin pa'i kun rtog grol nas: nga bdag zer thag chad na: nga dang lta spyod mthun no: bu mchog 'di dag sems la: brten nas brgyud da sbyar na nyon mongs g.yul las rnam rgyal:nga yi drung du sleb lags:ma brjed nus ldan rdo rje:snying gi dkyil du e bam:ces gsungs so: de nas yang bdag gis rje ma gu ru rin po che la zhus pa: kya bka' drin mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon po che: bskal ba'i g.yo 'khrugs dus kyi rtsub 'gyur dang : 'jig rten legs nyes mi bde'i sna ba kun:ji ltar byung ba yin gyis gsung bar zhu zhes zhus tshe gu ru rin po che'i 'di skad gsungs so: a ho: mos ldan khye'u chung lo tsā: dad dam dgongs pas gson dang: bskal ba rdzogs ldan nas bzung: bzhi gsum gnyis dang rtsod ldan: lnga brgya phrag bcu song nas lung gi mtha' la nye bar snyigs ma'i lnga mtshang maro na gyur nad mug mtshon 'khrug g.yo zhing rtag par mi dge bcur spyod:dge btsun zer ba ma yang g.yo rgyu bslu sems kho nas: bcas khrims than du brtsi ba 'dul ba'i gzugs brnyan tsam mo:sngags pa zer ba

mang yang: col chung spyod pa khrom gyer: nyon mongs 'chol nogs gyur ba'i dam tshig than la brtsi rnams gsang sngags gzugs brnyan tsam mo byang chub sems dpa'izer yang tshul 'chol mngon lkog mi mthun: 'gro ba'i srog cod dgos kyang: snying rje spu tsam med na: byang sems bslab pa gzugs tsam gter ston zer ba mang yang: lcang lo bud med brten nas: rdzun chos bka' rkun byed cing: nga gling sems can mgo bskor: dam nyams gter ming tsam mo: grub thob zer ba mang yang: be+e the'i brlabs pa'i 'byung po gzhanam go bskor ba'i bslu tshig: mig 'phrul mang po ston cing: nag phyogs mgo 'phang mtho bas 'gro mang 'di dag dbang gyur: nor la rngams pa che ba'i: dam sri'i de kun grub ming bya btang zer ba mang yab : dgra 'dul gnyen skyongs chen po: bya bzhag las ka mang po: 'du 'dzi'i blo sems bcur ba dran rgyu spyod pa mang po ri khrod pa zhes ming tsam bsgomasachen zer ba mang yang: stong lta had por kha 'byams: las 'bras khyad gsod mkhan tsho dug lnga me bzhin 'bar yang: med la yod tshul yin zer: tha mal ba dang khyad med

myi bsgom pa de tsho ming tsam: bla dpon thob thang chen po : spyod pa 'jig rten ji bzhin: ming la grwa tshangs 'khor slob: don du mkhon 'dzi gzhi ma: dkor la rtag par 'byams nas: gshin po lag zed mang bzhin: shi dus tha mal lta bu bla ma zhes pa ming tsam: sprul sku zer ba mang ya : bshad sgrub than du brtsi ba chos brgyad bya bzhag mang po: du ru'i rigs byed spyod cing: 'du 'dzi rnam g.ye ma po: bsgoms gral gtam gral sleb pa : dkor la rngams sems che ba'i: bu tsho sprul sku'i mi tsam: gcod pa zer ba mang yang: gzung 'dzin rang gar spyod cing bshan pa lag dmar mkhan tsho: 'drer 'dzin thor co rtsang spyod: gcod pa zer ba mi tsam: brtul zhugs zer ba mang yang: sman pa 'dod sred chen po: bu med sdig sems rngams pa: mi nag g.yo rkun rdzun gyer: mi yi lus su 'dug kyang: spyod pa sdig la mos pa'i: sha za srin po lta bu rtsub 'gyur sna tshogs ston pa'i: dus kyi ru 'dzing 'byung ngo: rtags ngan spyod pa 'i bstan tshe la srung byin rlabs yal lo: srung ma dam can yal nas nag phyogs mgo 'phang mtho la: nad rim nag po

sum bsgrel: gso ru mi btub tu ma ngos mi zin pa'i gdon nad: na kun bzhin du 'thor sdud: 'byung po'i g.yab mo 'dor ro: rgya 'dre ra mgo can dang: klu gdon dred mongagazugs can: bod sri bya rog gdong dang rgyas bsen 'tshubs ma 'khrug pa'i: skye 'gro sdug la sbyor cing: shi tshad 'dre ru 'gyur ro: phyi ma dmyal ba lhung ngo: sems can rang rangalas yin: sangs rgyas byon kyang skyob dka': 'gro ba bsam spyod log pa'i: gshis ngan 'gum pa bco lnga'i: gzhan dbang gyur la mngon no: dus kyi rang mtshang 'khrugs so gzhan yang snying la brten bya: ka la paṃ ga'i gsung dbyangs: rgya stag dmar po'i 'dzum la: chas nas bslu ba ngoms yong: zhen med brtul zhugs dgos so:re'abyams ngad pa 'phrozhing: ge sar mdangs la dug phog: gnam lcags ral gri ster yongs: mthu gtad ma byed bu mchog shar phyogs rdza spang khrod nas: g.yu yis thod rgyan can de: bsu ba byed la 'ong na: de gnas 'byon pa gal che: skabs der stod phyogs pho nya: bsod nams ming can sleb yong: gdul bya mnga' thang rgyas kyang: gol sa yin pa'i cham zhog: rta phyogs blo

rlu: gros mang gis: dam tshig ster ba yin pas: rang phyogs 'byon 'tshal zer yang: tshe la gnod pas cham zhog: 'go yul lcags kyu rnon pos 1 yi sde tshogs drangs bas:drug phrag gsum na gser zhol:'dzin pa mdo rtsa yin no:gcan spyang hab rgyug byed nas:lho phyogs lug khyu mang po:nye zur 'ur ded byed skabs:srog skyobs mdzadan phan thog: bar nas ngang khyu mang po: rdzing bu ku mud tshal la: 'phur lding sna tshogs byed tshe: thabs kyi skyongs ba rem ya 'brong nag mdur bas sna las: zhal lce mang po zeb srid: sngon gyi las 'bras yin pa sa: rang sar bskyur ba gal che: mi dmar blo stobs chen po'i: thabs kyi sbrang rtsir ster yong: zhen med gcod dgos man ngag: spyod na phung ba'i dus mchis ljong 'dabs gser gyi ge sar: rgod ldem pho nya'i 'byer srid: bang la gang snga byas na: khyed lag rted na dge lags: lho mon gsung dbyangs snyan mo: rang phyogs yul la ma shor: ljon shing 'dab 'bras ldan pa: zung nas spyod cig las ldan: gser thang nya brud rgyas la: se phung sprul pa'i cho rol: yul ljongs mi bde'i la yog ston tshe

gnyen po ki ma: rgya bya cod paṇa ldan pas: seng la phra ma 'gyed nas: sha rkyang 'thab rtsod 'byung ngo: gnyen po ma hā ka la: tsher nag shing gi lo 'bras ke la ra yi dar yug: chu sprel rog pos bslu tshe khyung dmar me yis gzir ya: cang shes po pho sgrogs pas: phyogs bcur 'ur skad 'gyed do: seng sding lo 'bras 'thor sdud: skyobs byed rta nag lcags ral: brag rim rdo rje'i rdzongs la: mi snyan kha ta grags song: g.yu bya'i lo 'dabs yan ya byad bzlog seng ha ḍāk+ki: bam ri thod pa mkhar nas bu mchog skyes bu gsum po:gser ldongs phyogs su spros so: khyod kyi chos bdag byed yongs: gdams ngag sbyin la mkhas na: 'gro don bsam yas e ma: gangs ri dkar po'i 'dabs su: ge sar 'od mdangs rgyas pa: bde mchog phyag na bsnams nas ngoms tshe spyod mkhas rem ya: lug dkar g.yu yi rwa can: 'dur lheb lhem ltem byung tshe: skad kyis kun la gtam smra: spyod tshul khyod gyis bgo skal: sbrul nag ltem lhem rgyugs nas: yul lnga khrag gi mtsho 'khyil: nad rlangs mkha' la 'phyo srid: gnyen po badz+ra pa ṇi: glang nag rwa co rno ba'i: mtshams kyi

rlu: ljon bzang bskyod nas: sna tshogs legs nyes 'gyed cing: ku mud lag tu rted do: thabs shes 'bar ba'i mda' gzhu: lha ldan phyogs su sleb srid gsar chos rnying mar sdud pa'i: rten 'brel kun skyong spring pas: bgo skal mchog gi yon tan: sa gzhi gser mig 'khyil klong: sdig pa rā tsa'i gzer theb: bya rigs 'dabs ma 'thor srid gnyen po 'byung 'dul dbal gtod khyi nag dom bu zug cing ngar skad lo ru shar nas: thig le bcu drug 'thor sdud: skyobs byed rdo rje legs pa: bkra shis chos dung dkar po stobs ldan gnam lcags tho ba: 'dzum sgegs yos bu'i bsnams nas: nub kyi phyogs su 'phen no: mi nag dung so can gyi: 'ur ba'i gling mo sna dgu: dus su ston par 'gyur gyis: gnyen po sha za kha che: rkang drug sbrang rtsi'i bcud la: g.yo sding lhum la zhugs 'dod: a has rtse mo byed spro: bde la lcags kyu'i bzung 'tshal: gla nag rtse 'jo byed pa'i: shar gyi bu pho 'gugs nas: rtsi bcud dri zhims ngoms la spyod 'dod rngams pa ha ha g.yu 'brug gsung dbyangs snyan pa'i: stsal bzang rma bya mang 'gugs chos kyi nyi ma

shar nas:'gro la bde skyid spel legs:gser gyi sgog shing khro lod:'go yi sgog gso phur ba:dpa' sda'i sgog bskyed rta mgrin a yu tshe rdzi mgon po:bar gyi gzhi bskyed tāre:dug shing brten pa zhi khro:skyabs kyis skal ba phyag rdor:gnub kyi tshe rdzi rta nag hor gyi skal ba 'byung 'dul:rtsang gi ljon bzang gu drag:rdo yi gzhi 'dzin seng gdong smaragyis srog 'dzin phag mo:mdzi yis dpal du khyung nag:bstan pa'i gsos su shan dmar:rgyud sde'i bcud 'dzin ral gcig:bstan dgra'i gshed ma sha za rong sngags snying po gza' mchog:tshe bskyed masnye ra ba:srog spel sgrol ma dkar mo dpal skyongs ku ru kul+le nor ster 'phags ma nyer gcig:mchog thob ma hā gu ru rkyen bzlog bstan srung rgya mtsho:gnad smin de ltar phab 'tshal:nus ldan rdo rjes ma brjed ces gsungs so:bdag gi yang dad pa 'od zer 'bar ba chen po'i zhus pa:rje btsun gu ru rin po che:rgyal kun phrin las 'dus zhal nyid:brtse ba'i bdag la dgongs su gsol dag snang gar gyi 'khrul 'khor rnams:sngar nas mthong snang ci lta bu:bstan pa'i gsos su bzhag na yang

blu legs nyes gling mo sna dgu 'gyed: de dag ci'i phyir byung ba yin: zhes zhus so: gu ru'i zhal nas gsung ba: yigam khye'u chung nus ldan rdo rjes: legs parabadag la gson dang skye ba tshe rabs sngon dus: gangs can bod kyi yul du: bsam yas gtsug lag lhun grub: rgya chos gdan du drangs nas: bshad sgrub ba dan 'jug tshe: shudapu dpal gyi seng ge grub chen 'aprog mi lo tsā lta spyod cung zad mi mthun: phan tshun tshig skyon mang brjod: rten 'brel sna kha cung ral: de phyir gling mo shar ro: gzod pa lhur lena'atshal ya: gar gyi 'khrul 'khor dag pa'i: 'gro ba'i snang sems bsgyur zhing phung khams rtsa rlung gnad smin: sgrub pa'i gar bsgyur dam pa: 'jog par ga la rung ngo gnad mchog sems la 'chong shig: khyad par rā tsa g.yo bas: bra mchu gling mo ston no: zhen med rdul zhugs mdzad dgos ma 'khro ma chags klod ya rig mchoganus ldan rdo rje ces gsungs so: skabs 'dir zhus len gsal ba'i me long yod kyang re zhig gsang rgya gu h+ya de nas rje ma hā gu ru la bdag gis phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas gsol ba btab

pa: skyabs gcig 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog: bdag gis gsol ba gdab pa na: thugs rje rgyun chad med pa yis: byin rlabs mchog gi 'od zer can: mos pa'i thugs rgyud bskul nus pa:ci bzhin bdag la gsung bar zhu: zhes zhus tshe gu ru rin po che'i sku'i ba spu bye ba phrag brgya las gu ru rin po che bye ba phrag brgya 'od zer gyi rtse la spro zhing phyag g.yasapas thod rnga 'khrol zhing g.yon pa bdag gi mgo thog tu bzhag nas 'di skad gsungs so:hū / hū 'di nas nyi ma lho nub 'tshams shed na: rnga yab gling phran za byed srin po'i yul tsit+ta zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang rtsal: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig rin chen rgyan cha mang po si lili: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo:sgra dang rol mo mang po 'u ru phu yi dam lha tshogs hūṃ sgra di ri ri mkha' 'gro sde lnga gar byed shig se se shig: ging chen dpa' bo'i bro brdungakhrabs se khrab: ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar thibs se thib: chos skyong sde brgyad las byed khyugs se khyug: zhub chen stong gi sgra skad si li li: g.yas na pho rgyud thams cad sha ra ra

phyi g.yon na mo rgyud thams cad sha ra ra bar snang thams cad dar gdugs lhabs se lhab: dri zhim sbos kyi ngad pa thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda skad di ri ri: ging chen dpa' bo bshugs glu kyu ru dra/ hūṃ gi sna glu mang po di ri ri: phaṭa kyi brda skad drag po sengs sang: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: thugs rje gzigs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir thugs rje dgongs te gshegs nas kyang: bdag gis byang chub snying rje ma thob par: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba dang: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgra du gsol: o badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra ni maḥnyari niḥs ra tsaḥ1yaḥtsit+ta trīng hring dza dza: zhes thod rnga sgra dang snyan pa'i dbyangs mos gus tshad med pa dang ldan pas bskul na pha gcig nga nyid rang dbang med par byon nas byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro the tshom dang yid gnyis mi dgos so snying gi bu zhes gsungs so: de nas rgya gar parnyi rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu: ye ma: snyen ṭaṃ ya na'i ya ga: se kṛ ta la dgyes 'tshal he

le a ye wa nya du ṣe su ru a har: ru lu ma smi bha ti: e dha la ni su ran: bud+dha dharma saṃ gha: dhe wa ḍak+ki e cha spa ra ṇa phaṭa spro: se ha ra ṇa 'ub chub: sto rnyi tsit+ta ya ste: ma hā su ṣa ltosbyor: kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta sa ma ti yang sirnyi: phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin ngo mtshar: zhes zer nas me tog sna tshogs dang 'bru sna mang po 'thor byung de nas bod kyi rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'di skad gsungs so: e ma: skyes mchog 'gro 'dul rdo rje: brtul zhugs grub pa'i dpa' bo: rig 'dzin mchog gi sa nod: rnal 'byor nus ldan 'dus rtsal bstan 'gro'i 'gro don dus bab byams dang snying rje chen po'i 'gro drug zhabrul rgyun gcod cing: las can skal bzang rgya mtsho gdams pa'i rang byung ye shes: rtogs nas grub 'bras mngon gyur 'bum phrag tshom bu dang bcas: grol ba'i mthu dang ldan la dag pa'i zhing khams 'di dza ston 'khor dbyer med gyur pa'i rten 'brel dga' ston zhus legs ces brjod cing rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra sbir la shis pa brjod: de nas grub pa'i gter ston rnams gyis zhal nas: a ho: 'khor 'das snang ba thams cad: rig pa gcig tu grol ba'i chos nyid

myi gzhi med rtsa bral: bde stong ye shes ro mnyam: zung 'jug rnal ma'i gshis lugs mngon gyur dpa' bo chen po: gter la spyod ba'i bu mchog: dbye bsalalag len ma nor gab sbas lung bzhin brten 'tshal: zab gter klong rgya bkrol cing phan thabs bsam spyod kho nas: 'gro don 'grubs pa'i bsam pa: rmad byung rdzogs paragyur cig: gdams ngag sbyin la ma sob: gsung tshogs zob la ma shor: slob 'bangs 'dul thabs ma zhan: bsnyen sgrub bskang tshogs rem la: phya ma'i 'gro don 'grub pa'i bkra shis dge mtshan zhu legs: zhes gsungs nas brda thabs mang du mdzad par gyur to: 'di'i skabs su skabs su sman srung dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bro 'khrab gar byedacing glu mang du gyer: nyin lnga pa'i dus su tshogs 'khor bskor ba dang: drug pa'i dus su 'cham sna bco brgyad byung: bdun pa'i nyin par dngos grub la rol par mdzad do: de nasamatsho rgyal sogs mkha' 'gro ma bzhi po'i: thod chang stobs cing mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsungs so: tsogam ho gson cig nus ldan rdo rje: gnas 'dir 'byon pa ngo mtshar

zag med bde chen bdud rtsi: dga' ston phyir du bsgrub pa mthar phyin legs par grub bo: da ni khyed la stobs na: bde chen ye shes rtogs cing dbang bzhi'i pha phog dam pa bskur thob bral ba'i ye shes: da ltar khyed la phul lags 'bar ba'i bzhus pa'i dga' ba stong pa'i drangs ba'i 'od gsal: bcu drug 'bar ba'i yon tan mngon du gyur bar zhu'o: ces zer nas phud de nyid gu ru rin po che la phul: lhag ma rnams bdag gis rol bas bde stong zag pa med pas ye shes nyams su myong ngo: dga' bde tshad med pa 'bar rtogs pa'i gdengs zab mo dang ldan par gyur ro de nas nam mkha'i khams nas 'ja' dkar po them skas lta bu zhig byung ba la bdag zhugs nas phyin pho brang gi steng du phyin pa na de ru rang byung lhun grub kyi gzhal med khang gi nang du longs sku snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs pa la bdag gi dad gus tshad med pa dang ldan pas phyag bskor mang du byas tshe thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po a hrī bam gyi mtshan pa can chad de bdag gi snying gar zim par nyams rtogs 'bar 'gags med longs sku'i sgrub thabs yid yul du legs par gsal

ru bar 'dug go: de nas bltas pas steng gi nam mkhar 'ja' zer sna lnga dang 'od thig mthing gsal zlum la 'khyil ba'i dbus su chos sku kun tu bzang po mthingagasal gcer bu rgyan med yum kun tu bzang mo dkar gsal 'khril sbyor du rol ba ye shes 'od kyi phung po de nyid mthong ba'i tshe na rig stong bsal gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes nyamasasu myong ngo: 'dun pa de ru bzhag pa'i tshe chos sku'i thugs ka nas 'od zer mazing ga 'phros nas rang gi snying gar zim pas tshe rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob rig pa gcer byung gigadams pa yid yul du gsal 'dug kyang re zhig gu h+ya: de nas yang phyir log nas gu ru rin po che'i mdun du sleb ma thag tu bdag gis phyag bskor mang du byas nas gu ru'izhabs spyi bor blangs nas 'di skad gsol to:bka' dren mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon: thugs rje chen pos bdag la dgongs gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur ba dang: smon lamabaden tshig grub pa zhig gnang ba'i bka' drin bdag la stsol: zhes zhus tshe: gu ru'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nas 'di ltar gsol ba thob cig gsung yinam lha rngams brjod

srin po 'tshogs pa'i pho brang nas: 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan thod phreng rtsal: thugs rje'i 'od zer bye ba 'gyed mdzad pa'i: bka' drin mnyam med rje la gsol ba 'debs zhesdang rang sar grol ba'i rdo rjes bzhad: nga rgyal log 'khrul gzhom mdzad rat+na rtsal: 'dod chags rtsad gcod pad+ma chags pa bral: phrag dog drungs 'byin dpal la gsol ba'adebs: gti mug dbyings sgrol bhurnya thod phreng rtsal: tshogs brgyad rnam dag gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad: byin rlabs 'byung gnas bde chen rgyal po'i sku: khyad 'phags rig 'dzinarjes la gsol ba 'debs: gdug pa 'dul mdzad 'od zer mtha' yas sku: phrin las kun 'grub gtum drag rgyal po rtsal: ma rungs 'joms mdzad raku thod phreng rtsal: thugasarje bsam mi khyab la gsol ba 'debs: yul rtog rang grol rig 'dzin rnam pa brgyad: kun rtog rnam dag grub chen brgyad cu dang: ye shes rang gdangs rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga: sprulapa bsam mi khyab la gsol ba 'debs bde stong bskyed mdzad gzungs ma mtsho rgyal dang: lhan skyes ye shes rab spel man+ta ra: sgrub pa'i drod bskyed shel dkar rdo rje mtsho mchog

gyi gi pho nya gsum la las byed dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'khrigs: mchog thun dngos grub rab spel bdud rtsi sman: med byung bka' gsang dkyil 'khor thongs rdzogs la phrin las lhun grub mdzad la gsol skal ldan bu la 'bral med byin rlabs kyang: las can rnal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed: dad pa can rnams mchog gi sa la sbyor: bka' drin mnyam med rje la gsol skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun tu yangs: 'du 'bral med par byin rlabs rjes bzung nas: nyams rtogs yon tan gong nas gong 'phel zhing sku gsum rgyal ba'i btsan sa zin par shog: ces gsol pa phur tshubs su gdab na dbang dang byin rlabs thob par gdon mi za'o: de nas smon lam 'di mang bskyar bzlas byed gal che'o: e ma ho: 'di na lho nub 'tshams shed steng gi char: rnga yab gling zhes za byed srin po'i yul dus gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs mdzad pa yis gling mchog khyad par can la skye bar shog: zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo tsit+ta'i dbyibs rtsa ba klu rgyal 'jog po'i thod du bcings: sked par lus med mkha' 'gro tshogs 'khor

bskor: rtse mo tshangs pa'i yul du bsnyegs 'dra bas: ri rgyal khyad par can der skye bar shog: dpal gyi ri bo 'bar ba'i rtse mo na:shar phyogs shel la lho phyogs be+eḍūr+ya:nub phyogs ra ga byang phyogs in+d+ra nil: phyi nang 'od gsal zhing der skye bar shog gzhal yas chen po phyogs bzhi'i 'tshams brgyad dang:gru char bar 'khyams thams cad rin po che sgo bzhi tshad med phrin las dbyibs dang ldan: lhun grub gzhal yas khang der skye bar shog rtsig pa 'dod snams pha gu drwa ba dang:drwa phyed mda' yab rin chen rgyan rnams rdzogs drel bu g.yer kha snyan pa'i chos sgra sgrogs pho brang khyad par can der skye bar shog: gzhal yas khang dbus rin chen zur brgyad khri: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla zung 'jug steng rgya ba kun dngos o rgyan yab yum bzhugs: bka' drin mnyam med drung du skye bar shog: lo paṇa rgya mtshos chos kyi bsgro gling mdzad ma mo mkha' 'gros mchod pa'i sprin tshogs spro dpa' bo dpa' mos las byed bro gar 'khyug ston 'khor dbyer med zhing der skye bar shog:gru chad glo 'bur rig 'dzin mkha' 'gros gang sgo bzhir rgyal chen sde bzhis bka'

྅ nyan mdzad: zhi rgyas dbang drag pho nya sprin ltar gtibs: dag mnyam dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog: gzhal yas khang steng lhun grub longs sku'i zhing:rnam dag bkod mdzes dri bral bde ba can: rang byung sangs rgyas snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur ma chags bde ldan zhing der skye bar re ga: sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs rig pa 'dzin:ya mtshan bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam rol can: dpag yas 'chi med tshe la mnga' brtes pa: snang ba mtha' yas druja du skye bar re ga: yang thog 'od gsal ye shes lnga ldan klong:'gyur med grwa zur bral ba'i thig le'i dbus: gdod ma'i ye gzhi chos sku kun tu bzang: skye ba med pa'i zhing der skye bar shog zag med 'du ma byas pa'i bya ba mo lhun grub rang gdangs rgyal ba rigs lnga dang 'gags med stong gsal yangs pa'i rang sgra sgrogs: blo bral rig pa'i zhing der skye bar shog shar phyogs ri bo gsal ldan bya ba na zhe ldang rang grol me long ye shes sku: gu ru bde chen rgyal po ston 'khor bcas: dgongs pa dbyer med zhing der skye bar shog:lho phyogs ri bo 'od zer brgya ba phu nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid

ye shes sku: gu ru khyad 'phags rig 'dzin ston 'khor bcas: dgongs pa dbyer med zhing der skye bar shog: nub phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin 'bar ba phu 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog ye shes sku: gu ru 'od zer mtha' yas ston 'khor bcas: dgongs pa dbyer med zhing der skye bar shog byang phyogs ri bo 'big byed bya ba sa phrag dog rnams dag bya grub ye shes sku: gu ru gtum drag rgyal po ston 'khor bcas: dgongs pa dbyer med zhing du skye bar shog: gu ru'i thugs rje 'od zer bye ba phrag: sprul pa rig 'dzin bye ba phrag brgya 'phrul las byed sgrol ma bye phrag sa ya 'byed rnam 'phrul bsam yas zhing der skye bar shog: gdug pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng rtsal brgyad dang mchog gi rig 'dzin rdo rje khro bo lod rmad byung rakru dbu 'bum he ru ga'i gdul bya dang po nyid du skye bar shog mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag sa ya'i: 'gro ba rnams la chos kyi char phab nas: las nyon sgrib pa kun bsal dag pa'i zhing: rmad byung gu ru'i drung du skye bar re ga bdag la bzang ngan las kyi 'brel tshad kun: rnam smin bag chags dri ma rnam dag nas: tshom bu gcig tu

dpal ri pad ma'i drung: 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du skye bar shog: 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa kun: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo bar bgyi gzung 'dzin mdud pa rab grol nas: kun mkhyen ye shes mgon po'i sa thob shog: ces smon lam rnam dag su byed na tshe chos mthar phyin don gnyis lhun gyis grun po gsungs so: de nas gu ru rin po che'i phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub skor nyi shu rtsa lnga gces nor gyi tshul du gnang ngo bdag la zhag bdun gyi snang nyams mched do: da ni 'byon so las ldan mchog gi bu zhes gsungs so: de nas bdag kyang 'bral mi phod pa'i dga' spro phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa yon tan dran pa'i mos gus bka' drin che ba'i mi phyed pa'i yid ches byung nas lus ba spu gzeng: mig mchi ma 'dril: sems skyo shes tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i gu ru rin po che la phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas bu khyod dad pa mos gus dang ldan pas 'du 'bral spu tsam med skabs dang skabs su zhal gzigs lung bstan byed la byin gyis brlab po 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad

pa'i phyir du da gshegs par 'tshal: zhes gsungs so lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtshos rol mo'i sgra bsam byis mi khyab pa bsgrags so: de nas ye shes kyi ḍak+ki dag bdag nyid phyir ldog nas phyin tshe shar phyogs gu ru bde chen rgyal po'i drung du sleb tshe bdag gis phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas gu ru'i zhal nas:kya ho:las ldan khye'u chung lo tsā: bu mchog nus ldan rdo rje: dad mos yon tan ldan pa: khyod la gdams pa zab mo yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i: man ngag ster ro zungs shig: snod ldan kun bzang byung tshe gtan phob legs par sprod dang: 'gro don nyi ltar gsal lo: ma brjed 'dus pa rtsal lags:ces gsungs nas 'od gsal thig le'i rgyud sangs rgyas lag 'chang gi gdams pa gnang ngo de nas yang phyin tshe lto phyogasagu ru khyad 'phags rig 'dzin gyi drung du sleb tshe bdag gis phyag mang du 'tshal la maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i dus su gu ru'i zhal nas:kyiho:mos gus dam tshig ldan pas: rig mchog nus ldan rdo rje: lhun grub yon tan ldan pa gus pa'i snyan mchog gson dang: khyod la yang gsang gdams pa: man ngag snying phyung ster gyi:yid la

rlu bzungs nas gsang rgya: snod ldan rig pa'i ming la: gtan dbon legs par ston dang: snod ldan bcu gsum dag gis: grub 'bras mngon du gyur ro: lasaldan mang por phan thog: ces gsungs nas nyid kyi sgrub thabs dbang lung man ngag bcas gnang byung ngo: de nas yang phyin tshe nub phyogs gu ru 'od zer mtha' yas kyi drung du slebatshe bdag gi phyag dang maṇ+ḍal yid sprul gyis mchod pa phul skabs gu ru'i zhal nas:kyi—1 btsar+sha 'grus mese gus che ba: yon tan blo gros zab mo: grub mchog nus ldan 'dusartsal dad mos drag po'i gson dang: snying gi yang bcud zab mo: gdams pa thugs kyi thig le khyod la gtad do zungs shig da dung spel ba'i dus min: rig bzang mang ga'imatshan la: sbyin dang grub 'bras mngon gyur: skal bzang mang por phan thog: ces gsungs nas nyid kyi sgrub thabs dbang lung man ngag bcas gnang byung ngo: de nas yang phyin tshebyang gu ru gtum drag rgyal po drung du sleb tshe phyag dang bskor ba maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po phul dus gu ru' zhal nas kyisto dad brtsa ba gsal mos ldan: mchog gi rig 'dzin dam pa

dpa' bo nus ldan 'dus rtsal legs par gson la bzhugs dang yang gsang man ngag zab mo:snying dang 'dra ba'i chos skor: rig pa'i klong du sbrum la: da lta spel ba'i dusamin slob bu pha la'i ming can:byung tshe gtod la nges med: sgrub tshig zin na grub 'bras:mngon gyur the tshom med do:ces gsungs nas rtsa rlung bde stong rang 'bar:'khrula'akhor gar gyi rnam 'gyur:rdzogs chen rig pa rang shar:spyod pa bog 'don zab mo rnams bdag la bka' khrid man ngag bcas gnang byung ngo:'di dus phyogs bcu nas rol mosna tshogs kyi sgra grags song ngo: de nas ye shes kyi ḍak+ki dang bdag gnyis phyir sdog nas 'ong ba'i skabs su srin yul brgal 'tshams su 'ja' 'od thig le brgyan pa'i brag ba gamamatho la 'jam pa'i rtse ngos su drang sgong bcu gsum bzhugs pa mthong tshe bdag gi zhus pa 'di rnams su yin ci mdzad pa red ye shes kyi ḍāk+ki lags zhus tshe lan gsungs pa:a ho rig mchog nus ldan rdo rje legs par bdag la gson dang:khyed ni las 'phro phun tshogs:yon tan dus la bab pas dag snang bsam mi khyab pa shar ba ngo mtshar che

rdu: lags:phyi ltar rig 'dzin rgya mtsho:nang ltar drang srong bkod pa gsang ba byang sems rol ba rnam par shar ba yin no:drang sgong 'od zer go cha:drang sgong bde ba'i dbang phyug:drang sgong 'dzin pa rang grol:drang sgong nyi ma'i snying po:drang srong stong chen mtha' yas drang sgong blo gros bzang po:drang sgong 'jam dpal gzhen nu drang sgongapad+ma dri med drang sgong mun sel mdog nag:drang sgong mthu dpal stobs 'bar drang srong gser 'dabs yan pa:drang srong lag na rdo rje:drang sgong 'khor lo chen po:'gro don brtul zhugs mdzad nas bzhugs pa yin no e ma:ces gsungs dreg:de dag la bdag gis glu dbyangs snyan pa'i tshig gis:e ma:thugs rje ldan pa'i drang dre nga khyed cag bdag la gson dang:bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad na:'jig rten phan bde spel ba'i:tshig nyung don chen 'dus pa'i:man ngag gsung bar zhu legs:zhes zhus tshe de dag gis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsungs so a ho:rigs mchog yid bzhin nor bu tshur gson bdag gi ngag la cung zad snyoms la nyon lags:'dir snang 'khor ba'i chos la:
