zhen 'dzin drungs nas 'byin dgos: 'gro khams pha ma'i tshogs la byams brtse'i rjes bzung gal che: nyon mongs g.yo 'khrugs mang po: zhen med rang sar gcod dgos: sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad dus gzhan la 'dom snga ma byed zab gter klong rgya grol skabs: sgod min lag tu ma shor: gzhan phan don gnyer brtul zhugs: byang sems yin na gal che: gang snang dag pa'i rang bzhin skyon mtshangs log lta ma byed: gang shar ye shes rol pa: stsol grub spang blang mi 'tshal ma rig rgol ba byung yang: snying rjes rang sar grol dgos: 'khor 'das rig pa rjen par: rtogs nas sangs rgyas 'grub ya ces gsungs so: skabs 'dir dris len shel dkar phreng ba rin po che'i do shal zhes bya ba yod kyang slob bu'i bhud+dha'i ming can byung tshe bkrol dgos de bar gu h+ya de nas phar o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba la gzigs pa'i tshe rgya mtsho bar khyams su mdangs ldan dri med dha na ko ṣa'i dwangs mtsho bsil ba 'jams pa zhim pa sogs yan lag brgyad ldan dri bsung sna tshogs 'thul kha khyer che la dpang rngams mtho ba de yi dbus su o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i bla shing rin

rlu po che'i spud pa gser gyi dril gser las stong nyid chos kyi rang sgra sgrogs pa:de ru 'ja' zer sna tshogs pa'i drwa ba mig mang ris su bkra ba:mkha' 'gro nyi rdula'akhrigs lta bu'i bro gar byed cing gsang ba'i brda skad e a ra li sa ma yā hrīng hrīng dz+nyā na phe sogs brjod nas bzhugs pa mthong ngo:de nas yang phyin tshe byang phyogs sidhi ya na'i grongakhyer bde dga' bsam mi khyab pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i de ru mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bde stong spros mtha' dang bral ba'i don spyod nas bzhugs so:de dag gi nanganas mkha' 'gro shin tu mdzes ma zhig na re:nir+sha re mi med mkha' 'groligling na:bde skyid ngo mtshar che'o dga' stong nyams la spyod nas bza' btung re ba mi dgos:sdugabasngang ming tsam ma mchis:skyid pa nged tsho'i 'tshogs gral chos brgyad 'du 'dzi'i dben cing:nyams rtogs yon tan 'bar yang:bde drod gtum mo'i sbar ba'i:gos kyi sred pachod songs:thabs mchog dpa' bo khyod la re ba'i 'dun ma shor song:bde stong bdud rtsi'i ster bas:sku drin mchis sam ma mchis grub mchog nus ldan rdo rje:thugs la

'jogs par zhu 'tshal: zhes zhus zer: de'i lan du bdag gis smras pa a ho nga dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje'i: gnas bde chen 'khor lo'i drung na: thabs 'gyur med thig le bzhugs yod: khyod spyod 'dod yod na mkha' 'gro: don dga' bzhi'i ye shes ster sla: bcud 'jog snod yod dam a red brjod las 'das 'od gsal bcu drug: dpa' bzodapa'i go cha yod dam: rtsa bde chen longs spyod sprul 'khor haṃ sbar ba'i gtum mo bzhugs yod bkrag thub pa'i yon tan yod la: 'bar rdo rje rgyas pa'i yon tan bcud rol pa'i ḍak+ki su kha'i: rtsa yan lag brgyad ldan yod dam: dad mos ldan mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho: tshig thugs la 'jog pa'i bka' drin stsol: zhes smras tshe de na re a haṃ ye: nged mimin mkha' 'gro tshogs kyi: lha khyed la mos gus bzhag na: thabs bde stong 'gyur med bdud rtsi: gnas chog tshe spyod 'dod e ma don dga' ba bzhi yi ye shes: dpal gnang thob bral ba'i stsol na: bcud gtam snod 'od gsal bum yod: dpal bcu drug phyed phyed thig le: lus rtsa khams dpa' bo dpa' mo mchod gyur na 'od gsal rab 'bar: de dga'

gyi spro'i shugs kyi bzod spyod: rtsa sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i drung na: me gtum mo nged la yod kyis: nya dpa' bo khyed la bzhugs na: deng bzhu btul byas na bkrag 'bar: dpal 'gyur med rang byung rdo rje: bcud len pa pad+ma'i snod bzang: 'gugs lcags kyu'i ḍāk+ki su kha'i: rtsa mtshan nyid bzhi ldan yod do: 'di lto sbyor byed na spro lags khyed thugs la de ltar 'jog 'tshal ces gsung tshe bdag rta mchog rol ba'i lha ru gsal ba dang mkha' gsang rdo rje ru gsal thabs de la brten nas bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du byed pas 'dun pa gsum bzhag pa dang: mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo ru gsal ba dang mkha' gsang pad+ma 'bar ba dang thabs mchog de la brten nas bde stong spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes mngon du byed pas 'dun pa gsum bzhag pa'i sa ma mā ho: ces bskul sa ma yā tswa zhes lan sbyin a nu ra lha nya: zhes chags pa chen pos bskul: a nu ra ga ya mye: zhes chags pa chen pos rgyas gdab: dza hūṃ baṃ ho zhes phyag rgya bzhi bsnol: bho rnyi tsit+ta spa ra ṇa phaṭa: ces bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du mkha' khyab tu spel la don

gnyis byas: bho rnyi tsit+ta saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ:ces rol pa chen po'i bde stong dga' ba bcu yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab 'char nas ḍak+ki'i tshogs rnams dgyes pa bskang ngo: de'i skabs susbyor sgrol gsang ba'i gnas mchog zhus len yod kyang re zhig la gu h+ya de nas tshur 'ong dus rgya gar gyi yul du thon skabs sha za mkha' 'gro mang po'i 'du tshogs byed nas gzhon nu mang po bsad nas tshogs 'khor byed kyin 'dug: bdag gi de dag la smras pa a ho skye 'gro sems can rnams kun pha ma'i rang bzhin yin na: gsod gcod byed pa sha tsha snying rje med pa ga chad: phyin chad de ltar ma byed: sems la zungs shig ḍāk+ki: zhes smras tshe de dag gi mgrin gcig tu dhi bam ye: sems can spyod pa rtsub mo srin po las ga kho na sdig la khol mo yug spyod: sna tshogs legs nyes gsal ba'i: bka' chad bstan pa tsam du: sgrol ba'i las ka byas ya: smra ru mang po 'dug pa'i: khye'u chung ba khyod gson dang zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo: sku dgra rnam lngar gyur pa: nyams pa bdun ldan sde tshan: bsgral ba dam tshig min nam nged cag spyod pa rtsub kyang: bsam pa dam tshig dag go: 'di

྅ bas dkor la g.yeng na: nyes sgrib tshad med mchis so: 'jig rten chos brgyad spyod dang: sdug bsngal mang yo theb ya:ces zer ba la bdag gis lan smras pa:a re:sha za 'dre mo'i sde tshogs: khyod yi sha la za shing: rang rgyud byis srog gcod na: de yang dam tshig red dam: dal med gzhan srog gcod la 'ur rgyug sna tshogs byed nas:spyod pa rtsub mo byed pa: dam tshig dag pa red dam: zhes smras tshe dus su lan du 'di skad gyer:rnyi ra he smra mkhas nus ldan rdo rje: pha ma sha la rol na: khyod yi sha dang 'dra mtshungs: thar ba'i lam sgog gcod na: ngar 'dzin dam tshig red dam: dam med dkor kha grong chog: nyes pa shin tu lci yang: spyod pa nyon mongs mang na: sngags kyi dam tshig yinanam: zhes zar ro: de dus ye shes kyi ḍak+ki ma des smras pa:ka ṭaṃ hi ra we bu med sha za'i sde tshogs: mgo 'phang rab tu ma mtho: deng sang snyigs ma'i dus su: khyod cag dam tshig gnad la:cung zad ral nas yod do: nged cag dbyings na bzhugs kyang bka' chad thog ltar 'bebs so: khyod dang bu phrug mdza' bshes: kun la 'tshe bar ma byed ban

btsun sngags skyes yongs dang: mi skya pho mo thams cad: byams dang brtse ba'i skyongs dgos: dam tshig gnad la ma 'da' byi rol kla klo mang po: rgya dang bon nag tshogs rnams khyed cag rnams la gtad do:bsgral ba'i dngas ma mchis na: rdo rjer phag mor phul dgos sa ma yu las ma 'da':ces gsungs tshe sha za'i tshogs kyi e ma ho sa ma ya na ragaṇa:zer nas khas blangs mna' bor ro:bdag la yang thams cad kun gyis bzod par gsol lo zer nas phyag bskor mang du byas la 'dud pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po mdzad byungango:yang phyin nas rgya gar rtse phrug sgong zhes bya ba na byis pa lo bcu drug lon pa zhig phyi rol pa'i chos la skyo ba skyes nas skyabs 'gro'i bzlas pa byas nas stod pa'i rmi lam ngor nganyid sngon gyi bla mar gyur pa'i rten 'brel yod pa ngo sprod 'di ltar byas so:a nyong ngo khyed kyis shes sam ci:khyod ni tshogs smon las 'phro ldan:dge btsun bsam 'grub skye b.rashes:dad gus mos pa'i tshur gson dang:'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kun:gzhi med rtsa bral stong pa nyid smra bsam brjod pa kun dang bral:snang ba'i chos rnams stong

43 pa ste:rtog pa'i btags tsam gzhal na mthong phung khams skye mched dgag gzhi dben:'khrul ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin stong:med la yod snang mig yor bzhin mdor na gzung dang 'dzin pa kun brdal khyab de bzhin nyid du blta sngar 'das rtog pa'i rjes mi gcod:ma 'ongs ba yi mdun mi bsu:da lta'i rtog pa rkyen dang bral:shes rigartse mo byung rgyal nyid:mngon byung rjen ne lhug par bzhag:'khrul rjes mi 'brang sangs nger gnas:'dzin pa'i mi bsre 1da de brdal:mnyam rjes kun tu rtsol med skyongs rjes thob spyod pa bog 'don bslab:byams dang snying rje byang sems bsgom:dran dang shes bzhin bag yod gzab 'dir snang mchil ma'i thal bzhin bor:'khor ba'i bya 'phro phyam bzhag brdal:mi rtag 'chi ba yangs med bsgoms nges 'byung dag snang mos gus bskyed:mi med dben par skrub tshug zungs na tshod dar dus nga phyogs sgo ga:de bar lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad:g.yel med brtson pa'i nyams su longs:ma brjed snying gi nor bu legs:zhes brjod tshe ngo 'phrod pa'i rtags byung ngo:de nas mar 'ong dus las ldan bu gsum

po ye shes kyi ḍāk+ki'i lung bstan gnang ba thob nas legs par go byung: de nas yang phyin tshe rgya gar gyi gnas mchog bco brgyad legs pa'i tshul du mthong ngo: yang bal yul du sleb tshe sgrub gnas yang le re da kyi brag phug la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bro gar 'khrab pa zhig mthong byung sngags kyi las 'phro zhig kyang sad do: de nas yar lung shel gyi brag la sleb tshe sman srung mkha' 'gro mched lnga'i bdud rtsi phul byung yer ba zla ba phug sogs dag pa'i snang tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa shar ro de na brag dmar gangs seng gnam la 'phyong pa lta bu'i rtsar sleb tshe ḍāk+ki de nyid kyi se gol brag la theb skas sgo shags kyi phye bar gyur to: de nang rab 'jigs drag po'i dur khrod du 'dug: khyung dmar me'i gshog ldan zhon pa zhig byung nas shan dmar sgog len gyis rgyud dang: sha za 'dre 'dul gyi man ngag gsum bcas sbyin no: de nas mar rang yul du thon skabs ye shes kyi ḍak+ki ma de yis: e ma 'khor 'das gzhi med rtsa bral: ye stong nam mkha'i rol pa: spros bral blo 'das lta ba: rtog pa'i bkra shis e ma: lhun grub gsal sangs rjen pa: sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan: phyam brdal

gyi ro gcig sgom pa: gdengs thob bkra shis a ho: byams dang snying rje chen po: 'gro don rgya chen 'grub cing: rnam rgyal spyod pa zab mo: mthar phyin bkra shis a ye: lha gcig pad+ma'i pha nor dag snang dgongs mdzod sa gter: bstan pa'i gsos su gyur nas: phrin las 'grub pa'i bkra shis: gang snang dag par shar cing: brda tshig lung byang rtogs nas: bskal bzang slob ma thams cad: bya btang brtul zhugs 'grub re ga: bstan pa'i sgron me sbar cing 'bum phrag smin cing grol nas: rnga yab dpal gyi ri la grol ba'i rten 'brel zhu legs: ces zer nas yar gshegs la sku shin tu chung ba tshon gang tsam par gyur tshe 'di skad gsungs so: ha ha 'di snang sgyu ma'i yul la: bltas na gad mo bro byung: med la yod par bzung ba: shin tu 'khrul 'phyan ha ha: sna tshogs 'gro ba'i yul la: bltas na bzhad mo shor byung: ngar 'dzin rang gar spyod nas nyon mongs 'dam 'phyangs ha ha chos byed rnams la bltas nas: 'dir snang zhen pa'i bzhad spro: gzung 'dzin mdud pa ma grol bya bzhag mang po ha ha bsgom can rnams la bltas na: a 'thas

'jug sgom gad pro: rtag chad mtha' dang bral ba'i sgom mkhan dkon no ha ha: thos can nga rgyal chen po bsgom mkhan gti mug 'thib pa: bya btang 'jur sgegs bltas pa rnal 'byor 'du 'dzi mang po: bla chen chos brgyad g.yeng bas: ban btsun dkor la g.yeng ba: sngags pa ro bshar nyul ba: chos byed sgong 'dod chen po de dag mthon na ha ha 'di 'dra ma mdzad rem lags ces zer nas yal te stong pa'i dbyings la sgra 'di ltar grags so: gzugs sgra dri ro reg stong: sku dang ye shes phyam brdal dga' bde bsam mi khyab pa'i: a ti med byung rtse mo bsgom pa'i rten 'brel zhu legs: ces grags so: de nasamanal sad pa na nam langs bya byis kyi skad 'byin no: bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams yang rab tu 'bar 'dug go: dag pa'i snang nyams rin po che'i mdzod khang lta bu41: zhes pa 'di yang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'apel rgya mcho chos kyi bdag po dharma kairte chosakyi bdag po 'gyur med rgya mtsho las ldan gyi gzu ma rat+na sa ra rnams la zhal 'babs kyi tshul du dag snang yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu 'di nyid phab nas sbyin pa yin no las ldan skal ba bzang po can rnams kyisadad rten bzhengs

rnu shing gsung mchog bri ba sogs tshogs gnyisakyi bshags sbyangs mthar phyin nas zangs mdog dpal rgya ri bor phyin pa dang de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs kun tu 'phral rkyen ngan pa'i dbang du mi 'gro zhing tshe dang chos kyiphrin las mthar phyin nas don gnyis lhun gyisagrub pa dang zab chos 'di nyid gang du dar ba'i yul thams cad la char chu dusasu 'beb lo phyug rtag tu legs mi nad phyug nad kyi rgyun chad bkra shis rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho la spyodacing dam pa'i chos kyi snang bas sa gsum khyab pas rten 'brel gyi che ba de tsam smon no a ho dag snang bsam mi khyab pa'i bkod tshul rnams chags sred 'dod pa'i yul du shar ba min dad pa posagus tshogasabasags ldan pa yis 'bras bu rnam par dag pa' yon tan no nga rgyal log sred can gyi skyon du mthong thos nyung zob rdzun can tshos chos la sgro bskur btags ra rur 'og cor can gyi rdzun re smad ma mthong logs rtogs can dag the tshom 'byung blo mang zogapo rnams ni de rjes 'brang 'khrul snang gdams pa'i gegs su gyur pa yi srog gi dbang po lha dang bsrung mas bsnubs las ldan dad can pho mo thams cad kya 'dun pa'i zhing khams ngo mtshar dag pa'i rten rmad byung tshogs bsagasazhi sa bzang po bkod spel sbyangs gnad la rem cag phyi rabs rnams bdag 'dra kun nyi' mnog chos ba mo'o su ma mgu yang ban sprang zhe blo bde dge bas 'brel ba thob pa'i skye 'gro kun 'di snang sgyu 'phrul dbyings su zhig ma
gyi zhing bkod mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gsang mdzod lasaḥ gdul bya'i mos bskul pad+ma dbang gi lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

gyi na mo dz+nya na dhak+ki ni yaḥ tho/byo/spros mtsho byung sangs rgyas gnyis pa dngaX grub pa'i khyu mchog gnub ston rje dgyes pa mchog bskyed rnal 'byor ma sgyu 'phrul 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro 'dudaX e ma hoḥ dus gang gi tshe o rgyan dhu ma tha la'i dga' stonaḥ o ṭi ya na'i hi ma la'i dus kyi tshogs sprinaX phyi dngos po dag pa nang 'dzin rtog grol ba gsang ba 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i ltad moḥ dbyings rig gnyis med kyi khri gdugs brdal zhingaX 'od gsal dga' bzhi'i sprin char spro dbusaḥ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i rnyak+ki'i gsang gsum gsum bde ba chen po'i chos ston la rol zhing rig 'dzin pan grub rgya mtsho'i bshad sgrubs mdzad gralaḥ bde stong tshims pa drug gi zlos gar la rol zhingaḥ mchog ldan chos kyi rgyal srid rang shar rang grol du skyongs tshe rje dus gsum mkhyen pa slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po'i zhal snga nasaḥ e ma ho ngo mtshar bdud 'joms dpa' bo'i sprul pa cha shas tsam yin par bsngags nas dbu yis gtug shing mthun rkyen gyi gnang sbyin brtsalaX 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mi pham rnam par rgyal bas yum gyi dku na

snyi gnas dus gsang gsum rdo rje'i byin rlabs brtsal tshul 'ji nyung nirma ka sogs nas gsang bkrol ba dang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor tshe sgrub mthar phyin ma hā'imatshan can gyis yig ge dang sbyangs ba'i yon tan cung zad re'i bka' drin brtsalaX rgyal ba'i dbang po kun mkhyen chen po dngos snang mtshan brjod par dka' ba dri med 'od zeragyis lugs gnyis bya ba gang thad nas sku drin chen po'i brkyangs shing sbas don rang byung ye shes ngo sprod cing yab rje'i sku yi gsang ba 'dzin par yang yang bsngagasaḥ rdo rje bduda'ajoms mi yi zol 'dzin nyag gi rigs 'khrung las rabs gleng pas bka' lung dbang khrid mang po'i smin par byas shingaX gnas dus rten 'brel gyis sa yi gter la spyod pa'iskabs min pa 'dra gsung ba byungaḥ sngon dbang las kyi 'brel ba mthu btsan pas phyag rgya rat+na'i ming can dang 'phrad nas mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i grogs su bsnyen mtsho rgyal dngosasnang dbus phyogs nas pheb pa'i mkha' 'gro su kha badz+ra gyis rjes su bzung zhing rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dgyes pa'i 'dzum gyi ke sar las 'phos pa yin par gsung gis gnang

rgyal sras lha rje mchog rabs rtsal bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam par byon nas brtse bas rjes su bzung smin grol gyi bka' drin gnangaḥ rang re gnyis kyis mkha' 'gro dgongasa'adus gdan drang rgyu dus la bab e yong bsnyams pas sems la nan bzhag gyis gsung yang bka' drin can de'i gzugs sku dpal ri la bsdus song nas kho bo skyabs medabashes bral du lus kyang gsung gi bdud rtsi snying la nan du bcug re 'ga' nyams kyi snang char gter ston gra ba mngon shes can yin zer bas dbu sgra lan tshar bcu gsum gnanganas 'di dag snang gi skor gcu gsum yin pas phab rmad kyis chosaḥ sems can sangs rgyas snying po canaX ye nas dag mnyam rgyal ba'i zhing nyid las gzhan pa'i rang mtshan pa btsal kyang rnyed par 'gyur min gsungaX e bo ma yaḥ zhes dbugs dbyung nas phyi sku gdung rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gtad rgya mdzad: grub pa'i khyu mchog gter chenasnga ma nyi rtsa lnga'i byin rlabs kyi zeg ma reg: nang gu ru gangs chen mtsho'i sku lus kyi bkod pa bstan nas gtad rgya mdzadaX sbas pa'i rgya bkrol mchog ster nyi shu rtsa lnga'i byin rlabs

gyi kyi drod rtags 'phosaḥ gsang ba mkhar chen grub pa'i rgyal mo'i gsang ba gsum gyi bkod pa ya mtshan pa bstan nas gtad rgya mdzad smon lam 'phro btsan zab gter gyi phrin las can nyi shu rtsa lnga'i byin rlabs kyi chu bo babaX yang gsang mnyam sbyor mkha' yi brda' sbyor a li ka li la brten nas gtad rgya mdzadaḥ dus bab chos kyi rgyal po sprul pa'i gter 'chang nyer lnga'i byin rlabs kyi drod tshad reg pa'i mod laX dz+nyā na dhaka dhaka'i glu dbyangs me tog char spro zhing mngon brjod rtags kyi bstod pa dang bcas nas gangs ljong bod khams skyongs ba'i ded dpon du spros soḥ de yang mdo khams lcags mo'i rus rigs 'chang zhing rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i sku rab gsum pa 'jigs med gzhan phan gang gi rigs kyi myu gur lho nang chen gyi yul grur shing pho 'brug gi zla 11tshes 17dge bar dku nas bltams tshe 'ja' dang 'od kyi gur phub sa g.yo zhing sgra ldir ba sogs la yul mi'i bsngags brjod 'khrol tshul ma dang slob ma cha shas nas brjod pa byungaḥ de rjes na tshod phra mo'i dus pha shi mas bsgyur gzhan gyi khol bor gyur ba'i skabs bde sdug

gsar ba'i gshis nyams kyis gzir ba yid skyo'i gnas su mngon pa gong ma'i rnam thar phyogs mtshungs tsam du 'byung chung ngu'i dus nas nyams dang rmi lam lung bstan pa sogs smras na ngal ba'i rgyu tsam du 'dug kyang zol chos tsam mo0 rdza 'tshams sprul rin po che nas dgos kho bo'i phrin las kyi mjug yin gsung de dang mthun par dpal ri dang po ṭa la g.yu lo bkod gsum gyi snang tshul ban bon yig gzugs su bkod gzhan yang mjug ma gsum gyi gter la dbang zhes dhak+ki'i lung las byung ba ltar bdud 'dul mched gsum gyi ye shes sgyu ma'i sku rmi snang tsam re'i bka' gnang ltar zab chos phan bu re gsal bar byas sngar byon bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho las pad+ma rtsal rdzogs nyid sangs rgyas gnyisapa pad+ma badz+ra gyi phyag rgyar bzhengs nas bdag chos blon zla ba gzhon nu la bka' drin nod pa bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi skor rnams rdo stod rdo snying mthon po'i nye 'dabs kyi chos dgon nas gsal bar byas yang ma mo mkha' 'gror tshogs 'bum gyi brngan pa phul rjes nyams kyi snang bar kho bo ging chen po bzhi'i dar gyi 'od ler bkod nas yul gling mang por

rlu bsgrod mthar mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa yin zhes bya ba'i bum lter mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang chen yin skad pa'i mdun sar 'khod skabasaḥ gnyis susnang zhing dug lnga rgyas pa'i rū tra 'di 'od zer nas dpa' bo bzhi'i bam chen po 'jigs rung rngams pa drangs phyung ba mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gtso mo de yis nyon mongs rgyun gcod kyigri gug gi so ngar la drangs nas rnam shes dbyings su spar tsit+ta che mchog mkhris pa yang dag mchin pa gshin rje glo ba dbang chen stsa chen phur pa mtsher khrag ma mo bhan klad riga'adzin mkhal ma zungs mchod bstod drags sngags rtsa rgyus rus tshig gser dang khrag 'khyams la bzhugs pa'i bka' sdodaX rtsib ma rtswang dra mgo sgra gtor gdug ba su ta gtorathags mig dang rnab sna lce yis gtor rgyan byas nas skad cig gis nam mkha' la gza' skar bkra ba'am sa gzhi dra gu 'khrungs ba ltar dpal chen sgrub sde dgu yi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal bar bkod de gtad rgya mdzad nas dbang skur gsung gnang man ngag brtsal la 'od gsal rdo rje'i rol ngor 'byams su klas so tshul deltar

du bder 'dus bkod rdzogs rgyal po bstan 'gro'i dpal du snang bar byas soḥ nyams kyi 'khrugs slong dang po'i rgol ba byung dus dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa'i gu ru rta khyung drag po rtsal gyi gzhom pa dngaX bar gyi 'jubs ma tshe bdag drag 'joms bdud 'dul drag mo mched gsum gyi mthu kho nas dngaḥ nyams dang rtogs pa'i bog 'don bla sgrub skor gsum dang snyan brgyud skor gsum gyis byin rlabs las dngaX dus phyi'i regs sngags byad ma'i dmod mthu dang mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor ngan sngags kyi dpal rdo rje gtsug tor dang khyung nag thogs rgod 'bar ba'i bden pa'i stobs la brten nas zhi bar byas soX nad rims kyi rgol ba byung tshe zab chos dri med klo yangs las drag po me yi phre nga bas zer ngar gyis bsregs pa dang: khyad par snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rgya mtsho kha lhud be+eḍūr+ya'i tshon rtsis bsgyur ba na gnas dang gnas phran mang por sgrub pa'i gzhi bzubhe ཿ nag po skor bdun dang dgra bla'i dbang phyugs kyi mtshon ngar brdar: lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las kho na la sems 'dun dril skabs skyabs rjes nges don pad+ma brin las zhabs kyis dus kyi ru

dru 'dzing chen po 'dir gter brgya'i byin rlabs 'byor ba'i rig 'dzin gter gzhed snying po yin par bsngags nas dbang chen sprel lo'i sprel zla'i tshes bcu latshogs 'bum brngan pa rgya cher 'bul nges pasaḥ myur bar gdan drangs nas gtad la phab dgos gsung kyang rngo thog ma byungaḥ lo de'i 'byug zla'i nyer lngar la thugs sgrub yang snyinga'adus pa dang tshe sgrub pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshogs sgrub dang dga' ston 'byor tshod re spel tshe nam mkha'i dbyings nas rnga gling rol mo'i sgra sbir zhing dbang gi 'ja' khyims pad+ma'idrwa gur bkram klong nas gsang ba ye shes yin zer ba'i mkha' 'gro dmar mo rus rgyan dar chas can zhig gis mthing gi me long la gser gyi brda' yig 'bru bdun bkod nasabasngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor bzhin du bka' yi gnang ba byung kyang sbas rgyas btab po rigs sras shes rab thogs med dang bla ma blo tis gnyis kyi gsang bkrol kyang bdagagi brda' thim du bzhugs yang re 'ga' byang brag dkar spre'u rdzong nas yin zer ba'i mkha' 'gro dmar mo gzungs kyi thag pa'i rgyud las byon nas mdzub mo'i brda' yi gter ngo

sprad pa sku rten gsang ba ye shesaḥ gsung rten po ti dgu 'ja' 'khyugs 'khyugs zer lam lam dngaḥthugs rten phur pa khru gang ba dang mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi sgog tig yid bzhinajor bu rnams gter ngo sprad kyang thabs dang rten 'brel rdzas yo byad mang po zhig 'byung dgos pas rgan pa'i 'ur mgo gshogs na 'gyel brdab chen po 'byung snyams nas sbas rgyasabatab skabs grub sprul rig pa'i rdo rje 'jigs med brtan pa'i rgya mtshan dngos byon dam pa de dngaḥ 'bangs sku skyes lnga dgra bla'i rgyal po'i sku rten pa rnams kyis lung bstanadabugs dbyung gzeng bstod mdzad nas bskul ba'i tsheḥ kho bo' snang ba brda' ru shar ba tsam las khra mo thub pa mi 'byung bas snyoms las su gzhag yod zhu ba phulaX de dag ni kunartog sems kyi rbun pa tsam ste snang ba brda' dper shar ba de las gtan la dbab dgos gsung nan bzlog la spob par yang zab nyi zla'i sgom bu de bkrol nas rang gi sgrub panyams len byas soḥ de rjes zab chos 'dis sna sel dang phrin las 'byung ba'i slad du mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod gtan phab yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung tshogs ston mchod pa bro

gyi gar glu sogs nyams dga' dang spro'i mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i thabs mang la brtson par byas so 'di skabs dbangachen gsung gi bka' bab dam pa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bla ma blo gros nas khyod kyis bgo skal du gyur ba'i mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus thugs kyi mthil na bzhugs pa de bstan 'gro'i slad du gtan la phob dang 'gro don cheḥrte na 'brel gyi mthu btsan rgol ba 'jomasaḥ ru 'dzing thubaḥ sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las rgyas par 'gyur nges pasaḥ sa gter la re ba'i gdos sems mi dgos gsung nas snag gog gi mthun rkyen dang yi ge phyi mo ba bcas 'byor byung ba'i bka' drin chen po'i dge mtshan dngaX gzhan yang dngos grub kyi rdzas bhan+ta'i bcud ko ro tsa na 'dra bar gyur pa dngaḥgator ma dang sras phur da la yo byad la 'od zer 'khrungs baX me longs la zil ba khrom khrom du brda' yig rnam pa brgyad du shar ba rnams kyi rten 'brel ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs na nga yang nyams kyi snang bar zhung zhung gi bud med mched lnga byung sgra yi mdud pa rdo rjer bcing nas pad+ma'i thod gdeng mdzes shing shing lo'i smad shams dang pad phreng spras pas mgrin

phuX he he: zhung zhung ghas la nas wi he he ru ru ka ka dzoḥ na rmo nam gu ru yaX dh+wan rnyak+ki gu h+ya dz+nyaḥ phe po na mo bha tra yaX sa ma yo ki ti tha moḥ bhi mo ga ṇa tsakra sproX ko nga tsa na gha gha sur+ya'i ga'ur zungasaḥ gharnyo la nas spra raḥ zhes zer nas bskor ba byas la mkha' dbyings su yal lo: yang ma la ya nas yin zer bas sha za lnga'i zhal nas he ra:byen 'dra ba'i gter kha zhing seng ge'i gdod 'od rin chen lu gu rgyudaḥ sur+ya'i dpal nod dam pa mang zhig dgyes nag klong dug gi ngad pa bsdu nas 'gro nga tsho ma mo / re 'dun skong dus kyi ru 'dzing 'joms pa'i tho lum yin zhes sogs sgra mang don gcig glu yis bskul tshe zab mo'i chos gter mgo brtsam tsa na phyag rgya'i tsit+ta rlon mnyes rdzas yin zhes phul ba dngaḥ se ra 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i sku gang gi rin po che byu ru mkha' 'gro'i bla rdo che brjed mdzes pa sprengs nas 'byor ba sogs kyi / bzang po'i mtshams sbar nas legs par ba 'a las basbyar skabs phyi'i nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi drwa gur ngo mtshar ba yun ring bo'i bar du bkrams dri bsung spos

gyi ngad ldang ba dwangs spros gnas su mngonaḥ mtshar mor bshud glu thod rnga ting ting shag dril chung g.yel phreng rnga dug rgyud ming rba gling sogs snyan pa'i sgra dus ring mor shar ba byung ste las dag cha shas kyi spyod yul tsam mo ༷ yang kha ro ta nas yin skad pa'i a tsar mi gnyes kyi smrar mi shes pas brda' tshig mang pos bskul ba dngaX 'jigs rngams nas yin par skad pas lce spyang bcu drug cho cho zung zung ldag ldag dus la bab dam tshig yinaḥ zhes 'dra min gyi bskul brda' mang po byung ba dang bdag dang gter slob gzung ma gsum gyi ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su mthongaḥ zhag bdun phrag tsam 'das rjes bka' srung btsan rgod chen po'i bskul ma byung tshe gzi mdangs dpa' brjed bzod sran dka' ba byungaḥya re 'ga' nyams kyi snang char drang sgong chen po gnas 'jog bya ba dngaḥ dhak+ki dmar mo skra 'khrol ma gnyis kyis rol pa'i gar bsgyur zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi mang po zhig gnang mthar e ma hoX sku rgyud nyi zla kha sbyoraḥ gsung rgyud pad+ma 'bum brtsegs thugs rgyud zla gam klong dgu yon tan rgyud nor bu sbungs ba brin las rgyud mkha' 'gro dhu ma rnams

kyis tshom bu 'bum 'bum bcas mkha' spyod la pheb 'groḥ a la la hoḥ zhes zer nas yal ma ཿ yang 'od gsal nyams kyi snang char gnub ston grub pa'i khyu mchog spug nag sngags kyi chas gos can gyisaḥ e ma hoX snang srid lha dang lha mo'i dbyingasaḥ 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum dalaḥ khams drug dwangs ma sngags kyi rtenaX lus gnas lus la ma skyes paḥ ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs can 'di thabs shes nges pa'i rgyud don yin ༷ la la na dwa dhu ti'i khams 'khor lo lnga dang khams kyi chos snang dang mi snang phyed snang ba kun rdzob rgyu yi sbas don yin0 'bar dang 'dzag pa las byung ba'i dbab bskyil 'dren dgram dam tshig gis yas dbab thabs dang mas brtan niḥ 'dod chags chos kyi sbas don yin sems lnga'i drangs ba'i 'od gsal niḥ bde ba chen po'i ye shes deḥ ga ga sems shin tu phra ba'i gsangaX snang ba sems kyi sbas don yin ches phra'i ye shes bum sku'i tshulaḥ 'od dang yi ge sku yi tshad mdor na narma mkha'i mthar mnyam paX stong nyid rtags kyi sbas don zhesaḥ thams cad dag dang mnyam par rtsa ma lus ngo bo nyid du sgrubs zhes

྅ sogs rgyud kyi gsang ba bsgrags pa dngaX yang mdor bstan pa niX lung a nu yo ga mdo ltar du bshad paḥ lung gis 'byedaḥ tshig gis bkrolaX sa lam gyis 'gros bstan pa yinaḥ mdo rgyud ltar du bshad pa thag lta bas bcadaḥ la spyod pas doraḥ man ngag gi rgyab skyor bya ba'o mdo man ngag ltar du bshad paḥ lus lung gi mdo chi sa srog gzugs su sgrubs paḥ mi shig thig ler gzhi bca' ba yin gsungaḥ yang 'gags bsdu ba laḥ ti ka gsang ba'i sgron me lnga brgya lnga bcu rtsa gcig rgyud kyis skor yang zab sgog gi ga'u stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis sgrub pa'i skoraḥ zab pa snying gi me long bcu brgyad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis man ngag gi skoraḥ gnad gsang nor bu'i bang mdzod brgya dang sum cu dbang gi skoraX u pa dhe she'i gsang gnad bcu bdun nyer lnga lung byang gi skor rnams bzhugs pa yin gsungaḥ yang bar skabs mkha' 'gro sngon mo rus pa'i rgyan can zhig gisaX yigam nor bu rin chen rang la yod mod kyi dgos dgu gzhan du rnol 'os ma yin gsal byed mig dbang rang la 'dzom lags pasaX mig 'bras 'bad pas rtol ba ma lags kyi

shes rab sgron me nang nas 'bar lags naḥ rtog ge'i blo la bstun pa ma lags kyiḥ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sku la btud lags pasaḥ gdul bya 'bad pa'i sgrub dgos mi 'dug gi zhu bde'i 'od gsal lhan skyes rang 'bar bsaX mdzes mo'i bzhin la zhen gdung mi 'tshal gyiḥ mi 'gyur dpal gyi be'u'i rgya grol bsaX sa dhe'i gter la sred pa mi 'tshal gyiḥthugs 'phrad rjes med blo bde'i rnal 'byor bas0 bya ba ma grub sa la gang ma mchisaḥ kha cig rgyud glan zhing tshig gis bkrolaḥ go ba 'dam 'byar bse ru stong par lusaX sangs rgyas ma mthong sems can snying po 'draḥ sbas don ma rtogs sa 'og gter dang 'dra: chos sku ma tog dmus long kun spod 'dra: mnyam nyid ma tog byis pa'i rtse 'jo 'dra: bde stong ma tog rgan mo'i zhen gdung 'dra nyan thos byis pa'i khrod na khyod mi gsalaX rtog ge sgro btags khyu la rje mi mdza'/rmong gling rag po'i khrod du don mi mthong ngo mtshar can khyod bdag gzhan thugs rje'i zungasaḥ sbas don bkrol ba gdul bya'i gsos su cheḥ bde stong maṇ+ḍal sku drin gzo phyir 'bulaḥ zhes zer la phyag byas nas yal loḥ bar skabs bdud

6 rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can byung la mtsho sngon po kha zhag phab be+eḍūr+ya'i tshon kha bsgyur ha la'i me tog 'dab 'bras gtor byed mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gsang sgogabacud du dril baX lnga brgya'i snyigs ma skyobs pa'i man ngag gnad la dbab pa ngo mtshar che zhing shin tu ya mtshan pa'i gnas su mngon zer nas yal bar skabs su smug nag g.yuyi ral gcig ma byung la a maḥ sngon the rgyan dhu ma tha la nas rje khrag 'thung nag po'i gtad rgya mdzadaḥ mgon gter brgya'i dbang bskur byin rlabs pas khong gter bzhedasnying po ya mtshan rmadaḥ dbang chen po'i sprel lo'i sprel zlar bskulaX sa 'dzin ma gser gyi rdo rjes bstod dngul bum pa bcud kyi bkang bas gsoḥ dbang zer stong dngar ba'ilcags kyus bskulaḥ lha chen po'i ru mtshon phyar la 'bodaḥ khong smon lam 'phro mdzoms dam pas bsnyenaḥ grogs las 'phro 'dzom las lde'u mig byasaX rtags rten 'brel dus tshigabadun gyis bskulaḥ ma mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod sgo 'phar phyes0 mtshams re 'ga' chod la nyes 'gal reX dgra nag po'i 'ur mgo khyi yi gshogs glang dmar po rwa brdar khra la

laḥ stag khra mo'i rtsal chen bskyod nas thal rje mi 'gyur gser gyi pha 'o laḥ mdangs 'od gsal rma bya'i bsil khang phubaḥ gral mdzes pa nor bu mgul phreng la dpal gnamalcags gzer bu'i rgya yis gdab phyogs rma bya'i rtsal phyung pheb pa naḥ 'dzum rin chen g.yu yi bum bcud bgo thabs 'di ni gnad brgya'i 'gags mdo yin khyod dgong brgyudalus la stobs rtsal rdzogasaḥ ma mkha' 'gro brda' brgyud nu zhe'i brgyagaḥ bu dam gtsang snyan brgyud snying tig bkrams khong 'brel ba thob tshad mkha' spyod 'groX zhing sdu ma tha larango mtshar rmadaḥ dbang sprel lo'i sprel zla'i tshes bcu nasaX dusabadun la mkha' 'gro glu yis bskul rtags rten 'brel dge ba'i phrin las su zhing 'di ru mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus phebaḥ da dbyings kyi rje mo'i thugs bzhed 'grubaḥ las mdzad pa phrin las rgya cher spelaḥ a la la sa ma ya zhes zer nas yal loX de ltar byung tshul gyi lo rgyus zhib par sprosate skal ldan rnams la nges shes khyad par 'khrungs bar byas nas mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbang rdzong la 'jug 'tshal de yang mtshungs bar ldan pa ni lhan skyes bde ba chen po' ye

gyi shes 'khor 'das yongs khyab tu brdal ba de dngaḥ lhan cig byed pa ni thabs dang shes rab nges pa'i sa lam la 'jug phyir bum gsang shes rab dbang gis smin par byas nas thabs grol gyi lam khyad par can la brtson pa dngaḥ rgyu ni sems can sangs rgyas snying po can dag mnyam chen po'i ngang tshul dngaḥ bdag po ni zhu bde 'bar 'dzag gi dgongs spyod la mkhas pa'i rgyal po lta bu dang0 dmigs pa ni chos kyi rgyal srid brkyang zhing bstan 'gror phan pa'i sman 'gyed pa dang de ma thag dga' bzhi'i drangs ba'i 'od gsal nyams su myong bde'oḥ dbang gi dngos rgyu rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor mkha' gsang bha ga'i dal la brtenaḥ rdzas kun+dha byang chub kyi sems bcud la longs spyod paḥthabs sngags kyi dgongs spyod dag pas mkha' gsang bsre ba sgrub bya bde ba chen po'i ye shes rang mtshan pa mngon sum du mthong baḥ dam tshig ni mi 'gyur kun+dha snying la gnas pa dngaḥ brtul zhugs kyispyod pa rlang po'i sbyor sgol bdag gzhan gnyis med kyi don du nyer gsum mam nyer lngar gnas pa dang 'bras bu ni rang lam kyis tshag chad bcu lam lngas

rtsal chen rdzogs nas ma chags pad+ma can nam yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen du mnga' dbang 'byor zhing sku gsung thugs yon tan nyer lnga'i gdul bya'i khams tshad med par 'gro don phrin las rgya che rgyun ring du 'byung bar bya'oX de lta bu'i myur lam phyag rgya rol pa zla gam klong dgu'i dbang bskur zab mo zhu phyir sgyu lus 'od gsal kyi maṇ+ḍal phul mdzodaX bde stong zhi bde'i rnal 'byor la khyed shes kyi 'dun pa drag po'i gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod de ltar lo rgyus bsnyad nas su slob bu'i sgo gsum smin par bya dkyil 'khor mchog ni yang dag ston rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi'i dbang skur len rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig srungasaX thabs shes nges pa'i lam bsnyen na tshe lus gcig gis rig 'dzin 'grub 'di la the tshom tsam yang medaḥ sa ma yāḥ e maḥ slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po'i bka'aḥ mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gsang mdzod 'diḥ gnub ston grub pa'i khyu mchog dang dgyes sde mkhar chen mtsho rgyal maḥ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro yiḥ dgongs pa dbyings gcig la brten nas smon lam gtad rgya mdzad pa dang sems can yun du bde phyir sbasaḥ

( snyigs mar nad mtshon gze lang tsheḥ o rgyan rgyal tshab skyes bu lngasaḥ dag snang dgongs pa sa gter gyisaḥ rtsod chen gsum gyi ru bzlog nasaḥ bstan 'grol bde skyid nyin mor byedaḥ bka' 'di btsan rgod 'bar ba dngaḥ bdud rgyal thod phreng sngags bdag laḥ dkar mo nyi zla'i phreng ba dngaḥ sha za lce spyang gdong la gtad bka' log 'dod sred can la sdomaḥ thugs sras rig 'dzin phyag tu sprodaḥ 'brel tshad mkha' spyod zhing la 'godaḥ don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi zaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gter rgyaḥ gtad rgya sbas rgyaX zab rgyaX gas rgyaḥ gu khyaḥ brda' thimaḥ3)ཿ zhes pa'ang lung zin bstan pa'i khur chen bzhes pa'i dpa' bo bdun gyis bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang thabs grogs smon lam las 'phro can dam tshig 'dzin pa'i dpa' mo'i yang yang bskul ro ra/ kho bo mkha' mnyam ye shes rdo rje'i rig 'dzin gter bzhed snying po'i dag snang sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/
༄༅// snyigs ma'i gter ston nus ldan rdo rje'i zhal gdams nyams mgur ngo mtshar dad pa'i mchod sdong zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

༄༅// chos dbyings ka dag nam mkha' yangs pa'i ngang / chos can zug rngu'i spros pa kun gzhom cing / snang srid dag mnyam brda dang dpe char shar/ nga bdag bdud 'joms rig pa'i rdo rjer 'dud/ shin tu rtogs dka' rdzogs pa chen po'i chos/ smra bsam brjod 'das khyab brdal yangs pa'i klong/ ye shes chen po kun gsal kun rig sgo/ 'di na 'dzub mo'i zla bzhin brda tshig dgod/ de yang mdor bsdus de bzhag thabs tsam bstan pa la/ nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong lta bu'i lta ba dang / gza' gtad bral ba'i ri rgyal bzhin du sgom pa dang / rang sa zin pa nyi zla lta bur 'od gsal ba dang / las dang 'khrul ba kun gyi skyon dang bral ba'i spyod pa dang / mnyam rjes dbyer med rigs par rtogs thabs la bzla ba dang lnga las/ de la dang po ni/ byi snang ba'i yul du mchis so cog ma dag ltar phar mi gcod par dag mnyam ye stong kun bzang du thag gcod pa dang/ nang 'dzin pa'i rtogs tshogs phra rag thams cad bden grub rtsis gdab ci yang mi bya bar 'dzin pa kun bzang ru thag bcad nas 'khor 'das bdag gzhan phyi nang gis chos thams cad med

༄༅// la yod snang rab rib 'ja' tshon tsam las don tu khyab brdal yangs pa spros bral nam mkha' ltar dag pa rang ngo 'od gsal ba/ ngo bo stong pa/ rnam pa mkhyen cha ma 'gags pa/ gsal stong dbyer med du thag chod nas rtogs pa ni lta ba'o/ gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i lta ba go myong rtogs gsum thon pa zhig byas nas gang shar ba yang rang sar glod/ gang snang ba yang rang sar bzhag rtog pa'i 'phro mi mthud/ mi smra mi 'gul mi blta bar thad dkar du bsreng / bcos bsgyur dga' sdug gang yang mi byed/ zhen pa dang spang ba gnyen po med par mnyam nyid du 'jog pa'i kun shes kun rig kun gsal gya ye shes 'char zhing rig pa'i rgyal po'i rang sa zin pa'o/ 'di dus nyon mongs pa dug lnga sogs mi dge ba ci ltar shar yang rjes gcod zhen chags ma song tshe thams cad ye shes su rig pa 'i rlabs kyis grol ba ni dper gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'o/ snang ba cog bzhag rgya mtsho rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu dang / 'dzan pa cog bzhag ri rgyal g.yo bas mi brgyal ba lta bu dang / rig pa chog bzhag nyi zla sprin gyis ma bcing ba lta bu dang / 'bras bu cog bzhag nam

mkha' slong byed kyi skyon gsum dang bral nas dwangs gsal lta bu dgos pa'o/ sgom pa'i ngo bo dmigs pa med pa ni stong pa chen po'i gzhi bya ba dang / had por ma song ye shes chen po ru bab skyong ba ni kun tu snang ba'i lam bya ba dang / sgo kun nas rigapa gcig tu bsdam la bor med du bcing ba ni rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mthun grogs bya ba yin no mdor na shar ba ji snyed cig pod kyang sku gsum gyi dgongs klong yin pa'i shar bas mi 'ching / 'dzin pa phra rag thams cad kyis bcing zhing 'ching ba yin pas de gcod dgos pa ni gal che/gzhan yang zab gnad rgyas pa mang yang blun po rang gi mi shes pa'i mdo rtsa ni 'di kho na'o/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar lta sgom gnyisakyi lam gnad ltar gom myong rtogs gsum thon tshe/rig pa'i rang sa zin pa ni/ ngo bo 'od gsal chos sku mtshan ma med pa dang / rang bzhin 'od gsal ba longs sku 'gags tha med pa dang / thugs rje 'od gsal ba mtha' thams cad las grol ba dang / snang ba 'od gsal rang shar gyi ye shes/ 'dzin pa 'od gsal rang grol gyi ye shes/ rang rig rang gsal sgron me'i 'od gsal ba ste rnams pa mang du shar

༄༅// ba rnam ni yon tan yar ldan gyi tshul du 'char ba'o/ bzhi pa ni/ doltar lta sgom gyi ngang bskyangs ba'i skabs su/ chos thams cad gdod nas med cing ma grub la gzhi gcig pu'i rang bzhin skyon yon gyis slad mi 'jug pa'i phyal ba sku dang ye shes 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis rdzogs shing yongs su grub pa'i dam tshig dang / nyon mongs rangagrol dang / snang ba sku rdo rje/ grags pa gsung rdo rje dran rtogs thugs rdo rje/ yang dag bcu'i dam tshig sogs yongs su dag par bsrung ba ni dbyings kyi rgyan no/ mi dge bcu sogasadug bzhin spongs zhing dge ba phra zhing phra ba nas dngas len bya ba ni dam tshig go'adi lta phyogs su spyod pa mi 'chol ba ni gnad gsang ngo/snang b.lichos thams cad med cing ma grubapar zad pa'i yon tan rig pa'i rang sa zin cing tshad la pheb pa'i yon tan dang / bde gsal mi rtog sdug bsngal gsum dang spyon pa'i bya bzhag sogs ci ltar byung yang rang saranon pas nyams kyi snang ba'i gong rol du pheb pa'i yon tan chos can gyi snang ba dbyangs su zad nas chos nyid mngon sum lhug par mthong ba'i yon tan rnams rdzogs pa dang /

'khor bar mi 'jigs 'jigs med rtogs pa'i gdengs/ nyon mongs ma spangs spang med thob pa'i gdengs dang / 'bras bu rtsol med rtsol yul bral ba'i gdengs/ sku dang ye shes yon tan rnams la gzhan thob kyi re mi 'cha' ba'i gdengs thob pa'o/ snang ba dbang thob rkyen ngan grogs su 'char ba dang / rgyu lus dbang thob nad gdon rkyen gyis mi tshug rlung sems dbang thob nyams len la rang byan tshud pa'o/ de dag thams cad rnams pa nyon mongs sogs dngas du len pa 'dra yang ngo bo skyon gyis ma gos pa'i nam mkha' ltar ka nas dag pa nyid do/ lnga pa ni/ shin tu phra ba'i rang rig rang gsal rig pa'i ye shes nyid rang la 'grogs nas/ za nyal 'gro 'dug bya spyod bzlas brjod ting 'dzin sgom pa bskyed rim lha snang bde ba sdug bsngal bar ba gang gi skabs su yang / ngang ma shor/ ha rang go ngang mngon gyur/ sa ma bor/ gnad ma lus tsam lam du khyer la/ dang po rtsol/ bar du lhod/ tha ma klod la ngo bor sdod pa ni gnad zab mo 'o/ de lta bu'i sa bcad mdor bsdus pa lnga 'di ni nyams len gyis gnad gsang yin no/ rgyasapar spros na gzhung gzhan dag tu gsal

༄༅// ba'o/ smras pa/ zab gsang snying thig chos bcud nam mkha'i klong / dbang po'i rim 'jug bgo skal gza' skar bkra/ mun sgrib mgo rmongs ma mthong gang zagal/ mdzub mo'i zla bzhin lkog yig 'di tsam bkod/ zab cing gting dpog dka' ba'i myur lam don/ rang blos 'dam bu'i slong du ma shongs te/ gol nor 'brul ba mchis nasaphyogs logs su/ bzung zhing bris kyang rtsa gsum spyan sngar 'chags/ 'dis mtshon dge ba'i lus can skye 'gro dag sdug bsngal gsum sogs ming gi lhag mar gyur/ bsam pa'idon rnams ngang gis 'grub nas su/ tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang sku 'grub par shog ces pa 'di rang slob dam pa dge btsun mthun dpal gyi bzhed ngor rmong pas ban gzugs kun nyisabris pa dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ lags so/ sarba maṅga le/

༄༅// rnam pa kun tu mtshan ldan gyi bla ma la dad pa dang mos gus ma brjed/'dus byas kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam 'dra bas gang la'ang chags zhen 'ad echod ltos/dug lnga 'di nang gi bdud lnga yin pas 'dis rkyen dbang du ma gtong /phyogs 'dzin 'di yon tan gyi 'gogs byed yin pas phyogs med la dag snang bskyed dgos/'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bya ba zin dus med pas thams cad ro snyoms ci thub gang thub kyis/rnam g.yeng 'di bslu byed kyi dam sri yin pas rtag par nyams len la brtson mdzod/rang bab ga ga ma'i shes pa 'di chags sdang rmongs gsum dang ma 'dres shing bde gsal mi rtog gi ma bslad par bar med zang thal khyab brdal rdzen par ngang skyongs cigagang dubasdad kyang ma nyan pa med pa'i snang ba yang khrol le/ bde sdug gang gi skabs su yang ma nyan pas zug rngu med par shes pa dga' yal le ba zhig dgos/nyin mtshan 'gro 'duga'agul bskyod thams cad kyi dus su bla ma dang lta ba 'di ma brjed par lhag ger dran thub pa zhig rem rem/kun nyi'i phul/ bla ma phyag 'tshal lo/don dam lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa

ni/ bla ma la mos gus kho na byas pa'i mthu la rag las pas kha tsam min par snying khung rus gteng nas gsol gdab dbang len thugs yid bsre ba rnams la ci nus kyang 'bad/ denas sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi rdul rkyen ma zhugs par bzhi cha gsum bral gyi shes rig zang ma thal byung btang bza dgags sgrub ched 'dzin ma byas par/ bying rmug 'thibapa rang sangs rjen pa rlung sems blo yis bslad pa med par gang shar rang grol thugs 'phrad rjes med kun bzang khyab brdal chen po'i ngang la yun thung grangs mang rtogs pa brtenathob bya ba gal che/ blos sgom du med kyang rtogs pas rtsal sbyangs bya ba gal che/ nyon mongs rang grol gang shar phan gnod dang bral bar snang ba yangs khrol le/ shes pa sang sa phyamame/ bya ba zin pa'i mi bzhin blo sems lhod dung nge gnas pa zhig gal che lags: zhes bla ma tshul khrims rdo rje'i zhal ngo ma bzlog tsam du nus ldan pas gus phul/ sarba maṅga le/

༄༅// nyams len thun la 'jug tshe yas mas kyi brgyud pa kun 'dus gu ru rin po che la yid khyed shes kyi dad pas skyabs su 'gro med la yod par bzung ba'i 'gro ba rnams kyi ched du zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya'o zhes sems bskyed/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od zlum 'khyil gyi klong pad zla'i khar ngo bo bla ma yin pa la rnam pa o rgyan pad+ma snang srid zil gnon rtsal du gsal gdab/ yid khyed shes kyi dad pa dang bcas te tshags bdun pas gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ mthar 'od zhu byas nas rang la bstims pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib tshogs dag nyams rtogs 'phel la thugs yid ro gcig tu bsre nas bzhag pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro yin pas med thabs med lags 'di nas shes pa rmug po phyis yul thog la phar ma 'byams shing/ nang 'dzin rtog gi rgyas ma bsdams par/ bar med zangs thal gyi shes rig gsal la sangs cha can/ 'gyu la grol cha can/ gnas la dwangs cha dang bcas pa sems rnam shes tshog brgyad kyi rnams pa'i g.ya' dag cing rig ngar nyid du sa ler shar ba byi rmug 'thib gsum/ 'phro rgod 'thor 'byams gang yang ma

red pas rig stong zang ma/ shar cha'i rnam rtog gi rjes su ma 'brang zhing rtsis gdab ma byas par/ 'char gzhi'i rig ngar skad cig ma de gar dal gcig tu bzhugs pa dngos gzhi yin pas thugs la zhog dang po gtan dbab sogs song zin nas ngo 'phrod chags byas nas zhus pa yin lags/ rjes su lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags yod kyi dge tshogs thams cad mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don du sras bcas rgyal ba'i bsngos bzhin bsngo ba dang smon lam gdab par bya'o/ 'di 'dra'i spyor dngos rjes gsum tshangs ba'i nyams len la rtse gcig tu bzhol rgyu'i bka' drin ma chung 'chi med rig 'dzin lags/ nus ldan pas phul ba dge drin mtshungs med bla ma rdo rje 'chang /gnas sbyi bos gtsug gi nam mkhar mchod/ lar chos la mos pa'i gang zag khyod/ tshe phyi ma bsam nas 'der skeb legs/ rgyud brtags dpyad byed pa ma 'chug rem/ grogs gnyen gshes zhen pa chod na dge pha bla ma'i zhal chems bsgo ba ltar/ sgo gsum po dge la sbyor ba dang / chos dam tshig gnad du thang ba na/ khyod pha yi drin lan bzo ba 'dra/ don

༄7// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / 'gro don ched kho na la dmigs nas/ /byams snying rje'i blo spyong 'bad pa na/ /khyod ma yi drin lan bzo ba 'dra// lar gangasnang dag pa rab 'byams la/ /khyer shes nas dad pa sbyang ba dang / /blo the tshom log lta spang nus na/ gnyen nye 'brel drin lan bzo ba 'dra/ rang rtsa nas bzhugs pa'i chos sku de/ lelo dang gzung 'dzin dbang ma gtong / ngang gnas gyi bsam gtan btsun mo lags/ gzhan bud med brten pas dgos med 'dra/ dbyings 'od gsal yangs pa'i gdan khri la/don bde stong zag med zas la spyod/ gang shar yang rang rig rgyal po'i rgyan/ khyod rang yul dpon gyi dgos med 'dra/ gdangs shes rab zab mo' kun shes gsal/ 'dzin rtog pa'i yul las 'das pa'i dus/ 'bad rtsol bral ye bab blon po yod/ khyod rang yul mi rtags dgos med 'dra/ lar snang ba'i yul la zhen pa chod/ nyam dman sprang rigs la zang zeng gtong / lam zab mo ston dang sbyin pa'i nor/ khyod rang khyim nor phyugs dgos med 'dra/ phyi so thar mdzes pa'i me tog la/ nyes kun sdom dge ba'i las rnams bsdud/ 'gro

don byed tshul khrims bslab pa'i rgyan/ khyod rang khyims rgyan gyi dgos med 'dra/ sdang dgra yi zug rngu sran nus shing / chos phyir du dka' chegs tsha grang bzod/ don lta ba'i gnad rtogs bzod pa'i gos/ khyod rang khyims gos gyi byar med 'dra/ lar dam pa'i chos la gzhol ba'i skabs/ snying dpa' shugs bskyed la go cha bgogayul le lo'i thang gcod brtson 'grub rta/ khyod rang khyims rta yi dgos med 'dra/ dus nyin mtshan dbyer med nyams len ngang / rgyud bsam gtan de las ma 'das na/ de rgyal ba dgyes pa'i bsam gtan zas/khyod rang khyims zas kyi byar med 'dra/ don thos bsam sgom pa'i na tshod dar/ lta sgom pa'i gdengs dang mi 'bral na/ blo gtad chog shes rab grogs po yod/ khyod rang yul grogs kyi dgos med 'dra/ gnas mi med dben pa'i ri brtse na/ g.yul rkyen snang bdud kyi jag pa nyung / der brten mdzod rang yul dgos med 'dra/ 'dra bcu gsum pa yi rgyang glu de/ sems la brten phan no chos lhun gnyis/ rgan nag po spyon pa kun nyis phul/ dge'o/ maṅga le/ / a ho/ tshogs smon las 'dzom gyi ban chung / mos gud dad pa dang ldan pa'i/

༄༅// tsha bu snying nor khyed gson dang / zhal ta tshig gsum zhig bshad do/ bu lon skyed 'phel la mkhas kyang/ gshin rje'i ngo so ni mi lon/ dbul bo nor med kyi sprang po/ rang mchu bsdam tshul de sgyug log bya blo mang po yi a khu/ dran rgyu sbos rgya dang mtshungs yang / 'grub pa'i dus skabs ni ma mchis/ blo sna bstung thabs la rem lags/ dran tshad chol nyog du smras yang / bshad thog ldan dus ni mi 'dug: spyo gtam ha cang la gsung na/ ngag 'khyal rgya 'byams su shor 'gro/ rang yul chags sdang gi gnas su/ pham rgyal rtsod pa la gzigs dang / ro mnyam yin na so ngo mtshar/ phug tu 'tshub 'dug kyang 'joms mdzod/ na tsha zug rngu res mnar na/ ku yang blo bde ru bzhugs tshe/ don gyi rnal 'byor zhig los yin/ rkyen mi theg pa rnams nyams chung / dgra 'dres 'tshe ba sogs byung dus/ skyid nyal ro snyoms su mdzad na/ rdzogs chen rnal 'byor pa zer chog sdang zhen mdzad pa rnams mi nag mtshang bri skyon brjod du byung skabs/ 'dzum dga' spro chen du 'dug na/ don gyi rnal 'byor pa los yin/ zhal gnag am bsdam de skyug log 'gro don dkor kha ru byon na/

zas skom 'bul ba la mi re/ tshad med snying rje de ngo mtshar/ bzang ngan gtam brjod tsho yi mug gshin la dbang bskur de 'dod na/ rang byung rig pa yi chos sku/ nges par rtogs pa rnams ngo mtshar/ ja khor rlom pa dag sha tsha/ gson la bde sprel du byon nas/ drag las gto 'don sogs mdzad kyang / ngar 'dzin rtsa ba nas chod dgos/ rang 'dod phug bcug mkhan gad bro/ gtam gral bgos gral la sleb yang / 'ur mo'i gsung mdzad ni ma byed/ phan gnod gnyis ka rang byung na/ gzhan blo dkrugs don ni ci yod/ mi gsum 'du ba la sleb yang / nyams len 'u ru ru ma sgogs/ blo thag ma chod pa'i mtshang yin/ gsang sgrogs nyes pa ni 'byung nges/ bla sprul brgya stong re mthong skabs/ rtogs 'bul byed pa la dga' yang / the tshom gzeb nang du btsud nges/ de dus ci bya rang rtol med/ gang snang dag mnyam gyi rol bar/ bzang ngan gang yang ni ma brjod/ don med nyes lhung re phog thang / rnam smin mnar dus su kye ma/ ja dngul phyag rgyu ni ma bsags/ 'chi dus tha mal du lus nas/ zas nor gzhan dag gis hab thob/ 'khrul ba'i a khu rnams snying rje/ ci yang mi shes

༄7// pa'i glen nag /shes 'dod zhe rtsa de sbos nas/ 'di dgos kha 'tshams so gcod pa'i/ ngas slob kha cig ltar ma byed/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bya ba//zeg dus 'grub skabs ni med na/ da nas blo thag de chod la/ btang snyoms ro gcig tu bzhugs zhu/ mi la kha ta yang mod med/bslab palislob bu dag ma skyongs/ don med ngan gshis sushor na/ dug lnga'i 'dam 'khor la rang 'ching / rang rig gsal dag gyi rol ba/ gzung 'dzin dri ma dang bral song / re togs gzeb nang la ma bcug gnyen po dug tu yang 'gyuraskad/ deng dus kha lta mkhan rnams kyis/ yengs 'khrul med tshul re bshad na/ rgas pa'i gnyer ma yangs sangs byung / chags sdang pham rgyal re rtsod skabs/ lha mi thams cad kyangabazhad bro/ stong skad mthon po re gsungs tshe/ rten med nam mkha' na bzhugs yod/ khab rkud dar rgyu re mdzad skabs/ mi nag skye bo las sra brtan/ sgom med blo 'das re gsungasaskabs/ sangs rgyas mi gzugs zhig yin 'dra/ 'khrul 'byams chos brgyad re byed tshe/ yul gyi dpon po las 'tshubs che/ dgos med nges 'byung re bshad dus/ sngar kyi bka'

gdams re 'dra yang / bsog 'jog dkor kha la byon tshe/ mthong na khyi phag dang 'dra'o/ chags sdang ro snyoms kyi gcod tshul/ gsungs na sa ra ha dngos 'dra/ /cor chung dmar ‘dang rdzun gtam/ bshad na mtha' mi dang khyad med/ chos gral dbang gral la rgyug tshe/ slob ma las ldan re 'dra yang / gshe bskur gling mo sogs ston na/ bsgral ba'i zhing bcu 'dra nges/ bsam pa dam chos las med tshul/ gsungs na bstan 'dzin zhig los yin/ don med bya bzhag la g.yeng skabs/ 'khor ba'i kha dpon ni ngo ma/ bu khyod de ltar ra byed/ rgad po'i bsam dkar gyi kha ta/ bshad na mtshang 'bod dang 'dra bas/ thugs la phog sdug re shor na/ snying nas 'gyod sems kyis bshags so/ mi nag skye bo yi khrod na/phrug rgan mo yis bskor ba'i/ dug lnga chol rnyogs su spyod pa'i/ rgad po skyon mtshang gi rang bzhin/ 'jig rten rnam g.yengs su 'khrul ba'i/ rmongs pa kun nyi pa nga la/ khyed brten pa ni don med/ thos tshogs mkhyen rgya ni nga med/ nyams myong yon tan ni lta ci//sgom med rdzogs chen ni mi shis/ rang rig rtogs pa ni phar zad/ blang dor ngo sprod dab

༄༅// shes/ zog gral bzhag na ni mi gzugs/ mi gral 'ong na ni lkugs po/ nga 'dra brten pas ni ci byed/ de las mkhas grub kyi mnga' bdag skyes bu dam pa rnamasabarten nas/ 'khor ba'i pha mthar la 'gro ba'i/ gdams ngag zab mo re zhus la/ nyams len rang thog tu tshud nas/ sangs rgyas go 'phang la byon tshe/ rgad po nga rang ni ma brjed/ delugs tsha bu yis dran mdzod/ a la brtse mtshar gyi gtam yin/ rgad po'i ngo sprod zhig phul na/ mtha' brgyad bral ba yi gnas lugs/ tha mal rang byung gi rig pa/ gsal stonga'agags med kyi ye shes/ gnas 'gyu'i shan 'byed kyi ma 'brel/ mngon lkog rtsis gdab ni mi dgos/ 'dzin stangs rtog pa yang spu cam/ bsre bslad ma zhugs pa gal che/ yulasnang nub pa'ang ma yin/ ltad mos bslus pa ni lta ci/ ye sa 'khrul sa mtshams la mi gcod/ thim la ma rmugs pa'i ye shes/ mkhyen cha 'gags med du bzhugs na/ bslu ba medapa ni nges pa/ bu khyed de ltar du sgom dang / bslus nas na song du lhu na/ sdug sdug nga rang gi khur nges/ sems thag chod byed kyi ska cha/ ma brjed sems dkyil du 'chongs lags/

'di 'dra'i nyams len gyi rtsa ba/ pha cig pad 'byung gi drin gyis/ dbang med de 'dra zhig go byung / rdzogs chen rtogs snang ni skyes yod/ khrom sngon bsgrags lom ni yod med/ re dwogs mtshan ma dang bral song / snyad ka brjod na yang mdo 'dra/ /dgongs pa klong chen ni rdol ba'i/ shu ga lce gnyis la mi skrag / legs nyes bshad dgos kyang lab 'dod/ de lugs sems dkyil du 'chongs lags/ sprul mang nus ldan pas gus phul/ / a ho/ sems kyi gzhi rtsa chod pa'i skyes bu lags/ yin min re phyogs dpyod pa ga la dgos/gang shar rig tshad ye shes rang bzhin la/ spang len bsal bzhag sgog las grol ba 'dra/ dri bral chos dbyings kun tu bzang po la / 'gyu dran rtog pas bsre ༄༅//bslad byed mi 'tshal/ nang gsal ye shes thim la ma rmugs gshis/ gnas dang 'gyu ba'i shan 'byed ga la dgos/ brtan pa chos sku rgya tshad phyogs klong bral/ ma ngag snang ba rdul tsam ma mchis so/ g.yo ba gzugs sku 'gas med ye shes klong/ ma dag snang ba spang dgag mi dgos so/ ri chen gser gling phyin pa'i skyes bu yis/ sa rdo phal ba btsal kyang mi rted
༄༅// na/ 'od gsal rdzogs chen sgom pa'i rnal 'byor khyed/ bcing dgag sbubs su ma bzhugs tsha bu lags/ kun nyis smras pa dge'o/ sarba maṅga le/

༄༅// ka dag stong chen yangs pa ye chos nyid/ kha dog dngos mtshan grub pa ni ma mthong/ ga ye gsal stong zung 'jug tu 'dug go ngar 'dzin ma chod rtogs ldan de ha ha/ ca co'i tshig la mkhas pas na ci bya/ cha lugs gzugs brnyan mdzes pa ni don med/ ja dar bsogs 'jog byas pa de 'ching byed/ nya mo rgya yis zin bzhin du 'ching ngo/ ta tha spyor sgrol mkhas 'dod du sems kyang / tha mal bya spyod lab lob tu ma gol/ da nas rang rgyud brtags dpyad re gzab nas/ na gzer byung yang gdeng thob re dgos nges/ pa zhorazob pa'i rgyu ma yi nor rdzas/ pha rgan byas nas bu'i phrug res bskor nas: ba btsong ja nas nyo ba la rgyug mdur/ ma bu'i drung sleb bzhin gnags ni mi 'dzum/ tsa tsir 'ur sgra gcongakhyu rnams grags 'dra/ /tsha mo 'thung rgyu'i dal khom ni med par/ dza gtam thab mo ngan shag de smra bzhin/ wa sbe gla sgo gsod sems kyis nyul yang / zhwa mo med pa'i mgo rna yang 'khyaganges/ za rgyu rted yang ra khyims la khyer snyams/ 'a ye gra lag nyo ba yi ban chung/ ya yengs rlung gi khyer ba ltar song kyang / ra lug shul nas 'phar spyang gis spyod te/ la 'ur khong

khro sdang nas su tshig rtsubs/ sha 'phro de tsam za bar ni mi byed/ sa rdo min tshad nyo tshong re dgos pa'i/ ha ha de 'dra'i ban log re ma byed/ a lags gong ma'i rjes snyogs re ma 'jugs/ kun nyis bris/ / a ho/ ka dag stong chen nam mkha' lta bu'i gdangs/ kha dog ma nges gza' gtad kun dang bral/ ga nas rang bab nyid las ma 'das so/ nga bdag 'gong bo thul cig rjes 'jug rnams/ ca co'i smra bshad byed pa mi gasdu'o/ cha lugs mdzes pa tsam gyis don mi rtogs/ ja chang gser dngul 'khor ba'i gtan nor spongs/ nya mo rgyas zin lta bu'i lcags sgrog khrol/ ta na ga na sbyor sgrol zab mo'i lam/ tha chen ral gris bdag 'dzin rtsa ba chod/ da lta nyid du gnas lugs rtogs par mdzod/ na mchi'i rgud pa nam 'ong cha med yin/ pa re pu re'i bsam sbyor sne mang des/ pha rol gcig pur 'gro dus phan mi thog ba thag tsam 'dir yar mar rag las yin/ ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi sras gcig mdzod/ tsa dur thar srog gcod pa chags sdang gnyis/ /tsha zer phyi nang kun dkris nyon mongs las/ dza gad ltar du spyod pa nyams re thag wa skya khyi phag spyod pa gsang sngags

༄༅// min/ zha bo ci bzhin srid mtsho'i mthar mi brgal/ za zob rang mgo bskor ba yid re gcong / 'a ye rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje gzigs/ ya mtshan lus rten rin chen phong la nye/ ra tsa snying la zhugs pa'i chos gzugs mkhan/ la la ma gtogs 'ja' tshon dpe ltar lhag sha chang bza' btung gzad nas stong 'dug byed/ sa mthar grogs med rgyu dus rang re sdug ha ha de ltar ma byed mthu dpal lags/ a dbyings ngang las rdzogs sangs rgyas pa gnad/ blun rgan rgad po kun nyi'i ming gi phul: ga a ho/ sngon bsags 'bras bu bzang po' dal 'byor gyi mi lus/ yang yang rnyed dka' 'dod 'byung yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ mdo med sto zad byas na shin tu yang phongs 'dug da lta nyid du la chos rtsol ba la rem lags/ thams cad mi rtag chags 'jig 'chi ba de thog bab/ gar byung cha med dbugs ni ngar thung la rgyu skabs/ sngar byas las kyis non de phra shad rang byas nas/ gcig pur bar dor 'byen dus 'o brgyal ni che nges/ da nas dben ri brten la sgrub tshugs de zung lags/ dgra gnyen chags sdang blo phug 'dun ma ru bzhag nas/ yar mar

dkor kha grong chog 'dre brdung la rgyug bzhin/ za 'dod thob blo'i rgyu nor 'dzad med des phyug kyang / chos kyi rgyal por yar zhu bca' dus la dka' nges/ bzod med 'bras bu dmyal bar zeb dus ni sdug lags/ zab mo gcod kyi rnal 'byor yin bsam la 'jug ste/ 'drer 'dzin cor chung ro bsha' grong rgyug tu 'grim nas/ gzhan don chen po 'byung snyams nga rgyal de che yang / ma ki rdo rje'i dmyal ba bzod rgyu ni dka' lags/ 'di phyi'i 'dun ma mthar thug e 'grub re snyam na/ sngon byon rgyal ba'i gshegs shul rmad byung la brtson nas/ nyin mtshan 'khor yug sgom sgrub zab mo la gzhol nas/ 'chi ba thog bab byung yang blo bde re gal che/ 'dzin med 'od gsal yangs pa'i nyams len de 'bad nas/ṭ+wāṃ gcig 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i rten 'brel zhig zhu lags/ dad brtson snod ldan skyes bu smon sems kyis bskung ngor/ dug lnga'i dbang phyug nus ldan rdo rje des phul lo/ sarba maṅga

༄༅// skyabs gcig pad+ma ka ra de/ bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod/ tshogs smon las 'phro ldan pa yis/ slob bu chos nyid rang grol lags/ so thar mdzes pa'i gesar gyi/ 'jo sgegs bkra ba'i ban chung la/ sde gsum mkhyen pa'i blo mig rgyas/ kun gyi bstod pa 'u ru sa de 'dra'i ngang la mthar 'khyol na/ rgad po nga yi blo sems bde/ 'on kyangacho rigs ngan rkyen gyis/ blo ni rtsi rkud breg dang mtshungs/ sems ni rlung kha'i dar phyar 'dra/ bsgyur sla nam mkha'i glog ci bzhin/ de ltar byas na yab mes kyi/ chos srid zin la cicha yod/ gtam ni bung ba'i sgra bzhin mang/ smra dang mi smra bzang ngan tshig thams cad chol snyogs 'byung ba ni/ ba yi lci ba ngan dang mtshungs/ mi gcig 'gro ba'i rkyen theb na/ dgyesapa'i 'dzum mdangs lan brgyar ston/ tshig rtsub bshad pa'i dam tshig de/ mdo sngags gang gi nang na gda'/ drod chung mgo yang ngos rgyag che/ sa phag mi thub mtshang brjod mkhas/kha gsag can la blo gtad na/ phu bo'i mdza' spyod chog la khad/ gdams ngag gnang ba'i bla ma ni/ bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje 'chang/ sangs rgyas stong las khyad par 'phags/

log lta spongs la dag snang bskyed/ bla mar pham rgyal rtsod pa dang / zas ngan lci ba la spyod pa/ don med dkor kha grong nyul na/ ngo mi mtshar la ga re bro/ /byams dang snying rje dngabral ba'i/ so thar yin 'dod gzugs mdzes kyang / grol ba thog pa nyung rab yod/ bdag ma zhugs kyang brag cha tshor/ rin chen byang chub sems bral ba'i/ byang sems yin 'dodazhe sbos kyang / 'phags pa'i spyan sngar 'khod rab med/ ngas mi shes kyang lo rgyus thos/ dam tshig sdom pa dang bral ba'i/ sngags pa yin 'dod 'chol snyogs kyang / rdo rje 'chang dngaring rab yod/ zhib cha bral dang lo rgyus tshor/shar grol dus mnyam dgongs pa dang / bral ba'i rdzogs chen rtogs 'dod kyang / rkyen mi theg pa'i ngang mtshan can/ grol ba chos skuthob pa dkon/ byams dang snying rje dang bral ba'i/ spyod lam rang grol yin 'dod kyang / 'chol snyogs yin na nyam re thag gnad thag song na ro mtshar che/ gcig shes kun grolaman ngag ni/ kha bshad byas na sla mod kyang / don rtsa ldan pa shin tu dkon/ de phyir blo sna na du bskor/ gnad thog dril nas snying po longs/ nyin mtshan bar med sgom mdzod dang /

༄༅// nyams rtogs yon tan nyi ma 'bar/ rgyal kun dgongs pa mngon du 'gyur/ pha bzang bu yi nyams len yin/ ma brjed thugs kyi dkyil du 'chong / kha gsag bshad pa mang na yang/ mtshang thog rgol ba nga las med/ rgad po'i tshig rtsub smras pa yis/ thugs la phog na bzod par gsol/ 'jig rten chos brgyad bya ba ni / grub pa med do spos rgya mtshungs/ da nas zhen med rang sar gcod/ brtul zhugs skyongs shig snying gi bu/ chags med 'khor ba rgyab du bor/ nges med brag phug zha ltar kyon/ stsol med rang grol nyams len mdzod/ bu khyod skyid pa'i lam sna zin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa ni/ sems can kun la khyab mod kyang / ma rtogs dmus long 'khor bar 'khyams/ lag pa'i gar bsgyur dang 'dra na/ rang rig rtogs mdzod snying gi bu/ gso rgyu mang po med skabs 'dir/ rang yul phyogs su ye ma sdod/ 'dug yun ring na rkyen gyis bslu/ dben ri brten dgos snying gtam yin/ sdig pa'i grogs na da ma 'grogs/ kha zhe med par ye ma smra/ bshad na pha gtam bu la lod/ rang la kun gyis brnyas tshul ston/ de phyir gzhan dang blo ma

bstun/ man ngag 'di rnams thugs la zhog nga yis brtags 'bras byas pa la/ khyed la chos gegs mang du gda'/ bzlog byed nges med 'grim pa dang / brtul zhugs bdud gcod man ngag sgom/ khyad par phrin las lam khyer gyi/ sgrub pa yi dam rtsa ba bya/ yang bsnyen dung phyir bgrangs gyur na/ rtags dang rten 'brel shin tu dge bar chad phreng kun zhi bar nges/ sgrub gnas bkra shis sgo mang dang / 'du phug sbrel rdzongs la brten nas/ rtsa gsum bsnyen zhing bskang tshogs gtong / nyams len rnal ma'i don la 'bad/ bde legs dpal gyi 'bras bu 'khrung / nyams rtogs yon tan 'od brgya 'bar/ bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsal/ bu khyod thugs kyi dkyil du sbos/ khyad par dad mos brtson 'grus kyis/bdag gi 'dab su brten bcas nas/ bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin byas pa yis/ sngon spron las sad shin tu dge/ mi ring rnga yab la ci thang / don gtam rtse mtshar 'dres ma 'di/ snying gi slob bu smon sems la/ kha ta sems kyi 'khri shing zhes/ rgad po kun nyis zhal gdams yin/ ma brjed sems kyi dkyil du zhog don dang ldan na ya mtshan che/ /snod lhag man

༄༅// ngag chud zos yin/ /skal bar ldan na zhal gdams ltar/ /gzu bor gnas pa khyad chos yin/ /log pa'i lam du mgo 'khor na/ /rmongs ba'i bu sdug cha lugasayin/ las da ldan pa yin nam min/ gang zag khyod la rag las so/ lcags sprul kun nyis gus pas phul/ / a ho/ ka dag blo bral chos sku'i bzhugs tshul ni/ kha dog mnges 'di zhes mtshon dpe bral/ /ga ler rang sar ltos dang gnas lugs mthong / ngar 'dzin rtsa ba chod cig snying gi bu/ /ca co'i kha bshad mi gtso don la thugs/ /cha lugs snatshogs sgyu mar blo ma 'cha'/ /ja dar gser dngul rgyu rdzas nor phyug kyang / /nya mo rgya yi zin bzhin 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /ta ler rang thag nang nas rbad gyis chod/ /tha na bzlas brjodaphran bu yan chad kyis/ /da lta nyid du blo sna dge la bskul/ /na 'chi'i rgud pa byung yang 'jigs med mdzod/ /pa ra pu re'i blo rtse mang po yis/ /pha rol 'gro ba'i las ka mi 'byungabs/ /ba thag 'khor ba'i chos la zhen pa chod/ /ma gi khams gsum gnas las thar thabs rem/ /tsa ma ra tsa'i khe ldan dgra byung yang / /cha grang bzod pa'i khur bo'i dpal

bgos nas/ /dza gad spyod bzhin snying rje'i shugs kyis zungs/ /wa mor khung bur 'gum bzhin dbyings su sgrol/ /zha bo gzhin du 'khor ba 'dir ma sdod/ /za zis myos ltar nyon mongs rang ma spyod/ /'a ye sdug bsngal khri mun gnas las 'don/ /ya rab rgyal ba'i gshegs shul mdzad pa skyongs/ /ral gri 'dzin sogs byang sems spyod pa bzhin/ la 'ur dben pa'i ri la bsgrub tshugs zung / sha tsha snying rjes 'gro don 'ba' zhig rem/ /sa lam tshe 'dir bsgrod pa'i nyams len skyongs/ ha bgad khrel ba'i gnas su ma 'dug par/ /a ti'i klong du tshe 'dir grol thabs zhu/ /glen nag slob bu chos gsal gyis bskul ngor/ /sngags nag rgad po kun nyi'i ming gis phul/ /sprang nag ban spyon smon sems zhes byas bris//yul nag 'khor ba grol ba'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga le/ ༈ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog de la/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang slob pad+ma don 'grub lags/ dad dang mos pas snyan gson dang / /rgad po'i kha ta tshig gsum bshad/ /srog dang sbrel nas nyams su longs/ /khyed cag sprang po'i bu rgyud rnams/ /bya blo mang ba'i na kun 'dra/ /dang po

༄༅// legs pa'i tshul du snang / /lo re bzhin tu ce zhan yin/ /bzang byed mkhan gyis rab brkyang nas/ /ya rab brnye'i gzugs su byas/ /'on kyang mi gzhi ngan rkyen gyis/ /snang phyir khur nang ngan shul snyogs/ /de 'dra byas na ngan song gi gting rdor lhung ba'i la nye tshang / /khyims thabs 'khor ba'i tshul bzung na/ /grong mtha'i khyi mo tshang ma bzhin//kha lag skad cig dal khoms med/ /shes bzhin dug 'thung ma byed rem/ kha ta mkhan po zhal gnag nas/ /khro tshul rngams pas brdeg brdung kyang / /bzang lan ngan mjal ma byed las/ /mgo 'dren byed mi dkon nges yin/ /dbyen mkhan bzhad 'dzum mdangs bstan na/ /log pa'i lam 'dren kha ta mang / de rjes 'brang na las rlung gi ded nas gcong rong gnas su 'khyams/ /blo ma mang la nang du bstung/ /gtan gyi dkon mchog gtsug tu khur/ /'dun ma mthar thug chos la dril/ /rgad po'i kha ta sems la 'chongs/ /spyan mig yar ltos lha lugs skyongs/ /'khor ba'i gnas la rgyab 'khor cig sprang po yin kyang 'chi ba 'byung / /phyugs dang 'du 'dzi g.yengs sa med/ /bza' rgyu rnyed na des chog pa'i/ /blo

bde 'ong ba'i chos zhig rem/ /dman pa'i gyong lag brgyal gyur nas/ /bzang mthun mi la rku rgyu dran/ /'di phyi gnyis kyi 'gro lam bcad/ /gzhan gyi gad mo'i gnas su mngon//de 'dra ma byed snying gi bu/ /'dod yon chos la zhen pa chod/ /byams dang snying rje'i rgyud btul nas/ /dad pa mos gus dag snang bskyed/ /dran shes zab mos rgyud bsdam nas/ /ya rab sems dpa'i spyod pa skyongs/ /de na mkho ba'i gnad gcig yod/ /ma brjed skyongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /drin chen pha ma'i kha ta las/ /rgad po'i tshig ngan 'di'i zab pas//sems la bzung na snod ldan yin/ /brjed na ci byed mgo 'khor song / /gang byed khyod la rag las pas/ /blta rgyu yod la nyan rgyu yod/ /pha bzang bu gces ma 'khrugs rem//rgad po dug lnga'i nor phyug pa'i/ /kun nyi'i gtam nag 'chol ba yin/ /dge'o/ /lags so/ /sarba maṅga le/ / a ho/ /gnas nges med dben pa'i yang rtse nas/ /chos tshogs drug g.yul klong 'tshubs cha bral/ /bu de ru sdod pa'i tshad zung dang / /rang rig pa chos sku mjal nas yong / /nang sems nyid lta ba'i yang rtse na/ /blo gzung dang 'dzin pa'i 'khrul snang

༄༅// bral/ /bu de ru shig ger lhod zhog dang / /don sku gsum ngo bo mjal nas 'ong / /phyi tshogs drug yul la bar klod da / /der 'dzin med ngo bo'i ngang la zhogagashis brjod med don dam ye shes de/ /don rig pa'i chos sku mjal nas 'ong / /nang ngar 'dzin ngang la klod der ltos/ /der 'dzin med ngo bo'i gshis su zhog don skye med yangs par yan pa na/ /dbyings ka dag lta ba mjal nas 'ong / /bu de 'dra'i phan na lta ba med/ /gshis de las zhan pa'i bsgom pa med/ /ngang klong las 'das pa'i spyod pa med/ /don de gsum ngang la bya ra mdzod/ /ces zhang po pad+mas mos ngor kun nyi'i spel/ /sarba maṅga le/ / / a ho/ /las spyo na phun sum tshogs pa skal bzang gi skyes bu/ /gzung 'dzin thad gar gcod pa'i nyams len re dgos nges/ /rig pa bcar phog mthong ba'i zhal gdams re zung lags/ /yengs med 'khor yug bsre ba'i nyams len de gnad nges/ /'khrul bral spyod pa zab mo bag 'don re brtson lags/ /tshab phebs chos sku'i rgyal po'i ro bo ru grol nges/ /ces kyang zhu'o/ /maṅga le/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i zhal gdams zheg dgos pa'i/

/rnal 'byor gang des yang yang nai bskur ngor/ /zob rgan bdag gi rgyud la ni rdzogs chen/ /nyams myong yon tan spu tsam yang ma mchis/ /'on kyang da sngon rig 'dzin gyi brgyud pa'i//gsang ba snying po'i sgo 'phar de phyes nas/ /tshom bu 'bum bcas ka dag la pheb song / /zhal gsung rdo rje zeg ma yi sgra gdangs/ /bdag gi sgra 'dzin yul snang du phyogs mched//de lugs zhus na thugs khrel de ma mdzad/ /deng sang rdzogs chen yin rloms kyi skyes bu/ /kha ba bu yug las kyang ni mod 'dug stong skad mtho bas sangs rgyas de 'grub dka'//thob na nam mkha'i g.yu 'brug kyang los grol/ /lta ba go myong rtogs gsum da ldan pa'i/ /snang srid 'khor 'das rgyu ma ru rtogs pa'i/ /bshad bshad mi dgos rang mdangs des ston 'ong / /blo 'das mnyam bzhag ye shes de bstan thob/ /zhi dul lhod bag dug lnga ni ce phra// rtogs yod khar btags mi dgos dang bltas chog /sems kyi sgom pa de ka yang ma min/ /mi sgom 'khrul 'byams byed pa rang lta ci/ /sgom dang sgom byed gnyis med zhig dgos lags/ blo 'das don gyi gnas tshul ni de ltar/ /dmigs med ye shes mnyam rjes

༄༅// dang bsres la// rang shar brtul zhugs zab gnad la sbyor 'tshal/ /rjes thob dran shes bag yod dang ldan pas// rgyu 'bras blang dor mi rmongs par gal che//zhi dul gzob pa lhur len la rem rem// lta ba mtho bzhin rgyu 'bras la zhib dgos/ /nag po kha 'byams bdud dbang du ma 'gro// sems la zungs shig skal ldan gyi bu mchogatshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa la ci cha/ /mi ldan kha bshad lcags sprul nas gus phul/ / / ha ha 'byung sgyu lus g.yar khang lta bu'i/ /nam lo zlas zhag gis ded nas byung / /rkyen 'chi bdag rgyal po sleb nges yin/ /'dir yid dpyod tsam zhig ma byed pas/ /gdengs grol tshad thon pa ma yin nam/ /lar srin po'i mun gling 'khor ba'i gnas/ /rgyu bde ba med de mi gtsang 'dam/ /da ro mnyam byas nas zhen lugs la/ /chos dag mnyam rtogs pa ma yin nam/ yul lcags sgrog gnyer chen nyon mongs lnga/ /nang bdag 'dzin shes pa hu re ba//gshis shin tu 'thab par 'dug tshul la/ /skyabs bla ma'i man ngag ma yin nam/ /kha stong skyang dge med sdig med zhig don mi dge nyams su blang bar 'dug de khyab brdal rnal

'byor ma yin nam/ /tshong so nams dkor kha grongs chog la/ /blo'i rgyang thag 'phen pa byed tshul 'di/ /don gzhir bzhengs bskyed rim ma yin nam/ /mig cer cer khros pa'ibazhin mdangs ngoms/ /rgyud tshogs drug yul la 'byams pa 'di/ /dbyings a nu'i theg pa red dam ci/ /rkyen thog bab tha mal lta bu la/ /lto gos kyis brgyan tsho chos pa 'di//gzhi rdzogs chen rnal 'byor red dam ci/ /de sems la zung mdzod kun nyi lo/ /blo kha yengs mig yeng sa ma byed rem/ / ga sa ho/ ma mang ma mang blo ma ma / /ma zhen ma zhen 'khorab spongs/ /mi dga' mi dga' zhen pa chod/ /ma len ma len yul ma len/ /ma 'tshag ma 'tshag bud med sbongs/ /ma 'dug ma 'dug dben par song / /ma sgrub ma sgrub rgyu ma sgrubs/ /ma zhen ma zhen mdud pa sbongs/ /ma nor stong nyid lam ma nor/ /ma spang bla ma gdengs su 'chong / /ma 'cha' gzhan tshig ngang ma 'cha'/ /ma 'khrul ka dag rtogs par mdzod/ /ha ha/ /ces kyang yid rdor la kha mang rgad pos bris pa dge'o/ / / a ho/ /'dir 'tshogs bde stong sgom pa'i rnal 'byer rnams gson dang / /nyams len dag snang mos

༄༅// gus byin rlabs kyi rten gzhi/ /mi g.yeng rtse gcig brtson pa nyams rtogs kyi rgyu gcig ma dag las rlung sbyangs ba dgu sprugs kyi gnad dang / /byin rlabasadabang gis smin pa bum can la gzhol zhing / /tshogs rdzogs mthar thug bde stong 'bar 'dzag de bsgom na/ /bde skyid lang tsho'i nyi ma gsar bu re 'khrung lags/ /de ltar semasal bzung na dga' nges de 'dra lags/ /ces slob tshogs la sakhyas phul/ // ka ye snying gi slob bu 'gyur rgyam lags/ kha zhemed pa'i yar zhu tshig gsum phul// ga ler rang tshodazung la chos brgyad dor/ /nga yi blo sems bde ba'i 'dun ma yin/ /ca co'i mgo 'dren rtse skyongs kha ta zhog lugs ma bsgyur gos dkar lcang lo mdzod/ /ja dar gser dngul longs spyod nor ma bsogs/ /nya mo chu dang bral bzhin rang sdug nyo/ /ta ler mkho ba'i zab gsang rdzogs pa che/ /tha mal spyod lam skabs kun brjed ma shor/ /da nas rtsal sbyongasartogs gom gdengs ldan mdzod/ /na 'chi thog bab byung yang blo bde rem/ /pa ra pu re'i dran rgyu ma mang bas/ /pha rol 'gro ba'i las ka lta ci smos/ /ba thag gseb tu rang gis rang

bcing ngo / /ma ki ngan song gting rdo ma byed lags/ /tsa ma ra yi kheng sems dpon skad skyur/ /tsha na byung bzhin bze re ye ma che/ /dza gad dug lnga'i 'dam la mi lhung ba'i/ /wa ki shāri'i ral gris bsnub thabs brtson/ /zha bo ji bzhin 'khor ba 'dir ma lhag za zis phyos ltar le lo rnam g.yeng spongs/ /'a ye dal med bsnyen sgrub ma 'bad na/ /ya ya sla sla'idon chen 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rwa dang 'dra ba'i rgyud ni mi gyong bar/ /la 'ur chags sdang pham rgyal rang sar gzhol// sha tsha snying rjes 'gro ba ma lus skyongs/ /sa chen kun bzangadagongs pa skyongs shig bu/ /ha brgad kha zhe med pa'i gtam ma mang / /a rog grogs mchen kun gyis brnyes bcos byed/ /e dbyings rnam kun mchog ldan rig pa skyong / /ā nimi dmigs brjod 'das ngang skyong dang// e yig mi 'gyur sku gsum rgyal sa zin/ /de 'dra byed par ma sob snying gi bu/ /yang yang zhu ba ma brjed thugs la zhogs mthayirgad poblun rgan kun nyi pas/ /mos ldan slob bu 'bral mi phod pa yis/ /dad 'dun mchi mas brnang bas bdag bskul nas/ /lcags sprul ming 'dzin nyams chung mkhan des phul/ / /

༄༅// a ho/ /snying gi nor bu 'gyur lo khyed gson dang / /'jig rten 'khor ba'i las la zad dus med/ /bslu byed rgyu ma'i chos tshul ce mang mang / /dgra gnyen chagasasdang mtha' la thug re dka'/ /zhen log nges 'byung sgog gi gta' ru zungs/ /'dod yon mtshang btsal dben par sgrub tshugs zungs/ /nye 'brel dgra bgegs ro snyoms phyam brdal zhog mi nga yi kha la nyan na de ltar rem/ /gol sa mazo bzhin dug lnga'i rab tu sbos// mnga' dbang 'byor bzhin dga' sdug sla bor 'byung / /grags 'dod phyir du chos brgyadabya las mang/ /dman pa'i sa bzungs dug lnga 'bur 'joms dgos: thob thang dor zhing grags 'dod chos brgyad sbongs: mings kha la nyan na de ltar rem/ /bze re che bzhin gzhan la kha bskang mang/ /rgyud ni gnags pa'i tshig rtsub sna dgu 'byung/ /rang yan gzhan med snyams pa'i nga rgyal che/ /mi la re ma che la tshig ma 'cha'/ /rgyud dal tshig 'jam don ldan gtam tshogs brjod// rang man gzhan med snyams pa'i kheng pa skyongs/ /mi ngas kha la nyan na de ltar rem/ /thos tshogs g.yeng ba'i chos la zad mtha' dka'/ /rigs gnas

bzo rigs 'dzad med lho sprin 'dra/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i bya ba 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /don thos yi dpyod re rtogs bral ba'i rjes/ /che bzhag chung bskyur sgom med gnad la spyor//mi nga'i kha la nyan na de ltar rems/ /tshe 'di blos thong phyi ma dang du longs/ /dkon mchog gtsug brten 'dun phug phyi ma gnyer/ /las snang 'khor ba dong sprug rang sems 'dul//mi nga'i kha la nyan na de ltar rems/ /zhi dul bag yod rtag tu lus srog bsdom/ /bla ma la gus mched la brtse sems bskyed/ /zab gter rgya mtsho bshad dang sgrub pas mchod//bsnyen sgrub blo bde yid spro dga' brgya 'phel/ /mi nga'i kha la nyan na de ltar rems/ /chags sdang gza' dpon mi 'ong snying gi bu/ /kha mkhas dathon po mi shes rang sar skyur/ /log 'khrul dbang du ma gyur mgo bca' spongs/ /mi nga'i kha la nyan na de ltar rems/ /re bskang bshad na bdag gi shes mod kyang / /mi smra lkugs po bzhin sdod dam bca' yin//sems la 'chong shig snying gi nor bu lags/ /rgad po'i spring yig yin lags/ // slob bu 'gyur rgyam la gdams pa'i man ngag mtshangs rgol bzhugs so/ /pha cig bdud

༄༅// 'joms gling ba de/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod/ /mun pa'i khrod nas nyi ma shar/ /dge ba'i blo ldan snying gi bu/ /drin chen dga' ster sgob bu gson//'di snang sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur la/ /cha bzhag ma mchis ya ma zung / /blo gtad med do rdzun pa'i chos/ /rmi lam yul la zhen 'dzin chod/ /chos brgyad bya bzhag sna tshogs sgo/ /'dzad rgyu med pa'i gang ga bzhin/ /spyod na zhen log skyugs bros gnas/ /bden med rang sar 'jog par zhu// grags stong dbyar rnga'i sgra chen ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bsam mi khyab//chags sdang rtsod na snying po med/ /ne+e tsos co 'dri 'jog par zhu/ /rigs nus skye sgo thob thang ni/ /yun du mi rtags nam mkha' la/ /bya 'phur rjes tshol mi rnyed bshin/ /gol sa bzang po 'jog par zhu/ /zas nor rtsa shing sa gzhi la/ /gces spras grogs mkhar skyongs dang mtshungs/ /rang gis rang bcing mdo med las/ /don chung mkhon 'dzangs 'jog par zhu/ /dpa' yis mi brgya sod pa na/ /sdig pa'i ba dan kun gyis bsgrangs/ /mnar med gnas su sa bon lhung / /ya nga'i las de 'jog par zhu/ /'khor ba'i khyims thab bye ma'i

mkhar/ /nam phug mi thub chu yis 'jig bsogs 'jog byis pa'i zlos gar 'dra/ /dkor nor chos phyogs 'jog par zhu/ /zhing khams bkod pa'i yon tan la/ /bsgrangs na zad rgyu med mod kyang / /chen po'i 'bad rtsol 'o brgyal gnas/ /rang gzhi'i ngang la bzhugs par zhu/ /dam chos byin rlabs che tshul gyi/ /'gyur sngags bzlas pa zad mtha' bral/ /kha 'don mang po gol ba'i rgyu/ /grags stong rang sar 'jog par zhu/ /dag snang can gyi gzigs ngo la/ /ri lung thams cad sgrub pa'i gnas/ /bskor na 'dzad med ngal ba'i rgyu/ /rang sems nang nas bskor bar zhu/ /nyon mongs gnyen pos ma thul na/ /ri la song kyang 'grogs nas yod/ /dben par sems kyang baglu nyin gda'/ /rkyen sprad dug lnga 'bur 'joms zhu/ /rnam rtogs mthud na 'dzad rgyu med/ /rjes 'brang spyod pa sems can las/ /rnal 'byor bden med rtogs pa'i blos/ /rtsal sbyang shar grol mdzad par zhu/ /sangs rgyas med la sems can med/ /ngo bo nyid du dag mnyam rol/ /rang byung gnyug ma'i chos sku de/ /yang yang mjal 'phrad mdzad par zhu/ /ye rdzogs dus gsum bde gshegs de/

༄༅// /mi bsgom mi dor rtsis gdab bral/ /ku yang blo bde'i gnad theb na/ /bu khyod pha yi gdung zin lags/ /byis pa'i dus nas blo sems dwangs/ /sngon smon dag pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /da ni rang rig rtogs nas yod/ /bag 'don rtsal rdzogs brtan thob zhu/ /lha gcig o rgyan pad+ma yis/ /rjes su zin pa'i skyes bu khyed/ /nyon mongs 'dams su ma 'phyang dang / /mi ring dpal ri'i zhing la 'gro/ /gtam de snying la brten nus na/ /bla ma'i zhal gdams gnad du theng / /go yul tsam du lus pa na/ /chos dred 'dul dus mi 'ong lags/ /yang gcig rgad po'i ma ṇi bzhin/ /kha ta tshig gsum lab rgyu yod/ /snying gi nor bu 'gyur rgyam lags/ /ma brjed sems kyi dkyil du sbos/ /a ho/ /tshogs bsags las smon sbyang 'phro phun tshogs su gyur ba'i/ /dal 'byor yang dag rin chen bzang po la brten pa'i/ /zab gter rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag lung zin du bsngags pa'i/ /skyes chen khyed ni 'jig rten chos brgyad la ma g.yeng / /ldog bskum blo bstung dad mo'i snying rjes yis brlan phob/ /ces kyang dgos med dam pa'i lha chos la brtson 'tshal/ /mgo 'dren

kha ta'i grogs po ser sde ni mi 'dul/ /chos med sdig sems can gyis khrims chad du mthong 'ongs/ /long ba'i mig bzhin ma mthong yul du rang sgod thongs/ /blo 'dri gros 'debasabyed pa'i kha gsag mkhan mang yang / /lkugs pa'i ngag bzhin ma mthong mi shes sogs gsung 'tshal/ /pha ma drin gyis brkyang yang chags sdang gi ma brtse/ /bstan pa'i zhabs tog bsgrub kyang 'khon 'dzings kyis ma bslad/ /bshad sgrub lag rjes sems yang chos brgyad dang ma bsre/ /gcig pur sgrub tshugs zungs dang nyams rtogs ni 'bar nges/ /bsgrags kyi yang rdzongs mchog gi sgrub gnas su bsngags so/ /zangs ri mkhar dmar brten na sngon sbyang gi 'phro sad/ /mkha' 'gro'i 'du kug la brten nyams rtogs ni 'bar nges/ /brag lha mgon por brten na phyi nang gi rkyen sel/ /bcu gsum dus su g.yo chen ri gzur gyi nyams 'byung// bdun gyi rjes su rlabs chen rba 1nga gi rtsal zhabrug bzhi bcu'i skabs su rdo rje 'bebs pa rang shar 'ong / /lnga bcu nas bzung rig pa tshad thog la pheb nas/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bsam yas su 'bar ro/ /bde skyid gsar ba'i nyi ma 'od stong du

༄༅// rgyas nas/ /bstan pa'i sgron me phyogs rnams kun la yang sgrogs shing / /rdo rje snying po'i mdzad phrin yar zla ltar 'phel 'gyur/ /zhal chem dpe nang ma lhag sems thog la blang nas/ /pha nges rjes snyogs mdzod cig dam ldan gyis slob bu/ /sdom pa bsrung na gser mdog 'chang snga rang ma byed/ /byang sems ldan tshe chags sdang 'du 'dzi la ma 'khor/ /sngags la spyod kyang dam tshig 'chol snyogs su ma shor/ /thos tshogs g.yeng ba'i phyogs lhung gol sa la ma 'khrul/ /kha bshad tshig gi me tog mang bo la ma re/ /ces kyang lta sgom zab mo'i gnad gsang de skyongs dang / /gangs seng dkar mo'i bcud la skyen brjod ni mi mnga'/ /gser gling phyin nas sa rdo phal ba dag ma tshol/ /brgyud pa gong ma'i rjes snyogs man ngag la sbyor 'tshal/ /ces kyang nus ldan rdo rjes zhal chems su phul lags/ / / a ho/ //tshab tshub sna tshogs gzer gyis bsdam na yang / /blo sems bla mar dad pa'i nor dang ldan/ /chags sdang 'ur mo zing la dga' mod kyang / /lha gcig gu ru dga' ba'i paṇa grol lags/ /dug lnga'i sna la gnyen pos ma bcom na/ /zhal gnag kha ta mkhan po

dkon le 'dra/ rang sems zhi dul bag yod ma mdzad na/ zhal chem mtshang thog rgol ba dkon le 'dra/ /nges med gnas la bsnyen sgrub ma mdzad na/ /dkor kha grong chog dkor gyis baspus le 'dra/ /bla ma'i drung nas gdams ngag ma brten na/ /dad pa sgyu ma dred rgyud gyong le 'dra/ /drin chen kun la byams brtse ma mdzad na/ /su 'grogs sdang ba'i 'ug rgan nyin bud 'dra/ /de dag sems la zungs shig slob bu lags/ /kun nyis phul lo/ // bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye/ /yul yangs pa chen po'i grong khyer na/ /gzhi dbyings gcor 'das kun khyab yan/ /mdangs ma 'gags tshogs drug brag ri mtho/ /rtsal 'dod yon lnga'i snang ba dpe/ /rgyu gnyis 'dzin rgyal po 'ug rgan zhig 'dor ba' rtsa ba ngar 'dzin daze / /rtsal sna tshogs 'dab chags rlung la ldan/ /sems sems byu gi 'ari na pas dpe/ /don rtsa ba bsags pa'i ldon shing la/ /las sna tshogs bsags pa'i kun gzha dpe/ /skabs drod gsher rlan gyi bskyed pa'i 'dabs/ /las rlung 'gyu 'khri byas pa'i gsal cha dpe/ /'bras smin pa'i ma thog snying po la/ /de las kun gzhi'i rnams shes dngas gsal/ /khong rgyal po'i rngam pa'i tshul gyis rol/ / ra 'ari na zhu re pa des dpe/ /zas lhag ma
