༄༅// 'thor ba'i rtsal snang brgyag yid sgo lnga'/ rtogs tshogs dus kun tu de las 'byams pa'i skabs/ /nyin ma' 'bar yug tu 'byul ba'i dpe/ /bya khyung chen rgyal po'i ma bzod nas/ /rig pa'i ye shes kyi dpe rta cang shes 'phur ldan ltad mor mngag so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab dpe/ /de bden pa'i zhu ba thing ba'i tshe/ /'khrul snang tsam du zad pa'i cha des/ /dbyings nam mkha'i khams nas sprin gcig bsdus/ ga zag gi bdag med gtan dbab dpe/ /rno thog gi mde'u ngar ma bslang / /gzung ba chos bdag gtan dbab dpe/ /gdangs sgyu zuX/la ser rlung drag tu phab/ /khyad par ming gi gdab gzhi btsal/ /dngo sa po' rtags 'dzin bzhig pa/ phan gnod kyi mtshang la rgol ba/ /re dog gi rdzun phug gtug pa sogs man pa' dpe / /rgyu rgyal chen rno ba'i mde'us bsad/ /gzung 'dzin stong nyid du bshigs pa'i dpe/ /klong 'a gral mi shes pa'i sa ru bshig khyab brdal chen po gcig gi rol ba bdag med shes rab dpe/ /rtsal 'dab yang rang gis 'dzadar du bsdus/ sems sems byung thams cad ma yang rang sar rang grol sku gsum du sad pa'i dpe/ /da rang byung rdo rje'i rang tshugs zin/ /de dus rig pa'i yo lang pho por sad pa'i dpe/ /ha ha/ /ngo mtshar gad mo/ /ces kyang rang slob paṇa grol la sur+yas phul lo/ /

/ a ho/ /brgyud ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta ba ka dag spros bral 'dus ma byas/ /'di yin 'di min gza' gtad mtshan 'dzin bral/ /smra brjod spros pa'i gzeb tu dzad pa na/ /spros bral ka dag lta ba mi 'dra lags/ /sgom pa 'dzin med gang shar shugs 'byung ngang / /gud yangs blo bde rang sar 1da la zhog/ / bcas bcos 'dzin med dgag sgrub byed pa na/ /byar med don dam sgom pa mi 'dra lags/ /spyod pa bag yang rig pa'i rno so can/ /'khrul med gshis tshug zin pa de ga gnad/ /lta spyod phyogs 'chal gu re tha chad can/ /'dzin pa 'ur sob mkhan de mi 'dra lags/ /'bras bu sgrib bral rang gsal rjen pa de/ /'ub chub blo bral ye shes nang gsal can/ /bcos ma'i gzeb nas thon pa'i glo bur ba/ /glog 'gyu ltar de 'bras bu mi 'dra lags/ /bdag ni blun zhing rmongs pa'i mgo 'thum pa'i/ /rgyud pa'i gsung rgyun lung tshogs ma mthong ba'i/ /'di tsam las ni mthar thug go ma nus/ /bdag 'dra byang chad rmongs pa'i gang zang gis/ /stong 'dug byed rag 'di la gzigs na legs/ /dge'o/ // pha gcig dri med 'od zer/ /'bral med snying la

༄༅// brten bzhugs/ /ye nas chos rnams stong pa/ /mi gnas rmi lam rang bzhin/ /bden med bden par bzung bzung / /da ni stong par blo sbyong / /1 mi rtag rgyuma'i khang bu/ /chu yi rbu ba ji bzhin/ /rtag med rtag par bzung bzungs/ /da ni 'chi nges blo sbyong / /2 'di phyi gnyis kyi mtshams na/ /bar do'i rnam shes 'khyams po/ /lus medalus de 'grogs 'grogs/ /da ni snang tsam blo sbyong / /3 re rtogs gnyis kyi 'ching bas/ /dam sri phan gnod lha 'dre/ /med la yod par bcing bcing / /da ni rang snang blo sbyong /4 skye med rang byung lha sku// rang la ye nas rdzogs kyang / /'jur bo blo yis 'ching 'ching / /da ni snang stong blo sbyong / /5'gags med rtsa rlung thig le/ /rang gsal gzhug ma'ichos nyid/ /a 'thas blo yis bcos bcos/ /da ni rang bab blo sbyong / /6 lta ba chos sku'i rgyal po/ /spros bral zang thal brjod med// blo yis spros pas bcing bcing / /da ni skyemed blo spyong / /7 sgom pa longs sku dmigs med// zang thal gtad med rgya yan/ /gnyis 'dzin rtsol bas 'ching 'ching / /da ni 'dzin med blo sbyong / // spyod pa shugs 'byung sprul

sku/ /'dzin rtogs dmigs med blo 'das/ /phyogs chad blo yis bcad bcad/ /da ni 'khrul bral blo spyor/ /9 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku/ /rang gsal dag mnyams chen po/ /bdag gzhan gnyis su bltas bltas/ /da ni dag grol ngos bzungs/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i gter mdzod/ /g.yo med pad+ma las 'brel/ /bdag blo'i chu 'dzin mched nas/ /gdung ba'ichar rgyun nar mar/ khugs byung 'o dod shor byung / /'od snang 'ja' sku'i ri mor/ /rang snang rang la mngon mdzod/ /dge'o/ // a ho/ /'dir 'dus rdo rje'i mched lcam rnamasagason dang / /rgad po'i gtam la nyan rgyu zhig 'os 'dug / ci za ci 'thung 'dun pa de ma gtogs/ /bskyed rdzogs phyogs la thugs 'dangs ni mi 'tshal/ /bzlas brjod ngag ginus pa la thug kyang / /mkhris nad can la btso zan de sbyin 'dra/ /tshong dang kha rtsogs sna tshogs de bshad na/ /dran rig mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu de mdzad 'dug chos zhu dbang bskur tshogasagral du sleb skabs/ /nad kyis mnar bzhin mi 'dod kyang gnyid rmugs/ /sngon 'gro'i sgo tsam mthong dus ni rab mod/ /'on kyang rtsa rdzogs thob bzhin du je zhan/ /khreg thod zung

༄༅// brgal spyod lam ni chol snyogs/ /las mtha' log la som nyi yang ma mchis/ /phyi tshul dben pa'i sgo rgya de bsdam kyang / /nang nas grogs rnams phan tshun la rku 'phrog bsnyen sgrub gong ma'i rjes snyogs de mdzad kyang / /lkog nas bud med sbyor 'dod kyi re bas/ /la lung mang po brgal ba la ci cha/ /dad pa'i zhing sa bzang po yis bskul ba'i/ /skye bo mang po 'du 'tshogs kyi khrod du/ /mi nag las kyang dpa' gdeng ni mtho ba'i/ /ma mthong 'gro ba'i bstan pa la smod pa'i/ /las ngan khyi phag spyod pa de yi mug so thar mdzes pa'i me tog de 'chang ba'i/ /las ldan nyin skar tsam pa las ma mchis/ /sngags nag mgo sbu rna cha can mod kyang / /gsang chen nub rir phyogs pa'i rtags red na/ /mi nag kha nas bsgom skad de bshad kyang / /rdzogs bstan dbyings su sdud pa'i mdangs yin ya/ /sgom gdengs thob la rig ngo de shes snyams/ /da dung sems rig shan 'byed ni mi nus//stong nyid rtogs zer kha mig de bsgrad kyang / /tshig ngan gcig tsam lam du ni mi longs/ /byu ru'i mdang kyi zhal ngo nge bstan nas/ /zhe sdang 'bar ba'i sku lus kyang sbos thal/ /bud

med chags pa'i sred pa de ma bor/ /gcig bor gnyis dor gsum brtse sogs mdzad nas/ /da dung gnyis gob chod pa yi spyod bskyangs/ /sems can ma rig mgo 'khor ba rnamasakyis/ /brtul zhugs gdeng thob rnal 'byor la mi brten/ /mig 'phrul zob rdzun mkhan tsho la re 'cha'/ /'di phyi'i 'dun ma nyes lam du shor song / /nga dang 'dra ba'i slob dponazhig yod na/ /deng 'dir mtshungs pa'i slob tshogs dang los ldan/ /dpon slob grab bzang ngo mtshar can yod na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs khrel kyang los shor/ /a rog snyingagi bu tsho la brtse phyir/ /kha ngan tshig gi mda' mo zhig 'phang yod/ /a ho rtse mtshar bshad pa yin ma gtogs/ /mtha' mi kla klo'i rdzas sngags de btsan pas/ /rang dbang rang la mi thob pa'i dus yin/ /thugs khag med kyang bya spyod ni rtsub 'dug sngar byas las la bag zon re mdzad nas/ /da 'byung dgos pa'i so nams ni 'di ltar/ /kha ngo dkon mchog sna ring la blta zhing / /'dun phug phyi ma'i don gnyer la brtson nas/ /dgos med 'khor ba'i bya bzhag de stongs la/ /chags sdang pham rgyal brtsod mtha' la ma re/ /so thar mdzes

༄༅// pa'i me tog gis spras nas/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu'i bsrung mtshams la gzob dang / /mnyam med thub pa'i rjes zin de ngo mtshar/ /byang sems snying rje'i gtongadang ldan pa'i/ /sbyin sogs phar phyin rgya mtsho'i sgo 'byed cing / /stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug tu bsgom dang / /spyan ras gzegs kyi bu chen de los yin/ /rang ngos lta gangemathon po zhig thob nas/ /sgyu ma'i yul la zhen med gya brtul zhugs/ /spyod lam dam tshig sel med pa rnam dag /brtson na o rgyan pad+ma yi gdung 'dzin/ /rang rig chos sku rtonges zhig min na/ /gzhan la dbang bskur byed pa de mi rung / /bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i drod rtags de med par/ /drag las 'ur zing gto sgrub tshos ci bya/ /dus gsum mngon rnam dag zhig med na/ /rmi lam 'khrul ba'i rjes 'brang kyang don med/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i lung byang zhig med na/ /lha mthong 'dre mthong bslu tshig de ma smra/ /gshin po'i rnashes gar song zhig go dgos/ /de min mtho ris 'dren 'dod kyang dka' nges/ /a khu rnams ni tshong ba re mtshar kyang / /'chi bdag gshin rjer bu lon de sod dka'/ bu

skyed 'phel skor kha la mkhas kyang / /lag stong mchan bcug 'gro dus su ci 'jal/ /grub min grub 'dras 'gro blo de bsgyur kyang / /ston 'khor dmyal gnas 'grims dus su ci bya//zog po g.yo rgyu can tsho yi tshe sgog /bya rog gtsug phud mnga' ba des 'drongs mdzod/ /gter min gter 'dras sa steng kun khyab nas/ /bka' sku ris 'jog sna tshogs su byed nas//ma mthong 'gro ba lam log du skyol te/ /shi tshad rdo rje'i gnas ngan du drangs ba'i/ /rdzun pa de dag ma tshogs ni mkha' 'gros// ming tsam med pa'i brtul zhugs la dgongs 'tshal//mi nag nga yi kha tshig la nyan na/ /phyi ma ma gtogs 'gro sa ni mi 'dug 'khor ba'i bya bar snying po gang med do/ /'jig rten chos brgyad rgyab du rang bor la/ /bsgos gral gtam gral mdo med la ma rgyug rang lam dam pa'i lha chos de 'grub dgos/ /dran shes bag yod zab mo yi rgyud bsdam/ /chos min bya bzhag ci nas kyang spongs lags/ /nyon mongs dugalnga 'bur 'joms la rem bzla/ /gser gling phyin nas stong log de ma mdzad/ /dam chos sang byed gnang sgrub tu ma lhag rdzas ngan kha sna'i du ba de ma spyod/ /myos byed kha zas 'bru

༄7// chang ni ma btung / /'ching byed bu med shag rog de dor mdzod/ /rtse gcig yan lag dge ba la blo gtugs/ /'chi 'ong snyams pa'i yi mug de ma bskyur/ shar grol dus mnyams chen po yi gnad skyongs/ /zhen med brtul zhugs mchog gsang gi sa zungs/ /ri dwags smas bzhin dben pa la brten 'tshal/ /dam tshig mngon skog med pa zhig rem rem/ /'dul khrims srog gtar 'dzin pa la brtson mdzod/ /byams dang snying rje'i go cha de bsgos nas/ /gzhan phan don gnyer 'gro don la ma 'byug 'dod chung chog zhes brten rgyu la sbyor 'tshal/ /blo rtse mi rgod bla ma la gdengs bca'/ /thamal 'khrul 'byams ma shor ba zhig dgos/ /da lta 'chi yang blo lhag de med mdzod/ /'di bde phyi skyid bsam na yang rang lag / 'khor ba'i gting rdo byed pa po'i phang kye/ /chos log dam nyams bka' log zhig ma mdzad/ /a rog slob tshogs thugs la re 'jog 'tshal/ /don ldan shes tshod snying gtams de yin la/ /ha ha/ /sngar dus rgya bod bstan mchog de dar dus/ /ngur rmig rab byung 'dul ba yi sde dang / /gos dkar lcang lo gsang sngags kyi sde las/

/pon tan rdzogs tshul las gzhan ni ma mchis/ /deng 'dir chos lugs 'dra min de sna tshogs/ /bzang rtags ci yin ngan mtshang ni yos yin/ /bskyed rdzogs rlung sems dbang thob kyi rnal 'byor/ /mtshan ldan shes rab dga' bzhi yis gzhur 'drongs/ /dper na rma byas dug spyod bzhin rgyan 'gyur/ /so skyes der 'gran dam sdom de ral nas/ /bya phran dug spyod srog rtsa de chad 'gyur/ /de bzhin thar ba'i lam sna de 'gag 'gro theg chen rnal 'byor gsang sngags la los spyod/ /dman pa rnams kyis 'dul khrims la gzab 'tshal//ce'i phyir rdo rje'i dmyal gnas su sdug che/ shal ma li yi sdong po de khrims drang / /brjed med kha ta sems dkyil du zungs lags/ /nged rang dpon slob phan tshun de kun gyis//zur za phrag dog 'thab mo de spongs la/ /brtse sems dad pa dag snang dang ldan pa'i/ /lta spyod gong ma'i rjes snyogs la brtson nas/ /ma hā gu ru'i bsnyen sgrub de byas la/ /tshogs bsogs sgrib sbyang 'phags nor la rem dang / /tshom bu bsdab nas dpal ri yi pha khyims/ /gdod nas kun bzang rgyal sa la chas 'gro /rang rig pad 'byung mjal ba de ngo mtshar/

༄༅// /dam nyams log zhabrul bdud dbang la ma 'gro rang re lhan skyes rdo rje yi gnas su/ /bzod par dka' ba'i zug rngu de myong dgos/ /de phyir bag yod gzob pa ni lhur longs/ /glen nag tshig tshogs tsit+ta la sbrum 'tshal/ /da sngon brgyud pa rin chen gyi gser thag zab gter pha phog bsgo skal du mchis shing / /snang srid chos skur rtogs pa yirnal 'byer/ /grub pa'i sar gshegs kho na las med mod/ /dam sems rkyen gyi 'khri bag de ma zhugs/ /bya yis rtse 'jor dam sri des bslad kyang / /brtul zhugs gdengs skyong bar chad dang bral song / /nga rang yun du i sdod ni mi shes/ /khyed rnams smon lam las 'phro dang ldan pas/ /pha gcig skyabs mgon bla ma de'i rjes snyogs/ /ces slob ma'i tshogasarnams kyis bdag la dad 'dun nyi ma shar ba lta bu re yod kyang / /rkyen dbang la 'gro nye 'dug pa 'ga' re la snying brtse ba'i kha ngan tshig gi zhu ba de phul ba'o/ /mi 'dangs dang ldanapa rnams kyis gdams ngag mtshang thog tu rgol ba yin// glo spro che zhing zhe sbos pa rnams kyis khang khro ldang thang / /ha ha/ // kye kye gson mdzod snying gi bu mchog rang rgyud nyon

mongs dug lnga 'di la//gnyen po dam pas 'bur 'joms kyis lags// khams gsum mi rtag byis pa'i chos la/ /'dzin zhen rtsa ba chod na dge'o/ /phyi nang sgod bcud stong nyidachen po/ /'di la cung zad brtag dbyad mdzod cig rang byung bsal bzhag bral ba'i chos sku/ /bsgom gyi de nyid yin no bu mchog kun rdzob don dam dbyer med mnyam nyid/ /spyodapa'i yang snying yin no gtan tshogs/ /the tshomasamed do rang byung rig sku/ /mngon gyur gdengs thob chen po 'bras bu/ /ces so/ / / brgyud pa dgu ldan khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang //rig 'dus mtshan ldan bla mar dad brgyas 'dud/ /ha ha/ /cing mi shes byis pa'i co 'dri lta bu'i gdams pa 'di lta ste/ yi/ /nam mkha' mi nga la smin no/ /gzhi grol gyi chos skurashes 'dug// stong chad du lhag par mi gda'/ /rdzogs chen gyi mnyam nyid go byung / rang grol gyi rig pa'i ye shes/ /'od gsal du 'char bar 'dug go /sems tsam du lhag parami gda'/ /rtsol bral gyi rig par thag chod/ /thams cad kyang stong nyid go yang / /dge sdig kyang phra ba kun nas/ /spang len la zhib cha byed pa'i/ /rtogs grol gyi yon tan 'char

༄༅// mdzod/ /rang rig pa chos sku chen po/ /gzung 'dzin des sgrib pa bral te/ /rgya grol gyi yon tan mthong nas/ /khyab bdag gi sangs rgyas thob shog ha ha/ /ces kyang kun nyis bris song / / a ho/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs don gyi lha sku la ltos dang / /rtsol bcas blo yi bcos ma'i rnam rtog de'i ci bya/ /ye nas rtsa thig rlung gsum sku gsung thugs kyis rol ba/ /re togs chags pa'i mdud rtsi'i 'dzin ltab sa de'i ci bya// har sangs rgya yan dmigs med stong chen gyi 'khor lo/ /kha 'byams tshig tsam stong rkyang lta ba de'ici bya/ /da lta'i shes rig ma bcos ka dag ni gnyug ma/ /'dzin rtsol 'khrul ba'i mun sgom sdug khur re'i ci bya/ /rig pa sems su mi yengs don dam gyi rtsa ba/ /bcos ma'i lamagyis bsre bslad spyod pa de'i ci bya/ /rang la rang sangs rgyas pa gdod ma yi chos sku// bden zhen yul du blta ba'i 'bras bu de'i ci bya/ /gzung 'dzin mnyam nyid dbyings su sgrolaba'i gnad med na/ /phaṭa sgra khros pa'i tshul 'chos gcod pa de'i ci bya/ /'khor 'das sgyu 'phrul rtogs pa'i zab gnad zhig med tshe/ /grong chog 'dre brdung lta bu'i gto yas de'i ci

bya/ /zung 'jug byang sems ma bcos ye gnas kyi bdag nyid/ /phyogs chad ris su 'dzin pa'i snying rje de'i ci bya/ /ha ha da ni ces kyang rang sar du bskyur thong / /sur+yas rang labris so/ / / a ho/ /mi med kyi dben par sdod dang/ /nyams rtogs kyi yon tan 'char 'ong / /dkon mchog la blo phug gtod dang / /'di phyi yi dge 'bras thob lags/ /'khora'adas chos ro mnyam mdzod dang / /stong nyid kyi lta ba rtogs 'ong / /ye dbyings su rang bab klod dang / /har sangs gi gnas lugs rtogs 'ong / /bzang ngan gyi re drogs chod dang //khyab byed kyi spyod pa de'o/ /rang byung la rang gdengs thob tshe/ /mthar thug gi ngo bor 'pho lags/ /ha ha/ / / kye ma/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba chod dang / /yul rtog a 'thas zhigagorang skyon rang gi dpyod dang / /grogs la skyon blta zhig 'ong / /sgo gsum rdo rjer rol dang / /byin rlabs mi ring 'jug 'ob / /dug lngar zhen 'dzin chod dang / /chos brgyad 'du 'dzi dben 'ong / /rang tshugs rang gis zungs dang / /bar chad bdud las rgyal lo/ /stong chen lta bar klod dang / /chos nyid kho na rtogs so/ /gzhir gnas lhun grub shes na/

༄༅// /yul med sangs rgyas thob lags/ /tshig 'di 'gyur rgyam bskul ngor/ /sprul ming kun nyis phul lo/ // a ho/ /sems nyid gdod nas ye sangs rgyas mod kyang / /log rtog dbang gis gzung 'dzin rab tu 'thas/ /ma rig dug lnga'i yo lang zhig pa'i phyir/ /thad dkar gcod pa'i gnas lugs skyongs ba nas/ /ye shes kun gyi gsang bamajal bar 'gyur/ /mi med gnas mchog brten na 'du 'dzi nyung / /gdams ngag sgog dang bsdos tshe 'dun ma 'grub/ /dran shes bag yod bsdam na lam la gzhol/ /zung 'jugathod rgal bsgom na tshe gcig grol/ /dam tshig mngon lkog med pas dge legs 'phel// ces kyang sur+yas phul lo/ // skyemed gnas lugs rtogs na/ /kun bzang dgongs paragrol 'dug/ /'gag med rig stong rtogs na/ /thog ma'i gzhi ru grol 'dug 'dzin med sor bzhag rtogs na/ /bla med gnas lugs yin 'dug khyab brdal chen po rtogs na//'bras bus rgyal por grol 'dug ha ha/ // e ma chos stong nyid bral ba'i blun sgom de'i/ /ye grol ba'i sa de kye ma kye/ /blo thos skam ko ba snyogs ma yis/ /lar 'bras bu 'byin

pa nga re mtshar/ deng tshe gang lus ngag dge sbyor las/ /mi sgom pa'i sgom par ces mi 'bad/ /las sde snod gsum shes 'chi ba las/ /ngang cog bzhag thabs la gcig gis dga'//kha mkhas pa'i chos bshad nga rgyal bas/ /don nyams myong rang rgyud lon na rab/ /mi sngun tsam dben par sdod pa las/ /sems nyon mongs ma zhen dben pa yin/ /tshul btsunagazugs chos brgyad bya ba las/ /nang 'dzin pa'i btsun na dge slong mchog /gcod zer nas phaṭa sgra drag po las/ /phyi'i gzung ba'i yul la zhen pa chod/ /bskyed sgom la 'badapa'i brtson drag las/ /yid bla mar mos gus byas pas bzang / /ngag stong skad mthon po'i kha bkang rag don zhen pa ldog na rtags kyis bsdam/ /sgom 'bad rtsol dran pas bcingab las/ /thag gcig thog chod na las de 'grub// las dge med sdig med brjod mi rung / /chos kun rdzob lam gyi mtshang rdol 'ong / /chags sred pas nag mo dang 'grogs na//srid 'khor ba 'ching ba'i lcags sgrogs yin/ /rgyu g.yo rgyu'i rdzun dang dmod pa spongs/ /las rgyu 'bras sdug bsngal rang thog ldang / /yul mtshan ma can gyi zhing khams la/ /blo

༄༅// dben par sems pas grol 'dod kyang / /sems rmongs pa'i bya bzhag de ka sbongs rkyen bag chags bral ba'i rig pa ni/ /sems da lta'i zang ka ma 'di yin//gzhi rig pa'i dus na sems 'dzin med/ /sems zhen pa'i dus 'dir rig pa min/ /de gnyis ka ngo bo gcig nyid kyang / /chu chab rom lta bu'i brda khyab yod/ /yid zhes bya sgo lnga'i rten gzhi yin/ /de ye shes dbyings la nor srid kyang / /gud yang dog ngos nas 'dra mi srid/ /gzhi zhes bya'i ka dag khyab cing brdal/ /yul spros bral har sangs yan pa'i klong //rtsal ma 'gags chos la zhen rtsol spongs/ /gnad de ldan grol ba thag mi ring / /'di sems la 'chong mdzod slob bu rnams/ // a ho/ /skal ldan de rigs pa'i bu chung / /med gcig dang phyal bar ltos dang // khyab brdal gyi lta ba rtogs 'ong / /ngang gnas su 'byams klas mdzod dang / /rig stong gi sgom de mthong 'ong / /'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs//yul med du spyod dang spyod pa/ /phan gnod kyi mtshang la rgol dang / /zhen med kyi gzhi ru grol lags/ /gnad 'ga' re 'di la yod pas/ /thugs dkyil du bzung kyang khrel med/

/rang slob mchog pad+ma kun grol/ /snying brtse'i gtam sur+yas bris so/ /dge'o/ // bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chosi kun rtsa ba sngon 'gro'i rgyud sbyangs nas/ /thun min 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po la/ /ngang gnas mngon gyur thabs mchog yangs zab lam/ /lta ba sgom pa spyod pa rnam pa gsum/ /dang po med gcig phyal ba lhun grub bzhi/ /yul dang yul can kun tu btags pa'i chos/ /stong pa nyid dbyings rtogs pa med pa dang / /stong pa de yang bem stong ma song ba/ /rig pa gcig tu rdzogs pa gcig pu'i don/ /spros pa'i mtha' bral rnam thar gsum gyi bdag skyon yon gang gis ma bslad phyal ba'i don/ /sku dang ye shes yon tan rgyal mtsho'i chos/ /ye dbyings klong du rdzogs pa lhun grub ste// tshul bzhin rtogs par gyur na lta ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbyings gsum gcig tu 'dres pa'i dbyings/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /ka dag lam rig zang thal smra brjod bral// ngo 'phrod ngang der ma bor sgom pa'o/ /re dwogs dgag sgrub spang blang 'dzin zhen bral/ /yar gyi sa sa rgyas mar gyi sems can dang / /bzang po lha dang gnod byed 'dre bo che/ /gang la chags

༄༅// bral spyod pa'i rgyal po ste/ /lta spyod gnad du bzung ba mchog tu bsngags/ /nang dbyings gzhon nu bum sku'i rgyal sa cher/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lnga tshan rnams/ /lhun rdzogs dbyings su kun bzang chos drug brtes/ /'bras bu'i chos mchog bla med e ma ho/ /de ltar gdam ngag bdud rtsi'i yang bcud 'di/ /dad pa ldan pa'i slob bu rig rdor la/ /sprul ming tsam 'dzin spyon pa ma rung ba/ /kun bzang nyi ma zhes bya'i bris pa dge legs so/ /sarba maṅga lam̐/ // a ho/ /lugs gnyis rnal 'byor dam pa/ /rgad po'i ngag la gsan dang / /kha ta tshig gsum bshad do/ /skye lus gcig la brten nas/ /don mang 'grub par mi 'gyur/ /grong chog 'dre brdung ma mdzad/ /ngar 'dzin rtsad nas chod dgos/ /gshin la zab dbang bskur na/ /rang rig chos sku rtogs dgos/ /sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs na/ /kun slob rnam dag yod dgos/ /gzhan la phan 'dogs bsam na//lhag bsam rnam dag yod dgos/ /rdzogs chen rig pa rtogs na/ /rkyen khyags bzod pa yod dgos/ /lta ba stong nyid shes na/ /'dod yon zhen pa chod dgos/ /zhabrul bral spyod

pa rtogs na/ /rgyu 'bras mi rmongs mkhyen dgos/ /dad pa mos gus yod na/ /gang snang dag mnyam 'char dgos/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'dod na/ /dben par sgrub tshudagos/ /'khor ba'i gting rdo bsam na/ /nyon mongs 'chol nyog mdzod cig kha lta stong skad mtho yang / /mdog ngan kha nas ston no/ /ral ba lcang lo bcing na/ /'chi du ma lhag sngags pa gos dkar 'chang na/ /sdig rgan sgog gcod ma mdzad/ /bsgru med rnal 'byor bsam na/ /mdo med rnam g.yeng ma byed/ /grub zin med pa'i bya bzhagarang sar gcod mdzod/ /dag pa'i zhing khams sems na/ /pad 'byung sprul pa'i 'dabs su/ /brten la zhal gsung zab sgrub/ /deng sang mgo spu can mang / /gson kyamed pa/ kha 'chal stong skad sgrogs so/ /dga' sdug nam mkha'i gar 'dra/ /'tshubs gzeng rong klong chu ltar/ /mi bde'i la yog ston pa'i/ /gang zag de 'dra thams cad/su nye bad mi 'dod// sems gcong can dag ga chad/ /de 'dra'i lan mo ma byed/ /bdag 'dra kun nyi ming gis// sngags pa sang mi nyid la/ /gus pas zhu 'dzar phul lo/

༄༅// /sarba maṅga le/ /a ho/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs ye dag spros bral gyi gshis su/ /'dod yon ma spang 'khor 'das dag mnyam gyi tshogs 'khor/ /rtsol med rangango shes pa'i khyad chos la pheb nas/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan zung 'jug rgyal sa de zhu'o/ /a haṃ dbyer med mnyam nyid zhu bde rang sbar nas/ /'khor lo bzhi ldan thabs shes lto sbyor gyitshogs 'khor/ /zhen med bde stong dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal la pheb nas/ /stong nyid mthar phyin gnyug ma'i sangs rgyas de zhu'o/ /ka dag brdal khyab yangs pa chos nyid kyi klong du//lhun grub 'gags med sku dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'khor/ /har sangs rgya yan spros bral 'du 'tshogs la pheb nas/ /rig stong rang sangs rgyas pa'i chos sku de zhu'o/ /e ma dga'oskyid do rang snang gi 'du 'tshogs/ /sgom med yengs med rang byung ye grol gyi ngang nas/ /skye med dbyings su grol ba'i smon 'dun rang zhu'o/ /ces kyang rnal 'byor bī ma'i bskul ngoranus ldan pas bris pa'o/ // e ma/ /gnas kyiphun sum tshogs pa ka dag gi zhing na/ /lhun grub ston mchog blo 'das rang byung gi chos sku/ /ma 'gags ye shes rtsal snang sprul pa

yi 'khor tshogs/ /mnyam nyid dgongs pa zang thal chos nyid kyi 'khor lo/ /dus gsum ro mnyam slong chen yangs pa ru bskor nas/ /khyad chos drug ldan bum sku'i bzhugs tshul dengo mtshar/ /tsit+ta rang byung lhun grub dpal mchog gi ri bo/ /rigs kun yongs 'dus ngo bo o rgyan gyis slon dpon/ /tshogs brgyad rnam dag rje 'bangs paṇa grub gyi tshom bu/ /gangashar rang grol rig pa'i ye shes kyi chos 'khor/ /'bral med mi sheg thig le'i dwangs ma ru bskor nas/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan mjal ba de ngo mtshar/ /ye nas dag mnyam yumalnga'i klong chen gyi zhing 'dir/ /rang snang sprul pa ston mchog sems dpa' ru shar te/ /dgongs spyod rnam dag lhar snang rdzogs pa yi mched lcam/ /'gro 'dren gdug pa 'dul byedadrag po yi zab lam/ /tshogs gnyis gcig char rdzogs pa'i ga ṇa de tsakra'i/ /rmad byung myur lam zab mo'i gsang sgo de phyes nas/ /lha mchog lag na rdo rje'i tshom bu la ngo mtshar//'dir 'tshogs dpon slob rgyu 'byor yon bdag gi gtsor byas/ /'gro khams rgya mtsho ma lus rab 'byams kyi grong khyer/ /mi ring bcu gsum rdo rje'i rgyal sa rang zin pa'i/ /myur

༄༅// 'grub bkra shis smon pa'i dge mtshan la drangs te/ /thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa'i rten 'brel zhig zhu'o/ /nus ldan pas so// a ho/ /'khor 'das gyi snang ba sna tshogs su shar yang / /rang ngos su brtags na bden med kyi rol pa/ /'dzin byed kyi shes pa thol chol du 'phro yang / /sor rtog gis dpyad na gar song rang cha med/ /bdag gzhan khya gnyis su sbrel mar la 'dug kyang / /bdag med kyis brtags tshad 'ching byed de chad do/ /tshogs brgyad kyi shes pa ji ltar du 'gyu yang / /ngo bo de 'pho 'gyur spu tsam yang med do/ /chos kun gyis rtsa ba chos nyid du gcig pas/ /khyab brdal de rtogs gom myong ba zhig thob na/ /rang grol gyi rig pa'i lta ba ru 'dug go/ ji ltar du 'dzin byed phra ba nas chod dgos/ /rtog dpyod ni sems pa yin pas na gzhom dgos/ /thad grol gyi rig pa dus gsum las 'das pa'i/ ye shes gang rjen par byung ba las mi spro/ /rgya chung gi shesapa cor chung la mi bsdud/ /stong 'dug gi ngang la had po ru mi brgyal/ /gsal 'byams gyi gshis la zhen pa yis mi bcad/ /rang byung girig pa gsal sangs yang rjen pa/ /klong

chen gyi dbyings la mnyam nyid du 'jog pa/ /ka dag gi rang bzhin bsgom pa ru 'dug go/ /nyin mtshan du bar med rang rig gi gdangs 'dzin/ /bab chol gyi spyod pa chol nyogs sumi bya// gang shar gyi rol ba sgyu ma ru lam khyer/ /rig pa yi ye shes 'dzin pa ru mi gol/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa bden med du mi bskyur/ /dge sdig gi las la 'jug ldog re gzababo/ /mos gus dang brtse gdung snying rje yang gal che/ /mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin rgyu rdzas la mi 'khrul/ /sngon byon gyi dam pa gong ma yi mdzad srol/ /ci bzhin tu 'jug pa grogs chen gyi spyod pa/ /yang snying 'dir gom 'dres zhib cha re byas na/ /pha gcig gi brgyud pa'i myur lam la zin te/ /rang snang gi zhing la grol ba ni ci cha/ /snying dkyil du zung dang mdo rtsa ru nges so/ /bag med du ma 'khrul drin chen gyi ma rgan/ /kha skad de mthon po kun nyis rang bris dge kye ho/ /sngon smon las gyi 'brel ba yi slob ma/ /dad brgya'i ge sar g.yo 'dud kyi sbyin bdag 'dod 'bras ci bzhin rtsol ba yi pho nya/ /'dun phug phyi mar re ba po'i snying nor/ /dam tshig srog gi sbrel ba khyed gson dang / /'dir snang rgyu ma'i gar bsgyur gyi

༄༅// skabs 'dir/ /gnyen grogs mi rtag tshong mgron tsho'i dpe bzhin/ /'dod yon bden med rtsa 'go yi zil ba/ /chos brgyad mdo med rmi lam la spyod bzhin//chags sdang pham rgyal grub zin gang ma mchis/ /kha gcig gos phyir sdug chen du ma ltar/ /rang mgo thon na gzhan mgo kyang phar zad/ /sgyu ma'i yul la sdod grab re ma 'cha' daskabs khyed rang phyed bral gyi snang ba/ /sdug chen mi theg khur lci 'di ci'i phyir/ /yi mug zhe chags bzod med du byung ba/ /'dus byas rang gi mtshangs ngan de bstan gyis/ /rgyal bgong ma'i mi rtag tshul gsungs phyir/ /baspu ba med kyi sems gnad de bag klod/ /tshe rab thog med dus skabs nas da bar/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi zug rngu la dus 'da'/ /skyesanas bzung ste 'chi ba de chos can/ /khyims thabs brtsi na nam zhig la los bral/ /za dga' 'thung skyid 'dod yon la longs spyod/ /lus 'dir sdug bsngal sna 'ga' re sbyangs phyir//nad kyis mnar ba don med du mi 'gyur/ /dge ba'i ra mda' khyad 'phags zhig 'grub 'dug khyod rang phyis su lhag pa yi 'bras bu/ /sdug rgyu med par nges pa'o bu chung / /bzang

grogs dgos mthun brgya stong re yod kyang/ /thams cad mi rtag pa ste 'di'i rab bzhin/ /dge sdig las la 'jug ldog re gzab 'tshal/ /mi chen gol sa ma 'dzin par dman mdzod/ /'dir snang sgyu ma yun ring du ma 'khrul/ /bu lon kha skyed ma spel bar sod chug /blo sna mang pos don chen ni mi 'grub// zas gos thabs mi sdug pa re bsags nas/ /phyi ma'i don gnyer 'grub thabs la rem rem/ /khyer rang shi gson gang thad nas yin kyang / /dad mos yid ches dga' gdung yang brgya 'phel/ /rnam bzhag bgrangs mi dgos nges yin zher lhag rgad po'i rgyud la phan byed kyi gso sman/ /gang yang ma mchis chu dkrubs las mar bzhin/ /'on kya mchog gsum thugs rje yi bsil zer/ /pha gcig o rgyan pad+ma yi thugs rje/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gser thag gi mthu yis/ /brgya ma re na phan pa re 'byung srid/ /sems kyi gshis nyams rmi lam gyi brtags 'bras/ /kun nas dpyad pa 'di 'dra zhig red bsnyams/ /gshin po'i las snang myo rgyud phyogs zhig na/ /grogs bzang gza' mi gnyis pa yi bu mo/ /dge ba'i blo ldan dam chos la brtson pa'i/ /skal bar ldan kyang

༄༅// rgyu mthun la gol sred/ /tshe rabs sgrib sbyangs dur rme des mnar thang / /de 'phos bag chags lus snang de lnga nas/ /gser zhol rin chen bzang po zhes gragasal/ /o rgyan las 'phro gling pa yi rjes 'dzin/ /chos ldan skye ba rnam gsum dang ldan nas/ khro bha la ru dag pa yi rten 'byor/ /rdzun gtam bshad na zad rgyu ni med mod/ /'khrulaba'i ngag la bzhad mo re shor srid/ /dam tshig nyam chags sbyangs phyir la satwa'i/ /bzlas pa 'bum phrag dri bshags rgyud stong tshar/ /lha skal dri med dkar po yi snang bsnyen/ /chosaskal ma ṇi bka' 'bum re gal che/ /'od mdo brgya rtsa lhung bshags yang stong tshar/ /gnad smin grub na snyigs thog zhig yin bsnyams/ /gson po'i bya bzhag tshe mjug la skad cigasngon 'gro'i rgyud sbyangs dge 'dun gyi tshul 'dzin/ /bya ba rigs gnas sna tshogs la mi 'byams/ /lha gcig o rgyan pad+ma de gtsug brten/ /kha ngo dkon mchog rnam gsum la gtadacing / /'dun phug phyi ma'i don gnyer la 'bad nas/ /las sna 'khor ba ru log zhig brtson de/ /nyams len rnal ma'i ye shes de gcer byung / /'dzin med 'od gsal rtogs pa yi

gdengs bskyed/ /lta gdengs thob pa'i bshes gnyen de bsten nas/ /dal khom med par lha chos la brtson pas// tshe 'phro thung ngu'i nam phug ni mi thub/ /'ja' tshon lta bu'i 'khorab la ma zhen/ /grub zin med pa'i bya 'phro de cham zhog gnas mal longs spyod dka' tshegs la ma bsre/ /sdug bsngal khyim thabs yang 'dzin rang ma byed/ /'dun ma mthar thugatshags su re tshud na/ /bla ma rabs mnyes sgrub pa yi maṇ+ḍal/ /sa steng nor gyis bkang nas bdag mchod las/ /chos tshul zin na de yis ni dga' nges/ /gdam ngag zhal ta mang potsho mi shes/ /rgad po'i tshig nyung don 'dus 'dir 'bad na/ /bsam pa dkar po'i kha ta 'di las lhag/ tsit+ta phyung yangs sha lang zhig los yin/ /ngag la drangs na tshig ngan re smrargyu/ /de bas med do bu khyod kyi sems 'byor/ /'phral gyi rkyen bzlog tshig bdun pa 'bum ther/ /phur bsnyen bye ba 'khor 'bar ya khri ral/ /gdugs dkar khri bzlog sgrol mdang bsam lhun/ /gnad smin byas na phan bde yang los 'char// zang zing 'byor ba sngar nas yang bsam yas/ /da skabs dngos 'byor rab tu ni spros pas/ / blang yang darkare de

༄༅// zhus na so ngo mtshar/ /bsam pa'i mgu ba chen po ru lhag go rigs bdag gtsugs rgyan mun sel ni zung dang / /rin chen mig mang gser mdangs kyis sbud tha // bcu phrag gnyis pha kha tshar dang bcas so/ /bkra shis spos rgya'i mdangs 'dzin pa'i lha reg dri med dkar po in+t+ra dang byu ru'i/ /mdog 'char ku mud gzugs bkra ba'i sgod bzang / /legs pa'i pad+ma la dza yi phra ldan/ /gzung 'dzin a dar+sha yi rang bkod pa/ khes rab rang bzhin khu byug gi rgyan bzang / /'dung ma dbang mdogaphra gsum gyis mig padzes/ /reg 'jam paṇa tsa mched ldan de che bas/ /zhwa mo rin chen kha sgogs dang bcas so/ /'bru bcud zhun mar gtam pa yi zhal bum/ /bkra shis lha dar dkar po dang bcas nas/ /legs par 'phro nas ngag lam gyi 'phrin ltar/ /gos dang rgyan bzang bdag gis rang byed lags/ /khyad par sems bskyed dmigs 'dun de bzang po/ /ldan tshod dag gis da kyil 'khor gyi zhal phye/ /sdug bsngal rang grol chos 'khor de bskor nas/ /tshe 'das gtsor byas mkha' khyab kyi 'gro kun/ /'khrul snang rmi lam rang sa la bsgral nas/ /ka dag

dang tho'igazhi thog la grol ba'i/ /bsam pa bzang po gser 'dra zhig 'dzin dang / /nam mkha' med kyang gsang sngags de los yod/ /rgad po nyon mongs rmag rum la bying yang //rig pa'i nyi ma cung zad zhig mthong bas/ /gshin gson bde skyid ldan pa la bkod thang / /a re grogs po sems sdug rang ma byed/ /sgyu mar skyid sdug byas pa po'i ci bya/ /ga ler mkho nges dam chos 'di red pas/ /'grub thabs ma 'chugs nan zhus zhig yin ya/ /bdag snang sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor gyi bkod pa/ /yun ring zhig la thub chags kyang byas med//ma shi bar du dpon slob rang legs smon/ shaṃ yang dag pa'i zhing khams su tshom bur/ /'tshogs ba'i rten 'brel che ba ni de tsam/ /ces kyang lcags khung sprul ming tsam 'dzin pa//kun bzang nyi ma zhes 'bod pa de yis/ /ma legs nas khal gcig phyed dang bcas phul/ /'byor 'dzar yi ge de tsam las ma khom/ /sarba maṅga le/

༄༅// e ma rigs kyi bu mchog /rgad po'i ngag la gson mdzod/ /nga med bdag tu 'dzin pa'i// 'khor ba'i 'dre bo che de/ /yul med zang thal ngang du/ /phaṭa ces brjod la bsre mdzod//'khor 'das chos kun gang la/ /rtsol bsgrub re rtogs ma byed/ /de nyid yin lugs dngos pos// dgra gnyen chags sdang 'khor lo/ /de ni 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa/ /ro snyom ngang du bskyur mdzod// chos kun rtsa ba sems nyid/ /yul rkyen gang dang gang la/ /'dzin zhen byu tshe de thog rbad kyis 'dzin med dbyings su/ /chod pa de'i ngang gnas mdzod/ /snang srid lha dang lha mo/ /gnod pa 'gro ba'i sems spongs/ /'dzin zhen med pa gnad do/ /bdag 'dzin 'gong bo thul na// gcod kyi de nyid de 'o/ /rang sems bla mar shes na/ /gzhan zhig tshol 'gro mi dgos/ /gzhi dbyings skye med ngang du/ /ma bcos lhod de bzhag na/ /de las lag pa'i sgom med/ /rang rig chos sku'i rgyal sa/ /zin na de las gzhan pa'i/ /lha zhig bsgrub rgyu ma mthong / /rang snang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor/ /shar ba de ma yin pa'i/ /zhing khams yul gzhan rted rgyu/ /ma mthong de lugs thugs la/ /zung

mdzod rang slob mtha' yas/ /sprul ming gzugs brnyan tsam 'dzin kun bzang nyi ma zhes 'bod pa des rdzun gtam smras pa dge legs 'phel/ // a ho/ /tshogs bsags smon pa grub pa'i 'bras bu las/ /dal 'byor rin chen thar ba'i gru gzeng thob// bsnyen bsgrub gong ma'i rjes snyegs rem la bsgo/ /gser gling phyin nas stong log mi mdzad par/ /chagasasdang mda' lnga'i dgra'i dbang mi 'chol bar/ /'dzin med lta ba'i phu thag chod par bces/ /snang srid 'khor 'das ji ltar snang gyur kyang / /bden med nyams snang rdzun gyi ri mor blta/ /chos brgyad 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba'i phyug na yang / /chags bral stong pa'i dpyad pa btang bar rems/ /mdzes chos smon tshig tsam gyis sangs mi rgya/ /grags stong 'brug sgra'i dpe la zhen pa chod/ /thugs mthun khrims gtsang bslab gsum zhib pa dang / /chags sdang rgyag sems btang snyoms mdzad par zhu/ /lhan skyes ye shes rig pa byang chub sems//btang snyoms dgra la ma bskur brtson pas sgrubs/ /bla mar mos gus nyi ma shar nas su/ /thugs yid ro gcig mdzod cig 'gyur rgyam lags/ /zhe sdang dgra dbang ma gtang paṇa

༄༅// grol lags// le lo 'du 'dzi ma ches slob bu rnams/ /phag mo'i dbang bshad khrod lod sgrub khog rnams// yob sa su grub kyang sngar nas bskur ma phod/ /yamasani sgrub pa'i rkyen la 'gro bsam dogs// da skabs skyes pa las mtha' log pa la/ /bskur na gdams pa'i che ba shor snyams dogs// dan dang dad pa che ba'i 'gro 'dug la//legs par bskul ngor zob rgan ma sems lags// bhi to ta ma'i bskyed rdzogs rim pa yang / /grub par byas nas rgun dus 'phrod thabs bya// lcags sprul ming 'dzin gnyom chungakun nyi'i phul/ /bla slob zhal 'phrad 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel zhu/ / / lugs gnyis mkhyen dpyod yangs pa gang de yi/ /drung du 'dzar phul ched la gzhan ma mchis/ /tshe stod dgra'adul gnyen skyongs bya ba la/ /kun gyi ya rab brjod cing rab bstod kyang / /snying po ci yod brag cha stong pa'i sgra/ /smra mkhas lce yi brjod sgos rab snyan pas// glen pa'i thos kyangago ba 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /snying po ma mchis ni tso'i chos bshad 'dra/ /bzlas pa kha 'don dag la brtson pa rem/ /sems kyi dpyod rgya bsam mi khyab na ya / /rtsa ba ci yod 'khrul

ba'i las rjes 'brang / /de phyir blo sna nang du bstung byas la/ /dkon mchog gtsug brten 'di phyis re ltos bca'/ /blo ldog rnam bzhi'i rgyud sbyangs byams brtse ldan/ /stong nyid snying rjes rang sems 'dul la brtson/ /phyi ma'i 'gro chas 'grub par ma zob rem/ /de lugs sems la 'chong shig a sgron lags/ /dus mtha'i sngags ming kun nyi nas phul/ // slob bu a paṇa la gdams pa'i glu dbyangs tshig ngan don 'dus pha ma'i kha ta lta bu mtshang rgol zab mo bzhugs so/ /skyabs gcig bdud 'joms gling pa dang / /dbyer med pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// mi 'bral bde chen 'dor lo yi/ /rgyan du mchod la gus pas 'dud/ /mos pa'i nor dang ldan pa khyod/ /sngon smon las kyi 'brel ba'i bsdus/ /bzo gnas rigs la rtsal mkhas pa'i/ /pad+ma rnam rgyal gus pas nyon/ 'gro drug 'khor ba'i bya ba ni/ /zin pa'i dus med ga chad gnas/ /yid mi dga' zhing snying mi bde/ /bud med 'dre mo mngon rgyugs yin/ /'grog na zhe sun sdug bsngal gzhi/ /khyims thab mi mdzes skyo ba'i gnas/ /de la ma chags gnas ngan spongs/ /mi dregs dpon gya gol sa ni/ /chags sdang rin gyis

༄7// nyo ba yin/ /mtho rtsis ma che dman sa skyongs// de na skyid pa'i gnas skabs yod/ /bzo gnas spre'u'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /rnam g.yeng byis pa'i rtsed mo dang / /khyad par ma mchis ya ma brla/ /blo sna bstung la bya bzhag bor/ /nyo tshongs dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi/ /bya blo mang pos dgos pa med/ /dam pa'i chos la sems gcig dril/ /snying po lon na ya mtshan che/ /dpon la ngo bstod byed ma dga'/ /dman par khro nyams rtsub regs spongs/ /thams cad su mthong dga' yal le'i/ /bsam pa skyid pa'i kun slong mdzod//dgra la ma sdang pha ma yin/ /gnyen la ma chags 'khor ba'i sgrogs/ /thams cad ro snyoms bzhag nus na/ /chos pa'i 'dun ma bskor lugs yin/ /rang yul yag dga' nye sdug dor/ /'dod yon sgyu ma'i dga' ston bor/ /yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams 'dir/ /thar lam sne la 'ju bar mdzod/ /dal 'byor rin chen gru gzeng 'di/ /tshe stod sdig pa'i ngang la 'da'/ /da ni sprin bar nyi ma'i skabs/ /tshe smad chos kyi lam la dril/ /srid gsum mi rtag ston sprin 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar bsgyur bzhin/ /gza' tshangs tshongs mgron

ji bzhin no// des na mi rtag blo sbyangs mdzod/ /'khor ba gang skyes sdug bsngal gzeb/ /'gro drug duḥkha bsam mi khyab/ /ngan song g.yang sa chen po las/ /sgol ba'i thabs la brtson par mdzod// zag dang zag med dam pa'i chos/ /las 'bras basmu ba mi mnga' zhing / /sdig pa'i las la spyod pa na/ /bslu med ngan 'gror lhung 'gyur ro/ /de phyir rgyu 'bras khyad ma gsod/ /skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ /'di phyi'i re ltos bca' ba dang / tshe rabs gtan gyi blo phug du// re bcas dgos 'dod ngang gis 'byung / /nam mkha'i gar khyab 'gro bas khyab/ /de dag las nyon zug rngus mnar/ /pha mar gyur ba'i byis pa la/ /brdal khyab snying rje'i rgya yis gdab// btang snyoms gru la nye ring bral/ /thugs rjes lcags kyus yongs su 'dzin/ /byams dang sning rje zung 'brel ba'i/ /dus rnams kun tu 'gro phan sgrubs/ /'di 'bral dam chos sgrub thabs dka'/ /de phyir yang dag don la brtson/ /smin byed dbang gi da lar zhugs/ /byin rlabs dngos grub thabs la brtson/ /lhan skyes ye shes gcer bur byung / /de yis rgyal kun gsang mdzod rdol/ /khyad par snang

༄༅// srid 'khor 'das kyis/ /bsdus pa'i chos rnams ma lus kun// bdag med rnam gnyis kyis gzhal na/ /phyi ru yul stong rang ngos stong / /nang du nga bdag rnamapar stong / /gzung 'dzin phug rdib rang sar gcod/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings mngon du byed// bdag med gnas lugs rjen byung nas/ /'dod yon chos la zhen pa chod/ /ces kyangadagos med blo sbyang brtson/ /'khor ba sgyu ma'i rol par blta/ /'di snang rmi lam khyer so bya/ /tshogs drug smig rgyu ltar du spyad/ /dngos med 'khrul snang gzugs brnyan bzhin//gnyen dang nye 'brel dri za'i grong / /bzang ngan gtam ni brag cha 'dra/ /bden med chu yi zla gzugs bzhin// gnyisamed gnyis snang chu bur ltar/ /'khrul snang mig yor bkodadang mtshungs/ /sna tshogs sprul bsgyur bkod pa 'dra/ /des na 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus chos/ /bden med dpe bcu ltar shes nas/ /zhen pa'i skyon mtshangs phug rdib bya/ /kha tsamam yin don dam par/ /bden med stong gsal chen po'i gshis/ /dang po go la bar du myong / /tha ma rtogs paligadengs ldan mdzod/ /de nas bzhi cha gsum bral gyi/ /rig pa 'pho

'gyur kun dang bral/ /stong gsal 'dzin med myong zhen dben/ /phyi nang bar med zang ma thal/ /'thib cing rmongs pa'i dri ma las// grol te mkhyen gnyis chags thog bral/ /yulasnang ma nub gsal sang nge / /'dzin cha phra ba'i spu ris bral/ /gnas 'gyu'i shan 'byed 'phrang las dgrol/ /mngon skog 'gyu ba'i rtsis gdab med/ /yang 'jog ris chad blta mdagos/ /ku yang blo bde chen po de/ /skyid pa'i ro nyal gdams pa'o/ /bde sdug chags sdang rmong pa'i blo/ /ci snang nyams kyi rol pa ste/ /gtad med rang gsal ngang la klod/ /bdegasal mi rtog stong pa'i nyams/ /gang yang rdzun pa'i rol par bzhag re 'ga' rtogs byung skyid so snyams/ /skabs skabs stong 'dug sdug rgur sems// 'ga' zhig ci 'dug gtad med blo/ /sna tshogs nyams kyi bye brag yin/ /'pho 'gyur bral ba'i mos gus dang / /phyogs med dad pa dag snang shar/ /snang srid sgyu ma rmi lam du/ /thag chod zhen 'dzin phugardib tshe/ /nyams len gnad la 'gro ba'i rtags/ /dug lnga ce 'phel chos brgyad mang / /dgra 'dul gnyen skyongs so nam sgrub/ /nor la gces spras ce brtan tshe/ /sgom pa gnad du

༄7// ma song ngo/ /khyod kyang mgo rmong las la dga'/ /grub zin med pa mang po brtsam/ /tshig gcig bzod pa'i go cha med/ /thob dang gol sa mtho la dga'/ /mi la kha ta mang po smra/ /rang mgo 'khor ba mi go 'dug nyin re dga' nas 'dzum mol mol/ /thabs rer sdug nas tshub kyi le/ /dpa' rngams khro gtum gzi brjid che/ /de 'dra thams cad ma spang na/ /nga dang lta spyod ye ma mthun/ /nges gsang rdzogs chen bsgom 'dod na/ /skyid kyang snang ba lhod po dgos/ /sdug kyang shes pa dga' mo brten/ /na tshe dga' ba bsgom dgos so/ tan yang blo lhag med pa gal/ /dgra byung bcom kyang zhe sdang med/ /gnyen byung 'du kyang 'dod chags bral/ /gar bsdad snang ba yangs khrol le/ /su 'grogs shes pa dga' ya le/ /dug lnga bag la nyal nas song / /dad pa dag snang gong du 'phel/ /dus kun spyon pa 'ur bslab ltar/ /dga' kyi le ba 'dzum mo lo/ /mos gus mchi mas brnang ba dang / /chags sdang ro snyoms nyal la spro/ /de 'dra byung na pha rgan ngas/ /gces pa'i bu phrug dam pa yin/ /ma ldan gdams pa snod lhag na/ /don mi 'grub cing dgos pa med/ /snag

shog ro med byas pa yin/ /chos bshad kha yi sbu ba tsam// kha ta pha gtam bu la lod/ /gdams ngag lkog gyong snum dang mtshungs/ /dam ldan zer yang dam nyams 'dra/ /las canabarjod kyang las ngan yin/ /mngon lkog phal gtam ma yin par// don gyi kha ta zab mo 'o/ /sems la zung shig rigs kyi bu/ /nyin re bzhin du yang yang ltos// kha yengs mig yengs ma byed par/ /blo sna bstung la nang don sgoms/ /kha bshad tshig gi ro mi gtso/ /spyod lam zhi dul bag yod cing / /dug lnga 'bur 'joms dam tshig dang/ /sdom pa gtsang na ngomatshar che/ /deng sang kha bshad nai tso'i gtam/ /smras na rtogs ldan kho na 'dra// gdengs skad mtho ba'i chos zad kyi/ /blo 'das kho na yin pa 'dra/ /skya min ser min yan chad kun//mnyam rjes 'dres yod skad pa mang/ /de 'dra mthong na bdag yi mug/ /ngo mi mtshar la ngo re tsha/ /dus kyi snyigs ma'i rang mtshang yin/ /dmyal ba'i 'phel kha'i mang lug la/ /mgo 'khor snying rje kye ma kye/ /de 'dra'i lan mo ma byed par/ /kha 'og lus chug lus po dben// 'di bde phyi skyid thabs la brtson/ /sems la zungs shig a paṇa lags/ /nus ldan rdo

༄7// rje'i zhal ta yin/ /dge'o legs so ma lam/ /gu ru khyad 'phags rig 'dzin gyi sku la rgya mtsho'i gling gi ḍak+ki rnams kyis phul ba'i bde stong 'od zhwa zhes bya ba'i rnam bshad bzhugs so/ /a ho// chogs smon las 'phro 'dzoms pa a pan khyod gson dang / /gsang sngags theg pa thabs kyi khyad par de 'phags so/ /yag 'dod mdzes chos tsam du brten pa ni min no/ /dmigs bcas bsod nams tshogs bsags sgo mang du 'dug kyang / /skabs 'dir dgos pa'i zhwa yi yon tan ni 'di ltar/ /rgya mtsho'i gling gi ḍāk+ki ma tshogs kyis phul ba'i/ /bde stong 'od zhwa byin rlabs ya mtshan gyis spras pa/ /rtse rgyal rdo rje theg dgu'i yang rtse yi brda thabs/ /mdangs lnga'i sgro zer nyon mongs dug 'joms kyi rtags mtshan/ /ldem sgro zung 'jug ma rgyud rdzogs pa yi yon tan// nyi zla nor bu sku gsum zhing khams kyi bkod pa/ /mi 'gyur mthing mdzes chos dbyings kun zlum gyi brda rtags/ /pad+ma 'dabs gsum chags bral dri med kyi don mtshon/ /'ja' zer lnga ldan ye shes lhun grub kyi gzhal med/ /thod rgyan 'od skor nges pa lnga ldan de mtshon no/ /dmar

ser bkrag 'khyud bram ze'u brda thabs rang bzung tshul/ /zur gsum dug lnga'i 'gro ba gsang gsum gyis 'dren rtags/ /nang khong stong pa khyab brdal phyogs bral gyi yon tan//gzhan yang lce brgyas bstod kyang yon tan ni 'dzad med/ /'di bzhengs 'gro ba'i dug gsum sgrib pa rang bcoms nas/ /gcig char sku gsum rig sku spros bral nyid rtogs te//rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri pad+ma yi pha drung / /tshe 'di 'phos ma thag par mngon sum la phyin nas/ /zhal mjal lung ston dbugs dbyung gzeng bstod de mdzad nges/ /dka' tshegs khyad bsad bzos pa don med du mi 'gyur/ /sa rdo'i gzhal med bzhengs dang cung zad zhig mi 'dra/ /skyo ba'i ma bslad dad mos drag po yis brtson dang / /bu khyod dal 'byor don med chud zos su mi 'dug/ /tshe rnga nyi ma'i grib so tsam skabs kyi dus 'dir/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab 'thug po ru ma lhung / /che bzhag chung bskyur mdzod la dal med du dge sgrub/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong chags sdang pham rgyal de lhod thong / /myur lam rdzogs pa chen po'i spo sna la brten nas/ /tshe 'dir srid pa'i pha mthar brgal thabs

༄7// la rem rem/ /bdag la 'dod pa'i yo byad bzang po 'di'i yon du// ja dngul rgyu rdzas sbyin kyang cung zad zhig los yod/ /de las 'di ltar dgos pa'i phan yon zhig gsung na/ /dga' nges zer ba'i gtam lan mdo bsngo de phul lo/ /kha mang rgad po kun nyis tshig 'chal de shor song / /dge des tshom bur rnga yab 'god pa la smon no/ /gnas skabs bde skyid spyod pa'i bkra shis de zhu lags/ /sarba maṅga le/ / a ho/ /shes pa zangs thal spros bral rgya yan sang yangs chen po'i gshis su ma bcos rang babs shig ger klod blo yis ma bcos par sa ler zhogaḥ rtog pas ma bsgyur bar shig ger skyongasaḥ 'dzin pas ma bcings bar rang bab du yanaḥ re drogs kyis ma bcing bar sal gyi 'byams su klasaḥ mnyam nyid 'od gsal khyab rdal la yid dpyod kyis ma bcings bar mnyam par 'jog pa ni gnad yin rtogs grol dus mnyam rang grol du 'dug gokha 'byams tshog skam go yul du lus na 'khor bar lhag gos tsa ma deng sang sgom par skad pa'i glang chen dag la mi re ba gnad yinaX kun gzhi sogs gsum la 'thas kyangaḥ gsal gsal ba

ri baḥ har har du 'dug par 'dra yangaḥ ma nor ba gnad ༷ 'byams su klas pa yin noḥ yengs min bcing bral 'od gsal rtsol med du bzhag thabs bya'o ༷ sa ma yāḥ mkha' tha gri 'bar ma'i gdams zab yin noX smras pa ci yang mi shes mkhas rloms sems pa'i miḥ 'od gsal dbyings sgom blos byas 'khrul 'khor canaḥ stong lta had por gol / nyi ngas su ma mgu yang brtsed mtshar tsam du bris dge'o/ ga rang snang mi shig zangs mdog dpal gyi ri/ /rang byung 'gags med lhun grub gzhal yas khaṃ/ /rang rig rgyan rdo rje 'chang / /rang sems dad brgya'i ge sar g.yo bzhin 'dud/ /gnyis 'dzin sgyu ma'i smag khrod 'thib mo'i gzeb/ /gnyis snang gar gyis bsgrus pa'i gang zag gnyis med don la mos kyang 'du 'dzis khyer// gnyis rtog 'dzin pa chod par bla ma mkhyen/ /kun bzang chos dbyings yangs pa'i rgyal sa la// kun rtog blo yis bsal sted mod kyang / /kun tu mnar ba'i bdag 'dras blo dman rnams/ /kun nas dran shes zab mo'i bag zon mdzod/ /stong chen khyab brdal yangs pa'i gshis lugs mchog

༄7// stong gsal 'dzin med dbu ma chen po ste/ /stong pa'i chos la zhen pa ma chod na/ /stong 'khrul byis pa bdag 'dra snying re rje/ /gsal byed nyi ma rig pa'i ye shesamachog/ gsal ba'i gnyen po gzhan nas 'tshol 'dod dag /gsal dag mun pa'i smag rum tshud la re// gsal ba mthong 'dod bdag 'dra snying re rje/ /ma bcos gnas lugs bcos ma'i lam du drangs/ /ma dmigs ye shes 'dzin pa'i gzeb du tshud/ /ma bcos rang bzhag 'jur bu'i rgod blo can/ /ma shes kha dog tha dad snying rje'i gnas/ /dbyings nyidargya chad phyogs lhung kun dang bral/ /dbyings ni bzang ngan bsgyur bkod yus las 'das/ /dbyings la ma rdzogs 'khor 'das gang yang med/ /dbyings de phyi nang res chad bdaga'adra 'khrul/ /sangs rgyas sgrub gzhi rang la ma rdzogs na/ /sangs rgyas zhig gzhan rtsol sgrub ngal ba can/ /sangs ma rgyas pa'i rtags ngan yin pa 'dra/ /sangs rgyas gzhan golabadag 'dra snying rjes gnas/ /rig pa'i ye shes kun shes kun rig mchog rig go sems pa'i 'dzin cha sbu tsam med/ /rig gam ma rig rtog pa'i bsre bslad bral/ /rig gdangs

ye shes shar cha nub med 'dra/ /'gyu yang rtsis gdab byas na ce 'thus 'gyur/ /'gyur med gnas zhes dga' yang 'ching ba'i gzeb/ /'gyu rtog re drogs gang yang ma byas na//'gyu bral gnyug ma'i btsan sa zin pa 'dra/ /bde ba'i nyams kyang rdzun pa nam mkha'i 'ja'/ /bde bral sdug bsngal chu yi ri mo 'dra/ /bde zhing gsal ba'i snang ba gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /bde rtsub nyams la zhen med dgos pa 'dra// chags sdang rgyal pham brag cha stong pa'i sgra/ /chags sred bud med srid gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu// chags yul sgyu ma'i snang bar zhen pa chod/ /chags med don gyi rnal 'byor mdzad na legs// gang shar rang grol kun bzang dgongs pa skyongs/ /gang la phyin kyang snang ba yang khrol le// gang dang 'grogs kyang shes pa dga' ya le/ /gang ltar bsdad kyang 'khrul med mdzad par zhu// yang gsang 'od gsal myur lam mchog gi sgo/ /yang dag lta ba'i phu thag chod pa yis/ /yeng 'khrul med pa rgya yan lhug pa che/ /yang yang spyod lam rgyu 'bras zhib par 'tshal/ /rang la mi ldan gtam sgo mtho ba dang / /rang 'dod yid 'dzin nga rgyal che ba yi/ /rang 'byul gnar ba'i skye bo blo

༄༅// rtsal rgod/ /rang 'dra'i gdams ngag bri ba bzhad mo'i gnas/ /a ho/ /smon lam gyi 'brel ba'i nor bu mchog dga' spro yis mtshar zhus gcig phul na//dpal ri de pad+ma'i pha khyims nas/ /dpon slob kyi tshul du bstan 'gro'i don/ /rlabs chen re 'grub pa'i smon 'dun bcas/ /lho nub nas shar gyi phyogs su 'dongs/ /gser zhol du rten 'brel mthu las 'dzom// rang nyid kyang chos brgyad 'du 'dzi dang / /le lo sogs rnam g.yeng che ba dang / /sman 'dod kyi gter chos bkod pa min/ /smon lam gyis bskul ba'i rgyu mthun dang/ /dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i brda thabs sogs/ /rtsol med du ma bkod thabs med zhig yang yang la byung ba'i bkod re thal/ /che ba dang grags pa phar zad de//za sems dang bskru sems skyon ma zhugs// ma rig pa'i dmus long 'gro ba rnams/ /mgo skor gyi 'dun ma spu tsam med/ /lha gcig khyed mdzad spyod shin tu legs/ /'dod chung dang chog shes ngo re mtshar/ /rtse gcig tu lha chos la mos nas/ /tshos brgyad la zhen log ngo mtshar che/ /'on kyang ni zhabrul snang 'gro ba rnams// tshad med de lcags kyus 'dor ba na/

/skyabs de tshos blo gtad log par 'gyur/ /byang sems kyi dam bca' mi nyams sam/ /gdul bya rnams thugs rjes ma 'dor zhu/ /rang nyid la gzhan phan don gnyer blo/ /yod tshulade smras na bzhad mo'i gnas/ /mi rgan gyi bsam bzang 'dra ba des/ /dpa' bo mchog khyed la yar zhus yin/ /gnas tshul la ka dag stong pa nyid/ /spros bral gyi gshis lugs rjenapa las/ /'khor 'das kyi chos rnams kun la yang / /bden grub de med pa tsam zhig go bcas bcos dang rtsis gdab mi dgos par/ /gang shar kyang rang grol rjen pa'i gshis/nang gsal gyi ye shes ma rmug pa/ /gting gsal gyi rig pa mthong ba 'dra/ /khyab brdal gshis yul med rol pa la/ /phan gnod kyi yul las 'das mod kyang / /stong nyid dngasnying rje zung 'jug gis/ /ma rtogs pa'i yul la rgyas gdab shor/ /rang rtsal gyi snang ba skad cig ma/ /dbyings nyid la bsdu ba dang mnyam par/ /pha gcig gi zhabs drung la 'khodapa/ /dka' chen zhig spyod 'dug os dgos snyams/ /chang brgyag zhig 'thung ba'i rgad po spro// chos byed khyed dben pa'i gnas su spro/ /nyi 'od dang bsil 'dzom 'byung khams spro/

༄༅// /chos bdag mchog dad mos ldan pa'i spro/ /spro chen gyi ngang nas rtse mtshar zhig phul ba yi dge mtshan la brten nas/ /dag dbyings su tshom bu gcig tu 'khod//rten 'brel gyi che ba de tsam zhu/ /sprul sku pad nor la gdams pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lam̐/ / a ho/ /chogs smon las 'phro bzang po'i mthus bskyed pa'i/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byer bdag la dgyes par gson/ /'dir snang sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor gar bsgyur la/ /zhen chags ma byed rmi lam yul dang mtshungs/ /don med 'du 'dzi'i bya ba la g.yeng na/ /spre'u'i gar la brtse ba yi chad gnas/ /'jig rten chos brgyad yul la mgo ma 'khor/ /byis pa'i rtse 'jor brten pa ga chad gnas/ /dkor kha grong nyul ha cing ma rgyug las/ /rang byung nyi ma sprin gyis bsgrib 'gro thang / /sdang chen 'khor ba'i gshis la mgo ma 'khor/ /ro mnyam kun bzang dgongs pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ /'byor ldan phyug po'i rjes su ma 'brang bas/ /chos byedanyi ma 'du long brel gyis bslu/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong pham rgyal ma rtsod las/ /pha gcig pad+ma'i thugs kyis khrel nas 'ong / /yar mar bskang chogs mchod bstod ma chag las/

/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khu ldog ston nas 'ong // srung ma las kyi pho nyar bsngags dgos las/ /bar chad dgra bo gar sdang cha med yin// bsags sbyang spel gsum gnad la mabartson na/ /bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub la gegs mang mchis/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin ma brten na/ /'gro don rgyun chad lhung ba phog thang ngo / /nges med gnas subartul zhugs ma brtson na/ /gzhan don mi 'byung mda' lnga'i dbang gyur skad/ /'byor ba'i yul la chags pa ma bor na/ /bslu brid bdud po gar yod cha med yin/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa'i chos sku ma brkyang na/ /gzhan don phar zad rang don 'byung mi srid/ /zab gter rgya mtshor bsnyen sgrub ma mdzad na/ /skal ldan 'du ba'i dga' tshal rgyas mi srid/ /khyadapar yar lung phyogs su brten bcas nas/ /gu ru'i gsang phug rnam gsum ma brten na/ /tshe dang chos la bar chad gegs mang mchis/ /der brten rang gi zab gter bsgrub nusab/ /bstan 'gro'i don 'byung bar chad g.yul las rgyal/ /shar phyogs sngags kyi 'du ra'i nye phyogs kyi/ /yang ldongs 'du phug bsnyen bsgrub tshad 'byel na/ /rtags dang rten

༄༅// 'brel phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /rje btsun tā re'i gsang gi rdzongs mkhar bsten// gu ru pad+ma srog dang sbrel la sgom/ /yar mar tshogs dang mchod pa rgyun mi bcad/ /lo bzhin rdo rje 'bar ba'i rdzong mkhar brten/ /bsrung ma dam can rgya mtsho gnad du bsnun/ /bstan dgra kla klo'i steng du 'bod rbad bsad/ /khyad par gshin rje king ging dmar po yi/ /bsnyen sgrub tshad 'byol rtags dang rten 'brel 'byung / /le lo 'du 'dzi'i baspu brid khyad bsad nas/ /yang dag snying po'i bsnyen sgrub ma 'jug rem/ /'dod yon chos kyi mdzes sdug ngom na'ang / /'dod chung chog shes brten la ma 'chug rem/ /snyan cing grags pas kun 'dud byed na'ang / /chos brgyad 'du 'ardza byed la ma dga' rem/ /zas nor 'dod rgu'i po byad spung na'ang / /ser snas ma bcing dkon mchog mchod thabs rem/ /smar phyogs rdo stod nor bu rted na'ang / /bcu gsum bar du gsang rgya bsdams thabs rem//las ldan nyer lngas dman pa'i tshul bzung nas// 'du bar 'ong tshe ngo shes mdzad par rem/ /dran tshad smra rgyu ma yin gzhan gyis brnyas// rang tshug rang gis 'dzin thabs ma 'jug

rem/ /stod smad kun tu mdur zing byed pa na// g.yin gyis brtes 'ong de ltar ma mdzad rem/ /gzhan yang rgad po'i tshig 'chol smra ba la// zad mtha' med kyang mdo tsam de ltar ro//ma brjed thugs la zung shig snying gi bu/ /stobs ldan rdo rje'i bzhed pa 'grub gyur cig dge'o/ /legs so sarba ma le/ / a ho/ /re sa gus can gyi bu mchog lags/ /'di snangasgyu ma'i zhabrul 'khor la/ /zhen pa chod na ngo mtshar che/ /'khor ba rmi lam gar bskyur la/ /ma zhen 'dod yon chos phyogs gtang / /dran tshad blo sna'i don mi 'grub/ /gtad chogagacig pu dam chos yin/ /tshong dang g.yo rgyu'i bya ba yis/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i don mi 'byung / /dren che ba la skug ma 'jog rang gi dam chos 'grub na dge rnam g.yeng le lo 'du'adzi sbongs/ /chos brgyad bya ba rang sar gcod/ /sde chen dpon gyi las ka yis// phyi ma'i 'gro chos 'grub rab med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa ni/ /ye nas 'bral med 'grogs na yang / /da snga yan chad chud zos song / /da ni rang rig rgyal po'i gdung / /ye shes chen pos mchod bstod mdzod/ /mi med dben pa'i brag phug na/ /skyid pa'i ro nyal

༄༅// chog rab yod/ /'dod yon mi dgos zhen chags bral/ /chags sdang rgyal pham rtsod pa med/ /so nams las ga'i bya bzhag bral/ /'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng byed pa med/ /chags yul 'khor ba'i lcags sgrog bral/ /sdang zhen dgra dang nyer 'tshe dben/ /basmu brid sgyu ma'i ltad mo bral/ /des na rang tshug zin gyur na/ /sprang ban bdag gi zhe blo bde/ /'dun phug phyi ma'i don chen 'grub// gzhan gyi brag cha mi legs kyang / /rang don chud zos ma song ngo/ /gser gling phyin pa don dang ldan/ /lha mi'i gtsug rgyan gyur rab yod/ /deng dus nged rang tshom bu kun/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma gcig chog yin/ /dag pa rnga yab dpal ri nas/ /o rgyan pad+ma kā ra yis/ /'gro ba'i dpal du bdag bskrun nas/ /'khorab spang ba'i zhal ta las/ /chos brgyad 'dzin pa'i kha ta med// gzhan snang 'khor dang sdeb ba pos/ /legs pa'i lam du kha bskor nas/ /nga la bka' bkyon che na'ang / /lhagabasam dag pa'i dga' sdug bral/ /gang zag re re grol thub na/ /bdag lus snang ba don dang ldan/ /las 'phros bsdus pa khyed ngo mtshar/ /rta shul dang ni lcags khung gnyis/ /mi

rig shin tu ngan rkyen gyis/ /chos gegs bdud kyi bar chad che/ /sngags ma zhugs pa dkon dkon yin/ /khyed ni gsang sngags rig can min/ /da sngon chob chob zang zing yang//chos mgo thon pa ngo mtshar che/ /da dung de 'dra'i rjes mthud nas/ /chos kyi sgrub mtha' zin par rem/ /brtul zhugs bya bral mdzad par zhu/ /slob bu dad ldan zhes rgyam la/ /kha mang rgad po kun nyis smras/ /dge bas dam chos 'grub gyur cig a ho/ / na tshod dar ba'i lang tsho rgas pa'i non/ /'jig rten 'di snang bya ba sgrub mthar phyin/ /gser gling phyinanas dam chos ci tsam 'grub/ /stong log yin na ngo mtshar mi che lags/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i zhal gsung rdo rje'i sgra/ /nyams su myong ba'i yon tan ci tsam rgyas/ /dad mos che lugs mthong na ngo mtshar che/ /med tshul kha nas bshad tshe snying khrag phud/ /pha cig rdo rje 'chang gi bsil 'og du// gnas tshud rgyu la thar pa'i sa bon theb/ /khyed kyang thugs rje lcags kyus rab zin nas/ /'phos ma thag par lam sna e mi 'dren/ /sngar med gsal ba'i zhal gdams nga la med// sman gcig ster ba'i nyams len skyong dgos las/ /gsal

༄༅// ba'i chos kyi da ni grol tshe med// 'dir snang zhen pa'i gdung thag ma bcad na/ /gnyen dang nye 'brel skyong khoms chen po med// 'dod yon sgyu mar zhen pa ma log na/ /'khor ba'i 'dam las mdog ngan ston nyin gda'// skad cig rmi lam lta bu'i tshe mjug 'dir/ /yang dag snying po long shig lha rgyas lags/ /sprul ming tsam 'dzin nus ldan rdo rjes phul/ ༈ a ho/ /dad dam ldan pa'i slob bu gson/ /rgad pa'i drang gtam lab kyu yod/ /tsa tshub zhe sdang blo sna spongs/ /dga' sdug sbos rgya'i ri mo chod// chags sdang re drogs mdud pa bor/ /gang bsdad snang ba yangs mo dgos/ /gang 'grogs shes pa dga' 'dzum brten/ /tshul spyod rnal 'byor zhig po ltar/ /rgyud ni shin tu gyong ba 'dra/ /da nas gnyen po'i 'bur 'joms rem/ /dben gnas ri khrod 'grim 'dod kyi/ /sprin bar nyi ma shar na yang / /nam phug mi thub yal nas 'gro/ /de phyir dran dang shes bzhin gyis/ /rang rgyud thul la bzod pa brten/ /chos kyi nying khu ma zag cig mi mthun dga' sdug thams cad dor// byams dang snying rje rtag tu brten/ /bla mar mos gus 'bral med gal/ /mched

la brtse gdung dag snang bskyed/ /'gro drug pha mar snying rje bsgom/ /'dus byas mi rtag 'tshang rig gal// 'khor ba'i gnas las rgyal thabs rem/ /gdams ngag chud zos ma byed lags/ /ngo sprad man ngag gnad kyis skyongs/ /dal 'byor mi lus don dang ldan/ /khyad par so thar mdzes pa yi// me tog 'od mdangs ma yal bar/ /'dul khrims dag la gzab par mdzod/ /byang sems bslab pa'i me long de/ /chags sdang g.ya' yis ma bslad par/ /btang snyoms snying rjes gru chen brten/ /'gro ba'i don la brtson par rem//gsang sngags dmatshig sems kyis bsrung / /lus kyi chol nog dgos rab med/ /dam tshig med pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ /nged tsho'i phyogs na de 'dra med/ /rgad po'i kha la nyan bsam na/ /drin po che rnams brtse bas skyongs// sdig zas grong chog ye ma byon/ /'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng ye ma sgrubs/ /don med khang li ye mabasregs/ /'chi bdag bdud po thon nyin la//'gyod pa 'byung ba'i dus zhig mchis/ /ci byar zad do 'phyi nas song / /ma brjed snying gi dkyil du 'chong / /slob bu bde ba'i rdo rje la/ /kha ngan rgad po kun nyis smras/ / a ho/

༄༅// /yul drug dga' ba'i thang chen na/ /ngang mo'i gshog 'gyur ya la la/ /'dod yon 'od mtsho dkar po la/ /dga' sdug snang ba'i ri mo mngon/ /'on kyang 'gaba'adre'i khwa ta zhig rgyu nas kha lag brgyal ngo snang / /rang rgyud rang gis ma thul na// gzhan gyis ha bgad byed kyang srid/ /so thar mdzes pa'i lang tsho yis/ /ge sar 'od mdangs ldanalugs la/ /bltas na rgad po'i rgas gnyer sangs/ /'on kyang mtshang ngan yod lugs la// dpyad na khro gnyer ngo zom shor/ /da nas rang tshugs 'dzin byas te/ /snying po chos kyi sgrubamatha' skyong / /dben pa'i gnas su brten na legs/ /gso kyi nye 'khor khyed la med/ /'dod yon longs spyod khyed la med/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong khyed la med/ /tham thum ngang la dus ma 'da'/ /zab zob chen po'i ngang ma 'khrul/ /le lo phyi bshol 'khrul ba spongs/ /dam chos 'grub na ngo mtshar che/ /log lam bdud kyi dbang ma gtong / /don dang ldan nazhal gdams yin/ /des na lus na yig gyong ngo / /sems la zung shig rig 'dus pa/ /kha ngan nus ldan rdo rjes smras/ / a ho/ /sngon smon las 'phro ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor ye

shes rgya mtsho lags// dam chos snying gi nyi ma brten/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi zab bcud 'thung / /spro chen bskyed la dag snang sbyongs/ /gnyug ma'i chos sku rtogs pa de/ /rtsol medasgom pa'i mchod bstod rem/ /dri med pad+ma dkar po la/ /brten nas tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang gnad/ /'du 'dzi le lo ma byed par/ /skyid pa'i ro nyal byed la rem/ /bza' btungatshogs 'khor ston mo yis/ /rang lus rgyal ba zhi khro mchod/ /yar dmar tshogs dang bskang gsol 'bad/ /ser sna bral ba'i chos phyogs su/ /ci 'byor gtang thabs ma 'jug rem//lus po dben chug rang sems thul// 'chi dus blo lhag med pa na/ /gdams ngag chud zos ma song ngo / /dal 'byor rin chen don dang ldan/ /dpa' bo chen po'i rjes zin nas//ge sar 'od mdangs sham bha lar/ /thigs pa tshar gcig smin snang shar/ /gdams ngag sems la 'dzin par zhu/ /nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa'o/ / a ho/ /kha ta den med ska cha la//bshad na zad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /'on kyang tshig gsum lab kyu yod/ /da snga chos tshul zin pa de/ /drin chen pha ma'i drin ma yin/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /grogs

༄༅// mchog 'ga' re'i drin las yin/ /chos sgrub mthun rkyen spel ba yi/ /don med bsam bzang rnal 'byor ba/ /ye shes rgya mtshor brtse sems kyis/ /'jam pa'i zhabs zog rtsi bkur rem// mi rgyud cho rigs ngan rkyen gyis/ /zhe sdang 'khro kha tsha rab yod/ /do'adra chos kyi phyogs na med/ /de nas rang sems 'dul thabs rem/ /chags sdang rgyal pham ye ma rtsod/ /'phyong rgyug bro gar ye ma 'brab/ /dkor kha byon nas 'thab rtsod spong / /sku jag khram pa'i rigs ma byed/ /bslu byed bud med la ma dga'/ /'dod yon sgyu mar zhen 'dzin chod/ /lha dang bla mar mos gus bskyed/ /ma dag 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo las/ /rgyal ba'i thabs la ci nus rem/ /gcig pu ri khrod zin na dge /mthar ma thon na 'phya bshad gnas/ /de phyir sems la brtags dpyad rem/ /gdams ngag chud zos ma byed par/ /bsgo ba bzhin tu snyi po longs/ /don ldan chos kyi gzugs thog nas/ /'chi bar nus na ngas blo bde/ /dal 'byor rin chen gru bo rnyed/ /khyod kyang mi lus don dang ldan/ /de ltar zungs shag snying gi bu/ /slob bu pad+ma kun bzang la/ /nus ldan rdo rjes phab

pa'o/ / a ho/ /mos ldan snying gi slob bu lags// rgad po'i ngag la dal gcig nyon/ /ma myos gzhin tu 'ur ma lang / /ma 'khrul bzhin tu gtam ma mang / /ma rab ser sna'i mdud pa bor/ /ma dad log lta spang bar mdzod/ /rang mtho nga rgyal ma che bar/ /rang gis rang 'dul dman sa zungs/ /rang rig ngo bo bla ma la/ /rang byung dad pa mos gus bskyed//kun rtog 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa chod/ /kun snang chos la zhen pa bor// kun bzang dgongs pa skyong nus na/ /kun ma dga' yang zhe blo bde/ /kha sems mi mthun mi dag la/ /kha ta snying nas byed mi dkon/ /kha rog sdod la blo sems thul/ /kha ngo dkon mchog gsum la 'khor/ /ca co'i gtam nyob rang sar kyur/ /ca nas nor la gces spras sbongs/ /cu gang lta bu'i sman gcig pu/ /ci nus snying po'i nyams len brten/ /sug sug gos ni bya bral ba// tshabs tshubs nang ni nyon mongs pa/ /chol chol gtam ni rnal 'byor ba/ /'ur 'ur byis pa dang 'dra ba'i/ /rang slob dharmā'i ming can pa/ /da ni blo sna nang du skor/ /'dun phug phyi ma don du gnyer/ /snying po'i nyams len gnad du 'byel/ 'bras med 'khor ba'i chos

༄༅// rnams dor// chags sdang rgyal pham ye ma rtsod/ /phyi ma'i 'gro chas 'grub thabs rem/ /bgo ba'i gtam bzhin khyod ldan na/ /rgad po bdag gi blo sems bde//gzhen nu khyed kyis don yang 'grub// skyid pa de tsho ngo mtshar che/ /zhes slob bu chos 'grub la gdams pa'o/ /a ho// gol sa mtho yang rang rgyud ma thul na/ /rang gis rang nyida'aching la ci cha yod/ /chos brgyad che yang dman sa ma brkyang na/ /phyi ma gnas su byon dus 'o brgyal che/ /chos byed sems kyang chags sdang rtsod che na/ /'ug rgan nyin bud bzhin tukun gyis sdang / /'du 'tshogs ltad mor sgyu ma'i ma brnan na/ /phyogs rnams kun nas thal rdeb 'phen la nye/ sems kyi ba dan rlung gis bskyod che na/ /phyi nang bar med zang thalared zer smod/ /tshong dang skor kha'i las la ma mkhas na/ /kun gyis zob zer mgo bskor byed la 'tshogs/ /dge med sdig med gzhan mgo bskor che na/ /phyi mar dbul ba'i rnamasmin e sdang bsnyams/ /da ni tsab tsub blo sna thams cad kun/ /che bzhag chung bskyur rang mgo thon thabs kyis/ /a khu 'chi bdag bdud po thon nyin la/ /mi 'jigs pa yi dpa'

gdengs med gyur na/ /'phra shad byed bzhin gdong ba mchi mas bkang / /gcer bu lag stong mchan bcug phyi mar 'gro/ /las byed gshin rje'i pho nyas nga ro sgrogs/ /'jigs pa chen po de yi skabs na yod/ /'gyod pa che yang ci bya zad nas song / /de phyir rang dbang rang la yod dus 'dir/ /rnam dag 'chi chos gsha' ma 'grub thabs rem ma zob ma zob mkhas chen gnyer ba lags/ /snying po lon dgos dbang ldan ma 'chug rem/ /mi ldan ne tso'i kha yis chos bshad 'di/ /smyo nag rgad po kun bzang nyi mas phul/ / a ho// bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len la spyod pa'i/ /las smon dang ldan pa'i skyes bu mchog /mos gus kyi nyi ma rab rgyas pa'i/ /spob bu rnams dad spros tshur gson dang / /'jig rten pa'i 'du 'dzi snying po med/ /rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i chos de spongs/ chags sdang ni 'khor ba'i gting rda'i rgyu// phan pa yang sbu tsam mi 'byung ba'i/ /rang rgyud de chud zos ma byed cig /bka' gter gyi chos la phyogs ris dang / /spang blang gi bsal bzhag ma mdzad lags/ /sgom pa dang nyams len che 'dod kyang / /nyon mongs pa'i dgra la 'phrad dus ltos/ /tha mal dang

༄༅// 'dra na gnad ma zeng // bden med du gzhig na rnal 'byor legs/ /gzhan rkyon ni phar la brtag ma mkhas/ /rang skyon rnams ngos zin byung na dge/ /gang snangal dag pa rab 'byams sgom/ /yeng med du sgrub pa'i snying po longs/ /gang shar la 'phyo 'dod rtsis gdab spongs/ /su 'grogs kyang byams brtse kho nas skyongs/ /rnam g.yeng dang lelo'i dgra bo sod/ /brtson 'grus kyi rta zhon snying rus bskyed/ khyims stong du sdod kyang mgo ma bskor/ /thun gseng la bya bzhag lag ma mang / /rjes thob du khyi bzhin grong ma nyul//kha brgad de 'ur zing skad ma mtho/ /mched lcam la tshig ngan mtshon ma 'debs/ /bla mar yang log lta'i skyon ma brjod/ /kha 'byams kyi stong skad dpangs ma mtho/ /dge sdig kyangaphra mo'i 'jug ldog rem/ /dala'aphyor kyi mi lus chud ma gsan/ mi rtag la rtag bsnyam las ma mang / /dam tshig dang sdom pa srog gta' zungs/ /nges med kyi ri la chos tshugasaskyongs/ /dkar nag de dkor la ma zhen lags/ /dge 'dun pa'i thugs la mkhon ma 'debs/ /drang tshul dabhe byams pa snying rje sgom/ /rmi lam tsam 'di ru skyid skyid mdzod/ /thang

cig ma 'di la bde bde mdzod/ /skad cig tsam 'di dus dga' dga' mdzod// gza' mkhon dang 'khrug pa ma byed cig bde skyid kyi ngang la ro nyal mdzod/ paṇa grol sogs kun gyi thugs la zhogs/ sprul ming 'dzin kun nyis gdams pa'o/ sarba maṅga le/ / dad ldan gyi slob bu tshe stobs khyed gson dang / /gdams ngag zhes phan pa'i zhal ta ni mi shes//'khrul 'byams lasong ba mdo med kyi lo rgyus/ /rgad po ngas myong ba cung zad zhig zhu na// 'dir snang gi bya ba 'dod yon gyi bkod pa/ /spang sngon gyi tshal des me tog dang 'dra yang //rtag brtan ni ma mchis rmi lam dang 'dra mtshungs/ /bden med kyi mtshang rig zhen 'dzin de chod na/ /blo bde yi 'dun ma shongs yangs zhig red na/ /'khrul 'byams kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gyi mdud pa/ /thog med nas gces par bsdam bsdam kyang bcing bcing / /yod med kyi mtshangs btsal rdzun rnga de bud song / /ye stong gi gnad rig mdud pa de rang zhig/sems bde yis nyal chog skyid pa zhig red na/ /thos tshogs kyi g.yeng ba'i mtha' rgya ni mi chod// blos 'jog gi sems sbyongs de ga yang gud chung / /stong lta ni had po'i rgyu 'bras

༄༅// yang khyad gsod/ /drang don gyi re ba'i 'bras smon ni thag ring / ne+e co'i khas chos bshad phyi lta zhig 'dra snyams/ /sems can gyi blo yis sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa/ /dpog 'dod pa'i shu ga lce gnyis mkhan nyams thag /de 'dra yi rjes 'jug mdo med zhig red na/ /nged rang tsho'i lugs srol pad 'byung gi phyag bzhes/ /lta ba yi bzhugs tshul mtha' brgyad dang bral song / /stong skyang de ma yin sku gsum la rdzogs 'dug /dbyings ye gnyis zung 'jug mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i/ gnyug ma yi chos sku'i dgongs don de rtogs tshe/ /'dzin ltang gi rtsal sbyangs rang dag zhig red na/ /bsgom 'dod kyi spu ris zur tsam yang mi spros/ dus gsum gyi rtog par daphyod cha rang ma zhug /tha mal gyi shes pa zang thal ba'i rang bzhin/ /gcer mthong nas ngang bzhag rgya yan gyi rol pa/ 'di yin dang 'di min blo rtog gi ma bslad/ /mngon lkog dang gnas 'gyu'i shan 'byed kyi sgrogs grol//tshogs drug gi shar cha nub pa'ang ma yin/ /nang gsal gyi rig pa thum la ni ma rmug/ /der 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i dpyod cha ni ga la/ /sems rtog gi 'dzin pa'i snyem yul las grol

zin/ /sngar byon gyi brgyud pa'i de 'dra zhig gsung pa'i/ /bslu brid zhig os dgos pad 'byung gi bka' yin/ /log lta mkhan rtog ge' snying la ni mdzer yang / /pha cig te bdud 'joms gling pa yi dgongs pa/ /dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlang la rdzogs pas/ /theg mchog 'dir zhugs pas spra ban nga blo bde/ /bu khyod kyang de ltar spyod na nai legs snyams// gzhan dag gi smod kyang blo bde zhig red na/ /'bad med du stong nyid snying rje'i de rgyas shing // phyogs med la dad pa dag snang rang shar la/ /zag med kyi dge la shugs 'byung du sbyor nas// mnyam rjes rang zung 'jug gdengs tshad dang ldan cing / /gol shor dang nor ba'i 'phrang rnams kun brgal te/ /gdod ma yi mgon po'i rgyal sa la chas nas//mngon gyur gyi chos sku 'grub pa zhig smon no/ /'bros phug zhes mkha' 'dza'i 'du ba yi gling nas/ /rig 'dzan gyi brgyud pa nus ldan pas gus phul/ sarba maṅga le/ ༈ /dad ldan slob bu las rab la gdams pa/ a ho// sna tshogs sna ba sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur la/ /snying po med tshul sngar song las la ltos/ /bsog 'jog ser sna'i nor la gces spras kyang /

༄7// /dbabhe med shul du bor tshe re chags gnas// 'khor ba'i kha dpon bsam na chos tshul spongs/ /dam chos yang dag bsam na 'khor ba dor// kha skad mtho yang ser sna ma grol na/ /je tso' kha nas chos bshad byas dang mtshungs/ /mgo dkar kha yi so rnams sul bur 'thor/ /chags sdang rgyal pham rtsod pa'i dus ma yin/ /rgas pa'i ngag nas zhal ta bshad che na/ /lad rgan zer cing log par mthong dog yod/ /de bas nges par lha chos bsgrub bsam na/ /kha 'og lus chug lus po dben par sdod/ /sems rtog 'khrul ba'i rjes su ye ma 'brang / /blo sna nang bstung 'dod chung chog shes brten/ /bla mar mos gus mched la brtse gdung bskyed/ /'gro drug pha mar stong nyid snying rje sgom/ /sgyu ma'i chos la skyugs log gad bro brten/ /rang gsal gnyug ma'i ye shes nan du skyongs/ /nyams rtog yon tan yar ngos zla ltar bskyed/ /lha gcig o rgyan nyid la dad mos gal/ /chos kyi sgrubamatha' shi ba'i dus la gtug /sang byed gnang bsgrub phyi bshol blo sna bstungs/ /btags shor khyi bzhin yul la mdur ma che/ /chos brgyad 'ur mo'i bya ba mdo med spongs/ /bsgos

gral gtam gral kun tu ye ma rgyug /rin chen gling phyin stong log byed pa rnams/ /khong pa'i don snying med pa'i zung zad yin/ /yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams la thugs skabs//'khor ba'i gting rdo byed na zhe re phang / /yid bzhin nor bu lag tu lon pa'i dus/ /gsol ba ma btab dbul phong nyams re thag /bzod med nyon mongs nad kyis gzir dus 'dir/ /dam chos bdud rtsi ma btung blo re gzul/ /rmi lam lta bu'i gar bsgyur snang ba la/ /chags med mdud pa ma bor mgo re 'khor/ /de 'dra'i rjes su ma zhugs dpa' bo khyed//don gnyas 'grub pa'i mdzad pa rmad byung ba/ /ci nas brten thabs ma 'khrugs e go bu/ /blun rgan kun nyi'i kha ta dran tsam phul/ /nor 'khrul mchis na rtsa gsum spyan sngar bshags/ /dge legs 'phel/ /zla 1 tshes 14 kyi thun mtshams la bya phug ron zhig byung nas/ /sdug byung sdug byungaX sdug byungaX ces zer ba la bdag gis cis byir ci la sdug zer ba'i lan du 'di lta steḥ kye kye sdug byung sems can snying rje 'chi ba dran rgyu phyogs tsam mi 'dugaḥ skye 'gro'i tshong 'dus zhig pa'i don laḥ snyang nas dran tshe mchi ma 'khrugs byung

༄7// kye kye sdug byung sprul ming snying rjeX dkor dang grong chog 'khor ba'i bya btangaḥ shin tu zhen pa mi rtog 'chi ba dran med thog rgyugs byung tshe snying rje kye kye sdugabyung grwa chubhe snying rjeḥ dge ba'i lam las 'khor ba 'byams pa'i rang sdug rang nyo 'chi ran byung yangaḥ ngan song rgyu bsgrub rnams dran yi mug kye kye sdug byung a ma rgan moḥ marachur bsogs pa'i bang mdzod bkang nasaḥ be'u ngan rnams kyi mchu bcing bya bsaX rnam smin rang thog myong tshe kye hudaḥ kye kye sdug byung a pha rgad poX tshwa tshong dgra jag lam la zhugasateḥ shi nas phyi mar dbul por gyur tsheḥ pha mas ci byed kye ma kye spyodaḥ kye kye sdug byung rnal 'byor sgoms canaX stong gsal lam la phyogs su mi bltaḥ go yul lhag nas 'chi ba byungadusaḥ tha mal lhag rnams a tsa ma'oḥ kye ma kye spyod dam ldan zer rnamasaḥ phyogs tsam mi shes dge sdig khyad gsodaḥ phra rag 'chol snyogs byed nas 'chi tsheḥ ngan song dmyal b.raspyod tshe kye kye kye ma kye hud 'gro drug sems can stong nyid snying rje byang sems bskyed nas rnga yab dpal gyi ri la shog dngaḥ pho nya nga nyid bsu bar sleb 'ongaḥ.e ma e ma dpal

gyi ri laX sdug bsngal ming med bde ba'i rang bzhin gang snang gang shar gang grags thams cad pad 'byung rdo rje gsum du lam khyeraḥ 'gro'o 'gro'o sku gsum klong laḥ ye shesalngaru zhon pas 'gro'o chags sdang rgyal pham dug lnga bshig nas chos sku'i gzhi ru grol bar e phaṭaḥ ces zer nas nub phyogs o rgyan gyis yul tu 'phur song snang shar roḥ slob bu'agyur rgyam zhes rgyam rang rig rnams kyi bzhed ngor sprul ming kun nyi'i bris pa dge'o/ zla 1 tshes bcu gnyis kyi snga thun la pheb tshe bye'u dngas dmar zhig byung nas 'di skad zer byung /kye ma kye ma rang tshugs 'dzin dgos kha rog 'dug pa'i thabs la mkhas na nged tsho lus dman dud 'gro'i tshogs kyang / bde ba'i stabs zhig byung thabs de lagasaḥ bdag gis lan smras pa/ ka ye rlubhe gi rtsa can byewa gang nas 'ong zhing 'gro ba'i don ci/ 'dod pa gang yin ltad mor gar 'gro/ gsang tshig med par bdag la gsung mdzod/ kho na re/e ma gson dang skyes bu snying nor/ bdag cag 'ong ba dbus nas sleb byung / 'gro don 'khrul snang ri mo gshigs 'ong / 'dod pa 'od gsal rdzogs chen gnad gsang / ltad mor

༄༅// sgyu ma'i yul la 'gro'o/ ma 'khrul ma 'khrul skal ldan gson dang / ma zhen ma zhen dkor la ma zhen/ mi dga' mi dga' 'khor bas mi dga'/ ma brtson ma brtson chos brgyad ma brtson/ ma 'khrul ma 'khrul rig par yan mdzod/ ma yengs ma yengs sems la 'chong mdzod/ ces gsung nas dbyings su 'phur song / / bla ma dran bzhen pas rjes shes kyis 'od gsal rgyun chags pa de'i nga nga der snang cha ma 'gags pas sku bum dbang / gsal cha ma 'gags pas gsung gsung dbang / gzung 'dzin gyis rgya grol bas shes rab ye shes kyis dbang / rig pa ye shes chen po rjen ner bud pas ka dag tshig gis dbang yang rdzogs gsungs so/ / skyabs mgon bla ma ma brjed 'di phyi yi gtsugargyan/ sdug bsngal na tsha lam khyer byang sems kyi spyod pa/ na yang na ste rten 'brel sgyu ma yi chos nyid/ 'chi yang shi ste snang ba gnas 'gyur gyi cha tsam/ grol kyang grol ste rang rig chos sku yi rgyal sa/ 'khrul yang 'khrul ste rlung sems skad cig ma'i cho 'phrul/ bde yang bde ste bsam btan skyid nyal gyi mal sa/ /sdug kyang sdug ste kun gzhi tshogs brgyad kyi

'dam dong / yod kyang yod de bden gnyis dbyer med kyi rgyal sa/ med kyang med ste rnam kun mchog ldan gyi mkha' klong / 'di 'dra'i mdo med 'chol gtam chos lo la gus phul/kun nyis so/ / ha haḥ blta ba la blta rgyu med do/ dbyings ye zung 'jug tu thal thal/ gtad med byung rgyal gyi ngang nas/ thol byung dgod kha zhig shor ro/ bsgom pa la bsgom rgyu med do/ shes rig zang thal gyi dkyil 'khor/ 'dzin med zhabrul sbubs nas thon te/ smrar brjod ma shes te lhag go/ / spyod pa la spyod rgyu med do/ rang grol rjes med du thal thal/kun 'byung zhing bzang la brten nas/ rig pa'i nyi ma zhig shar byung / he he zhu lu khyod la bshad rgyu ni phar zad/ rgad po nga rang gi 'di 'dra zhig bsnyams pa'i/ ngos bzang ma rnyed kyang thim la ni ma rmug /blo bde ku yangs dang byung rgyal zhig red ya/ /kun nyi'i phul/ rnuḥ chos nyid cir yang 'char la 'gags pa medaḥ 'gags med dbyings las bskul ba'i glu ni hūṃḥ nges don 'byung gnas snying ka o rgyan snyalaḥ chos snyi 'khor lor rnam rtog rag rnams nubaḥ phra ba'i las rlung byung zhing dwangs ba'i mtshamasaḥ kun gzhi'i chags bral rang

༄༅// gsal pad+ma mtshonaḥ tshog yul rang grol gye sar sdong po laḥ ya mtshan mchog brtes rang gsal gnyug ma'i skuḥ gang gi rang bzhin sku dang ye shes mtshonaḥ sa lam yon tan dngos grub mchog brnyes paḥ rang rig pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes sgyu grugasaḥ rig rtsal ye shes 'khor du mkha' dbyings lasaḥ 'aspyo 'ong rnam pa mang po'i rtog tshogs kunaḥ gnyug mar bzhengs bzhugs phyag rgyar rol bas bstoraḥ lta sgom spyod pas khyed skyu rjes slob cingaḥ snang srid bla mar 'char ba'i bskyed rim dang / thugs yid gcig 'dres zab mo'i rdzogs rim sgyuḥ mnyam rjes rnam pa kun tu bdag sgrub skyuḥ ye shes gzigs pas byin gyis rlobs pa'i phyir dbu ma'i dbyings nas mngon sum gshegs spya gsolaḥyon tan kun 'byung gu ru rin po cheḥ rang sems chags bral rig pa pad+ma 'byung snang sems zag bral 'bras bu sirnyi nyidaḥ dngos grub kun mdzod kun bzang thugs 1nga hūṃ tshe lus 'di ru thob phyir bla rnam dngaX nyams len dbyer med don la ma 'byugs remaḥ phu na dgra byung mdo na grogs rted sogasaḥ 'jig rten chos brgyad bya bas ci zhig byedaḥ nged rang

dal rten thob pa da res tsam ༷ khyad par gsang chen mjal ba lan gcig yinaX bya ba dgu sprugs thong la nyams len gyis 'chi dus blo lhag med mdzod seng ge lagasaḥ ces kyang chos par rem shig ngag rgyam loX rdzong stod rgad po nag chung spyod nas phulaX sgrub pa nyams len 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog sarba ma le/ / mi bde'i nyams gcol skyo glu rdol byung / mkha' spyod 'phur nus gshog rtsal yod na/ mtha' mi'i rgud gdung bzod pa lta ci/ lha lam 'ja' dar gdong nas bsgrod 'dod/ kla sgo'i chos gral snyogs pa lta ci/ thal dkar gnyis 'thung khri khar 'khod kyang / smon log bu dgu'i mnar gcod mi bzod/ rang gzhan mang po gdong lngar 'dod kyang / snyigs ma'i skyabs mgon gyur pa gcig tsam/ sgyu ma'i nor la sred gdung byas byas/ gcer bu lag stong gyur tshe thang chad/ mdo med mi la chags sdang rtsod rtsod/ chos rgya zhab bsen bsnyen tshe rang sdug sred gdung chags pas ser sna byas byas/ srid pa'i mes gdung skoms pas nyams thag rgad po gar song gar bsdad sa cha/ mkha' spyod dhak+ki'i snang ba mi 'bral/ mig gi bdud rtsi la phrug zungs te/ rgyal khab

༄༅// nyul bas rgad po'i yid skyo/ rang gzhi srid pa gzhan dbang mi 'chor/ blta rtogs skor dgos byung na ga chad/ pad+ma'i zhal tshab 'brug gi nor bu/ mkha' dbyings klong la nam 'gro cha med/ gzhan phan bsam pa bzang po yod kyang / spyi mthun las dbang skyobs pa'i mthu sdug /gnyen po'i bdud rtsi'i skal bar 'byor kyang / ha las rgyas pas 'tsho thabs dka' ye/ mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las la 'byor kya / yid gtad med pas rten 'brel der 'gyur/ bu gces rta mchog steng na brtse na/ rgad po rdza rnga'i ke'u tshangs snyogs 'dod/ lha ldan re ba'i shing rta med kyang / nye phyogs dbo li gad khung rtsol 'dod/ phan bde'i bsam sbyor ci byung ci lcog phar zad thug dus srog la mi sems/ chu log 'ol kha rang gnas 'gro yang / phong rgud mang po spyi mthun las so/ mi 'gyur gser gyi rdo rje 'od ldan/ dam tshig gzu kyi thags pas 'brel yangs/ /'gro 'dod rkang pa rlung gi 'degs na/ dam tshig chu la pho dgos e 'byung / gter ston rkyang pa'i skye ba bcu gsum/ pho rgo mtho bas min dang 'thob byung / zhal bzang bdud rtsi btung ba'i skal ba/ bka' sgrubs mos

gus dag snang rag las/ lnga ldan rang byung pad+ma rgyal po'i/ /zhab pad khur ba'i skal bzang yod kyi/ mkha' spyod lha gral rkyon du ma sems/ bde stong spyod la za rngams 'ur langs/'dod chags rdo rje 'phar lang min dang / rjes chags zhu bde'i bha gar 'jug snyams/ ga li ngo 'dzum 'dre mor mi sems/ mtsho rgyal zhabs sen bsnyen la re ches yeng ma lam la sdod tshul byas kyang / 'jigs rung duḥkha'i mnar ba kha cig sems kyis ma bor rtogs pas bzungs nas/ lta ba'i ngang la rgyas gdab tshug ya/ thugs khrel zhe gnyis med pas zhing rgan/ blo yis 'dor phod ma byung e ya/ kun nyis phul/

//sa gnubs grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po'i zhal nas/ sbas don bkrol ba phyag rgya bstan paḥ lam du slong ba gsum lasaḥ dang po niḥ kun rdzob rgyu yi sbas don kun gzhi chos kyi dbyings ma byung ma skyes paḥ khu sdul rlung gi rta la brten te sgyu ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor lung gi gsang ba chen poḥ yum kun tu bzang mo rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong panyid kyi dbyings dang / bde chen ye shes byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor yab kun tu bzang po nyid kyi rang bzhin dngaḥ dbyings ye zung 'jug chen po'i rol rtsal sras mnyam pa nyid kyi dal/ snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur thams cad zung 'jug ye shes kyi ngang las ma g.yos pa'i dkyil 'khor dang gsum mo/ deyang gnas pa rtsa nigatso mo gsum dang 'khor lo lngaḥ yan lag nyi khri chig stong gzhan yang bye ba sa yas rang bzhin tu gnas pa dang / de yang rlung lnga dang dbang po'i rlung dngaḥ yan lag gi rlung 'gyu bachen po dang 'bring dang chung ngu ste phyi nang gnyis su rgyu ba g.yo ba rlung gi rang bzhin noḥ de dag la brten pas bde chen nam mkha'i rdo rje gus byang chub kyi sems dngaX mkha' 'gro ma
