rngams ma'i dngaḥ dbyings phyug dpal gyis dngaḥ kun bzang gzhi yi dngaḥ 'bar ba las kyi dngaḥ tshang chen rlung gi thig le sogs mdor na gnas pa dang g.yo ba gnyis char mnyamapa'i bde ba chag gi rdo rje yab yum bgrangs las 'das soḥ 'di ne+e rtsa ba rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor zhes su grags de dag gi dwangs ma khams lnga 'dus pa 'byung ba'i dkyila'akhor ye shes kyi rten can gser zhun ma lta bu ru bzhugs pa ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs can cha med kun 'gro khyab pa'i thig le ga ga ma 'pho 'gyur med pa phra ba'i dkyila'akhor dngaḥ 'dod chags chos kyi sbas don sbyor ba bzhi ldan rlung gi rta la drangs nas gtum mo yas 'bar dang bdud rtsi mas 'dzag gis 'khor lo bzhi yi rnal 'byor las su rungabaX nam mkha' ltar khyab paX rdzing bu ltar 'byil baX sgron me ltar 'bar baX bum pa ltar gcun pa ste bzhi yi dam tshig chen po las su rung bas ḍāk+ki'i sprin rtsi bcud la bung babazhin tu 'khor bar 'gyur ro/ de yi tshe 'khor lo lnga yi dbyings bskulaḥ dpa' bo dpa' mo rjes chags la rolaḥ dga' ba bzhi bzhi dang stong pa bzhi bzhi'i 'od gsal mngon du

1/sa byas de dbab pa dang bskyil baḥ 'dren pa dang dgram pa 'dzag med na dwa'i stobs su bcing nas khams kyi zag pa zadaX gnas pa grangs su bsrengasaḥdabu mar ga naḥ khyad par dbyangs gsal nyi zla'i ga'u shes rab sgog tu shar ba 'od gsal rdo rje lu gu rgyud la 'khor 'das brtan g.yo gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga'i dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dam tshig gcig tu bsre bas dgongs spyod la sgob par byaḥ mkha' gsang bde ba chen po'i phyag rgyaX me dam tshig gi phyag rgyaḥ shes rab chos kyil brtan pa ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po'i spyod yul lo snang ba sems kyi sbas don la la na dwa'i dbyings bskul ba dhu te nam mkhar dpag pa'i mkha' la sur+ya dang par bsre zhing steng sgo nas kun+dhar 'dug paḥ mi 'gyur chos kyi mchod sdong chen por dbyangs gsal kha sbyor ba'i ze'u 'brur bde ba chen po'i 'od gsal kun nas 'bar baḥpa grol baX sred gdung dben paḥ kun nas nyon mongs pa mi mnga' baX dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i snying nye zhing zer gyis khu rdul rlung gi zag pa zad nas rang lam gyis ‘

po'i drod zin pa la sbyor baḥ stong pa rtags kyi sbas don snod bcud rnam dag lha dang lha mo sgyu lus rtsa dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor la la na dwa dhu ti'i lha skuḥ skad cig gi shar ba nam mkha' la bza' skar bkra ba lta bu yud tsam gyis rim bsdu nam mkha' la yal ba bzhin du stong pa'i rang bzhin gsal tsam pa0 snang ba'i rang bzhin mtshan ma med paḥ yid rig ye shes kyi wa snang gzung rig dam tshig gi lha snang bde stong kha sbyor gyi lha snang : 'bar g.yo dgyes chags kyi lha snang 'od gsal rdu ti'i lha snang / snang grags dran rig thams cad mkha' klong mnyam pa nyid du skad cig dran rdzogs bsdu ldang mnyam sbyor bya ba ni chos 'di'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i khyad par roX gnyis pa ni bsam gtan gyis chos bdun bca' ba tshogs bdun rang grolaḥ rlung dbyung ba nyon mongs dug gsal drangs su bsrengs ba dkyil 'khor bca' ba rngub dgang bya ba rdul tshon spro baX gzhil zhing 'phen pa tshom bu dgod paḥ dkar dmar bsdu ba lha sku'i rnal 'byor nyi zla kha sbyor ting 'dzin srog mkharaḥ dga' ba bcu drug lus kyi mchod pa byed pa bcing ba nang gi bzlas pa ku nyams

/〉〉 med gsang ba'i dam tshigaX 'od gsal bsnyen pa shes rab ting 'dzinaX me dang thig le mchod pa'i dam rdzasaX bskul bskyod thams cad bro gar rang bzhin mkha' la rol ba sngags kyi dgongs spyodaḥ de ltar mtha' bdun nam bcu yis rnal 'byer la rgyun du gnas par bya bas lus las su rung baX ngag sngags su 'phoḥ sems 'odagasal rjen par grol nas smra bsam brjod bral gyi ye shes chen por la zlo bar 'gyur roḥ gsum pa niḥ gnas la spyod cing dam tshig bsre baḥ yul la rol nas su kha sgrub pa mkha' 'gro dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs sngags zhing skyes thams cad rtse gcig tu bsnyen pa phyag gis bkur ba 'dzum gyis btud pa pad rdor bsre baḥ sngags su shes pa dgongs spyod la slob paḥ rjes chags kyis bskul baḥ byang chub kyi sems srungs baḥ gus dam tshig tu 'chang ba glu bro gar la gnas paḥ kun spyod g.yon nas 'khyer ba skyon canal 'dzem pa rigs can la brtse baX 'byung 'jug bde chen ye shes su kha sbyor baX 'di dag ni ma rgyud lugs kyi rnal 'byor gyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i nye lam sman du gyur
ba ca pa dab
༄༅// glob bu chos gsar la gdams pa rnal 'byor spro ba'i rgyang glu dpa' bo rig 'dzin 'bod pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya baḥ

༄༅// gnas dza lan rda ra'i ba gam nas/ /drin mtshungs gral skyabs kun yongs 'dus rje/ /dpal gling pa bdud 'joms dpa' bo des/ dus rnam kun 'bral med skyongs du gsol/ /gnas mi med rdza rnga'i ke'u tshangs du/ /skyabs mtshungs bral gdong lnga'i dbang po 'gyengs/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bdud rtsi 'bebs/ /khyed snod ldan yin na de ru bzhugs/ /rtsal rnam gsum lus la 'dzom pa na/ /gcan phal ba'i khyu las 'dra sa med/ /gnas mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings rum na/ /skyabs bsgru med mkha' lding rgyal po bzhugs/ chos rdzogs chen bstan pa'i nyi ma sbar/ /khyed bya ba thong na de ru bzhugs/ /don lhan skyes yid bzhin nor bu rnyed/ /yang 'dab chags gzhan dang 'dra sa med//gnas gangs ri dkar po'i rtse mo na// skyabs 'dren mchog dbyar rnga'i dbang po bzhugs/ /bcud lta ba'i rgyang glu 'gags med sgrogs// khyed pha yul bu ngo gna' ru bzhugs//chos dag mnyams rtogs pa'i dga' ba rgyas/ /de phal ba'i sder chags dang mtshungs pa min/ /ma dros kyi byang phyogs pad tshal du// skyabs brtse chen rma bya'i zlos gar bsgyur/ /

༄༅// chos thegs dgu'i ro bcud sbrang rtsi 'byed/ khyed blo thags chod na de ru bzhugs/ /yul zab pa'i bcud kyi zhe kha brgyag/ /'dabs rkang drug phal dang 'dra ba min/ /gnas mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i yang dben du/ /skyabs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs/ /chos zab gter chu bo bdun ldan 'gyed/ /khyed dad mos yod na de ru bzhugs//dbang snyan brgyud thabs kyi rtogs pa rted/ /chos dred po'i khyu dang 'dra ba min/ /gnas don la phun tshogs lnga ldan der/ skyabs gser zhal thugs rje'i nyi ma bzhugs/ /thabs gang la gang 'dul brin las 'gyed/ /khyed las 'phro ldan na de ru bzhugs/ /thugs brtse ba'i rjes bzung don ldan byed/ /blo ma rig rmongs dang 'dra ba min/ /rang mthong mi bstod ra ma yin par// gnas tshul gyi brtse gtams sprengs ba lags/ a ho/ /mi min rang snang ston pas brtse chen thugs rje yi zin skabs/ /dal 'byor don dang ldan pa dam pa'i lha chos la gzhol 'tshal/ nam 'chi cha med yin pas 'chi khar phan nges kyi gdam pa/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gnas las gtan bde sangs rgyas kyi sar snyogs/ rgyu 'bras bslu med 'di las

ra dor las rem brlo/ skyabs gsum phan bde'i nyi ma bsnyen na 'di bde dang phyi skyid/ theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba byang chub sems gnyis las slob shig /tshogs / dag phyir yan lag rab bdun la 'bad dgos/ dngos grub nyams rtogs rtsa ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gzhol mdzod/ ma bsgom dran pa grol ba zab lam 'pho ba la lus kyi tshogs bsags 'bum 'gyur sgyu lus sbyin gtong las slob shig /snang grags dranarig 'di dag snang ba lhar bsgrub la gnas shing / dbyings ye sras gsum 1de stong zhu bde la snyoms zhugs/ /mi rtog rang ngo shis pas rnams shes yid shes dang shan 'byed/ kun gzhi'i rmongs g.ya' bsal nas chos sku khyab brdal la ngo bo stong pa ka dag dgongs brgyud ye shes la 'jog kyi/ rang bshin 'od gsal sangs dwangs rang bab rig pa la cham bzhag/ thugs rje'i mkhyen cha ma 'gags rab kyi srog ldan/ /snang ba phyi ru ma lus rig pa'i rnam ldan las sangs khrol/ rtog pa nang du ma lus cha med kun khyab la brdal gyi/ zang thal ris med chen po gdod

༄༅// ma'i ye gdangs la sa bzungs/ /gcig shes kun grol 'dug pas rin chen gser gling dang 'dra mtshungs/ /mnyam bzhag mnyug ma'i 'od gsal rjes thob spyod lam la bsre dgos/ dza lan+ta ra'i ba gam bla ma sangs rgyas de bsgom nas/ /'dug pa tha mal mi 'chor gsol gdab dbang blang la gzhol 'tshal/ lam pa ka yi 'od klong gu ru thugs rje can bsnyen bzhin/ bza' btung tshogs su spel bas bsod nams 'bad med la 'khrungs 'ong / kuñci ka yi pad 'tshor skyabs mgon thugs rje can gsal gdab/ thugs yid dbyer med bsres pa rmi lam 'od gsal du kha sbyor/ /ma la wa brgyad stegs khar bka' drin gsum ldan rje bzhugs gsol/ /'gul bskyod bro gar bskor bas 'gro ba tha mas las mi 'chor/ /skyid sdug legs nyes gang byung re ltos bla ma las gzhan med/ /gang la gtug dgos byung yangs shan 'byed la dor la 'bad dgos/ sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur gang ngoms lta ba'i rtsal sbyangs zhig red na/ /yod pa brkyang 'tsho thub dka' rang byung ye shes de brten 'tshal/ /med na btsal bas mi rted 'phags pa'i nor bdun la spyod zhu/ /'bras

bu sangs rgyas dgongs pa kun bzang lag bcing ma 'di la/ 'bad pas lhur len bya dgos 'phrad pa lan gcig las dka' nges/ /bla ma'i thugs kyi man ngag chud zos rod medal ma gtong / /mi tshe chos la dril dang 'chi dus blo lhag gang mi gda'/ /zhal bkod dpe thogs ma lus dran pa'i ga'u ru chug la/ /spyod lam rnams bzhi dus kun shes bzhinagazigs rtogs re mdzad nas/ /bag dang ldan pa dam tshig srung mtshams mi 'chol bar spyod na/ /rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa bsgrod ye shes chos sku ru pheb 'gro/ /de tshul thugs la 'jog 'tshal kun nyis brjed tho ru gus phul/ /sarba maṅga le/'u gling pa bdud 'joms dpa' bo'i rjes su zungs/ /thar pa'i lam sna zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /phar ltos dpon gyi ci bya rang tshug zungs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma brten nabaslu med yin/ /tshur ltos g.yog gi ci bya bkol mi btub/ /gzhan phan don gnyer lhag bsam rnam dag rem/ 'dul rgyu'i dgra la zhe sdang ye ma rtsod/ /nyon mongs dug lnga thul na

༄༅// gdul bya yin/ /skyongs rgyu'i gnyen la zhen chags gdung ma che/ /rang rgyud chos kyi 'dul dgos snying gtam lags/ mi zhes ri mgo gang mtho'i nyi ma ste/ /blo gtad khel ba med pas btang snyoms 'tshal/ 'gros mdur rkang pa ma yang sdod tshug zungs/ /grogs tshol sa nas gyong dang 'phrad nyen gda'/ /le lo rnam g.yeng bag med mi bya bar/ nang don sgoms dang dge sbyor dag la 'bod/ bya ba zin med mang po'i sne ma brtsams/ da phan bshad sgrub bstan pa'i zhabs tog gyis/ /gto yas grong chog kun la 'byams ma che/ 'dre bgegs dam sri'i dbang du bsgyur yangs nye/ /mi ngan mdo rtsa shor la blo ma gtad/ /mis 'phya rang sdug nyo ba chos nyid yin/ /phra ma zhal lce rtsod mkhan nye ma brten/ /sgra 'dzin 'jam dal med pa gzigs dang gsal/ /rig rig mthong mthong nyo tshongs ma mdzad las/ bu lon sod med mi rna rdzod nges yin// blo sems nag po khung rub gyur na sdug/g.yo med rgyud drangs phan sems 'chang na legs/ /dran tshad thams cad kha las lab rgyu min/ /blo thog khel ba re 'ga' tsam las med// sgom don thugs la mi bzhugs tshig ma

'chal/ /kha 'byams lta ba'i nyes pa 'byung na thang // mtho ngo dma' zhen med par ngo snyoms nas/ /rang mdo mi 'chor ba zhig byas na legs/ gong rnams brtsi shes dma' ba skyongs shes kyis/ /phrag dog dga' sdug ma che shong yangs mdzod// bsam bzang gtam la shag lan med par nyan/ /ngo lkog mi mtshungs ba la blo ma bstun/ /lto gos gtam gsum chod padam pa'i lugs/ /de 'dra'i re ba med dang ci lcog zhog /ha cang bsdam ma che la lhod ma drag /pho bzang dag gi blo dang bstun par gyis/ /las dang rnams smin rang gi myong dgos pas/ /dkor sbyangs yon spyongs 'di la ma zob rem/ /glo 'dogs kher rgyu lkog sbyin mi mdzad par/ /bla gnyer blo rten bsam pa gcig dril gyis/ /so thar 'dul ba'i sdom pa'i rtsa ba 'di/ /rin chen srog ltar 'chang dgos bu rab po/ /byang sems bslab bya sngags kyi lta dgongs kun/ /ya rab gong ma'i rjes snyogs ma 'chug rem/ /bla ma sangs rgyas ma brjed gsol ba thob/ /thugs yid dbyer med bsre la bag ldan mdzod/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi zag su mi 'jug par/ /nyams len ci lcog 'bad la bskul ma yin/ /sa dang lam la

༄༅// bar chad med pa yi/ /'brel thog phan bder 'god la yang yang rem/ /dal rten rin chen chud zos mi byed par/ /'chi tshe gdung dang rang bsrel 'byung nges kyis/ /zhal gdams dpe thog lus na phan pa med/ /rtag par sems la zungs shig theg mchog rgyal/ /bsam bzang rgad po kun bzang nyi ma'i phul/ /sarba maṅka lam̐/ bslu med bdud 'joms dpa' bo'i zhabs pad la gus btud/ /skyid sdug legs nyes rnams kun thugs rje yi gzigs mdzod/ /sprang spyon gzhan don rgyal khams rgyang skor la phyogs tshe//bar chad bdud kyi rgol bas 'gro phan sgo bkag thal// mi min lha 'dre ar gtad dgongs pa yi gzir tshe/ /mngal skyes lus la 'byung po'i dbal zer yang thob thal/ /grong chog 'dre brdung byed rnams rnga sil rnams chal chol/ bdag med rtogs pa med pas gto chog de mtshang che/ gshin 'dren bum li chus bkang bdun chog la pheb kyang / /rang rig chos sku pa mjal ro dom de mtshangs che/ /nyin mtshan rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bsogs 'jog la re bas/ /'byor ldan chom rkun dag 'dra'i chos pa de mtshangs che/ /nyin srib khug lu byug 'dzin

slong mo la mdur kyang / /rab zla tha bdun bsnyen sgrub mi byed pa mtshangs che/ /thun mgor bla rnam lhang lhang dang spro re bskul yang / thun bar sgo nas sgo nyul rkang yang de mtshangs che//mtho skad gla yu 'khor thub rdzoṭa skad re sgrogs kyang / dug lnga'i gting rung nyal 'phaṭa byed pa de mtshangs che/ med mod stong pa'i 'ur mo khyu gzhogs su skad kyang / /khab dang rkudapa'i bsogs 'jog ser sna de mtshangs che/ /bdag med rtog zer khra ta'i a skad ltar 'chad kyang / /a don sems la med pas 'khrul rgan de mtshangs che/ /yul med brag cha stongapa'i lo rgyus la mkhas kyang / /lto gos gtam gsum ma chod rang ga ma mtshangs che/ /yeng 'khrul med zhes mig gcer nam mkha' la bsgrad kyang / /gto chog gshin 'dren gsonaskyabs 'khor yug 'di mtshangs che/ /lugs gnyis char 'gal smon pa sdig gla ba lta bu'i/ /chom rkun byi la'i brtul zhug byed mkhan dag mtshangs che/'dza deX yin zhes dbyar rgunaston daphyid la mdur mdur/ /bsnyen sgrub than du brtsi ba'i rnal 'byor de mtshangs che/ /skye ba mtho skad mngon shes rjes dran dag yod rlom/ /bshad sgrub than du brtsi ba'i sku skyes tsho

༄༅// mtshangs che/ ro bsha' 'drer 'dzin che zhing rtsing spyod la 'chol bas/ /mtshangs thog mngon sum bzhugs pas gcod pa tsho mtshangs che/ brgyud gsum chig rdzogasadagongs pa'i pha nor dang g.yel bas/ /sa min rdo min mang 'byor gter ston khong mtshangs che/ /'gal zla 'di rnams bral ba'i rnal 'byor re mdzad na/ /rgad po blo bde 'chi thuba'adun ma yang grub nges/ /skyo glu sems gyi 'bras bu dpe thog la shor thal/ /nus ldan dpal kyi rdo rjes rma mdun nas spel lo/ /sarba maṅga le/ /kho re sems kyi bu chung kirti pa/ /khong tshag klod la rig pa phyam brdal zhog /ris 'jog rtsis gdab spang blang ma bslad par/ /snang srid 'khor 'das ro snyoms phyam mer zhog /gang yin yin la gang min min du chug/bde sdug nyams kyi ri mo thad gar zhog /skyid kyang skyid la sdug na'ang sdug tu chug /dus gsum rtog pa dgag sgrub med par zhog /gang ltar song kyang song la ci 'ong shog /ces kyang dgos med nang du gtug la zhog /phan bde ster mkhan med rung yod kyang yod/ rnyed tshol bkur sti snyan grags dor la zhog /dbul yang dbul ste sprang yang spangs la shog/

'dun ma ma mangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ su ma mgu yang mgu ste dga' yang dga'/ nor mchog mos gus dad pa dag snang zhog /'byer gzhan chung kyang chung la nyung yang nyung /sgran thub bzod brtson sbongs klog phyogs la zhog /mi ngo khyog dang ma khyog thams cad rung / de ltar gdams ngag mdo rtsa sems la zhog /nga yi ngo bo pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal/ /rang bzhin ma 'gags sgyu ma'i ded dpon tshul/ /thugs rjes lcags kyus gdul bya'i dad blor zin/ bzang ngan gang 'brel o rgyan phrin las yin/ /spyod pa khyi phag 'dra rung las ldan gsung / /dgongs pa'i rtsal las rgyal khams 'jal skor byas/ /thams cad sprul sku'i zhing khams pad+ma 'od/ /skye med yig 'bru gcig mas gdangs sgra kun/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ//'gyu 'phro thams cad ye shes bla ma'i 'khor/ /rig pa pad 'byung bzhengs bzhugs mdzad phrin lags/ /mtshar rgyu yod do spro ba de rang che/ /gur chung nang nas skyid nyams bzhad mo byung / /'gro 'dod bsam pa ma ngal bde mor bzhugs/ /'degs 'jog sdog pa ma ngal stan thog bzhugs/ /bsogs 'dod nor gyi ma ngal gcer bur bzhugs/ /'gro nyin

༄7// gcig yod nged rang pha bu kun/ /bskyod nyin gcig yod pad+ma 'od du 'tshogs/ /bsogs nyin gcig yod longs spyod rdzogs skur spyod/ /blo sna ma mang bsamaphug de ltar lags/ /nga dang lta spyod mthun rnams sems la zhog /brel mtshub sgyu ma'i sems can snying re rje/ /sangs rgyas zhing bkod sems can lus su blta/ /'di rnams o rgyanapad+ma'i thugs rje yis/ /btsan thabs nyid du dpal rir lam sna drongs/ /mi dred had po nus ldan rdo rjes phul/ sarba maṅga le/ /dren mtshungs med bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /gnas spyi bo'igatsug gi nam mkhar mchod/ lar chos ma mos pa'i gang zag khyed/ /tshe phyi mar bsam nas 'dir sleb legs/ /rgyud brtags dpyad byed par ma 'khrug rem/ /grogs gnyenabashes zhen pa chod na dge/ /pha bla ma'i zhal chems bsgo ba ltar/ /sgo gsum po dge la sbyor ba dang/ /chos dam tshig gnad du theng ba na/ /khyed pha yis drin lan gzo ba 'dra/ /donabyang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /'gro don ched kho na la dmigs nas/ /byams snying rjes blo sbyongs la 'bad na/ /khyed ma yis drin lan gzo ba 'dra/ /lar gang snang dag pa

rab 'byams la// khyed shes nas dad pa sbyang ba dang / /blo the tshom log lta spangs nus na/ /gnyen nye 'brel drin lan gzo ba 'dra/ rang rtsa na bzhugs pa'i chos sku de/ /le lo dngagazungs 'dzin dbang ma gtong / /ngang gnasagyi bsam gtan btsun mo legs/ gzhan bud med brten pa'i dgos pa med/ /dbyings 'od gsal yang ba'i gdan khri la/ /don bdestong zag med zas la spyod/ /gang shar yang rang rig rgyal po'i brgyan/ /khyod rang yul dpon gyi dgos med 'dra/ /gdangs shes rab zab mo'i kun shes rgyal/ /'dzin rtogs pa'iyul las 'das pa'i dus/ /'bad rtsol bral ye bab blon po yod/ /khyod rang khyim mi drag dgos med 'dra/ / lar snang ba'i yul la zhen pa chod/ /nyams dman sprang rigs la zingazing gtong/ lam zab mo ston dang sbyin pa'i nor/ /khyod rang khyim nor phyugs dgos med 'dra/ /phyi so thar mdzes pa'i me tog la/ /nyes kun sdoms dge ba'i las rnams sdud//'gro don byed tshul khrim bslab pa'i brgyan/ /khyod rang khyims brgyan gyi dgos med 'dra/ /sdang dgra yisazug rngu sran nus cing / /chos phyir du dka' tshegs tsha grangs bsgrod/ /don

༄༅// lta ba'i gnad rtogs bzod pa'i gos/ /khyod rang khyims gos kyi byar med 'dra/ /lar dam pa'i chos la gzhol ba'i skabs/ /snying dpa' shugs bskyed la go chabasgo/ /g.yul le lo'i thang gcod brtson 'grus rta/ /khyod rang khyims rta yis dgos med 'dra// dus nyin mtshan dbyer med nyams len ngang / 41da bsam gtan de las ma 'dasan/ /de rgyal ba dgyes pa'i bsam gtan zas/ /khyod rang khyims zas kyi byar med 'dra/ /don thos bsam bsgom pa'i na tshod dar/ /lha bsgoms pa'i gdengs dang mi 'bral ba/ /blogatad chog shes rab grogs po yod/ /khyod rang yul grong kyi dgos med 'dra/ /gnas mi med dben pa'i ri rtse na/ /g.yul rkyen snang bdud kyi jag pa nyung / /der brten mdzod rangayul dgos med 'dra// 'dra bcu gsum pa yi rgyang glu de/ /sims la brten phan no chos lhun gnyis/ /rgad nag po spyon pa kun nyi'i smras/ dge'o/ / drin mtshungs med bla ma rin poche/ /gnas snying dbus thig ler dad brgya'i mchod/ rten dal 'byor mi lus thob pa de/ khyed pho sgo mtho ba'i 'bras bu min// 'di don dang ldan par ma byas na/ /khyed 'byon sa bar

do'i 'phrang chen yod/ /gnas mi med dben pa'i ri la songs/ /blo 'du 'dzi'i bya bzhag shul tu bskyur/ /skyo chad de ba la blo re sbyongs// dus de tshe nyams re 'byung rgyu yod//gzugs mdzes kyang mi rtags rgas pa'i chos// sgra snyan kyang mi rtags stong pa'i rgyu/ /yul gang yang zhakhrul ba'i mtshangs btsal na/ /khyed 'dzin zhen de la gnod re thang / /gar song yang bla ma rin po cher/ /yid mos gus ldan na byin rlabs 'byung / /blo the tshom can gyi gang zag la/ /mgon sangs rgyas stong gi byin rlabs zad// khyed de rang bde mor 'di ru bzhugs/ /sang nyin par e rtag cha med yin/ /dbug dar chen thim sdud shar ba na/ /dpa' chen po yod dam snying gi bu/ /khyed 'di snang skabs na zhe sdang che// dgra 'chi bdag bdud po thon nyin la/ /dpa' mi zhus zhe sdang rngam po che/ /bskyed nus pa yod dam snying gi bu/ /khyed 'di snang skabs na 'dod chags che/ /dgra shal ma ri yi sdong po'i rtser/ snying dga' ba'i lcags kyis bu mo yod/ /chags sbyor ba nus sam snying gi bu/ khyed 'di snang skabs na gti mug che/ /dgra bar do'i mun nag 'thibs pa'i dus/ /gti mug gi snang ba

༄༅// mngon sum can/ /de ro nyal thub bam snying gi bu/ /yul mkha' la lding ba'i bya rgyal khyung/ /sgro gshog drug rgyas pa'i lang tsho yis/ /sa bar snang rlabs kyis gcod pa la/ /thabs mang po mi dgos rang rtsar rgyas/ /lha 'od gsal nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong / /don shes rab rig pa'i bu chung bsgrod/ /rtsal ci lta ci snyed lang tsho rgyas//g.yul mtshan ma'i bar snang shugs kyis gcod/ /dpe bum pa bcag pa'i nam mkha' dang / /phyi nam mkha' rnam par dag pa gnyis// gcig gyur tshe dbye ba 'byed pa ni/ /gzhan sus kyang mi nus ro gcig ngang / /gzhi 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang / lam byung rgyal rig pa'i ye shes gnyis/ /blo 'dzin pas ma bcos ro gcig ngang / /da sus kyang gnyis su byar med lags/ /yul khrim bdag rgyal chen gtum rngams can/ 'khor bran 'bang rtsal du sdud pa'i dus/ /sems shes pa bred nas bag zon byed/ tshig re 'ga' tsam yang log sa med/ /'dir bya spyod rnams pa thams cad la/ /dran stod phur bkra nas lta ba skyongs/ /yid shes bzhin gsal ba'i sgom par 'grogs/ /rgyud bag yod kyis ni 'jug ldog

gzab/ slar ma rig mun pa sangs ba'i skabs/ /ye ci bzhin gnyug ma'i ngang mdangs rgyas/ /dus de skabs gzung 'dzin bdud las rgyal/ /bu de ltar ma 'chug snying sgob chos gragasalhun rgyam gnyis/ /nga dug lnga che bas khyi phag 'dra/ nga rnam g.yeng che bas byas pa 'dra/ nga mi dge che bas rnga mong 'dra/ /khyed rnams gnyis de ltar ma mdzad legs/ kun nyi'i phul/ /de nas yang / ka tshom yi ge'i tshig la mkhas 'dod kyang / /kha tsam brjod pa'i sems la phan mi 'byung / /ga nas brtag kyang shes 'dod zhe rtsa sbos/ /nga rgyal de tshos thar ba'i srog rtsa'agags/ /ca co gdangs dbyangs phyag len mdzes pa dang / /cha lang sil snyan 'bud dkrol legs na yang / /ja bkol byed rgyus dkor la mgrim srid kyang / /nya mo lcags kyu'izin ltar 'khor bar 'chang / ta ler dal 'byor mi lus rin po che/ /tha chad las nyon dbang du mi gtong bar/ /da nas zag med dge sbyor ma 'bad na/ /na tsha gzer chen theb du cizhig bya// pa gang la sogs chos skyong drag rtsal can/ /pha rol dgra bo brlag byed bsgrub na yang / /ba thag bkram bzhin rang gi rang nyid bcing / ma gyur 'gro bar zhe gnag rang la

༄༅// sdug /tsa tshub 'khrugs pa ngar 'dzin bdud kyi gegs/ /tsha zhing bsregs pa zhe sdang 'bar ba'i me/ /dza gad lta bu'i chags sred 'dod zhen chung / wa mo khung ltar 'gum bzhin gti mug mun/ /zha bo ltar lhag 'khor ba'i le los dgra/ /za zis myos ltar blud mkhan rnam g.yeng bdud/ 'a ye de dag ma lus thams cad la/ /ya rab rgyal ba'i shes rab ral gri yis/ /ra co bcad bzhin dpa' gtum cham phab te/ la 'ur gnyis med dbu ma chen po'i sbub/ sha khrag gtor bzhin rtsa ba drung 'byin nas/ sa chen rig pa chos skur dpag thub na/ ha ha 'khor ba 'di las thar ba 'dra/ a rog slob bu rnam gnyis thugs la zhog /kun nyi'i gus phul/ dge'o/ / e ma/ ka ye dben pa'i ri khrod skyid po/ /kha dog yag mdzes khang pa'i dgos med/ /ga bzhi gdung brgyad khang ba don med// nga 'dzin med pa'i sa phug bral phug /ca cos 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal lo/ /cha lugs chosagazugs bdag 'dra lta bu'i/ /ja nas bsogs 'jog khe bskyed byas pa/ /nya mo lcags kyus sha zan ltar ro/ /ta res dal 'byor lus rten thob dus/ /tha chad dkor la 'byams

song yi mug /da lam sang phod blo sna rang yang / /na gzer 'chi ba thog du sdug go// pa 'ur mi tshe yang la zad song / /pha rol 'gro ran da ni ci byed/ /ba glang dud 'gro'i khyu dang khyad med/ /ma gi dmyal khams 'grim dgos sdug go/ /tsa ri dben pa'i dga' tshal brten nas// tsha grang khyad bsad chos la 'bad dgos/ /dza hūṃ mig bsgrad 'dul las byas kyang //wa brgyal 'dra ba'i 'dre 'dzin mi 'dul/ /zha ltar brten pa'i bla ma'i sku drung / /za btung zings zing med kyang sdod dgos/ /'a legs bka' gdam gong ma'i mdzad spyod/ /ya rab rig 'dzin bla ma'i slobs brgyud/ ral ba glegs bam gtsug tu brten nas/ la 'ur rig pa'i rang ngo bskyang na/ khra khrag 'ja' lus 'od skur grub de/ sa lam skad cig gcig gis chod pa/ ha ha de 'dres skyes bu dam pa/ a don skye med nang dbying grol 'gro/ a legs rje btsun bla ma'i sku drin/ e go mig nas mchi ma shor 'ong / /'u cag de 'dra'i brgyud pa red ya/ /ya ya ma 'jug snying grong dam pa/ he he sprang po'i glu mgur phul lo/ / mos ldan blo gros bzang po la/ snying gtams sems la brlan rgyu bgo /dal 'byor rin chen gru gzing

༄༅// ni/ yang yang rnyed pa ma yin pa'i/ brgya las lan gcig 'byung ba yis/ /rten bzang chud zos ma byed rem/ /thos tshogs mtha' rgya chod par dka'/ /de tshulartogs pa'i re ba med/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// brten dang rtsa ba de ru 'dus/ dbang bskur byed pa'i re ba med/ /rnams grangs bsam mi khyab na'ang / /rang rigachos sku rtogs gyur na/ /rang dbang rang la thob pa'o/ /gto 'don byed pa'i re ba med/ nang rtog nyon mong 'dul la brtson/ /gzung 'dzin dbu mar bsgral nus na/ /rang zhabrul rtsa ba chod pa'i legs/ /a khu mkhas mkhas bsogs la mkhas/ /ja ṭaṃ skud ras 'bru nor sogs / mchod da sgye sgro bka' na'ang / gshin rjer bu lon sod rab med/ / sdug bsngalakhur bo chen po ni/ myong bar nges so ser sna spongs/ /bsogs 'jog ma byed chog shes brten/ /'dod chung ngang nas bsgrub la brtson/ /nga rgyal ma mtho dman sa zungs/ /mdzes lam re hrul bo gyon/ /grogs la ma chags gcig pur rdod/ /thos pa mi shes nyam len rem// bsgom pa bying rmug 'thib las grol/ /sla ba semasakyi gsang ba btsal/ ye shes rjen

par mngon byung nas/ /'du 'dzi bral ba nyams su longs/ /gang shar rang grol don la ltos/ /bde ba'i lam gyis bde gshegs zhal/ /ji bzhin rtog pa'i gdengs thob na/pa'i 'dun ma grub pa'i bzang / bu khyod dal 'byor don dang ldan/ /rgad po bdag gi zhe blo bde/ /dpon slob bsam pa mtha' ru phyin/ /de lugs ma brjed spros pa lags/ldan rdo rje'i phul ba dge/ / a ho/ mi med dzo rnga'i ke'u tshangs/ kun gyi thun mong ma yin/ rnal 'byor dben khrod 'dod pa'i/ /chos mthun sgrub khang de 'o/ byi tshul 'khor /snang / /nang ni sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ /don gyi he ru ka dpal/ /nga rjes slob dang mi bslu/ /dam chig gser gyi thags pas/ bcu gsum bar du 'brel ba'i/ /rong sngags rdoban chung / /nga yi gnas tshul mthong ngam/ gdos po'i bla ma gzhan med/ /mdo rgyud gzhung la ma dris/ /bslab sbyangs ltos pa yongs dben/ /blo bde'i rgad po skyid ya/ /mikun bzang nyi ma/ /don du kun bzang mjal yod/ ming don gnyis ka mthun pa'i/ /kun bzang gter ston 'dra lo/ /dge sa pa gnas lugs don las/ /g.yo ba skad /

༄༅// gda'/ /don brgyud gshis nas rdzogs pas/ /chos sku'i gter ston yin thang / /nges pa lnga la gnas bzhin/ /brda dpe'i dam tshig 'dzin pa'i/ /rig pa'i brgyud pa lhun rdzogs/ /longs sku'i gter ston 'dra ye/ /ma 'gags sprul pa'i dwangs mtshor// sa ler gzigs pa'i brdzur ngoms/ /'brel tshad don ldan mdzad pas/ sprul sku'i gter ston nges 'dra/ /ye rgya kun tu bzang mo'i/ /dgongs pa'i nu zho'i brgyag yod/ /chos sku'i gdul zhing med na/ gab paligater ston los yin/ /dam rgya rnal 'byor dbang mo'i//bde klong bā gar spyod yod/ /longs sku'i gdul zhing med na/ /sbas pa'i gter ston los yin/ /yid rgya gsang gsum zungs 'brel/ /rig lnga'i 'bum sprin 'khyud yod/ /sprul sku'i gdul zhing med na/ /mi rgan nga las che snang / /ka dag dbyar gnas gzhi bzungs/ /snang bzhi'i dbyar mthong mdzad cing / /rig par dbyar khas blang nas/ /ye shes lhung bzed gtsang mar/ /dug lnga cer grol bsod snyoms/ /gzugs sku ma 'dres chos gos/ /chos sku mkha' khyab snam sbyar/ /gang shar rang grol mthing shams/ /zhen med ro mnyam

gdang bar/ /spongs ba zhi lhag zungs 'brel/ /klogs pa sku gsum rtsal sbyangs/ /'gags med sbyin gtong phang med/ /blo bral tshul khrims gtsang ma/ /thugs phrad rjes med bzod chen/ /mnyam rjes zung sbrel brtson 'grus/ /cog bzhag bzhi yi bsam gtan/ /grol tshul drug gi shes rab/ /nub med rtag par spyod yod/ /snang tshad gzugs sku'i bkod pa//zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya/ gnas na nges pa lnga ldan/ longs sku gangs can mtsho yin/ /don du thig le nyag gcig /gzhon nu bum sku'i rgyal srid/ /gsang gsum gcig tu spyod pas/ /gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin lags/ sus kyang mthong thabs mi 'dug /ci bya dmu longs kha cig /gter ston rgyal po'i bkod pa'i/ /rtsal rnamasarang 1nga bsdu ste/ /gdul bya'i lung yul stong par/ /gyur tshe khyod kyis ci bya/ da nas nges gsang rdzogs chen/ /rgyal thabs spyi blugs dbang zhus/ /ston 'khor bum skur spyod pas/ /rten 'brel ma brjed kun rdor//gtum trag gling pas gdams zab/ /dge legs bkra shis g.yang 'khyil/ ༈ zhesagasung lhang gi bu 'khor rnams/ /dal 'byor 'di rnyed par dka' bas chos min 'jig rten gyi

༄༅// bya bas chud zos su ma gtong / /tshe 'di la rtag pa med pas chos brgyad 'chol rnyogs su ma spyod/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal las ma 'das pa'i dus 'dir thar nges pa'i nyams len zhig rem rem/ /rgyu 'bras bslu med 'di gsungs pa la the tshom dang yid gnyis ma byed// skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma yin pas yid ches kyis dad pa mos gus mdzod cig/ 'khor ba rten 'brel tsam yin pas 'gyur med byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di yang nas yang du bskyed cig /bsod nams tshad med pa yang dag pa'i rtogs pa 'byung ba'i gzhi yin pas tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal mchod 'bul la thang lhod ma btang / /tha snyad thams cad ming rkyang btags yod tsam yin pas spros kun bral ba'i lta ba stong nyid 'di kha bshad tsam min par snying nas rtogs mdzod/ /rang byung sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa lag mthil du bkod nas 'dzub khrid mdzad pa 'di yal bar ma dor/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar dang mthun par sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa ri sul du bzung nas gyong lto gos btang gsum la gtad ste gcig pur gar song cha med kyi sgo nas chos min gyi bya

ba sgog gi slad du mi byed pa zhig gyis dang/ /rang snang sku gsum gyi zhing khams gang rung la rgyang thag ces phyir ring ste/ nged cag tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'brel losayod bsam pa'i/ /so nams dkor kha grong chog sprang 'khyar nyug sdom yan mi gtong bar snying thag pa nas rem rem/ ༈ /gling ba bdud 'joms dpa' bo'i bdag rgyud skyongs//ka dag rang ngo 'phrod pa'i snying nor khyed/ /kha rog gcig par dben pa'i ri sul sdod/ /ga red 'chi ba nam 'ong cha mi tshod/ /nga bdag tha mal lus na 'gyod re che/ /ca co'i chosabashad mi 'ong phar la zhog /cha lugs yag po mi sems 'dod chung brten/ /ja dar rgyu rdzas bsags spel ci zhig bya/ /nya mo rgya ru tshud ltar 'chang byed yin/ /da ler rgyal ba gongama'i rnam thar bzhin/ /tha tshig chos pa'i sgrub gnas ri la 'dzin/ /da lta 'chi yang blo lhag med gyur na/ na rgas gang byung sems la bred sngangs med/ /pa khur sang byed gnang sgrub phyibashol balhung / /pha ltos dpon dang re ba'i ci zhig bya/ /ba rnga rang lcags brab nas bsgom sgrubs brtson/ /ma rab khyi gral zer yang dam pa'i lugs/ /tsa ra rtsi bzhin rang mthong mi

༄༅// che bar/ /tsha grangs myong nges dam tshig mi nyams par/ /dza gad snyeng zhugs spyon spyod la sogs dor/ /wa skya ri la bros bzhin dben gnas zung / /zha bo ji bzhinakhyim sal sdod ma che/ /za zi'i myos ltar dkor la yi ma 'byams/ /'a yi blo bstung chos la rtse gcig dril/ /ya rabs gong ma'i mdzad sgol 'byung ba legs/ /ra ltar gyong bo'i rgyuda'adi chos kyi thul/ /la 'ur su dang lta spyod mi bstun par/ ga pho nags gseb gab ltar nges med kyis/ /sa yul nye rang chags sdang chams kyi bskyur/ /ha ha 'khor ba'i chos lazhen ma ga rem/ a lags gtad sa bzhi po mthar 'khyor nas/ /yab mye'i gong ma'i slob tshogs rnams thar bzhin/ /bya btang 'ja' lus 'byung na a la la/ min kyang na dga'a'achi skyid blo bde ba/ /ces kya gal che ma brjed mthar phyin lo/ thugs dam dkyil zhog nus ldan rdo rje'i phul/rlu bya ba mi mang dben pa'i ri la skyid/ /phar ltos dpon med gcig pu blo bde skyid/ tshur ltos g.yog med ngo bsrung mi dgos skyid/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'di 'bral med pa'i

skyid/ /gdam ngag bdud rtsi'i zhe kha brgyag pas skyid/ /mtha' bral lta ba yang dog med pa'i skyid/ /zang thal bsgom blo 'khri zhen bral ba'i skyid//dad pas zhing sa rtogs pas byur bskyid/ /snying rje'i lo 'dab gzhan phan 'bad med skyid/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum skyel ma dag pas skyid/ /sbyin pa yang dag brgyag byed 'dzom pas skyid/ /thos pas rgyud ༄༅//grol zhi ba dul ba skyid/ /bsam pa'i khrel yod dran shes bag ldan skyid/ /'khor bar zhen ldog ngo tsha shes pa skyid/ shes rab sgron ma'i ma rig mun sel skyid/ /rnam smin lus rgyabrag gseb bzhugs na skyid/ /sems nyid yi dam lha skur smin na skyid/ /'dod chung chog shes kyi nas sgog 'tsho skyid/ /dal 'byor don ldan lha chos 'grub na skyid/ /mi rtag rgyudabaskul 'chi chos 'grub na skyid/ /'khor ba spangs nas chos mthar phyin na skyid/ /rgyu 'bras than kha mi brtsi zhus na skyid/ /snang ba bden med sgyu mar rtogs na skyid/ /bdag 'dzinagazhi rtsa thad gar chod na skyid/ /re dwogs 'phrang grol bdud las rnam rgyal skyid/ /shes pa dga' sangs snang ba yangs khrol skyid/ bya ba zin pa'i mi bzhin khung lhod skyid/ /dug lnga

༄༅// 'bur 'jom thugs 'phrad rjes med skyid/ /srid par mi ldog chos nyid mngon sum skyid/ /zhi bar mi zhen nyams snang gong 'phel skyid/ /gnyis med ka dag rigapa tshad pheb skyid/ /gdengs chen bzhi thob chos zad blo 'das skyid/ /'bras bu nang gsal kun bzang rgyal srid skyid/ gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'khor ba dongs sprugs skyid/ skyidapa'i 'dun ma sgrub mdzod mthar phyin legs/ /pha rgan nus ldan dpa' bo'i man ngag zungs/ /sarba maṅga le/43 gleng pa bdud 'joms dpa' bo'i thugs rjes zungasaX bdag rgyud chos dang 'dres par byin gyis rlobs a tse mtshar na mtshar lugs la sgyu lus rgas kyang sems margasaḥ na chung bud med bsten pa deX sems sdug gcig gi rgyu min namaḥ ra ma mgo steng la bkod naX ril mas gdong ba rtsog pa'i dpe bud med mashe ༷martsa rang rgyal na chos pabasgrub la gzhol khoms med da sngon tshar ba zin grub pas kha smras mi gtong ci byar zadaX da ni rang tshug rang gis zungs chos la bar chad med par gyis 'dod chags rang

mtshan ma yin paraḥ 'ju 'dul khams gsum rol bar slobaḥ rang rgyud chos dang 'gal mi rung 'gal na bdud kyis baspus pa yin spyod pa sdig dang 'dres mi rung 'dresan rkyen dbang shor ba yinaḥ nogs mkhon 'thabs rtsod byed mi rung byas na sdug bsngal 'dzad med yin gang byung des chog 'dod chung remasaX 'khor ba bsgrub nas 'grub pa medaḥskyabs gcig bla ma sangs rgyas la mos gus gsol gdab 'di ma brjedaḥ gdam ngag sems kyi bdud rtsi 'di rna rgyab rlung bzhin dor mi rung rang tshug rang gis 'dzin dgos las gzhan dbang gyur na a thang chadaḥ lha o rgyan rje la gsol ba thob thugasayid dbyer med yang yang bsres grogs dbang phyug chen por gsol mchod brtson chos brgyag 'byongs bas gnad de cheX grong chog gto la mi 'byams par lkug pa bzhin tu smra ba sdoms mdze bo bzhin tu sdod tshug gis ri dwags bzhin du ri sul zungs nyi zla lta bu'i nyams len gyisaX gsal 'grib med par mnyam rjes bsres skyid pa'i 'dun ma de yis 'grub sngags pa rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags 'byung rma bya'i dug spyod srog mi phamaḥ bya ba de

༄༅// ltar bsgrub cig ngag phun loḥ nga sngags rgan gyi zhe kha gcol na yang da 'di ltar 'byung na blo re bde blo bde 'grub par mdzod cig sku tshe ringaX nus ldan rdo rjes brtse gtam yinaX sarba maṅga le// 'di phyi'i re ltos spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyanaX gling pa bdud 'joms dpa' bo rtag par skyongs pad+ma'i mngon spyod zhing sar dbang bskur ba'i rong sngags yul gyi bstan pa dar bar shogaḥ bsgrub tshug ri la 'dzin pa'i snying nor bo 'dod chung chog shes brten na bdag blo bde tshe gang dkyus ring skyon gyis ma gos par chos tshug mtha' ru phyin na bdag blo bde dkor dang grong chog gto yas mi 'byams paraḥ bya ba gtang nas sdod na bdag blo bdeX chos min dam nyams mang po brten pa bsaX sgod ldan gcig brgyud bskyang na bdag blo bde dar zab gos kyi rgyan cha mi gda' yangaḥ klog hrul dman spyod bskyang na bdag blo bdeX chos brgyad phyi slong yul gyis mi gcol bar gcig pur dam rgya mdzad na

bdag blo bde nang rkyen nyon mongs mda' lngas mi gcol b.raX tshogs drug rang grol mdzad na bdag blo bdeḥ gsang ba rlung sems las dbang mi 'chor b.raX gang shar rang grol bzhugs na bdag blo bde zab mo'i chos gter gangs seng 'o ma'i rgyunaX skal ldan dpal du 'byed na bdag blo bde khreg chod man ngag chos nyid mngon mthong naḥ seng ges nga ro bsgrags 'bras bdag blo bdeḥ thod rgal snang ba dang po gcer mthong naḥ man ngag 'bras bu mchis pas bdag blo bdeḥ nam 'chi cha med 'chi rkyen nges med pasaḥ da dung pha bu 'phrod na bdag blo bdeX gong po'i yul nas sbas pa'i gsang rgya 'byedaX dpon slob tshom bu 'tshogs na bdag blo bde nyin mtshan yeng med bla mar gsol ba thobaḥ nga dang 'du ༵bral med do bskal ba canaḥ dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin duX bya btang ro snyoms mdzod cig kun rdor lags/ /rtag par 'khrul 'byams nus ldan rdo rjes phulaḥ sarba maṅga

༄༅// gleng ba bdud 'joms dpa' bo'i bdag rgyud de skyong mdzod/ skal ldan bu slob smin par byin gyis rang rlobs shig dal rten chud zos ma byed 'chi chos larems 'tshal/ mi rtag nam 'ong cha med skyo shes la 'bad dgos/ gsar ba sdug bsngal gnas las gtan bde la snyogs ranaX bslab gsum mdzes pa'i brgyan bzang go cha ru bgobazhin/ lung rtogs dam pa'i chos la spongs klog kyang g.yel med/ mi med dben ri zin pa'i bya btang zhig mdzad de lto gos gtam gsum zhen med rlung kha la btang nas/ budabasnyegs thob gsum 'bad pa'i dam pa tshos rjes slobs/ sang byed gnang sgrub lta bu'i byi shol de bstung la/ khe grags sngon rtsol gtan bde rjes 'jog de min par/ da nas shi lathugs par bsgom sgrub la 'bad nasaḥ skyabs gcig dpal 31 rgyan bla ma spyi bor ru bsnyen bzhin/ gsol gdab dbang len thugs yid dbyer med kyi ngang nas/ gnyugs masems kyi rdo rje rjen pa ru skyongs 'tshal/ bzhocha gsum dang bral ba'i zang thal gyi shes rig byar med blo 'das ngang la cham bzhag re mdzad nas/ rnam shes yid shes yid kyi rten

phur thad grol la byung zhing / snang ba phyi ru ma lus yul med la thal thal/ shes pa nang du ma lus phyams brdal la sangs nas/ thugs 'phrad rjes med las dang rnam smin rgyon grolade/ grol lugs bzhi yis dgongs pa'i btsan sa rang zin par/mnyamarjes nyin mtshan dbyer med 'od gsal la deng shing / rig pa sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gyi rgyal srid/ jibazhin mngon gyur nang gsal chos sku ru pheb pa'i/ pha rgan skyabs gcig bla ma'i man ngag la gzhol nas/ 'jigs rten bya ba btang nas dbyer med du bzhugs la/ rtog rtog dpyodadapyod grub mtha'i blo 'og tu ma shor/ ma bcos gsum gyi don rtags 'chang bzhin tu bzhugs nas/ sku gsum nyams len byed pa'i rnal 'byor de'i skyid pa/ nus ldan rdo rje'i bu chunganam mkha' bzang khyed laḥ brtse ba'i snying gtam phul lo thugs nyams su bzhes 'tshal/ sarba maṅga le/

༄༅// skyabs mgon bla ma'i thugs rje zung / /bu'i snang sems grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gir blta ba'i 'ching rgya 'di/ /thad gar sangs dgos snying gtam yin/ /dmigs pa yul gyi blo can de/ /zang thal byed dgos bltar med lta ba'i rang ngo skyongs/ /ched 'dzin grol dgos rang bab gnyug ma'i shes rig yang / /mi bsgom rang bzhag snying blo dang yid dang rnam shes sprin/ /mkha' la sangs dgos shes rab rig pa ye shes zhal/ /chos sku sad dgos ka dag mkha' la rig pa 'phrad/ /rnam smin las grol 'od gsal klong la ye shes 'phrad/ dug lnga rang grol thugs rjes dbyings la shes rab 'phrad/ ma rig rdul bral nyams len chu bo'i rgyun ltar la/ byang 'thib sangs dgos bzhag thabs byis pa nyal chog la/ rtsis gdab bral kud yangs nam mkha' rnal 'byor la/ had rmug grol dgos spyod lam rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la/ bla ma bsgom dgos shes sa bzhi yi dam tshig zungs/ thugs yid bsre dgos rtogs pa'i yon tan 'phel ba la/ gu ru bsnyen pa snying gtam na so cung zad rgud zin pas/ nang don bsgom pa phun

tshogs lnga ldan skyabs mgon drung / re ltos 'cha' ba rang snang ye shes dkyil 'khor nyid/ ji bzhin skyongs dgos gar 'dug snang ba yangs mor bzhugs/ nyams kun grol dgos su 'grogs shes pa dga' bde byos/ 'dzin zhen chod dgos khrag chod lta ba'i rtsal rgyas tshe/ /thod rgal bsgom dgos snyigs dus tshe thung rkyen mang bas/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa snying gtam 'chi kha tha mal mi lus par/ grol ba thob dgos kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal klong/ btsan sa zin dgos snying pha rgan kun nyi'i brtse gtam 'di/ /slob bu 'brug dar thugs la zhog sarba maṅga le/༈ skyabs kun dngos bdud 'joms gling par 'dud/ dus rtag par bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /khyod dal 'byor mi lus thob pa de/ /rkyen sgyu ma'i basmu dbang ma gtong zhig /tshe mi rtag nam 'chi cha med pas/ blo nang bstung dam pa'i chos la 'bong / /gnas 'gro drug gar skye sdug bsngal gzeb/ dus 'di ru thar nges bsam spyod skyongs/ /las rgyu

༄༅// 'bras bslu med rgyal ba'i bka'/ 'dir yid ches gdengs bskyed blang dor rems/ /skyabs bslu med dkon mchog rin chen dgu/ /dus nam yang brjed med blo phug gtod/ /ma mkha' khyab 'gro 'dren byang chub sems/ phyogs ris med brdal khyab yongs la bsgom/ /tshoṭa bsags spel yon tan 'khrungs ba'i zhing / da so nam g.yel med brtson pas sgrub/ /skyabs kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma mchog /tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi rgyan du 'chong / /da mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog dang / /thugs khrel med gsum pa mthar phyinarems/ gzhi lta ba ka dag chos sku'i dbyings/ /lam lhun grub rig pa 'od gsal ngang // grogs spyod pas gol shor nor 'phrang bsal/ /gdeng rtsal rdzogs 'bras bu tshe 'dir rems// de sems la zungs shig kun je ba/ /kho rgyal khams sprang 'khyams kun nyis phul/ maṅga le / ༈ skyabs gcig 'khor lo'i rgyan bzhugs bdud 'joms gling / /dad brgya'i lha rtse mchod kyis thugs rjes zungs/ rang lugs o rgyan pad+ma'i zab gsang la/ /spyod pa'i skal ldan pho mo dgyes par gson/ /dal 'byor mi rtag shing kha'i bye'u 'dra/ /'chi

bdag bdud po'i nam gshogs cha mi chod/ blo sna nang bstung dam pa'i chos la gzhol/ snang ba sgyu ma mkhan 'di brid la mkhas/ rnam rtog byis pa'i tshogs ni rkyen khar 'chor/ /yeng ma lam la mi tshe zad dog yod/ snying po med pa'i don la rtsal sbyangs rem/ /blo sna mang bas mdo don gcig mi 'grub/ /'jig rten bya ba btang nas byar med sdod/ mdze bo bzhin dumi yi gral nas bud/ dam pa'i zhabs la gtug pa ya rabs lugs/ da sngon 'khor ba'i chos kyis bsgrus bslus nas/ grub zin rmed pa'i bya ba rbad chod kyis/ gnyen dang nye 'brela'akhris gdung thag pa chod/ sngon 'gro chos bcus rgyud sbyangs ngo mtshar che/ /kha ni mi dge'i bang mdzod smra ba sdom/ /sems ni nyon mongs dug tshangs 'khrul rgyun chod/ /lus ni 'gro bskyod ma rgod sdod tshug zungs/ /sgo gsum bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di la rem/ /rang rtsal bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dgongs pa ni/ /bla ma'i drin las sus kyang mthong ba med/ /bka' drin gzhal byar mi 'os rdo rje 'chang / spyod lam rnam bzhir bsnyen sgrub gsol ba thob/ thugs yid gcig 'dres nyid la nan chags mdzod/ sgro 'dogs ma chod 'dri ba da lta gyis/

༄༅// lta ba kha la ma 'byams rgyud la gzhol/ chos kyi sgrub mtha' shi ba'i dus la gtug phu thag chod pa chos nyid zad sar skyol/ ma mthong rgyang grags che ba'i rdzogasapa che/ rtog 'dod zhe rtsa bos kyang don la med/ 'ur mo khyu gshogs lta bu'i rang mthong gis/ 'chi ba thogs tu bab tshe mtshang re 'bud/ snang stong zung 'jug mtha' bral nam mkha'iklong / sgolngabangasagasal 'gags med mnyam par brdal/ yid kyi 'dzin rtog ma zhugs shes rig gsal/ phyinang bar med zang thal yin skad do/ rnam rtog rtsal du yan gyi dgagasgrubs med/ yul dbang shes gsum thugs 'phrad rjes med grol/ / yul shes thug 'phrad rtog med zang thal klong / shes pa thug 'phrad thun gogs rig par sad/ /nang gsal thimal ma smug shes pa 'di/ ye shes yin no yid kyi shes pa sangs/ /chos sku yin te kun gzhi'i rmongs g.ya' grol/ rig pa yin gyi sems kyi dmigs gtad bor/ shes rab yin no sgo lngalas rlung dwangs/ chos nyid rang khar yan pas sang re yangs/ mabacos rang gsal 'dug pas ngang re bde/ zang thal bar med legs pa'i skyid re che/ gcig shes kun grol yin pas

a re spro/ /bsal bzhag rtsol sgrub bral bas kud re yangs/ mkha' mnyam nam mkha' mdzod la long re spyod/ ye shes sgyu 'phrul mdzad phrin rgya re che/ /chos sku g.yo ba med pas ka re dag /gzugs sku 'gags pa med pas thugs rje che/ /'og ma'i lam la mi rig rig pa'i gnad/ /khyad chos de gar 'dug na rang lugs yin/ khres pas shes pa sems kyi sems la blta/ /rtog med rmun po mi rtog gol sgrib can/ shesarab phyi gdangasaskyongs ba phal cher lugs/ /rang lug don la gnam sa tsam du khyad/ tshogs smon 'phro 'dzoms so nag sgom gra ba/ /skye bo dman la rtog pa mchog rtsol khyu/ /gang zhig bla ma dam pa'i rjes zin rnams/ /'phrad 'dod skoms pa'i gdung nas chu snyogs kyang / /gnasadusarkyen dbang du ma'i bshol nayangs/ /nam zhig rang snang dag pa dpal gyis rir/ /rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pad 'byung drung / /tshom bu gcig tu 'bod pas rten 'brel zhu/ /zhes mdo khams tsa ri ṭa'i gnas mdun nas gter chen yab sras gdung tsha kun gyi nang nas tha chad nus ldan rdo rje 'am kun bzang nyi mar 'bod pa des thun gseng du shar mar spel nas phul ba dge legs/

༄༅// /pha mtshan ldan bla'i thugs rjes skyongs/ /blo sna dam pa'i chos la drongs/ /bde ba'i me tog 'dab rgyas kyang / /kheng sems bor dgos nu mo skyid/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos yin pas/ /mir 'dzin grol dgos nu mo skyid/ /bde stong gsal ba sngags kyi lam/ yid ches thob dgos dam chos 'phrad pa da res tsam/ /snying po lon dgos mi rtag mi bstan sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ zhen pa chod dgos nagor ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin la/ zhen log bskyed dgos bslu med dkon mchog rin po che/ /skyabs su khur dgos theg chen rtsa ba byang chub sems/ 'di la brten dgos tshogs gnyis bre kha ga bas phyir/ bsags sbyang spel dgos nu mo skyid/ kun 'dus nor bu lugs bsngags pa/ bla rnam sgom dgos thugs yid dbyer med gcig bsres nas/ mnyam bzhag bya dgos ma bsgom sangs rgyas 'pho ba'i lung / sbyangs pa thon dgos /byams dang snying dze+elhag bsam gyis/'gro phan bsgrub dgos /tshe rabs theg chen dam chos dang / /'phrad smon rem zhig dpal ri mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus su/ /'dun pa zhog cig nu rang sems stong gsal brjod

༄༅// /rang sems sangs rgyas zhal ston bla ma la/ khyed shes dad pa drag po'i phyag bgyipo/ tshe rabs las dbang gis bskyed bde sdug nyams/ chu bos gzhung ltar 'byungagyi dgag sgrubs med/ sems kyi sems la blta ba'i 'dzan stangs des/ ngar 'dzin bslang bas bde sdug ya ma zungs/ las rlung rta la zhon pa'i zhakhrul blo yis/ rnam shes mda' lnga'i rjes 'brang bdud dbang 'chor/ /chos sku rang la bzhugs pa'i zhal ma 'tshos/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes lam byed thugs rgya chung / /sla ba'i yid ches dka' ba sems kyi gsab //bla ma'i man ngag mthu yis mthong ba de/ /hrig ger rig pa rang byung ye shes lags/ /dal gyis shar ba gdod ma'i ye gad sa skyongs/ khams gsum yongs grol dgongs pa'i btsan sa zungs/ srid gsum ka dag lta ba'i rdzong zin bya/ blo bral rig pa sgom pa'i 'phrang bsal nas/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan sgog grub nas/ /'khrul snang ban bun shes rab rlung gis gtor/ bde rtsub nyams kun rang zhig rang yal 'gro/ /mi med ri la sgrubs pa'i rgya mtshan tshug /kha tsam min par chos brgyad mgo snyoms thongs/ /lto gos rgyab zas gang byung

des chog mdzod/ smra ba sdom la nyon mongs 'bur 'joms kyis/ /bzung ba yul gyi ma bslu zhen 'dzin chod/ /'dzin pa sems kyi ma 'ching shar grol thong / /bya ba brtags nas kyisal dran ma mangs/ /spyod pa sdig dang ma 'dres bud med spongs/ /chags sdang pham rgyal ma rtsod shongs yangs bskyed/ dga' dga' sdug sdug rtog tshogs rjes ma ded/ /bla ma sangasargyas ma brjed gsol ba thob/ gdam ngag bdud rtsi ma ral dang du longs/ /lta ba kha la ma 'byams sdom shes kyis/ /sgom pa 'ud gog ma byed zangs thal skyongs/ /spyod lam rnamabazhi chos dang 'dres nges kyis/ /da ni nam 'chi cha med 'di la soms/ /cis kyang dgos med byi mar 'gro chas bsgrigs/ /dal rten don ldan bya dgos snying gtams yin/ /rdo rjernam rgyal sems la de tshul 'chongs/ /nus ldan rdo rjes brtse bas rgyang glu yin/ /nam yang thugs la zhog shig sa ma yā/ sarba maṅga le/
